jobs.title: Account Manager - Life Sciences
jobs.description:
We are seeking a strategic **Account Manager - Life Sciences** to drive client success, growth and satisfaction across key accounts, with a strong emphasis on Pharma, Biotech and MedTech clients. Acting as a trusted advisor and engagement architect, you will partner with clients, internal teams and senior leadership to shape account strategies, oversee delivery excellence and ensure long-term business growth. This role demands a strong blend of business acumen, delivery oversight, domain expertise in Life Sciences and leadership — ideal for a results-driven professional who thrives at the intersection of technology, business and customer experience.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Act as the primary Account Manager, collaborating closely with clients, internal teams, BU Heads and Sales Leads
* Align with senior Account Management leadership to co-develop and execute account plans for growth, delivery excellence and client satisfaction
* Serve as the engagement architect, defining account strategies and positioning EPAM for success across the Life Sciences value chain (R&D, Clinical, Regulatory, Commercial and Patient Engagement)
* Build and nurture trusted relationships with senior-level client stakeholders and internal executives
* Support clients as a product owner, helping shape product vision, roadmaps and compelling customer value propositions
* Drive revenue growth across assigned accounts and support company financial objectives by achieving revenue and profit targets
* Expand EPAM's footprint within Life Sciences accounts, driving opportunities across digital transformation, data & analytics, clinical platforms, regulatory systems and commercial solutions
* Lead sales/pre-sales activities including opportunity assessments, RFP responses, proposal creation and client presentations
* Demonstrate services through in-person or virtual client sessions and maintain a monthly pipeline, tracking progress and reporting key metrics to leadership
* Partner with program/project management to ensure successful delivery through an integrated delivery model
* Shape and scope engagement models, pricing and delivery strategies aligned to Life Sciences compliance and regulatory requirements
* Ensure smooth transitions from sales to delivery, maintaining accountability for client outcomes and satisfaction
* Monitor performance metrics across large-scale accounts and ensure alignment with business goals
* Stay abreast of market trends, emerging technologies and industry challenges across Life Sciences such as digital health, real-world evidence and pharmacovigilance
* Serve as an expert consultant guiding business transformation, product strategy and innovation initiatives for Life Sciences clients

**Requirements**

* 18+ years of experience in account management with large enterprise accounts
* Proven record of achieving and exceeding sales and revenue goals
* Expertise in the Pharma, Biotech and MedTech ecosystem including clinical trials, regulatory compliance and pharmacovigilance
* Knowledge of commercial operations and patient-centric solutions
* Understanding of technology platforms, digital transformation and IT services within Life Sciences and healthcare ecosystems
* Capability to operate at both strategic and tactical levels to deliver client and business success
* Skills in team leadership, performance management and cross-functional collaboration
* Proficiency in presentation, negotiation and relationship-building with senior stakeholders
* Competency in problem-solving, critical thinking and solution design

jobs.description:

Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

We are a **Process Intelligence platform company** that uses industry-leading process mining technology and AI to present companies with a living digital twin of their end-to-end processes.

**Process mining i**s a technology model that shows how the business runs, visibility into where value is hiding, and the ability to capture it. For more details refer our website : https://careers.celonis.com/join-us/open-positions?groupedLocation=Bangalore%2C+India

We are a high performing team, and India is one of our key growth markets.

  

**Key Skill Set:** Business Process Re-engineering / Business Processing Intelligence / Business Transformation Processing/ Process Mining / Task Mining, Gen AI (LLM/RAG), AI Automation

  

**Must to have :** Python & SQL  **coding**

  

**Functional / Domain /Vertical Any:** Energy/ Mining/ Metal indudtry / Consumer Goods / Supply Chain/ Retail/ BFSI/Logistics/ Oil and Gas / Manufacturing

**Strong Presentation / Demonstration skills / Client Facing / pre sales / consulting**

  

**Location :** Bangalore - Hybrid

  

**Job Title :** Applied Value Engineer / Senior Applied Value Engineer/ Lead Applied Value Engineer based on competency

  

**Role Description**

* As an **Applied Value Engineer,** you are pushing the envelope in solving business-critical problems for our customers. You will be working with our most strategic customers, understanding their objectives and key challenges, and building Celonis solutions using the worlds leading **Process Intelligence (PI) platform** in combination with the **largest AI and ML technology partners, s**uch as Microsoft, OpenAI and Databricks. With Celonis Process Intelligence (PI) platform we feed operational context to AI so it understands our customers business and enables them to industrialize AI unlocking **real ROI on AI deployments** and at scale. There is no AI without PI. You will prototype these solutions, **demonstrate their value to Executives** and ensure successful implementation, adoption and value realization in order to increase the footprint of **Celonis** at those customers.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **AI Discovery & Solutioning: Understand customers AI strategy and business critical challenges.** As Celonis product & domain expert, find the **best problem-solution fit a**nd translate customer requirements into innovative solutions that move the needle
* **Hackathons & Prototyping:** Think out of the box, have a can-do attitude and dont shy away from **complex problems. L**everage cutting edge AI technologies to rapidly build creative prototypes in customer hackathons solving business critical problems
* **Agentic Process Transformation:**Support our customers in achieving **real ROI out of AI deployments** at scale enabling a fundamental shift in business operations from traditional, rule-based automation to the use of autonomous AI agents **empowered by our Celonis Process Intelligence Platform**
* **Proof projects:** End-to-end execution of business-**critical Proof-of-Value projects, incl. architecture and deliver** secure, scalable **LLM/agent systems with RAG,** tools, and guardrails; integrating with enterprise data, identity, and compliance frameworks.
* **Ensure Successful Project Outcome:** Applied AI Engineers stay involved with projects until agreed value & adoption thresholds are reached
* **Specialize in Domains or Industries:** To scale knowledge across the organization Applied AI Engineers specialize in domains (e.g. supply chain) and industries

**Requirements:**

* **6+ years to 15 Yrs of experience l**eading technical **pre-sales,** including defining AI roadmaps, building compelling **ROI/TCO business cases** and prototyping of machine learning and generative AI solutions.
* Experience in Consumer-Packaged Goods/ Retail /Supply Chain/ Logistics / BFSI ) industry is must.
* Understanding of generative AI techniques like RAG, few shot learning, prompt engineering, multi-agent orchestration, multimodal understanding, or fine-tuning that are used to build high-impact use cases like intelligent chatbots and automated text processors.
* Understanding of **business processes across sectors** (such as Supply Chain or Finance) with the ability to translate high-level business needs into specific AI use cases.
* Good knowledge of **Python and common ML libraries** (such as LangChain, pandas, pydantic, sklearn, PyTorch) as well as data engineering tools and technologies.
* **Strong presentation skills** to both internal and external stakeholders (including executives), whether whiteboarding sessions or formal readouts and demos.
* Bachelors Degree required, Masters Degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or related fields, or equivalent work experience preferred.

**Nice to have (big plus):**

* Hands-on experience building agentic systems using LLM orchestration, RAG, function calling, and prompt engineering, while ensuring safety through rigorous evaluations and guardrails.
* Working knowledge of tools in the LLM ecosystem such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or other OSS packages.
* Experience in deploying and monitoring models at scale across major cloud platforms (AWS Bedrock, Azure AI, GCP Vertex)

  

**The Value Engineering (VE) Organization**

* **Purpose & Impact:** Value Engineering is a central, customer-facing function within Celonis that impacts Go-To-Market (GTM), customer adoption, and product innovation.
* **What Value Engineers Do:**

+ **AI Discovery & Solutioning:** Partner directly with enterprise customers to translate business needs and process bottlenecks into high-impact AI and process-mining use cases.
+ **Rapid Prototyping & Proof-of-Value (PoV):** Build custom analyses, executive dashboards, and end-to-end PoV prototypes (incorporating Python, ML, RAG, and AI agents) during pre-sales and customer hackathons.

Thanks & Regards,

Talent Acquisition Team Bangalore-India

jobs.title: Digital Lead
jobs.description:
Titan Eye+ is one of India's largest optical retail chains, with a sharpened brand platform, *Your World In Focus*, and an ambition to grow faster and stand out more clearly in a competitive category.  
The Brand Head brings brand building and demand generation under one leader. You will make sure the big brand story, the neighbourhood-level marketing and the daily social presence all pull in the same direction, and that every rupee spent can be traced to brand or business impact. You will lead a team of brand and social managers, set the bar for creative and for the numbers, and act as the brand's voice with leadership and agencies.  
Key responsibilities  
**Brand strategy and communication**  
 Own the brand strategy, annual brand plan and communication calendar, anchored in *Your World In Focus*  
 Lead 360 campaigns across TV, digital, OOH, print, PR and retail, from insight to launch  
 Drive launch communication for collections, lens innovations, partnerships and eyecare services  
¢ Manage brand films, celebrity and athlete associations, and key brand partnerships  
¢ Keep brand voice, identity and positioning consistent and distinct against competition  
**Hyperlocal, BTL and digital demand**  
¢ Set the digital-first local marketing strategy that drives footfall, eye-test bookings and conversions for every store  
¢ Oversee geo-targeted performance media, Google Business Profiles, WhatsApp and CRM programmes  
¢ Guide BTL and activation calendars and the new-store launch playbook  
¢ Balance brand and performance spend so the brand grows while stores hit their numbers  
**Social media and content**  
¢ Own the social strategy across Instagram, YouTube, Facebook and emerging platforms  
¢ Build an always-on content engine: reels, short video, creators and community, at speed and scale  
¢ Lead influencer and creator programmes, from national names to local creators  
¢ Monitor social listening and online reputation; respond fast to trends and issues  
**Measurement and budget**  
¢ Own the overall brand, local and social budget and its return  
¢ Track brand health (awareness, consideration, preference) alongside CAC, ROAS, cost per walk-in and conversion  
¢ Build clear dashboards and present brand and marketing performance to the leadership  
**Team and agencies**  
¢ Lead, coach and grow the Brand Managers and social team; set clear goals and high standards  
¢ Manage creative, media, digital, social, PR and BTL agencies; raise the quality and speed of their work  
¢ Work closely with Product, Sales, Retail Ops and VM so brand plans land in stores  
What success looks like in 12 months  
¢ One integrated brand, local and social plan running on a single calendar  
¢ Measurable gains in brand awareness and consideration in priority markets  
¢ Lower cost per walk-in and better CAC across the store network  
¢ A faster, sharper social presence with clear growth in engagement, reach and followers  
¢ A stronger team: Brand Managers and social team with clear goals, hitting them  
¢ Leadership seeing a clear link between marketing spend, brand health and store sales  
Candidate profile  
**Must-haves**  
¢ MBA / PGDM in Marketing from a Tier-1 B-school (IIMs, ISB, XLRI, FMS, MDI, SP Jain or equivalent)  
¢ 1014 years in brand management and marketing, with at least 34 years leading a team  
¢ Background at Lenskart, a leading FMCG company, or a large consumer retail / D2C brand  
¢ Proven record of building brands through high-impact 360 campaigns  
¢ Digital-first thinking, with hands-on depth in performance, social and local marketing  
¢ Strong in both creative judgement and the maths of marketing: brand tracking, funnels, CAC, ROAS and budget allocation  
¢ Experience managing large budgets and multiple agencies  
¢ Confident presenting to and influencing the MD and senior leadership  
**Good to have**  
¢ Experience with store-network or omnichannel retail marketing  
¢ Track record of brand repositioning or a major relaunch  
¢ Exposure to celebrity, sports or creator-led campaigns at scale  
¢ Experience in eyewear, optical, healthcare or a high-involvement category

jobs.title: Operations Head - Lending
jobs.description:
Leading fintech lending company is looking for a Head of Operations to establish, manage and scale end-to-end operations for its short-term, small-ticket unsecured digital lending business. You will work closely with the founders and NBFC partners to build efficient processes across onboarding, underwriting coordination, disbursement, repayment, collections, compliance and customer support.

  

Job Location: Bangalore

  

**Role & responsibilities**

  

- Manage end-to-end lending operations for short-term, small-ticket unsecured loans, including customer onboarding, KYC verification, loan processing, disbursement and repayment management

- Oversee collections and recovery, including early-bucket collections, roll-rate tracking, delinquency management and fair recovery practices

- Manage underwriting operations in coordination with the NBFC partner and ensure adherence to credit policies

- Ensure compliance with RBI Digital Lending Directions, including Key Fact Statement (KFS), APR disclosure, cooling-off period and grievance redressal mechanisms

- Coordinate and manage technology and service vendors, including Loan Origination Systems (LOS) and Loan Management Systems (LMS)

- Handle operational reporting, reconciliation and coordination with the NBFC partner

- Monitor operational performance, portfolio quality, collection efficiency and key lending metrics

- Build, streamline and implement operational processes, policies and workflows in a high-growth, early-stage environment

- Recruit, lead and develop operations, collections and customer support teams

- Work closely with founders, technology, credit, collections and external partners to ensure smooth execution and business scalability

  

**Preferred candidate profile**

  

- 8+ years of experience in NBFC, fintech or digital lending operations

- Mandatory: hands-on experience in payday loans / short-term app-based personal loans (salary advance, instant loans, small-ticket unsecured lending)

- Good understanding of APR structures, loan pricing and fee disclosure

- Hands-on experience managing onboarding, KYC, disbursement, repayment and collections

- Proven experience in collections and recovery, including delinquency buckets, roll rates and NPA management

- Working knowledge of RBI Digital Lending Directions and LSP-NBFC operating models

- Experience working with LOS/LMS platforms and lending technology partners

- Demonstrated ability to build processes, manage teams and scale operations in a startup or high-growth environment

- Strong leadership, analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills

- Graduate in any discipline (MBA/PGDM preferred)

jobs.title: Senior Associate Finance
jobs.description:
**Senior Associate Finance****Who We Are?**

**We're GrowthSchool. And we built Outskill.**

GrowthSchool started with one belief: you learn a skill fastest from the person actually doing it. So we partnered with the top 1% of instructors to build high-impact, cohort-based courses in personal and professional growth for learners around the world, and used AI to make that learning personal at a scale a classroom never could.

Then AI changed what **upskilling** even means. Roles started getting rewritten faster than curriculums could keep up, and the real divide stopped being skilled versus unskilled. It became AI-ready versus not.

So, we built **Outskill**, our AI education arm, to close that gap practical, implementation-first AI training for professionals, teams and enterprises. Today, GrowthSchool and Outskill have reached **16M+ learners across 160+ countries**, with programs running everywhere from individual upskilling to enterprise AI transformation.

**Our mission: Make 100 million people AI-ready by 2028.**

**What that actually feels like day to day:** We're 300+ people, backed by Sequoia, moving at a speed that surprises most people who join us. Products ship in weeks, not quarters. There's no thick layer of process between an idea and it going live. You'll own things visibly bigger than your title. Some experiments will fail publicly, and we'll talk about them openly on Monday.

If you need a finished playbook before you start, this will be uncomfortable. If you'd rather write the playbook, you'll like it here.

**Why This Role Exists**

As GrowthSchool continues to scale, our finance function needs strong execution at the operational level to ensure that everyday accounting, payments, reconciliations and compliance activities run smoothly.

We're looking for a **Senior Associate Finance** who can independently manage day-to-day accounting and finance operations, maintain accurate financial records, support audits and ensure timely execution of recurring finance activities.

This is a hands-on role where you'll take ownership of the operational backbone of our finance function ensuring accuracy, discipline and reliability across financial transactions and administrative processes.

You'll work closely with the Finance team and internal stakeholders to build structured processes that can support the company's growing business operations.

**What You'll Do**Day-to-Day Accounting & Finance Operations

* Record and maintain daily financial transactions accurately in the accounting system.
* Manage accounts payable and receivable, including invoice processing, payment tracking and follow-ups.
* Perform regular bank, vendor and ledger reconciliations.
* Manage employee reimbursements, expense claims and related documentation.
* Support monthly and year-end book closure activities.
* Maintain organized financial records, vouchers, invoices and supporting documents.
* Identify discrepancies in financial transactions and ensure timely resolution.

Statutory Compliance & Audit Support

* Assist with GST, TDS and other applicable statutory filings and returns.
* Prepare and share financial data, reconciliations and schedules required for statutory, tax and internal audits.
* Coordinate with auditors, vendors and internal teams for audit-related requirements.
* Support the finance team in meeting regulatory and compliance deadlines.
* Maintain proper documentation and records for compliance and audit purposes.
* Ensure financial information and supporting documents are readily available whenever required.

Asset Management & Administrative Operations

* Conduct periodic physical verification of company assets.
* Maintain and update the fixed asset register.
* Track asset additions, transfers, disposals and related documentation.
* Coordinate with vendors and internal teams for day-to-day finance and operational requirements.
* Handle documentation, filing and record-keeping for the finance function.
* Support miscellaneous administrative activities required to keep finance operations running smoothly.

Process Discipline & Operational Excellence

* Follow established accounting processes and ensure accuracy in daily execution.
* Maintain timely updates across payments, receivables and reconciliations.
* Identify operational gaps and suggest improvements in existing finance workflows.
* Ensure recurring finance activities are completed within defined timelines.
* Maintain strong documentation and process discipline across all assigned responsibilities.

What Success Looks Like (First 612 Months)

* Daily accounting is accurate, timely and error-free.
* Payments, receivables and reconciliations are processed on schedule without backlogs.
* Statutory and compliance data is always ready ahead of deadlines.
* Audits are supported smoothly with well-organized documentation.
* Fixed asset records are accurate and physical verification is completed on time.
* Financial records, vouchers and supporting documents are properly maintained.
* Finance operations run reliably with strong process discipline and accountability.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a **detail-oriented and execution-focused finance professional** who takes ownership of day-to-day accounting operations and understands the importance of accuracy, consistency and timely execution.

The ideal candidate combines **strong accounting fundamentals, hands-on experience with accounting systems, compliance knowledge and operational discipline.**

Must-Have

* **B.Com / CA Inter / CMA Inter** qualification.
* **Up to 3 years of experience** in accounting and finance operations, preferably in an industry environment.
* Hands-on experience managing daily accounting transactions and maintaining books of accounts.
* Working knowledge of accounts payable, accounts receivable, invoice processing and payment management.
* Experience in bank, vendor and ledger reconciliations.
* Hands-on experience with accounting software such as **Tally, Zoho Books or similar platforms**.
* Strong working knowledge of **MS Excel**.
* Working knowledge of GST, TDS and other applicable statutory compliance requirements.
* Experience supporting statutory, tax and internal audits.
* Experience managing employee reimbursements, expense claims and financial documentation.
* Understanding of fixed asset management and asset register maintenance.
* Strong attention to detail, accuracy and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage recurring tasks independently and meet deadlines.
* Strong ownership, accountability and follow-through.

Good-to-Have

* Experience working in **startups or high-growth organizations**.
* Exposure to **AI, EdTech, SaaS or B2B technology companies**.
* Experience managing finance operations across multiple business entities.
* Familiarity with finance automation tools and digital accounting workflows.
* Knowledge of advanced Excel functions and financial reporting.
* Experience improving accounting processes and operational workflows.
* Ability to leverage technology to improve finance operations and reporting efficiency.

What We're Evaluating

We're less interested in how many years you've worked and more interested in how much ownership you've demonstrated.

We'll be looking for evidence of:

* Ownership of day-to-day accounting and operational accuracy.
* Strong understanding of core accounting principles and processes.
* Reliability in managing recurring tasks, reconciliations and compliance data.
* High attention to detail with strong process discipline.
* Ability to identify discrepancies and resolve issues independently.
* Bias toward execution, accountability and follow-through.
* Ability to thrive in lean, fast-moving environments.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to build the finance foundations of one of India's fastest-growing learning companies.
* Direct exposure to Finance leadership and business operations.
* High ownership from Day 1 with real responsibility for finance oper

**Job Title: Snr Product manager - Customer Platforms**

* Wealth and Personal Banking serves millions of customers worldwide with a complete range of banking and wealth management services to enable them to manage their finances and build their financial futures. It is a global business that brings together management responsibility for Retail Banking, Wealth Management, Insurance and Asset Management with a focus on customer-centric propositions and innovative distribution channels.
* As the Product Manager - VOC Platforms, you will act as a product owner and expert for our VOC platforms. You will manage and govern the development and utilisation of the platforms such as Medallia and MMX (complaints platfrom). You will support over 15 markets and currently 6000 global platform users with a view to increase utilisation in near future. You will ensure the platforms deliver value to the business and are used effectively. You will work closely with CX specialists and other platform users to understand and deliver their business needs through the platform capabilities. You will manage the relationship with platform suppliers to maximise value to IWPB by driving the implementation and adoption of new functionality and ensuring the rapid and effective response to our required fixes and CRs.

**In This Role, You Will**

* Manage the full product lifecycle to ensure that, over time, the needs of the platform users continue to be met
* As platform SME, work closely with Technology, Transformation, D&A and market teams to ensure the VOC platforms change agenda is delivered on time and in budget. Be hands-on and remove delivery blockers through appropriate action and escalation
* Operationalise the voice of the customer platform at its full potential across users, securing ROI and value to business and customers

**Platform management (BAU)**

* Manage the integrity of the platforms and all aspects of the of business-as-usual platform operation
* Improve platform functionality, eg. Text Analytics evolution, Topic creation, AI, rules, process, triggers, surveys
* Monitor the performance of the platform to optimise value to the local and global change agenda
* Ensure platforms updates are implemented, assessed and used
* Contribute to achievement of objectives and key results across the VOC Product and use data to inform prioritisation and decision making. Maintain a focus on ROI to ensure priorities align to areas of greatest impact
* Create and manage a standard process and ways of working to respond to requests for changes
* Own the global operationalisation of the customer platforms (e.g. Medallia; Complaints platform)
* Provide status reporting regarding project milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks and issues
* Communicate and align with multiple stakeholders across organizational levels and locations
* Work creatively and solution-focused, demonstrating collaboration, innovation, and excellence
* Establish gaps in platform utilisation and opportunities to create value to business from the platform capabilities
* Own the management of training, support materials, product enquiries. Develop and report utilisation KPIs
* Own, deliver and report on a program plan to meet HSBC’s needs, maximise value from the customer platforms and maintain the functional and security integrity
* 3rd party supplier management

**Platform development (transformation)**

* Manage the pipeline of new capabilities, improvements, fixes, and requests from VOC platforms’ users
* Prioritise product requirements and own the product backlog; coordinate pilots/launches/training
* Keep up with trends and emerging business models, reimagining how to generate value to the business/customers
* Work with platform suppliers to influence their development plans, derive value from updates and ensure speedy satisfactory resolution of HSBC requests
* Obsess about how to apply technology and data to solving problems or finding new opportunities

**To Be Successful You Will**

* Previous experience in implementing and configuring customer platforms (e.g. Medallia, complaints platforms)
* Previous experience in creating and managing text analytics rules and topic trees; closed loop alert rules, user roles
* Experience in a global roles, with proven experience in working in a cross functional matrix environment

* Proven ability to build strong relationships across stakeholder groups
* Excellent understanding of the bank’s risk framework and experience of working with second line of defence: legal, compliance, financial crime (AML & sanctions), fraud, risk
* Strong outward focus and grasp of the competitor environment – opportunities, threats, gaps
* Demonstrable resilience and persistence – a ‘can-do’ attitude

jobs.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
****Title And Summary****
Specialist Product Manager
  
  
Senior Product Manager, Business Experimentation & Optimization
  
  
Who is Mastercard?
  
  
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
  
  
Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
  
  
**Overview**
The Services team is a key differentiator for Mastercard, providing cutting-edge products and services that help our customers. Focused on thinking big and scaling quickly around the globe, this agile team is responsible for end-to-end solutions for a diverse global customer base including issuers, acquirers, and merchants. Centered on data-driven technologies and innovation, these services include payments-focused consulting, loyalty and marketing programs, business experimentation (Test & Learn), and data-driven information and risk management services.
  
  
As a member of the Business Experimentation Product Management team, you will build industry-leading experimentation software which brings sophisticated analytic techniques to businesses and users around the world. We are rapidly building new products, evolving products in the age of AI, and expanding the ways we deliver Test & Learn to our clients. We are looking for AI native PMs who can execute and evolve our product strategy and help us build the AI enhanced version of Test & Learn.
  
  
Role
  
  
Product Manager for Mastercard’s Test & Learn product, an analytic platform used by the world's largest organizations to make multi-million-dollar decisions.
  
  
Develop product strategy derived from user research, market trends, customer pain points, and commercial priorities.
  
  
Translate a deep understanding of our users into an actionable roadmap. Leverage user research, market research, sales/marketing expertise, and usage data to inform priorities.
  
  
Own end-to-end feature development. Identify and prioritize problems, define use cases, design solutions, write requirements, support development and testing, and measure impact to inform future decisions.
  
  
Work as a part of a cross-functional product team to bring ideas to life. Work together with UX designers, engineers, and other product managers to improve our products.
  
  
Unlock the power of AI. Define how and where AI technology enhances the measurement and optimization of business initiatives.
  
  
**All About You**
Can work closely with cross-functional partners like engineers, designers, sales, marketing, and users.
  
  
A quick learner with the ability to multi-task in a team environment, not afraid to ask questions and make decisions. Enthusiastic, effective team member and mentor.
  
  
Broad strategic thinking skills, adept in translating product vision/strategy into an actionable roadmap.
  
  
Creative problem-solver, can balance competing needs and prioritize thoughtfully.
  
  
Strong professional presence. Excellent interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills.
  
  
Experience building with AI or using AI to enhance an existing software application
  
  
5+ years of professional experience in a similar role, or equivalent.

Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security. All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And Therefore, It Is Expected That The Successful Candidate For This Position Must:
  
  
Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
  
  
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
  
  
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
  
  
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:

* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

* Post Graduate
* Work Experience

jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**Overview**

The Business Analyst-Technical plays an important role within RTP International, supporting the definition, prioritisation, and delivery of technology capabilities across our markets.

The role combines technical product management and business analysis responsibilities with ownership of feature and user story definition, as well as active participation in backlog management and quarterly planning ceremonies.

As part of the Technology Backlog Management team, you will work closely with Engineering and other cross-functional teams to support delivery governance through cross-market technology vulnerability and risk reporting and remediation.

**Role Responsibilities**

**Technology Backlog Management**

* Translate technology epics into well-defined
  **features, user stories, use cases and acceptance criteria**
  .
* Maintain feature/user story
  **data quality**
  ensuring they are validated, mapped, and aligned to strategic objectives, with technical dependencies, customer outcomes, and delivery milestones captured.
* Participate in
  **team ceremonies**
  such as daily standups, sprint demo, and retrospective meetings, amongst others.
* Maintain
  **alignment**
  between technical requirements, and product outcomes throughout the feature lifecycle.
* Together with the platform lead, evaluate competing feature requirements and make informed
  **prioritisation and trade-off decisions**
  based on business / technology value, risk, and delivery capacity.
* Continuously track feature development, review product demonstrations against acceptance criteria and drive resolution of requirements or delivery gaps.
* Maintain high-quality
  **feature and technical documentation**
  that supports effective delivery, governance, and self-service.
* Ensure Jira Backlog health is maintained per Mastercard standards and guidelines.

**Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Partner with Engineering, Architecture, RDO, Bizops, Risk & Control, Corporate Security, and Operational Resilience stakeholders to elaborate and refine features and user stories.
* Support the delivery of key initiatives such as
  **Project Elevate**
  activities across RTP International, working across relevant workstreams and cross-functional stakeholder groups.
* Coordinate across interdependent teams to manage
  **feature dependencies, delivery risks, and cross-market outcomes**
  .

**Reporting**

Partner with stakeholders to provide accurate, concise, and decision-focused data across your assigned domain in RTP International to the agility enablement team and technology backlog management colleagues to support reporting, including:

* **Technology Backlog**
  intake, status, trends, and prioritisation.
* **QP Planning**
  committed and uncommitted outcomes
* **OKR**
  progress and achievement
* **Vulnerability**
  status and remediation progress
* **TIMS**
  progress and exceptions

Use reporting not only to communicate status, but to
**identify trends, exceptions and emerging risks and contribute to actionable insights into Product and Technology leadership**
.

**Qualifications**

* Overall
  **3-6 years of experience**
  as a Technical Business Analyst in enterprise-scale IT projects.
* Excellent analytical, communication, problem-solving, and documentation skills with tools such as
  **JIRA and Confluence**
  .
* Strong experience in
  **requirements elicitation, business process analysis, stakeholder management, and solution definition**
  .
* Expertise in writing
  **BRDs, FRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and functional specifications**
  .
* Good understanding of
  **REST APIs, microservices, system integrations, databases (Oracle/DB2/SQL), and enterprise application architecture**
  .
* Experience working in
  **Agile/Scrum teams**
  , facilitating backlog grooming, sprint planning, UAT, and release activities.
* Experience in
  **banking, payments, fintech, or other high-volume transaction processing environments**
  .
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills.
* Attention to detail with a commitment to producing high-quality results.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills.

Nice to Have :

* Technical background in software development or hands-on exposure to
  **Java/Spring Boot, React, or similar technologies**
  .
* Knowledge of
  **DevOps practices**
  , CI/CD pipelines, Git, Jenkins, Docker, and release management processes.

**Additional Information**

At Endava, we’re committed to creating an open, inclusive, and respectful environment where everyone feels safe, valued, and empowered to be their best. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives—because we know that inclusive teams help us deliver smarter, more innovative solutions for our customers. Hiring decisions are based on merit, skills, qualifications, and potential. If you need adjustments or support during the recruitment process, please let us know.

jobs.title: Product Owner (SAP)
jobs.description:
**Product Owner**
Recruiter for this position: Vipin Yadav
  
  
Hiring Manager for this position: Jaya Dadlani
  
  
Division: Product Engineering O2C
  
  
Serrala is the global leader in finance process automation. For over 40 years, we have been advancing the office of the CFO with our award-winning suite of finance automation applications.
  
  
Our solutions streamline all working capital-related processes, including Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Cash Flow Management, and Treasury, across both cloud and SAP environments.
  
  
Our 10+ hubs across Europe, North America, and India support over 2,800 clients worldwide, reflecting the trust we've built with a diverse global community.
  
  
Join us as we lead the future of finance automation!
  
  
**Role Summary:**
We are looking for a Technical Product Owner to sit at the intersection of engineering and product for our Credit & Risk suite. This role is for someone who can go deep into ABAP, RAP and Fiori technical topics to design and guide developers, write Epics and User Stories that developers and QA can implement and test without ambiguity, and — when dedicated QA capacity is limited — test the functionality themselves. Prior Product Owner experience is not required as long as strong Project Management and Agile delivery skills are in place.
  
  
The person will work closely with the Product Manager to understand, follow, and contribute to the Roadmap, and will collaborate in depth with customers, external credit agencies, Solution Architects, and Consulting to explain the product, gather feedback, and turn it into actionable backlog items
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Deep-dive into technical topics in SAP ABAP, RAP and Fiori to design solutions and guide developers through implementation.
* Write clear, well-structured Epics and User Stories that are easy for developers and QA to implement and test.
* Perform hands-on testing / QA yourself for critical items when dedicated QA capacity is limited.
* Understand, follow, and actively contribute to the product Roadmap set by the Product Manager.
* Collaborate in depth with customers, external credit agencies, Solution Architects, and Consulting teams — explaining the product, capturing feedback, and translating it into requirements.
* Bring significant/strategic topics to the Product Manager for joint discussion and decision-making.
* Apply a working understanding of SAP functional processes and Finance tables to ground technical decisions in real business context.
* Demonstrate excellent communication, active listening, and critical reasoning across technical and non-technical audiences.

**Must-Have:**

* Hands-on technical experience with SAP ABAP, RAP and Fiori/UI5 — enough to design solutions and guide developers, not just review code.
* Strong Project Management / Agile delivery skills (Scrum, sprint planning, Backlog management) — Product Owner title/experience is not mandatory if this is solid.
* Basic understanding of SAP functional processes; exposure to Finance tables (e.g. BSEG, BSID, Credit Management tables) is a strong plus.
* Demonstrated ability to write Epics and User Stories that developers and QA can pick up and implement/test with minimal back-and-forth.
* Willingness and ability to personally execute QA/Testing when QA capacity is constrained.
* Proven experience collaborating directly with customers, partners, or external agencies — explaining a product and incorporating feedback.
* Excellent communication and active-listening skills, with strong critical reasoning to navigate ambiguous, technical, and business conversations alike.

**Good-to-Have:**

* Prior experience as a Product Owner or in a similar product/technical-lead role.
* Domain exposure to Credit Management, Credit Risk, Order to Cash (O2C), or Accounts Receivable.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA (or ECC-to-S/4HANA migration context).
* Familiarity with JIRA/Confluence or similar Agile tooling for Epics/Story and Roadmap management.
* Exposure to integrations with external credit bureaus/agencies (e.g. credit reporting or credit insurance providers). Exposure to AI/ML-driven features such as credit exposure or risk-prediction models.
* Prior experience working with Solution Architects and Consulting teams in a customer-facing capacity.

Next steps: Simply apply here via the internal job market - we will contact you as soon as possible. Good to know: We will contact you first - your current manager will not be informed about your internal application.
  
  
Your HR Contact for this position is: Vipin Yadav
  
  
This role is based in: Pune

Technology and Business Enablement is the division that cuts across all of them, providing shared platforms, controls, and transformation programs. :

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager - Trading
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.
  
  
**The Role**
The Senior Product Manager-Trading will collaborate with the other Trading Product Managers and Trading Product Leads to help guide the vision for Trading, OMS, and IBOR products. We are building this product suite anew and collaborating with our design team to improve the advisor/trader facing workflows and build engaging experiences that scale. You will execute product vision, implement strategy, and collaborate with a cross-functional team in a manner that improves their efficiency and productivity.
  
  
Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Possess a solid understanding of Trading, Rebalancing, and OMS systems used in the US and European wealth management industry. You understand trading products in terms of their users, business value, technical landscape, data, vendors, and can relate these to other areas of the Addepar ecosystem
* Document and communicate goals for the product and drive an innovative product roadmap that conveys the team vision and goals to our clients
* Build consensus with the team to prioritize and define increments of work based on level of effort, interdependencies, and other relevant criteria
* Assist in adjusting strategy in response to changing company, business, market, and technical needs.
* Identify appropriate users, partners, competitors, and market trends from which to elicit input and draw inspiration

**Who You Are**

* Minimum 5+ years of relevant work experience and education in product management, software development, user workflows, and efficiently leading teams
* Fundamental knowledge in finance, trading, and investments, specifically with trading for wealth management firms
* Ability to communicate finance domain knowledge, problems and knowledge well both in person and in writing for internal development and sales teams as well for clients and 3rd party data partners
* Ability to partner with engineering to define the functional and technical implementation to tackle a business problem. This includes understanding of high level data development concepts, data modelling and the ability to write and review technical requirements documents
* Practical knowledge of agile thinking and lean practices; project management, and a strong ability to guide teams through project iterations
* A superpower for identifying the appropriate tools, people and techniques to accomplish objectives

**Our Values**

* Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
  
  
PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

We are looking for a Digital Marketing professional with expertise in managing end-to-end digital marketing activities, content strategy, creative development, packaging, social media, marketing campaigns, and influencer collaborations. The role requires a comprehensive understanding of digital marketing beyond just social media management.

  
  

**1. Strategy Development**

\* Identify target audiences and develop content strategies to drive brand awareness, engagement, and growth.

\* Stay updated on digital marketing trends, platform updates, and industry best practices.

\* Plan and maintain a monthly digital marketing calendar.

  

**2. Content Development & Creation**

  

\* Develop creative content ideas and concepts across digital platforms.

\* Create engaging content including social media posts, reels, stories, videos, blogs, captions, campaign copy, and other marketing collaterals.

\* Develop content that is relevant to the target audience and aligned with the brands positioning and tone of voice.

\* Work on packaging innovation, redesigns, and new product launches.

\* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure packaging creatives are developed, reviewed, and finalised within timelines.

  

**4. Social Media Management & Community Management**

  

\* Manage the brands social media platforms and ensure regular, consistent communication.

\* Monitor and respond to comments, messages, mentions, and customer queries.

\* Build meaningful engagement and foster a strong online community.

\* Handle customer feedback and complaints professionally, coordinating with relevant teams where required.

  

**5. Campaign Management Brand Awareness**

  

\* Plan and execute digital campaigns focused on brand awareness, engagement, and audience growth.

\* Manage paid social media campaigns across platforms such as Meta.

\* Execute influencer collaborations, brand partnerships, contests, and other digital initiatives.

\* Monitor campaign performance and optimize campaigns to improve reach, engagement, and effectiveness.

  

**6. Performance Tracking & Analytics**

  

\* Track key digital marketing metrics, including reach, impressions, engagement, follower growth, website traffic, and campaign performance.

\* Prepare regular reports highlighting performance, insights, opportunities, and areas for improvement.

\* Use analytics to understand audience behaviour and optimize content and campaigns.

\* Provide actionable recommendations based on data and campaign learnings.

  

**7. Influencer Marketing & Collaborations**

  

\* Identify relevant influencers, creators, and brand partners aligned with the brands positioning and target audience.

\* Manage influencer outreach, collaborations, campaign execution, and performance tracking.

\* Develop innovative partnerships to increase brand visibility and audience engagement.

  

**8. Website & Digital Presence**

  

\* Coordinate with relevant teams to ensure the brands website and other digital platforms remain updated.

\* Support initiatives to improve website traffic, digital visibility, and brand discovery.

\* Identify opportunities to enhance the overall digital consumer experience.

This role is for a Production Operator responsible for setting up, calibrating, and operating manufacturing equipment, ensuring compliance with GMP, GDP, and safety standards. The position involves preparing raw materials, conducting in-process checks, maintaining documentation, and performing cleaning and sanitization activities. You will contribute to operational excellence by supporting preventive maintenance, troubleshooting minor equipment issues, and implementing CAPA for repeat problems. The role emphasizes adherence to SOPs, personal safety practices, and continuous improvement through Kaizen, 5S, and lean initiatives. Additionally, you will engage in training programs, safety drills, and digital system usage (SOR, OEE dashboards) to strengthen operational efficiency and compliance.  
**Roles & Responsibilities**  
• You will be responsible for setting up and calibrating machinery, preparing raw materials, and ensuring readiness for production.  
• You will be responsible for conducting in-process checks (weight variation, hardness, disintegration) to maintain product quality.  
• You will be responsible for recording production activities, maintaining GMP documentation, and supporting internal/external audits.  
• You will be responsible for cleaning and sanitizing equipment, performing CLTI activities, and verifying calibration of instruments.  
• You will be responsible for troubleshooting minor equipment issues, supporting preventive maintenance, and implementing CAPA for repeat problems.  
• You will be responsible for following PPE, hygiene, and safety standards, reporting incidents, and executing LOTO procedures.  
• You will be responsible for participating in training sessions, safety drills, SOP updates, and engaging in Kaizen, 5S, and lean initiatives.  
• You will be responsible for using computerized systems (SOR), digital dashboards (OEE, Plant Visibility, AMPLE), and supporting root cause analysis to improve efficiency.

**Qualification**

**Educational qualification:** Diploma in Mechanical, Industrial Engineering or related field is mandatory.  
**Minimum work experience:**   
2+ / 4+ years of experience

**Resident Skills**  
• Current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMPS)

**Behavioural Skills**  
• Safety-first mindset with strong compliance and regulatory alignment  
• Collaborative across production, quality, and cross-functional teams  
• Continuous improvement orientation with problem-solving and innovation  
**Critical exposures**  
• Experience in the setup and operation of equipment used in the manufacturing of OSD products is desired.  
• Experience in digital systems, material handling, inventory accuracy and adherence to safety protocol is desired.  
• Exposure in troubleshooting machinery used in granulation, blending, compression, coating and packaging is preferred.

**Additional Information**

Benefits Offered  
At Dr. Reddy’s we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs.  
The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy’s are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining & relocation support, family support (Maternity & Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.  
  
Our Work Culture  
Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions.  models.

 UAE & MIDDLE EAST MARKET EXPERTISE

 PRESALES LEAD / MIDDLE EAST RECRUITMENT & IT STAFFING

 Lead discovery workshops, solution presentations, proposal walkthroughs and bid defense discussions.

 ANALYTICS & PROCESS EXCELLENCE   
 Track proposal turnaround, bid-to-award conversion, quality, pricing accuracy and lost-bid reasons.   
 Maintain CRM and proposal records; standardize templates and improve efficiency with appropriate automation.   
 Report pipeline and bid performance to leadership.   
 MANDATORY CAPABILITIES   
 Substantial hands-on presales, bid, proposal or staffing solutioning expertise in IT recruitment, staffing, RPO or workforce   
 solutions.   
 Proven UAE or Middle East client exposure and independent ownership of RFP/RFQ/RFI/tender responses.   
 Strong technical proposals, commercial bids, staffing delivery design, costing, rate cards, margins and SLA design.   
 Excellent executive presentations, proposal writing, cross-functional leadership, PowerPoint, Excel and CRM skills.   
 PREFERRED EXPERTISE   
 Presales leadership or team mentoring; enterprise or government tenders in Middle East markets.   
 Multi-country staffing proposals, managed services and technology hiring across Cloud, Data, AI/ML, Cybersecurity, ERP   
 and Software Engineering.   
 Recruitment automation, proposal management platforms and analytics.   
 SUCCESS METRICS   
 On-time, compliant submissions; bid-to-award conversion; proposal quality and accuracy.   
 Solution feasibility, commercial margin protection and proposal turnaround time.

Days 30: Assess bid pipeline, templates, pricing, service offerings and key stakeholder needs.

Days 30- 60: Lead assigned bids; establish review workflows and standardize proposal templates.   
 Days 60-90: Own complex bids end to end; refine solution and pricing frameworks; report performance.   
 QUALIFICATIONS & APPLICATION   
 Bachelor degree in Business Administration, HR, Marketing, Commerce, Engineering or related field; MBA preferred.

 commercial pricing experience,

At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrd  
  
Treasury is the Vice Presidency, reporting to the Managing Director and World Bank Group Chief Financial Officer, performing treasury functions for the IBRD and IDA and, to varying degrees, for other members of the World Bank Group and other public sector investors. Its activities are organized and grouped into the following departments: Capital Markets & Investment Management, Client Asset Management and Advisory, and Treasury Operations.  
  
Treasury (TRE) has been a large and significant player in the international financial markets for over seventy years and has achieved a global reputation as a prudent and innovative borrower, investor and risk manager. Treasury is responsible for: (i) managing approximately $195 billion in assets for the World Bank and other official sector investors; (ii) leading IBRD’s and IDA’s triple-A rated financing programs in international and domestic bond and derivative markets; (iii) conducting asset and liability management for IBRD’s and IDA’s balance sheets; (iv) overseeing the development and outreach related to the financing and hedging products the Bank provides for its developing-country clients; and (v) collaborating with the World Bank member countries to help build their capacity. Staff in Treasury regularly interact and collaborate with other departments across the Bank and Finance Partners’ teams.  
  
The Treasury Operations Department (TREOP) provides a full range of operational support for Treasury’s asset management, capital markets and banking businesses. The Department is presently organized in 7 operational units: Asset and Liability Operations (TREAL), Quantitative Solutions and Analytics (TREQA), and Cash and Banking Operations (TREBK), Treasury Quantitative Modelling (TREQM), Treasury ALM & Collateral (TREAC), Treasury Market Data and Valuation (TREMV) and a Financial Technology coordination unit (TREFT).  
  
Treasury Asset and Liability Operations (TREAL) is the unit responsible for delivering on a range of operations functions supporting the funding, investment, and asset and liability management portfolios for internal World Bank Group (IBRD, IDA, MIGA, and Trust Funds) entities. In addition, the team supports investment portfolios for a growing roster of more than 60 client entities in domestic and international markets. The team provides integrated and end-to-end support for all trade execution and portfolio servicing activities including trade review, settlement and documentation, options monitoring, debt service and cash and collateral management across the full range of products including bonds, swaps, repos, deposits, and exchange-traded derivatives.  
  
In performing these functions, the team works closely with internal partners and market counterparts as well as external service providers such as technology vendors, custodians, and paying agents. In addition to managing the day-to-day operations, TREAL staff lead the research, coordination, and implementation of new products and markets across Treasury. The team has a heavy focus on, and takes a leadership role in, evaluating and deploying the latest products and technologies (core trading platforms and new initiatives and technologies like CBDC, blockchain, AI, robotics, etc.) to create efficiencies, reduce risk, and advance thought leadership amongst WB’s peers and clients. TREAL staff participate in capacity-building programs for clients in these areas of expertise. TREAL staff recently co-led projects where the World Bank issued innovative digital bonds using blockchain technology and CBDC. In recognition of their efforts to advance capital markets and asset management, the TREAL team received several industry awards including for “Innovation in Reserves Management” (2021) and “Asset Servicing Initiative of the year” (2023). The team has twice been shortlisted for “Operations Team of the Year” award (2023 and 2024).  
  
Treasury ALM & Collateral Operations (TREAC) delivers operations support for asset and liability management, client risk management and collateral activities across IBRD, IDA and IFC. It is the operational engine of Treasury Client Solutions (TCS) and the central collateral management provider for WBG entities and RAMP clients. Team covers the full transaction lifecycle for funding and client hedging transactions, from trade setup and confirmation through settlement, rate fixings, payment events, exception handling, reconciliations and reporting. On the collateral side, it manages margining for OTC derivatives, MBS and futures, including daily margin calls, dispute resolution, CSA agreement administration, and monitoring of valuation.  
  
The team also supports long-term local currency investment transactions through IFC in countries where market solutions are not sufficiently available under the IDA–IFC Private Sector Window. The team works closely with front office, risk, finance, legal and technology teams, and with external counterparties, custodians, brokers and clearing organizations. Operating from Washington, D.C., Chennai and Sofia give the unit time-zone coverage and continuity. Beyond daily operations, TREAC leads systems implementation, convergence and digital transformation, with a strong focus on operational risk, controls and governance. The team operates on a common WBG operating model that aligns with IBRD, IDA and IFC practices, reduces duplication and manual handoffs, and delivers scalable, traceable, automation-ready processes.  
  
**Duties and Accountabilities:**  
The TRE Operations Chennai (TRECH) is an integral part of TREOP and is responsible for a variety of duties providing vital support across its operational divisions. It works closely with the Headquarters in Washington D.C and another shared services center in Sofia, Bulgaria. Under the guidance and supervision of a Team Lead and/or Functional Lead, the incumbent will have responsibilities for specific individual tasks/projects as well as for working as an integral part of the team in executing the Treasury Operation’s work program, while maintaining close relationships with the other Treasury departments.  
  
The incumbent’s primary responsibilities will include, but are not limited to, some combination of the following activities:  
  

* Work closely with the team to understand various facets of post-execution activities for fixed income, derivatives, and cash products to identify, analyze and prioritize process reengineering, automation and streamlining opportunities focusing on enhancing efficiency and accuracy.
* Support data collection, analysis, visualization, and report writing, including by innovatively using data, stories, and analytics to build powerful narratives.

jobs.description:

Within the Pricing Operations team, we streamline pricing and discounting processes, leveraging exceptional data management skills, automation and tools to ensure accuracy and consistency in price and discount data. With a focus on operational excellence, we align cross-functionally with Operations, Finance, Sales, Compliance, and IT to transform our policies, processes, and tool capabilities to create a simplified buying experience at scale for our partners, customers and sales.
  
  
Pricing Operations sits within the Commerce& Growth Acceleration organization, with a mission to provide frictionless commerce operations at scale for Cisco's customers, partners, sellers& renewal managers across all hardware, software, service offers and buying programs fueled by a culture where we celebrate talent& collaboration.
  
  
Your Impact
  
The Client Operations Analyst within Pricing Operations will bridge the gap between Cisco’s partner incentive discount strategy and the operational data infrastructure required to support them.
  
  
This individual will work directly with Business Units and Finance to implement and maintain Cisco’s discounting strategy across its entire portfolio of products, as well as work with Partner Incentive Owners to provide support of the strategy, setup and maintenance of high-revenue generating partner incentive offers. They will be responsible for understanding offer and sales business strategy translating it into clear data requirements to ensure correct partner prices and discounts are applied in Cisco’s commerce platform for hardware, software, service, and all subscription motions. This individual will also serve as point of contact for managing, tracking, reporting and resolving issues with the offer setups.
  
  
The Client Operations Analyst works cross-functionally to analyze business processes, identifies areas for improvement, and implements solutions that enhance productivity and drive business performance.
  
  

* Understand complex business strategies and requirements and translate into clear data requirements
* Collect, analyze, and interpret complex data sets to provide actionable insights that support decision-making
* Develop, lead and participate in cross-functional projects and initiatives to implement new offer setups, as well as operational changes and improvements
* Identify inefficiencies in current business processes and develop strategies to optimize workflows and operations
* Work cross-functionally with Sales, Finance, Product Management, and IT, to understand their operational needs and provide data-driven recommendations
* Create and maintain detailed documentation of business processes, workflows, and standard operating procedures
* Provide training and support to team members on new processes and tools

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* A minimum of 5 years of relevant business analysis experience within the IT industry, including tasks such as data analysis, requirement gathering, process improvement and process automation
* Experience leading data analysis and audit projects involving large data sets, where high-level Excel skills, including the use of macros, pivots, formulas, and data slicing, were used to identify trends and insights, resulting in actional business strategies
* Demonstrate ability to analyze data from at least four different sources to identify root cause of a problem, evaluate alternative solutions, with documented success in presenting and explaining findings to cross-functional teams, leading to consensus on a strategic path forward
* Proven proficiency in process and change management, demonstrated by leading at least two change initiatives that resulted in 100% user adoption and at least 20% improvement in process efficiency
* Proven experience in designing, deploying, and maintaining automated solutions that streamline sophisticated operational workflows, resulting in increased process efficiency and reduced manual intervention.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Effective verbal and written communication skills, bold, assertive and possess a sense of ownership of work you're leading
* Work independently as well as in a multi-functional team environment
* Highly organized with strong analytical and problem solving skills
* High level of accuracy and attention to detail in all aspects of work
* Responsive and timely in delivering on commitments

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
Disclaimer

WE'RE HIRING! | Banking Alliances & Partnerships Manager.

We are hiring a banking professional who can open, run and protect To The Moon Technologies Pvt Ltd's banking relationships: INR pay-in, payout, virtual accounts, CMS and API banking for a crypto trading platform.

* **Department:** Strategic Partnerships (Banking & Payments)
* **Reports To:** Founder & CEO
* **Location:** Lucknow
* **Travel:** Regular travel to Mumbai, Delhi NCR & Bengaluru for bank meetings
* **Experience:** 5+ years in Banking or Fintech
* **Required Expertise:** Digital Banking, API Banking, CMS & Virtual Accounts
* **Employment Type:** Full-time
* **Seniority:** Senior Executive to Manager, based on experience

**About ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd**

ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd is an FIU-IND registered Indian cryptocurrency exchange, headquartered in Jaipur and operating since 2021. We run spot and futures trading plus OTC on-ramp and off-ramp services for Indian users. INR flows, deposits, withdrawals and settlements, sit at the center of our business, and they depend on strong, compliant banking partners.

**Role purpose**

You will own ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd's banking ecosystem end to end. That means finding and onboarding banks, getting API banking, virtual accounts and CMS live, and keeping every relationship healthy. You will also build backup banking so no single bank or payment rail can stop INR deposits or withdrawals.

**Key responsibilities**

1.Bank partnerships and onboarding

a. Find, pitch and onboard private, small finance, cooperative and new-age banks for current accounts, escrow/nodal accounts, pay-in and payout.

b. Present ToTheMoon Technologies Pvt Ltd's business model, FIU-IND registration, AML/KYC framework and risk controls to bank product, risk and compliance teams.

c. Lead the bank's due diligence: documents, questionnaires, site visits and onboarding

paperwork.

2. API banking, virtual accounts and CMS

a. Set up and expand virtual account (VAN) structures for user-wise INR deposit collection

and auto-reconciliation.

b. Get API banking live for IMPS, NEFT, RTGS and UPI payouts, plus balance, statement and

status APIs.

c. Set up CMS for collections and bulk payouts, and drive integration with our tech team

through UAT and go-live.

d. Work with UPI collect, payment aggregator and PSP partners as extra deposit rails.

3. Relationship management

a. Act as the single point of contact for every banking partner, from relationship managers

up to senior leadership.

b. Handle account freezes, lien marks, LEA and cyber-cell requests, chargebacks and

transaction holds with the bank and our compliance team.

c. Run regular reviews of volumes, TAT, success rates and issues with each bank.

4. Negotiation and commercials

a. Negotiate pricing, transaction limits, float terms, MDR, payout charges and SLAs.

b. Review and close banking agreements, API terms and SLAs with our legal team.

5. Business continuity

a. Always keep at least two live banking partners for pay-in and payout, with tested

failover.

b. Spot risk early, regulatory changes, a bank's appetite for VDA business and line up

alternatives before they are needed.

6. Compliance and internal coordination

a. Work with compliance, finance, operations and tech so bank requirements under PMLA,

FIU-IND and RBI guidelines are met.

b. Keep partner dashboards, MIS and documentation current for management.

**Must-have requirements**

* 5+ years in banking or fintech, with hands-on work in digital banking, API banking, CMS and

virtual accounts.

* Has managed these products for a corporate client, a fintech platform, a stockbroker, a payment

aggregator or a crypto exchange from the bank side or the client side.

* Has taken at least 2–3 bank integrations (VAN, payout API or CMS) from first meeting to go-live.

* An active network of decision-makers in transaction banking, CMS, digital/API banking and

fintech partnership teams at Indian banks.

* Clear understanding of INR payment rails: IMPS, NEFT, RTGS, UPI, NACH, and escrow/nodal

account structures.

* Working knowledge of KYC/AML, PMLA, FIU-IND and RBI rules relevant to banks serving fintechs

and VDA businesses.

* Strong negotiation, presentation and written communication skills in English and Hindi.

* Graduate in any field; MBA in Finance, Banking or Business preferred.

**Skills and Competencies**

* **Banking Products:** Knowledge of current, escrow and nodal accounts; virtual accounts; CMS collections and payouts; API banking; UPI collect and payout.
* **Technical Fluency:** Ability to read API documentation and understand webhooks, callbacks, reconciliation files and UAT; comfortable coordinating with developers and bank technology teams.
* **Negotiation:** Ability to negotiate pricing, transaction limits, SLAs and agreements while maintaining strong banking relationships.
* **Communication:** Strong presentation and email-writing skills; confident in meetings with bank CXOs, risk and compliance heads.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Ability to align compliance, finance, technology and operations teams around bank integration timelines.
* **Problem Solving:** Ability to resolve account freezes, failed payouts, settlement delays and reconciliation gaps quickly.
* **Ownership:** Self-driven, works independently and takes complete responsibility for follow-through until go-live.
* **Integrity:** Handles confidential banking and customer data with utmost discretion.

**Good to have**

•Earlier work in a bank's transaction banking, CMS, digital banking or fintech alliances team.

•Experience at an Indian crypto exchange, stockbroker, payment gateway, PSP or NBFC.

•Has onboarded a VDA or high-risk business with a bank and understands the bank's concerns.

•Exposure to payment aggregator rules, cross-border payments or stablecoin on/off-ramp flows.

•Familiarity with reconciliation tools, MIS reporting and Excel-based analysis.

Pay: ₹444,000.00 - ₹700,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person
