jobs.title: Product Owner (UX)
jobs.description:
**About Revolut**
People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.
  
  
As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 15,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Product team shapes the experiences that power Revolut. They turn complex problems into simple, scalable solutions — collaborating across Design, Engineering, and Data to build features our customers love.
  
  
We’re looking for a Product Owner who knows how to take responsibility over a product roadmap, including day-to-day operations, project execution, and addressing risks. From conception to launch and beyond, you’ll collaborate cross-functionally and communicate with senior management to be the go-to person for your feature.
  
  
Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Setting your team's goals, success metrics, and roadmap to align with company goals
* Driving maximum impact based on data analysis, market research, and company strategy
* Completely owning your team's products, from ideation, through development, to launch, growth, and maintenance
* Working closely with Design and UX teams to define the customer journey and create an amazing user experience
* Liaising with Engineering to ensure effective delivery of your product
* Partnering with other stakeholders, such as Marketing, Legal, and Strategy teams

**What You'll Need**

* 3+ years of experience at a high-growth tech company or in banking/finance-related business areas (acquiring, payments, investments, cryptocurrency, insurance, etc.)
* 2+ years of proven success leading consumer-facing mobile products
* 1+ years of experience managing people
* Outstanding communication skills
* An eye for great UX/UI and impeccable understanding of design best practices
* High analytical acumen along with solid business sense that guides ROI-based prioritisation
* Experience formulating and driving a focused product vision, and owning the narrative with leadership, customers, and partners
* Experience leading product development and launch from scratch
* A readiness to provide insight and deliver measurable results under ambiguous situations in a fast-paced environment
* An entrepreneurial drive to never settle

**Nice to have**

* A bachelor’s degree from a top university

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager, FinTech
jobs.description:
**Who We Are Is What We Do.**
Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 150+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly.
  
  
Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 7,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers.
  
  
**Why should you be part of our success story?**
As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are.
  
  
Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50, Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator's top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google.
  
  
Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for a
**Staff Product Manager**
to lead a key area within Deel’s Fintech group, which powers how contractors and employees access, move, and manage their money globally. This includes cards, withdrawals, payouts, liquidity/advance products, and the notification systems that support these experiences.
  
  
You’ll define strategy, drive execution, and partner deeply with engineering, design, compliance, treasury, and operations to deliver a fast, reliable, and consumer-grade financial experience at global scale. This is a high-impact IC role with significant ownership and the expectation of strong product craft, systems thinking, and hands-on leadership.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own vision, strategy, and roadmap for a core Fintech domain.
* Lead cross-functional execution across engineering, design, and key business partners.
* Deliver high-quality financial experiences across cards, payouts, liquidity, and money movement flows.
* Improve reliability, performance, and usability for global contractor and employee money flows.
* Drive clarity and alignment across multiple product surfaces and teams.
* Dive deep into user problems, financial logic, system behaviour, and operational constraints
* Raise the bar for product quality, documentation, and communication.

**What You Bring**

* As a guide, around 7+ years of Product Management experience, with depth of experience in consumer fintech, i.e. EWA, cards, or similar consumer financial products.
* Proven ability to own complex, high-impact product areas with limited oversight.
* Strong product sense, systems thinking, and data-driven decision making.
* Experience working with engineering, compliance, and operations in a regulated financial environment
* Excellent written and verbal communication; able to drive alignment across stakeholders.
* Comfortable being hands-on: clarifying requirements, debugging issues, diving into edge cases, and unblocking execution.

**Why Join Deel**

* Build consumer-grade financial experiences used globally at massive scale.
* Operate with autonomy, impact, and access to strong cross-functional partners.
* Work at the intersection of money movement, cards, liquidity, and platform infrastructure.
* Help shape the next generation of Deel’s financial products for millions of workers and employees.

**Total Rewards**
Our workforce deserves fair and competitive pay that meets them where they are. With scalable benefits, rewards, and perks, our total rewards programs reflect our commitment to inclusivity and access for all.
  
  

* Our salary range reflects gross base salary. For commercial roles with commission eligibility, this figure represents On-Target Earnings (OTE), inclusive of base salary and target commission.
* Salary ranges are quoted in USD as a consistent global reference. Your offer will be localized to your country's currency using a market-aligned conversion.
* Final pay is based on objective, job-related criteria including experience, skills, and location.
* We don't ask about salary history. Offers are based on the role and what you bring to it.

**Some things you'll enjoy**

* Stock grant opportunities dependent on your role, employment status and location
* Additional perks and benefits based on your employment status and country
* Optional flexible working office membership, with IWG

jobs.description:
Banking SME / Product Owner – Digital Banking

**Contract:**
12 months

**Location:**
Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, or remote from the UAE or India, with
**two weeks per month onsite in Riyadh**

**Expenses:**
Travel, accommodation and visa costs are covered for contractors travelling to Riyadh.

The role

We’re looking for a Banking SME / Product Owner to lead the product roadmap for retail and/or SME digital banking journeys on a programme in Saudi Arabia. You’ll bring hands-on banking product expertise and work with business, technology and governance teams to deliver customer journeys from discovery through to launch and ongoing improvement.

The scope covers digital onboarding, account opening, payments, cards, deposits, financing and day-to-day servicing.

Key responsibilities

* Own the product roadmap and backlog for retail and/or SME digital banking journeys.
* Translate customer, business, regulatory and Sharia requirements into clear features, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Work with technology, design, operations, risk, compliance, legal and Sharia governance teams to deliver digital banking capabilities.
* Prioritise the backlog based on business value, customer impact, regulatory requirements and delivery feasibility.
* Drive improvements across onboarding, account opening, payments, cards, deposits, financing and servicing.
* Track adoption, conversion, revenue, complaints and digital servicing metrics, and use the findings to prioritise improvements.
* Support user acceptance testing (UAT), launch readiness, go-to-market planning and post-launch optimisation.

Skills and experience

* Experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager or Banking SME on a retail or SME digital banking programme, with ownership of a product roadmap or delivery backlog.
* Strong banking product knowledge and hands-on delivery experience in one or more of the following areas: onboarding and account opening, payments, cards, deposits, financing or servicing.
* Experience working with Agile delivery teams and translating business and regulatory requirements into features, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Ability to make and communicate prioritisation decisions across business, technology and governance teams.
* Experience using customer and product performance data to improve live services.
* Experience with Islamic banking products, Sharia governance or digital banking delivery in Saudi Arabia or the wider GCC would be advantageous.

jobs.title: Manager,  Product Management, Credit
jobs.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Manager, Product Management, Credit
  
  
EEMEA Consumer Core Credit team is performance driven and works cross functionally across the MasterCard network, Globally, Regionally and locally, to refine, execute & manage winning propositions that drive market share, revenue and transaction volume for MasterCard in the region.
  
  
The team is responsible for the ownership and market differentiation of MasterCard Consumer Credit products within Eastern Europe, Middle East and Africa - including; product strategy, branding, sales enablement, market positioning, end to end consumer & customer experience, operations and performance.
  
  
Mastercard is looking for an agile team player to help project manage, design, shape, and drive product capabilities for the Credit products. We are looking for highly motivated individuals with a solid track record, who feel passionate about payments as well as developing innovative solutions.
  
  
Role
  
  
Reporting To VP, EEMEA Credit, This Person Will Work Closely With The Credit Team And Relevant Stakeholders To Assess Program And/or Product Objectives, And Implement An Effective Plan And Strategy For Delivery. As a Manager, Product Management, Your Roll Will Include
  
  

* Manage Mastercard’s Credit Products & Strategy, including planning and forecasting, market research, development of new Customer Value Propositions (CVP), marketing and management of existing benefits, market roll-outs / penetration strategy and support.
* CX/UX lead for all Mastercard Credit card platforms, benefits and features ensuring consumer experience is seamless across all channels. Digitize consumer experience for accessing and redeeming benefits on Mastercard / Issuer platforms.
* Development of Best Practices, Case Studies and competitive analyses (including gap analyses) for the relevant products/segments. Liaise with the global team to leverage insights, learnings and platforms to support EEMEA Credit products.
* Special projects: project work can vary, but may include managing internal and client expectations, data analysis, and leading day to day execution.

**All About You**

* Multi-disciplinary knowledge, i.e. product management, consulting, marketing, business development, etc.
* Experience leading projects through all phases of the project/product development lifecycle
* Ability to handle multiple partners and projects from initiation to completion
* Excellent interpersonal, negotiation and conflict resolution and/or project management skills
* Understanding of competitive offerings and industry trends, i.e. fintechs, startups
* Intermediate technical/operations experience within financial/payments industry
* Excellent presentation, oral and written business presentation skills with various levels of audience
* Interest in working in a fast pace and evolving environment
* Strong analytical and organizational skills - ability to identify process/efficiency enhancements and attention to detail
* Ability to adapt personal work style to accommodate an ever changing, diverse and global environment
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office. Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint
* Must be a self-directed, self-starter comfortable working with strong degree of autonomy to accomplish results

**Education / Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree
* Experience in payments or product development preferred

**Language**

* Good verbal and written communication skills in English and Arabic

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

The Retail Banking Group (RBG) supports retail and micro-business customers in managing their finances, through expert advice and the provision of a full suite of specialist products and services in conventional and Shari’ah compliant banking. The business is committed to driving digital innovation to deliver excellence in customer service. We are actively seeking an ambitious professional to join our Retail Banking team at ADCB to work alongside passionate colleagues who share your ambition to redefine excellence in UAE banking.

We are actively seeking an ambitious professional to join our Retail Banking team at ADCB to work alongside passionate colleagues who share your ambition to redefine excellence in UAE banking.

**In this role, your key responsibilities include**
:

* Digital Channel Development and Implementation- Assess areas of development and innovation to existing and new Digital Channels (internet, mobile, tablet, SMS, wearable, digital TV) in order to broaden the overall service offering and enhance Digital Channel services in line with overall objectives of the business group.

Continuously oversee and analyze Digital Channel usage and revenue KPIs to ensure overall business objectives are met
* Quality Certification, Audit and Compliance- Ensure that all services meet regulatory requirements such as ISO 9001 certification for internet Banking/mobile Banking and product development. Administer the retention of such certifications in order to remain compliant and minimize any risk of non-compliance to the Bank. Ensure timely and accurate development of risk and compliance reporting as required in line with the agreed standards in order to communicate activity/incidence reporting and assist in departmental decision making
* People Management- Manage self and team in line with ADCB’s people management policies, procedures, processes and practices to ensure adherence and to maximize own and employee contribution to business performance. Organize and supervise the activities and work of the team to ensure that targets and objectives are achieved and the business plan is delivered in line with the required policies, processes, procedures and systems
* Policies, Processes, Systems and Procedures- Implement approved departmental policies, processes and procedures, and ensure employee adherence so that work is carried out to the required standard while delivering the required standards of service to customers and stakeholders
* Continuous Improvement- Manage and motivate the team to ensure they contribute to, and participate in, the identification and implementation of change initiatives, programmes and projects in line with the Bank’s standards
* Customer Service- Demonstrate Our Promise and apply the ADCB Service Standards to deliver the Bank’s required levels of service in all internal and external customer interactions
* Product and Journey Ownership - Own assigned customer journeys or platform capabilities within Group Digital and AI, translating the needs of Retail, Business and Corporate Banking clients and stakeholders into a prioritized product backlog with clearly defined features, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Digital Journeys and Channels - Develop and enhance digital journeys across Retail, Business and Corporate Banking, including onboarding, account opening, authentication, servicing, payments and related capabilities delivered through Web and Mobile channels.
* Platform Management - Manage assigned components of the Bank’s digital platforms throughout their lifecycle, including requirements, delivery, enhancements, defect prioritization, release readiness, operational performance and reuse across client segments.
* Agile Delivery - Work closely with engineering, architecture, UX/UI, testing and business teams through the complete Agile delivery lifecycle. Own backlog refinement, sprint prioritization and acceptance of delivered functionality.

* Customer Service - Demonstrate Our Promise and apply the ADCB Service Standards to deliver the Bank’s required levels of service in all internal and external customer interactions.

* Bachelor’s Degree in relevant specialization

* Knowledge of web channels and mobile technologies
* Planning, analytical and time management skills
* Written and spoken English

  : This includes market-leading medical insurance, group life and personal accident insurance, paid leave and leave airfare, employee preferential rates on loans and finance facilities, staff discounts and offers, and children education assistance (for certain job levels).

jobs.title: Sr Staff Product Designer - Krak
jobs.description:
**Building the Future of Open Finance**
Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.
  
  
**The team**
Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.
  
  
We’re looking for a Senior Staff Product Designer to lead design for Krak and help us build a neobank people trust with their everyday money.
  
  
This is a high-impact individual contributor role with responsibility for design across the product. You’ll set the direction for the Krak experience, influence product strategy, and stay close to the details through execution.
  
  
We’re a hardworking team that moves fast and ships with purpose. We’re straight-talking, no-nonsense, and deeply invested in the quality of what we build. We care about craft, we care about our customers, and we care about getting things right.
  
  
Building a neobank means earning people’s trust in the moments that matter: getting started, moving money, making a payment, or understanding what’s happened when something goes wrong. You’ll help make those experiences clear and reliable, bringing the same care to everyday interactions as you do to the overall product vision.
  
  
**The Opportunity**

* Own the design direction for Krak, connecting onboarding, accounts, payments, and spending into one coherent experience.
* Make everyday banking clear and intuitive, from understanding balances and fees to tracking payments and resolving problems.
* Shape product strategy and roadmap decisions with product, engineering, and leadership.
* Lead hands-on design and prototyping, setting the standard for interaction design, visual craft, and accessibility.
* Work with compliance, risk, and operations to make verification, security, and account recovery straightforward for customers.

* Use research and data to improve the product, and mentor designers through critique and collaboration.What You’ll Bring

**What You Bring**

* 7+ years in product design, with a strong portfolio of shipped consumer mobile experiences.

* Strong interaction and visual design skills, with the ability to work through complex financial journeys and their edge cases.
* Advanced prototyping skills and experience building or evolving design systems.

Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.
  
  
As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
**Summary**

The
**Senior Product Manager – Consumer Products**
is responsible for the end to end product development, delivery, and continuous enhancement of consumer financial products, including credit cards, loans, instalment plans, balance transfers, top ups, and related value added services.

The role will lead product strategy, market research, proposition development, product launches, portfolio management, and continuous improvement. Working closely with Risk, Technology, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Compliance, and other stakeholders, the role will ensure products are commercially viable, customer focused, digitally enabled, and aligned with Finance House’s strategic and regulatory objectives.

**Major Responsibilities**

**Product Strategy & Portfolio Management**

* Develop and execute product strategies and propositions for assigned consumer products, including cards, loans, instalment plans, balance transfers, and related services.
* Own the end to end product lifecycle from market research and business case development through launch, optimization, and product rationalization.
* Develop short, medium, and long term product roadmaps covering product features, digital journeys, underwriting, technology initiatives, and business priorities.
* Conduct customer research, segmentation, competitor analysis, and market reviews to identify new opportunities and enhance existing products.
* Define product propositions, pricing, features, eligibility criteria, and customer value propositions in line with market needs and business objectives.
* Monitor portfolio performance and identify opportunities to improve acquisition, activation, utilization, retention, revenue, profitability, and customer experience.

**Product Development & Digital Transformation**

* Lead the design and delivery of new products, product enhancements, and digital customer journeys from concept through implementation and post launch optimization.
* Define product requirements, customer journeys, business processes, and functional specifications in collaboration with Technology and Operations.
* Drive digital acquisition, onboarding, credit decisioning, fulfilment, servicing, and other initiatives to improve customer experience and operational efficiency.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, automate product journeys, improve turnaround times, and enhance digital capabilities.
* Partner with Technology, Data, and Analytics teams to leverage automation, AI, and advanced analytics to improve product performance and customer outcomes.

**Commercial & Financial Management**

* Establish product level financial objectives and monitor revenue, costs, profitability, portfolio growth, and key performance indicators.
* Develop business cases and financial models for new products, product enhancements, pricing changes, campaigns, and strategic initiatives.
* Recommend pricing, fees, promotions, and product economics that balance customer value, competitiveness, risk, and profitability.
* Monitor product P&L and identify opportunities to improve portfolio contribution and sustainable returns.

**Credit, Risk & Governance**

* Partner with Credit Risk to define and optimize product eligibility, underwriting, credit policy, risk appetite, and decisioning requirements.
* Monitor portfolio quality, delinquency, approval rates, utilization, attrition, and other relevant risk and performance indicators.
* Ensure products and product changes comply with approved risk appetite, credit policies, regulatory requirements, and internal governance frameworks.
* Work closely with Compliance, Legal, AML, Risk, and other control functions to ensure regulatory and operational requirements are addressed throughout the product lifecycle.
* Establish and lead product governance routines, including product performance reviews, roadmap reviews, and cross functional forums.
* Represent the function in relevant audits, regulatory reviews, governance committees, and discussions with card schemes, processors, vendors, and strategic partners.

**Product Marketing & Customer Growth**

* Partner with Marketing, Sales, and Distribution teams to develop product positioning, go to market strategies, campaigns, and customer acquisition initiatives.
* Develop strategies to improve customer acquisition, activation, engagement, utilization, retention, cross sell, and customer lifetime value.
* Use customer insights, behavioural data, and portfolio analytics to identify opportunities for targeted propositions and improved customer experiences.
* Monitor campaign and proposition performance and recommend improvements based on measurable business outcomes.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Work closely with Operations, Risk, Technology, Finance, Marketing, Compliance, Legal, AML, Data & Analytics, Collections, Sales, and other stakeholders to deliver customer centric solutions.
* Build strong relationships across the organization and influence stakeholders to achieve product objectives.
* Act as the subject matter expert for assigned products, providing guidance on product strategy, proposition, economics, customer journeys, and portfolio performance.

**Knowledge & Skill Requirements**

* Strong expertise in consumer financial product management, particularly credit cards, personal loans, instalment products, and other consumer lending solutions.
* Strong understanding of the complete product lifecycle, including proposition development, acquisition, onboarding, activation, usage, retention, and portfolio management.
* Strong understanding of consumer credit, underwriting, pricing, portfolio risk, and lending economics.
* Good knowledge of card issuing, card processing, payment schemes, digital lending, credit decisioning, and digital onboarding platforms.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to develop business cases, financial models, pricing strategies, and product performance analysis.
* Strong understanding of digital product development, customer experience, data analytics, AI, and automation.
* Strong analytical, project management, problem solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Good understanding of the UAE consumer finance and regulatory environment, including relevant CBUAE requirements and applicable card scheme requirements.

**Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Marketing, Technology, or a related discipline from a recognized university.
* Professional certification in Product Management, Agile, or a related discipline is preferred.
* Experience
* 10 to 12 years of progressive experience in product management within banking, consumer finance, fintech, payments, or related financial services.
* Strong experience managing consumer lending and/or card products across the complete product lifecycle.
* Proven track record of developing and launching products, enhancing existing propositions, and delivering measurable improvements in revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, or portfolio performance.
* Demonstrated experience in product strategy, roadmap development, pricing, business case development, and product performance management.
* Experience leading digital transformation initiatives involving digital acquisition, onboarding, credit decisioning, automation, or customer experience enhancement.
* Experience working cross functionally with Risk, Technology, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Compliance, and other control functions.
* Experience working within a regulated financial services environment, preferably within the UAE or GCC.
* Experience with card schemes, processors, lending platforms, digital banking ecosystems, or fintech partnerships will be an advantage.

B2C Debit, Product

Full Time

UAE

Lev Novak
  
  
**Description**
Tabby creates financial freedom in the way people shop, earn and save by reshaping their relationship with money. Over 25 million users choose Tabby to stay in control of their spending and make the most out of their money.
  
  
The company’s flagship offering allows shoppers to split their payments online and in-store with no interest or fees. Over 70,000 global brands and small businesses, including Amazon, Noon, IKEA, and SHEIN use Tabby to accelerate growth and gain loyal customers by offering easy and flexible payments online and in stores.
  
  
Tabby generates over $18 billion in annual transaction volume for its partner brands and is the highest-rated, most-reviewed, largest, and fastest-growing FinTech in the GCC region.
  
  
Tabby launched in 2019 and has since raised +$1 billion in equity and debt funding from global and regional investors, and is now valued at $6,5 billion.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager located (or ready for relocation) in the UAE to lead the development and growth of our P2P and local transfer products in Tabby Cash. Since our vision is to become a financial service for daily use, we need a passionate, driven individual to make sending money to friends and family a daily habit for millions of Tabby customers.
  
  
You will lead a dedicated team focused only on P2P and local transfers and work cross-functionally with engineering, design, data, marketing, legal, compliance and our banking partners to deliver a seamless and scalable experience in the UAE and KSA.
  
  
What you will be doing
  
  

* Own the strategy and roadmap for money moving between people inside the country: P2P between wallets, local bank transfers and instant payments.
* Launch new local payment rails and partner integrations end to end, from discovery and regulatory requirements to scale.
* Invent creative, viral social money mechanics that people love to use and share: request money, split the bill, QR, payment links and sending to people who don't have a wallet yet.
* Grow the network by turning millions of Tabby app users into active senders and recipients.
* Work closely with legal, compliance, risk and core banking teams so products meet local regulations and security standards without killing innovation, because we are about balance.
* Lead the launch of local transfers in KSA together with local partners.
* Shape how the team works together with the Team Lead: planning, rituals and a predictable delivery cadence.
* Set and track KPIs (senders, transfer frequency, recipients per user, retention) and run experiments to move them.
* Keep an ear to the ground on market trends, user behaviour and best-in-class P2P products to keep us ahead of the game.
* Plan launches with marketing and communications teams to ensure clear messaging and user adoption.

What you will need
  
  

* UAE residence or ready for relocation
* 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager with hands-on expertise in P2P payments, wallets, instant payments or mobile banking
* Proven track record of launching and growing consumer payment products with measurable results
* Experience delivering products with banks, payment rails or other regulated partners
* Resilience and ability to adapt to a rapidly changing environment
* Fluency in English

**Benefits**

* Ownership & Impact: A working environment that gives you autonomy and responsibility from day one.
* Culture: Collaborative, inclusive, and driven environment where your voice matters.
* Flexibility: Enjoy flexible working hours designed to optimize productivity and balance.
* Growth: Participate in the company’s employee stock options program and shape your career trajectory.
* Support: Comprehensive health insurance, generous PTO and a Flexible Benefits budget to meet your personal needs.

We are passionate about creating an inclusive, high-performing workplace that gives people from all backgrounds the support they need to thrive, grow, and meet their goals (whatever they may be).
  
  
If this sounds exciting to you, we’d love to hear from you!

You will own the end-to-end onboarding experience, from initial registration and account creation to identity verification, compliance approval and client activation. Your objective is to deliver seamless, secure, compliant and conversion-driven onboarding across web and mobile, while supporting multiple regulatory jurisdictions, products and business requirements.

This is a hands-on role requiring close collaboration with Engineering, Design, Compliance, Risk, Operations and business stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product ownership and strategy**

* Own the backlog and roadmap for registration, authentication and onboarding across CFD and Crypto platforms
* Define product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and business rules
* Prioritize by business impact, regulatory requirements, customer experience and technical dependencies
* Manage the full delivery lifecycle, from discovery and requirements through development, testing, release and optimization
* Ensure a consistent onboarding experience across web and mobile, while meeting product-specific requirements

**Client registration and authentication**

* Own registration and sign-in journeys: email, password, social authentication, OTP verification and account recovery
* Define requirements for session management, device management, authentication security and fraud prevention
* Optimize registration flows to minimize friction and abandonment while keeping appropriate security controls
* Manage account creation logic, duplicate account detection and client eligibility checks
* Support multiple brands, products and regulatory entities

**Client onboarding and verification**

* Design and optimize onboarding for retail clients and, where applicable, professional and corporate clients
* Own KYC requirements: identity verification, document collection, liveness checks and address verification
* Define onboarding questionnaires, suitability or appropriateness assessments, risk profiling and client declarations
* Manage onboarding statuses, rejection and resubmission scenarios, manual reviews and exception handling
* Coordinate integrations with third-party identity verification, KYC/AML and fraud prevention providers
* Communicate onboarding progress and next steps clearly to clients

**Regulatory and compliance integration**

* Work with Compliance and Legal to translate regulatory requirements into product functionality
* Support jurisdiction-specific requirements, including eligibility, regulatory entity assignment and disclosures
* Implement CFD- and Crypto-specific onboarding requirements
* Support AML, sanctions screening, PEP screening and enhanced due diligence workflows
* Ensure proper consent collection, data protection, audit trails and regulatory recordkeeping
* Coordinate regulatory changes and implement them on time across platforms

**Client experience and conversion optimization**

* Analyze onboarding funnels to identify friction points, drop-offs and opportunities for improvement
* Optimize registration completion, KYC approval and client activation rates
* Collaborate with UX/UI designers on intuitive, accessible onboarding experiences
* Define and monitor onboarding KPIs, dashboards and operational performance metrics
* Run experiments and evaluate improvements using quantitative and qualitative data
* Balance conversion optimization with regulatory compliance and risk management

**Qualifications & Skills**

* 4+ years as a Product Manager or Product Owner, preferably in FinTech, online brokerage, Crypto, banking or other regulated financial services
* Experience owning digital registration, authentication, KYC or client onboarding products
* Understanding of CFD brokerage and/or Crypto trading products and their onboarding requirements
* Familiarity with KYC, AML, sanctions screening, client classification and jurisdiction-specific regulatory requirements
* Experience integrating third-party services and working with APIs
* Strong understanding of web and mobile product development
* Proven ability to translate complex business and regulatory requirements into clear technical specifications and user stories
* Experience in Agile environments using tools such as Jira and Confluence
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills
* Excellent written and spoken English

**Why Join Us?**

* Work with an industry-leading global financial institution.
* Competitive salary and comprehensive employee benefits.
* Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
* Collaborative, inclusive, and dynamic work environment.
* Commitment to innovation and professional excellence.

jobs.title: Delivery Program Director
jobs.description:
Position Overview:

We are creating a new leadership role that brings Customer Success and Product Support together under one owner.

On the Customer Success side, you will be accountable for the full client experience after contract signature, from onboarding and go live through adoption, satisfaction and renewal.

On the Support side, you will have direct responsibility for the Product Support team and overall accountability for support service excellence. This includes defining support processes, driving continuous improvement initiatives, and coordinating with shared support and maintenance functions to ensure seamless collaboration and the delivery of reliable 24/7 customer support within SLA targets.

Your mandate is simple to state and demanding to deliver: every client should be well supported, getting real value from our products, and happy to recommend us. You will build the Customer Success function largely from the ground up, give the business a clear, data driven view of client health and raise the standard of our support operation.

The role is deliberately hands-on in the first year. Alongside building the team and the operating model, you will personally manage key customer relationships, lead critical escalations and work directly with the support team on day-to-day operations until the new processes and team are fully established.

Responsibilities:

**Lead Product Support**

* Define and run support processes covering triage, prioritization, SLAs, incident and problem management, root cause analysis and knowledge management, in close alignment with SaaS Operations and Engineering.
* Improve the speed and quality of incident and problem management, as well as how customers perceive it.
* Use monitoring, data and AI to move support from reactive to proactive, increasing self service and first contact resolution.
* Build a support model that scales with the customer base.

**Build and run the Customer Success function**

* Define and run the customer success operating model: customer segmentation and coverage, engagement playbooks, a common account plan and a customer health score.
* Set the rhythm of customer engagement, including onboarding reviews, regular service reviews, executive business reviews and renewal planning.
* Build a joint customer success model across SBS product lines and regions.

**Orchestrate the customer experience**

* Act as the single point of accountability for the customer experience across Support, Customer Success and delivery teams.
* Ensure customer experience responsiveness, predictability and transparency on incidents, releases and roadmap commitments.
* Own escalation management, personally leading critical escalations through to resolution and clear communication with the client.
* Work with Professional Services to ensure a smooth handover from project to run, so every go live lands well.

**Elevate customer satisfaction and retention**

* Run proactive health reviews and early risk detection, with clear recovery plans for accounts at risk.
* Own the voice of the customer: CSAT and NPS programs, app store ratings and structured feedback loops into Product.
* Contribute to the SBS Customer Satisfaction Program and embed the Golden Disciplines across customer-facing teams.
* Protect renewals by working with Account Managers well ahead of renewal dates, so there are no surprises.

**Maximize product adoption and realized value**

* Track usage and adoption across products and modules, and identify underused features and adoption gaps.
* Run adoption plans with customers to unlock more of the value they have already bought.
* Measure and demonstrate tangible ROI to client executives through regular value reviews.
* Bring structured customer insight into roadmap prioritization with Product Leaders.

**Surface growth opportunities**

* Identify new use cases, additional modules and upgrade opportunities within the installed base.
* Channel qualified upsell and expansion leads to Account Managers, and build a pipeline originated by the CSM team over time.

Qualifications:

* At least 10 years in enterprise software or fintech, including at least 5 years leading Customer Success, Support or Service Delivery teams.
* Strong track record in banking or financial services software, ideally in digital banking, open banking, payments or lending.
* Experience managing both SaaS and customer managed (on premise) clients, including SLA governance and major incident management.
* Credible with bank executives and comfortable leading difficult conversations when things go wrong.
* Experience across the Middle East and Africa, ideally with exposure to the US and Europe. Knowledge of the GCC banking market is a strong plus.
* Comfortable working in a matrix organization and influencing teams that do not report directly to them.
* Hands-on leader who can operate at executive level while confidently diving into the operational and technical details as required.
* Commercially astute, technically capable, and credible in banking conversations with both business and technology stakeholders.

Skills

* Operational discipline and a data driven approach to managing a client portfolio.
* Working knowledge of ITIL practices, support tooling such as Jira Service Management or ServiceNow, and customer success platforms such as Gainsight or equivalent.
* Technical enough to engage with Engineering on root causes across APIs, cloud platforms and mobile applications.
* Genuine interest in using AI and automation to improve support and customer success at scale.
* Strong understanding of banking operations, banking products and the realities of running software in regulated financial institutions.
* Clear, confident communicator in writing and in person.
* Fluent English. French or Arabic is an advantage.

Education

* Degree in business, engineering, computer science or a related field. ITIL or customer success certification is a plus.

Company Overview:

**Company Overview**

At SBS, we’re more than just a technology company, we’re a global fintech partner helping banks and financial institutions transform, innovate, and grow. With over 5,000 employees worldwide and clients in more than 80 countries, our solutions power everything from digital banking and lending to payments and core banking systems.

As part of **74Software**, we’re backed by a group of leading software companies delivering mission-critical solutions worldwide. Our focus is on delivering long-term value, leveraging cutting-edge technology, and fostering strong client partnerships. Join us and be part of a collaborative, forward-thinking team shaping the future of finance.

At SBS, we’re committed to supporting our employees in every aspect of their lives, from health and wellbeing to financial security and lifestyle perks.

We offer benefits that allow you to thrive at work and beyond, including health coverage, retirement plans, paid time off, flexible work, career development, competitive pay, and global culture perks.

We are committed to providing equal opportunities and ensuring a fair and inclusive recruitment process. We do not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, gender, sexual orientation, race, religion, or any other protected characteristic.

**Job Purpose:** To lead and manage the Trading and Structuring functions within Treasury, Asset Management & Global Markets, driving revenue growth through flow business, principal trading and structured solutions while ensuring compliance with approved limits, market risk parameters, regulatory requirements, and counterparty exposure guidelines.

* Develop flow business and directional principal trading strategies to maximize revenues.
* Identify and capitalize on market arbitrage opportunities.
* Develop and enhance AED spot, forward, and derivatives market-making capabilities.
* Execute transactions across approved asset classes within authorized limits.
* Build and maintain relationships with external pricing providers to secure optimal transaction pricing.
* Partner closely with the sales team to ensure timely and accurate pricing for client requirements.
* Provide term sheets for client transactions within agreed timelines.
* Ensure compliance with audit, regulatory, compliance, and AML requirements.
* Provide coaching, development, and on-the-job training to junior team members.
* Develop innovative solutions and trading ideas to support client requirements.
* Manage and hedge foreign exchange flow business exposures.
* Ensure product programs are established and maintained for all relevant products.
* Ensure appropriate trading and counterparty documentation is maintained, including ISDA, CSA, and Islamic agreements.
* Maintain adequate counterparty limits to facilitate effective risk management and hedging activities.

  

### **Requirements**

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Finance or a related discipline.
* Strong computer literacy.
* Minimum 10 years of experience within a bank treasury environment.
* Demonstrated experience in both flow and principal trading activities.
* Experience across Foreign Exchange (spot, forwards and options), Interest Rate Derivatives (IRS, FRA, IRO, futures), Commodity Hedging, and Structured Products.

jobs.title: Client Consulting Analyst
jobs.description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Overview:

Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) is the consulting arm of Visa and drives tangible, impactful results for clients. Drawing on our expertise in consulting, data analytics, technology, payments and economics, VCA solves the most strategic problems for our clients. The core client segments of VCA include issuers, acquirers, merchants, fintechs, payment enablers and governments.

Role Summary:

The Analyst for Digital, Strategy and AI supports the delivery of digital transformation, strategy and artificial intelligence (AI) engagements across the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) region.

  

The Digital, Strategy and AI Consulting practice is a team of experts specializing in strategy and digital transformation topics, including but not limited to:

Strategy:

* Defining business, segment, channel and functional strategies, such as digital banking, affluent banking, loyalty, open finance, stablecoins and artificial intelligence.

Ideation:

* Supporting the innovation agenda of clients through foresight, strategic trends research and co-creation activities.

Value proposition design:

* Developing holistic offerings, including products, services and customer experience, for strategic consumer, business and corporate customer segments.

Customer experience and engagement:

* Developing best-in-class digital customer journeys and engagement strategies, including digital onboarding, end-to-end digital journey transformation, digital channel benchmarking and user interface and user experience enhancement.

Performance analytics:

* Improving client performance and process efficiency by deploying data, digital and AI tools.

Digital delivery:

* Supporting clients with the implementation of digital strategies, including the design and development of digital channels, generative AI (GenAI) use cases and proofs of concept.

Key Responsibilities:

* As an Analyst, you will work within project teams under the guidance of senior consultants and managers, contributing to research, analysis and the development of client deliverables.
* Support the delivery of digital, strategy and AI projects across the GCC, from scoping through to final recommendations.
* Conduct market, competitor and customer research, including benchmarking and trends analysis, to inform client recommendations.
* Gather, clean and analyze data from Visa and industry sources to generate insights that support client recommendations.
* Contribute to the problem-solving process, including structuring analytical frameworks and developing insight-driven recommendations.
* Build business cases and financial models that measure business performance and quantify return on investment (ROI).
* Prepare clear and compelling client presentations and reports that communicate findings and recommendations.
* Support the preparation and running of client workshops and stakeholder sessions, and document findings, decisions and next steps.
* Track project workplans and deliverables, and keep the project leadership informed of progress, risks and issues.
* Collaborate with Visa Account Executives and the Product, Value-Added Services (VAS), Marketing and other internal teams to deliver integrated solutions as One Visa.
* Contribute to proposals and responses to requests for proposal (RFPs), as well as practice thought leadership, points of view and case studies.
* Help build reusable toolkits, templates and best practice documents that can be applied across the VCA practice.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* At least 2 years of work experience in management consulting, preferably on financial services, payments, digital or AI projects.
* Degree from a leading university, preferably in business, economics, engineering, computer science or a related field.
* Professional proficiency in English.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel, including building clear and compelling presentations, financial models and data analyses.
* Strong curiosity about AI, including GenAI and agentic AI, with hands-on experience using AI tools for research, analysis or content creation and an understanding of how to use them responsibly.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience working on projects in the GCC region.
* Exposure to digital transformation, strategy or digital banking projects.
* Knowledge of banking products, services, operations; payment schemes, services, card issuing and marketing initiatives.
* Strong interest in fintech and payments.
* Proficiency in Arabic is a plus.

What You Will Need to Be Successful:

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex problems and work with large data sets.
* Strong storytelling skills, with the ability to turn analysis into clear and compelling presentations.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Commercial awareness and an understanding of the financial indicators used to measure business performance.
* A collaborative, diplomatic and flexible working style, with the ability to work effectively in a matrixed organization.
* High attention to detail and a commitment to deliverables quality.
* Self-motivated and results-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines at the same time.
* Curiosity and a willingness to learn, take on feedback and develop new skills quickly.
* Ability to build strong working relationships with clients and colleagues.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

req39473

Relevant local language required (French, Spanish, German, Cantonese/Mandarin, Japanese, Portuguese, Hindi)

11/30/2026 (MM/DD/YYYY) at 11:59pm UTC

**Description**

At the **International Finance Corporation (IFC)**, a member of the **World Bank Group (WBG)**, you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. In fiscal year 2026, IFC committed a record $105.6 billion to private companies and financial institutions in developing countries. For more information, visit www.ifc.org.

The CFO and Capital Mobilization Vice Presidency, led by IFC’s Vice President and CFO, mobilizes private capital at scale to support clients that create jobs and drive growth in emerging markets. It brings together debt and equity mobilization, investor engagement, blended finance, and partnerships functions to expand the pool of capital available for development, while also overseeing the Corporation’s financial strategy and reporting, balance sheet management, and treasury functions. This prudent financial stewardship safeguards IFC’s AAA credit rating and ensures discipline, transparency, and alignment with institutional priorities.

Looking ahead, the VPU’s vision is to channel private capital into the sectors with the greatest potential to create jobs by embedding Originate-to-Distribute (OtD) approaches into IFC’s operating model, deepening and diversifying engagement with investors, donors, and development partners, and delivering innovative financial solutions that attract institutional capital to emerging markets. It will leverage data, technology, and market expertise to scale impact and improve efficiency.

As IFC continues to scale its impact and mobilize private capital at scale, in support of the WBG goal of creating jobs that lift people out of poverty, its ability to attract long term institutional investors to invest in IFC-originated emerging market assets has become increasingly central to its operating and financial model. In the context of heightened global uncertainty, constrained public resources, and rising development needs, effective engagement with institutional investors is critical to creating jobs, and sustaining and expanding development impact across emerging markets.

IFC’s originate-to-distribute and capital mobilization initiatives—including securitization, the Managed Co Lending Portfolio Program (MCPP), B Loan syndications, parallel loans, private equity funds and anchor bond investing, thematic bond issuances, blended finance facilities, and other structured mobilization vehicles—have expanded substantially in recent years, reflecting IFC’s strong focus on originating assets that both meet World Bank Group’s development mandate and are consistent with the investment preferences of institutional investors.

To support this strategically critical agenda, IFC is seeking Principal Investor Relations Officers in IFC’s Global Investor Relations function to work in collaboration with IFC’s originate-to-distribute (OtD) initiative and to help embed OtD into the operating model of IFC, by leading and strengthening IFC’s global investor engagement approach. The role will be to lead IFC’s critical institutional investor relationships, positioning IFC as a partner of choice for institutional investors while embedding scalable, best-in-class investor relationship management practices across the organization.

The Principal Investor Relations Officer will be responsible for deepening long-term investor relationships, expanding and diversifying IFC’s investor base, aligning investor mandates with IFC’s mobilization priorities, strengthening IFC’s visibility and credibility in global capital markets, integrating investor intelligence into institutional decision-making, and institutionalizing robust systems, governance, and standards for investor relationship management.

This vacancy announcement is for nine (9) positions posted across multiple duty stations. The selected candidates’ duty stations will be determined based on organizational requirements and business needs.

**Duties and Accountabilities:**

The selected candidate is responsible for performing activities in the following areas:

Own day-to-day IFC relationships with assigned Tier 1 and Tier 2 investors, under the Director’s executive sponsorship for the most significant relationships and expand participation in IFC-originated assets by connecting investor demand with IFC opportunities and the Originate-to-Distribute agenda.

**Relationship ownership & growth responsibilities:**

* Serve as accountable owner and primary point of contact for assigned investors. Where designated as geography Team Lead, lead and coordinate the other officers in the regional hub.
* Map investor interests and identify opportunities across IFC products, platforms and programs.
* Build trusted senior relationships and coordinate integrated engagement with product, regional, industry, transaction and country teams.
* Sponsor priority platforms, roadshows, investor education and external engagements for assigned relationships

**Planning, reviews & execution responsibilities:**

* Develop customized engagement plans, including strategic dialogues, co-investment discussions, site visits, reporting, events and investor education.
* Lead MOUs, frameworks, and commercial terms, subject to Legal clearance and authorized approval/signature.
* Lead onboarding and coordinate KYC and due diligence logistics.
* Conduct quarterly business and annual strategic reviews and maintain accurate Salesforce records and relationship updates.
* Support syndication and structuring teams while engaging with investors.

**Demand, risk & coordination responsibilities:**

* Capture risk appetite, pricing, tenor, sector interests and other actionable demand signals.
* Consolidate and propose relationship risk limits for funds, subsidiaries and insurers and assess financial sustainability.
* Communicate structured investor feedback to Syndications, with the OTD Analytical Team supporting consolidation and analysis.
* Advise underwriting and structuring on investor demand; designated authorities retain decisions. Participate occasionally in OtD or strategy meetings when relevant.
* Ensure that investor engagement activities are conducted in accordance with IFC policies, World Bank Group ethical standards, and applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
* Partner with Legal and Compliance teams on investor agreements, side letters, and co-investment arrangements.

**Selection Criteria**

* Master’s degree or MBA, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* A minimum of 12 years of relevant professional experience of increasing complexity and responsibility in institutional investor relations, capital markets, private markets, asset management, investment banking, or related areas.
* Extensive experience developing and managing senior-level relationships with institutiona

jobs.title: Business Head - Navi UPI
jobs.description:
**About Navi**

At Navi, our mission is to simplify finance for a billion people, through technology-first products built at scale.

Founded in 2018 by Sachin Bansal and Ankit Agarwal, Navi has grown rapidly across Loans, UPI, Insurance, Mutual Funds and Digital Gold – building products designed around speed, simplicity and customer experience.

Today, millions of customers use Navi for experiences like instant personal loans, fully digital home loan sanctions within minutes, low-cost mutual funds, instant credit lines in minutes and one of India’s fastest-growing UPI platforms.

**What makes Navi different is the way we build. We move fast, solve real customer problems and give people the ownership to create meaningful impact early in their journey.**

**Why Explore a Career at Navi?**

**Where Ownership Creates Real Impact**

At Navi, ownership starts early. People here are trusted to solve problems, make decisions and drive outcomes that directly shape the products and experiences used by millions of customers every day.

**Where Careers Accelerate**

Growth at Navi is driven by impact, not tenure. We strongly believe in promoting from within and creating opportunities for people to take on larger responsibilities as they grow. If you consistently raise the bar, you’ll find the space to grow quickly here.

**Where Great Talent Builds Together**

We take pride in building high talent-density teams where ambitious people learn from one another every day. Working on high-scale business and technology problems creates steep learning curves, fast execution cycles and opportunities to make visible impact throughout your journey.

**About the Team**

Since launching in August 2023, Navi UPI has grown from strength to strength to become India’s fourth-largest UPI TPAP. In a crowded market with large incumbents, Navi UPI has been able to capture a significant market share and win the loyalty of users on the back of a customer-first, product-led strategy. Our mission is clear: build on this foundation and become a leading and dominant player in India’s payments landscape.

**About the Role**

As Business Head, you will drive:

* The core acquisition engine of the group, bridging efforts across teams including product, growth, engineering, data and marketing; and
* The go-to-market strategy and execution of our to-be-launched PA (Payment Aggregator, i.e. merchant acquisition) business.

You will also act as the primary point of contact for our key partners and stakeholders including NPCI and work closely with our compliance, fraud, risk and engineering teams to ensure we deliver a stable and reliable experience to our customers. As a leader, you will be responsible for overseeing cross-functional efforts to build the Navi UPI user base, increase its loyalty and grow market share.

**What Makes You a Great Fit**

* Proven experience in driving outcomes in business, sales, operations or other generalist roles;
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and the ability to make data-driven decisions and measure impact / ROI;
* Entrepreneurial mindset and work ethic with high ownership and comfort operating in a 0-to-1 setup;
* Sharp attention to detail and a strategic mindset for long-term process optimisation;
* Ability to think outside the box and be comfortable dealing with unstructured problem statements;
* Exceptional leadership, team management, collaboration and communication skills; and
* Adaptability to navigate the evolving payments landscape, leveraging new trends and technologies to drive innovation.

**Soft Skills & Traits**

To succeed in this role, you will need to:

* Operate with speed, ownership and a builder mindset—constantly challenging the status quo to scale our UPI and, eventually, PA businesses;
* Lead end-to-end program management, ensuring timely delivery, execution excellence and speedy resolution of issues;
* Constantly design, execute and iterate experiments to test new ideas and identify the most effective approaches to drive business growth or cost optimisation;
* Leverage data to identify pockets of inefficiency and opportunity and influence stakeholders and leaders across the organisation;
* Partner with marketing, product, analytics, data science, FRS (Fraud Risk & Strategy), compliance and finance teams to ensure delivery of key business goals;
* Lead, manage and mentor a lean and dynamic team, and foster a culture of collaboration that ensures each team member contributes effectively to Navi's goals;
* Build and manage relationships with key stakeholders such as NPCI, PSP banks and other partners to ensure Navi UPI’s strategic goals are being met; and
* Collaborate with our FRS), Data and Engineering teams to drive our Trust & Safety (TnS) and reliability agendas.

**The Navi OS**

The Navi OS is our Operating System for how we work every day. Success at Navi is defined by living these core values.

* Start with the Customer
* Master the Details
* Act with Urgency
* Own the Outcome
* Build for a Decade - Not a Day
* Win as One

We hire talented individuals who already show these strengths, because those who share these values thrive at Navi and grow with the organisation.

To read more about the Navi OS, visit
navi.com/our-values

**Life at Navi**

Life at Navi is fast-paced, ambitious and deeply collaborative. Beyond work, teams come together through sports, celebrations, offsites, music jams, team outings and many more shared experiences that make the journey exciting and memorable.

We believe people do their best work when they feel supported, through flexible leave policies, strong health and wellness benefits, free financial, legal and medical consultations, ESOPs and a workplace designed for both productivity and well-being.

Whether it’s the sports turf, gym, focus zone or nap rooms, the campus is built to make everyday work more enjoyable.

If you’d like to know more about life at Navi, our culture and employee benefits, head to our careers page:
navi.com/careers/life-at-navi

If solving meaningful problems, building at scale and growing alongside ambitious teams excites you,

**Navi could be the place for you.**

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Bright Money**

Bright Money is a Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers. It brings together SaaS products to help consumers build credit, manage their debt, and get access to suitable loans and credit cards. These are the major financial needs of middle-income consumers living paycheck-to-paycheck.

Bright is a profitable, India-built, U.S.-market Consumer FinTech, with revenue trajectory to $100M in the coming 6 months. The business model combines subscription revenue with a financial service marketplace revenues, for loans, credit cards, and credit building tools.

Bright has launched an AI money assistant and AI agentic UX flows for access to credit. It will be the first AI-driven Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers.

The Bright product suite has potential for global markets beyond the US. The market size is 100M global middle-income consumers, with a revenue pool opportunity of $15B.

Bright is backed by 3 top global venture capital firms, and leading tech angel investors in the USA, Europe, and Asia.

Bright was founded in 2019 by a founding team from McKinsey’s Banking Practice (Petko Plachkov and Avi Patchava) and InMobi Data Scientists (Varun Modi and Avi Patchava). The core team is ex-InMobi Engineering and Data Sciences, recently joined by senior leaders from McKinsey. Bright is a data-driven, fast-paced execution culture that will build a Global Consumer FinTech, all functions operating from India.'

**What is the team & role about?**

We are hiring a Platform Product Manager - Banking Platform to own and scale core banking and money-movement platform capabilities that power multiple financial products. This role focuses on bank account lifecycles, payment rails, partner integrations, and regulatory-ready infrastructure, enabling product teams to build reliably and at scale.

This is a senior product leadership role combining deep platform ownership, people management, executive-level communication, and structured problem-solving. You will operate as a trusted partner to Engineering leadership and CXOs, translating complex technical and regulatory challenges into clear decisions and execution plans.

**What will you do?**

**Product Ownership & Strategy**

* Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for one or more Banking Services platform domains (e.g., account onboarding, verification, bank transfers, settlements).
* Define clear product goals, success metrics, and trade-offs across reliability, compliance, and feature delivery.
* Manage the full product lifecycle—from discovery and requirements to launch, adoption, and optimization.

**Banking Infrastructure & Money Movement**

* Drive platform capabilities supporting bank account lifecycles and money movement (e.g., ACH equivalents, local bank transfers, instant payments, reconciliation workflows).
* Lead integrations with banking partners, payment processors, and financial infrastructure providers.
* Ensure strong handling of edge cases such as failures, retries, reversals, exceptions, and settlements.

**Compliance, Risk & Resilience**

* Translate regulatory, scheme, and partner constraints into clear platform requirements (e.g., auditability, controls, data retention, reporting).
* Partner with Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Operations to ensure controls are embedded into platform design.
* Drive platform resilience designing for partner outages, degraded modes, and recovery scenarios.

**Execution & Delivery**

* Write high-quality PRDs and platform requirements that engineers can execute against with clarity.
* Prioritize across run-the-business work, platform improvements, and new enablement initiatives.
* Lead cross-functional execution across multiple engineering teams.

**Stakeholder & Internal Customer Experience**

* Act as the product owner for internal consumers of the platform (Product, Engineering, Ops).
* Improve developer and internal product team experience through clear APIs, documentation, and self-serve capabilities.
* Communicate progress, risks, and decisions clearly to senior leadership.

**Ideal candidate profile looks like?**

**Experience & Background:**

* 5 - 12 years of Product Management experience, with strong exposure to backend, platform, or infrastructure products.
* Prior people management experience, including mentoring or managing Product Managers
* Exposure to high-scale, high-availability systems with strict SLAs.
* Strong understanding of APIs, distributed systems, data platforms, and cloud architectures.
* Strong systems thinking and technical fluency, comfortable working deeply with engineers on architecture and trade-offs.

**Mindset & Operating DNA:**

* Experience defining and using KPIs/OKRs to drive prioritization and outcomes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Proven ability to manage complex dependencies and cross-functional stakeholders.

**Non-Fit Profiles:**

* Domain experts without Platform Ownership experience.
* PMs from Low-Scale or Low-Reliability Environments.
* Product Managers without deep technical depth.
* Pure UI/ UX-First Product Managers.
* Program Manager or Project Managers.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience building internal platforms or developer-facing products.
* Exposure to global-scale, high-availability systems.
* Experience in fintech, banking, payments, or other regulated systems.

**What Bright Offers?**

* A profitable sub-unicorn with U.S. market scale – liquidity potential at $1–3B valuations.
* Real ownership: You run your own BU with an independent P&L.
* Wealth creation: Equity at an inflection stage of scale.
* A data-driven, high-cadence culture that combines consulting rigor with FinTech speed.
* Location flexibility: 5 days from the Bangalore office in a week
