jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - AI Platforms, Director
Vice President, Finance Data Product Management – P&L
jobs.description:
The VP, Finance Data Product Owner – P&L Data (India) is the execution lead for the P&L data product agenda on
**One Data Foundation**
, supporting the VP, Global Data Product Owner – P&L. The role starts with
**Revenue and Expense Accrual**
data and sits where Finance, Accounting and Technology meet. It works day to day with data producers, consumers and P&L process owners’ teams, and turns the Global Product Owner’s priorities into certified, reusable data products.
  
  
The leader works with process owners to understand how the data is used and what outcome it supports and documents the manual processes and adjustments on both the production and consumption sides. The goal is to raise productivity and efficiency and keep the data products golden by reducing manual manipulation and point-to-point sourcing. The role builds
**governance by design**
(CDEs, definitions, ownership, lineage, DQ rules and controls) into each product and uses AI and automation to modernize a largely waterfall and manual delivery lifecycle.
  
  
*The Global Data Product Owner sets product strategy, priorities, the portfolio roadmap and senior stakeholder agreements. This role executes, recommends and escalates. Controllers, Global Accounting and FP&A own the process and the reported numbers, and Technology owns engineering and production operations.*
**Key Accountabilities**

* Bridge Producers and Consumers
* Be the working-level link between upstream accrual data producers and downstream consumers, so issues are raised once, routed to the right producer and tracked to closure.
* Partner with P&L process owners’ teams (Controllers, Global Accounting, FP&A and other consumers) to understand how they use the data and the outcome they need. Surface pain points and new needs early to the Global Product Owner.
* Draft and maintain producer–consumer terms: definitions, scope, frequency, granularity, quality thresholds, ownership and issue handling, for approval by the Global Product Owner.
* Support the consumer forum by preparing the agenda and facts, and make differences in how consumers interpret or override the same data visible.
* Understand and Reduce Manual Work
* Document the manual processes, adjustments and overrides on the production and consumption sides of each in-scope P&L process. Quantify the effort and find the root causes.
* Recommend and drive fixes: move adjustments upstream or into the product so they are made once and governed, remove spreadsheet dependencies, and stop point-to-point sourcing. Priorities are agreed with the Global Product Owner.
* Use AI and automation to speed requirements, metadata, CDE identification, lineage, DQ rules, documentation and testing, within agreed controls.
* Execute the P&L Data Products
* Run day-to-day delivery of the accrual data products. Maintain the backlog, define requirements, and work with architecture and engineering on sources, transformations, business rules and lineage.
* Prepare each product for certification: definitions, CDEs, lineage, DQ rules and controls complete, reconciled to the authoritative source, and confirmed to meet accounting requirements.
* Fix issues at the source with producers, strengthen reconciliation, and maintain a shared business glossary.
* Publish and reuse on One Data Foundation, enhancing existing products before creating new ones, and support retiring legacy sources and BI reports in favor of certified data.
* Report, Escalate and Lead
* Give the Global Product Owner clear, regular updates on progress, risks and decisions needed. Escalate early and prepare materials for senior stakeholder discussions.
* Work across time zones with agreed overlap hours, documented handoffs and clear written follow-up.
* Guide and develop team members in India as the work grows.

**Required Qualifications**

* Significant banking or financial services experience in Finance, Accounting or P&L functions.
* Strong working knowledge of revenue and/or expense accruals, accounting concepts, controls and reconciliations.
* Solid grasp of data lineage, quality and governance principles, with the ability to analyze and validate data independently (for example, SQL) and reconcile it to source.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to analyze manual processes and adjustments to find root causes and efficiency opportunities.
* Experience working between business and technology teams, with the ability to influence without direct authority and work effectively with global stakeholders across time zones.
* Clear written and verbal communication that explains data issues in terms of business impact.
* Demonstrated curiosity and a record of improving ways of working through automation or AI.

**Preferred**

* Hands-on experience with Databricks, Power BI or similar platforms; working knowledge of SQL and data modeling.
* Exposure to billing, revenue or general ledger systems and how they integrate with reporting platforms.
* Experience with platform migration or re-engineering programs, and with leading complex, multi-team work.
* Familiarity with GenAI or machine learning use cases in Finance, and agile or product ownership experience.
* Background in regulated or audit-sensitive environments, including regulatory and external reporting.
* Professional qualification (CA, CPA, CFA) or a degree in Finance, Accounting, Data or a related field.

MEASURES OF SUCCESS
  
  

* Delivery: accrual data products prepared and certified against the agreed plan, with documented producer–consumer terms.
* Manual work: manual processes and adjustments documented for each in-scope P&L process, with a measurable reduction in manual manipulation, spreadsheet dependencies and point-to-point feeds.
* Consistency and reuse: one agreed definition per P&L measure, more consumers on the certified products, and fewer report-level overrides.
* Issue efficiency: fewer duplicate issues sent to producers and faster resolution.
* Reliability: timely updates, early escalation and clean handoffs, as rated by the Global Product Owner.
* Partnership: process owners and producers report the role is fair, responsive and effective.

LEADERSHIP PROFILE AND CANDIDATE CALIBRATION
  
  

* Bridge-builder mindset (most important)

****What Good Looks Like****
Sits between producers and consumers by choice. Explains each side’s constraints to the other, gets both to commit to a shared agreement, and follows up until it holds.
  
  
**Watch-outs in candidates**
Acts as a requirements taker or a ticket router. Describes the role as “gathering requirements” or “sending tickets.”
  
  

* Curious about the manual work

****What Good Looks Like****
Wants to see how consumers really use the data and finds the adjustments and spreadsheets behind it. Asks why until the root cause is clear.
  
  
**Watch-outs in candidates**
Accepts manual adjustments as normal. Reports what people do without asking why.
  
  

* Ownership of execution

****What Good Looks Like****
Acts as an owner, not an order-taker. Follows through, flags problems early and keeps the Global Product Owner informed without being asked.
  
  
**Watch-outs in candidates**
Waits for detailed direction or makes portfolio-level commitments without agreement from the Global Product Owner.
  
  

* Reuse-first and governance by design

****What Good Looks Like****
Defaults to one certified source and one definition. Builds CDEs, lineage, DQ rules and controls in as the product is built. Challenges point-to-point feeds and local copies.
  
  
**Watch-outs in candidates**
Builds a new dataset for each request. Treats governance as a separate sign-off step.
  
  

* Curious and AI-forward

****What Good Looks Like****
Questions waterfall and manual ways of working. Experiments with AI and automation and keeps controls intact.
  
  
**Watch-outs in candidates**
Defends the current process. Views AI as hype or as a replacement for judgment.
  
  

* Works well across time zone

**Job Summary**

* Own the Cash product agenda across the Digital channels, with strategic accountability for translating Cash and Payments priorities into scalable capabilities across Host-to-Host (H2H), SWIFT and Common Channel Services (CCS).
* Lead the development, prioritisation and commercialisation of channel capabilities and features, ensuring investment is anchored in clear client use cases, measurable commercial value, regulatory needs and end-to-end client outcomes.
* Lead and develop a team of Product Owners to convert strategy into an executable global roadmap and deliver consistent, secure and reusable Cash Digital capabilities across markets, client segments and connectivity models.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy, portfolio and business partnership**

* Own the global Cash channel strategy and roadmap across Web, H2H, SWIFT and CCS, aligning country, regional and global demand to business priorities.
* Act as the senior Channels counterpart to Cash Product heads and represent the portfolio in senior governance, investment and prioritisation forums.
* Partner with global, regional and country Cash Product heads to understand business, client and product priorities in every market.
* Manage senior stakeholders across global product and country management, Channels and Technology, setting expectations on scope, timing and trade-offs. Make transparent trade-offs across growth, client commitments, regulatory or scheme deadlines, resilience, simplification and platform modernisation.

**Product execution and prioritisation**

* Own the global Cash backlog for Channels and rank demand using commercial value, client impact, regulatory urgency, risk, effort and delivery feasibility.
* Lead the working relationship between Cash, country, Channel Product and Technology teams to agree scope, dependencies, release plans and accountable outcomes.
* Run one intake process for all demand, sorting each request, assess client requests tied to mandates /RFPs and implementation deadlines, track regulatory requirements against deadlines.
* Apply a clear prioritisation framework, ringfence capacity across regulatory, client driven scope on revenue and client priority, and sequence delivery. Spot common needs across markets to deliver them as global capabilities.
* Maintain executive oversight of multiple initiatives running in parallel across markets, products and channels, keep a portfolio view of status, risks, milestones and cross-channel dependencies, intervening early where delivery or value is at risk.

**Client insight, proposition and commercialisation**

* Build evidence-based country and client use cases covering target segments, revenue and volumes at stake, adoption barriers, competitive gaps and the cost of not acting.
* Define differentiated value propositions and commercialisation plans for new capabilities, partnering with Sales, Implementation, Onboarding and Client Service to drive launch readiness and adoption.
* Track adoption, transaction volumes, client feedback and realised benefits after launch, using insights to refine the proposition and roadmap.

**Cross-channel capability and solution leadership**

* Translate Cash and Payments needs into end-to-end capabilities spanning digital journeys, entitlements, approvals, connectivity, formats, payment status and reporting.
* Guide solutioning across H2H connectivity (SFTP, AS2 and HTTPS), SWIFT channels (FileAct, FIN and gpi), ISO 20022 messages and legacy or local clearing formats.
* Promote reusable components, standard formats and common services while safeguarding security, resilience, sanctions, fraud, accessibility and regulatory requirements.

**People and talent**

* Lead, coach and develop Product Owners, translating strategy into clear objectives and allocating capacity to the highest-value work.
* Build strategic, commercial, client and channel depth across the team, strengthening prioritisation, stakeholder management, product discipline and succession capacity.
* Role-model the Bank’s valued behaviours, sound risk judgement, constructive feedback, inclusion, wellbeing and accountability.

**Risk, controls and governance**

* Embed product, operational, information security, regulatory and conduct requirements throughout discovery, design, delivery, release and post-launch review.
* Ensure material decisions, exceptions, residual risks and control dependencies are appropriately governed and documented.
* Maintain accurate client-facing specifications, user guidance, release notes, testing support and migration plans for new or changed capabilities.

**Skills And Experience**
**Must-have Skills**

* Cash and Payments Product Strategy
* Digital Channels and Corporate Connectivity
* Product Commercialisation and Value Proposition

**Other Skills**

* Portfolio Prioritisation and Investment Discipline
* Client and Market Insight
* Senior Stakeholder Influence
* People Leadership and Product Team Development

**Motivations**

* Shaping client-channel strategy and turning complex Cash and Payments needs into scalable propositions with visible commercial and client value.
* Leading across business, product and technology boundaries to resolve competing priorities and deliver high-impact outcomes across markets.
* Building empowered Product Owner teams that combine deep channel expertise with strategic thinking, disciplined execution and strong client focus.

**Qualifications**
**Key Experiences**

* 15+ years of senior-level experience in Transaction Banking, Cash Management, Payments or enterprise digital channels, including product strategy, proposition development, commercialisation and execution.
* Deep experience in corporate connectivity and more than one client channel, with working knowledge of H2H, SWIFT, APIs and corporate Web banking.
* Strong Cash and Payments domain understanding across domestic and cross-border payments, real-time and bulk payments, payroll, receivables, liquidity, statements and reporting.
* Working command of ISO 20022 payment and reporting messages, legacy MT formats, local clearing formats, and ERP or treasury management system integration.
* Demonstrated experience building business cases, prioritising investments and managing multiple initiatives across countries, products and channels.
* Strong experience in Portfolio management at scale, running a large backlog with many initiatives in parallel, while sharing limited delivery capacity across countries and demand types.
* Proven leadership of Product Owners or Product Managers and senior-level influence across Product, Sales, Technology, Operations, Risk and Compliance.

**Certifications / Qualifications (only where mandatory):**
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in business, finance, engineering, computer science or a related discipline. No role-specific certification is mandatory.
  
  
**Languages:**
English: professional fluency. Additional languages are advantageous where relevant to the role’s market coverage.
  
  
**About Standard Chartered**
We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.
  
  
Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
* In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
* Core bank funding

You’ll own lending operations end to end: designing the loan product, setting up the credit rules, launching the app and running every loan from application to repayment. You’ll also build collections from day one and hire a small team to run it all.

* Test the app end to end and launch it with technology vendors
* Run the full loan lifecycle: onboarding, KYC, verification, disbursement and repayment
* Set up collections and recovery, tracking DPD buckets in line with RBI fair practices
* Hire and lead a lean team across operations, customer support and collections
* Work with marketing on low-cost customer acquisition and repeat borrowing
* Report on disbursements, collections and NPAs, and keep operations compliant with the RBI Digital Lending Directions

**What You Need**

* 5–9 years in digital lending at an NBFC, fintech or LSP
* Hands-on experience with app-based, salary-advance or short-term unsecured loans
* Experience designing lending products or building a BRE or credit rules
* A collections track record, with numbers you can share
* A good grasp of delinquency, GNPA and collection efficiency

**Why join**
Real ownership, a seat close to the founders, and equity or profit share as the business grows.

* Worked in an agile environment or on the scrum methodology
* Passion for cryptocurrency, financial markets, and the CoinDCX mission

* Recruiter Connect – A short conversation to understand you better
* Functional Round(s) – Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem-solving

**Bengaluru**

Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering | Technology Delivery Leadership — Azure Cloud, Web Applications, Salesforce, and Payments
jobs.description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a seasoned technology leader to serve as Senior Manager, Software Engineering. This role is accountable for end-to-end delivery across Azure Cloud, modern web applications, Salesforce, and payment platforms. The successful candidate will combine strong technical expertise with disciplined execution, build high-performing engineering teams, and coordinate complex initiatives across multiple functions and geographies. This leader will translate business priorities into scalable technology outcomes while strengthening engineering practices, operational resilience, security, and accountability.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end execution: Own planning, architecture alignment, engineering delivery, testing, release readiness, production launch, and post-production stabilization for a portfolio of strategic initiatives.
* Drive multi-platform delivery: Provide leadership across Azure Cloud services, web application ecosystems, Salesforce capabilities and integrations, and payment processing platforms.
* Translate strategy into outcomes: Partner with product, business, architecture, security, risk, operations, and infrastructure leaders to convert priorities into roadmaps, executable plans, and measurable results.
* Strengthen engineering excellence: Champion scalable architecture, secure coding, automation, CI/CD, observability, performance engineering, reliability, and disciplined software development lifecycle practices.
* Build high-performing teams: Recruit, develop, coach, and retain engineers; establish clear expectations, empower decision-making, and create succession and capability-development plans.
* Coordinate globally: Align teams, vendors, dependencies, and stakeholders across multiple geographies and time zones, ensuring clear ownership, effective handoffs, and timely escalation of risks and decisions.
* Manage delivery health: Establish transparent governance for scope, schedule, quality, budget, capacity, dependencies, risks, and technical debt; use metrics to guide decisions and continuous improvement.
* Own operational outcomes: Ensure platforms meet availability, resilience, security, compliance, recovery, and support expectations; lead effective incident response and root-cause remediation.
* Influence technology direction: Evaluate emerging technologies, guide build-versus-buy decisions, and shape modernization plans that balance innovation, maintainability, cost, and risk.
* Communicate with impact: Provide concise, data-driven updates to senior leaders and stakeholders, surfacing trade-offs and enabling timely decisions.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Proven technology delivery experience, including significant experience leading engineering teams across multiple projects/initiatives in parallel.
* Demonstrated success delivering complex, enterprise-scale programs from concept through production and ongoing operations.
* Strong working knowledge of Azure Cloud architecture and services, cloud-native design, integration patterns, APIs, and DevSecOps practices.
* Experience overseeing modern web application delivery, including front-end, back-end, security, performance, accessibility, and production support considerations.
* Experience with Salesforce platforms, custom development, integrations, release management, and governance.
* Experience with payment ecosystems, including transaction flows, integrations, reconciliation, resiliency, security, and regulatory or control requirements.
* Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams, resolve cross-team dependencies, and lead distributed teams across geographies.
* Strong financial, vendor, resource, risk, and change-management capabilities.
* Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and decision-making skills.

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

5. Configure and troubleshoot integrations with Panorama, FortiManager, Check Point Management Server, and other supported platforms.

6. Perform hands-on administration and troubleshooting of enterprise firewalls, including firewall policies, NAT, VPN, routing, security zones, and access rules.

Mandatory Technical Skills

* Hands-on deployment and administration of AlgoSec ASMS.
* Strong working knowledge of AFA, FireFlow, and AppViz.
* Experience integrating AlgoSec with multi-vendor firewall environments.
* Experience with policy analysis, network mapping, application connectivity, and risk assessment.
* Practical experience with AlgoSec upgrades, migrations, and troubleshooting.

* Ability to analyze traffic flows and troubleshoot network connectivity issues.

* Basic Linux administration and troubleshooting skills.

  

Preferred Qualifications

* Certifications such as PCNSE, CCNP Security, CCIE, Check Point CCSA/CCSE, or Fortinet FCP/FCSS.
* Experience working with banking, telecom, government, or large enterprise environments.
* Knowledge of AWS/Azure network security.
* Familiarity with REST APIs, scripting, and automation.
* Experience handling multiple customer implementations independently.

jobs.title: Manager - Technology & Engineering
jobs.description:
We are looking for experienced professionals who have spent years proving themselves but haven't always received the recognition they deserve. We don't necessarily want people with impressive designations, big corporate titles, or fancy resumes. We want people with real skills, strong execution capabilities, fresh ideas, and an ownership mindset.

**Your skills deserve more than just a designation**

* Have you ever been the person who solves the toughest technical problems, builds systems from scratch, keeps things running, and makes technology work, yet rarely gets the recognition you deserve?
* We believe great technology professionals aren't defined by their job titles. They are defined by what they build, what they solve, and the impact they create.
* We are looking for an experienced, ambitious, and technically strong professional who wants to take ownership of technology and engineering initiatives and help build something meaningful.

**What will you be responsible for?**

* Develop and drive the organization's technology and engineering roadmap.
* Oversee software development, technical infrastructure, and technology implementation.
* Lead and coordinate engineering teams and technology initiatives.
* Build scalable, secure, and efficient systems and processes.
* Identify opportunities for automation, AI integration, and digital transformation.
* Establish engineering standards, development processes, and quality benchmarks.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and implement relevant solutions.
* Collaborate with business teams to translate business requirements into technology solutions.
* Manage technology projects, timelines, resources, and implementation.
* Take ownership of technology performance, innovation, and continuous improvement.

**What are we looking for?**

* 7-10 years of experience in technology, software engineering, technical operations, or technical program management.
* Strong understanding of software development and modern technology infrastructure.
* Experience managing technology initiatives and engineering teams.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms, APIs, databases, cybersecurity, and system architecture.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to independently make decisions and execute ideas.
* An ownership mindset and a passion for building rather than merely maintaining.

**What does success look like?**

* Reliable, scalable, and efficient technology infrastructure.
* Successful execution of engineering initiatives.
* Improved engineering productivity.
* Effective automation and technology integration.
* Reduced operational inefficiencies.
* Technology that contributes directly to business growth.

**This is not a conventional salary-based opportunity. We believe those who help build value should have the opportunity to participate in that value.**

Our compensation structure is designed around:

* Revenue Sharing: Participation through mutually agreed revenue-sharing arrangements, subject to defined terms and performance parameters.
* ESOPs: Employee Stock Option opportunities, subject to eligibility, company policy, vesting, and applicable terms.
* Ownership: The opportunity to influence technology decisions, build systems, and take meaningful functional responsibility.

**Who should apply?**

Someone who has spent years building technology for others and is now ready to help build something they can genuinely take ownership of. If you have the experience, the capability, and the hunger to prove what you can do, we want to hear from you.

jobs.title: Business Head
jobs.description:
**About SmartQ:**

SmartQ is redefining how the world experiences food. As a next-generation food-tech innovator, we solve real operational challenges through empathy-led insights and powerful technology. Our mission is clear: to elevate everyday dining into a seamless and meaningful experience.

In the last decade, we’ve transformed cafeteria and food operations across industries with scalable, cutting-edge solutions. Operating in 14 countries and backed by Compass Group- a $60B global foodservice leader SmartQ continues to push the boundaries of what modern food-tech can achieve.

Since our inception in 2015, we’ve become a trusted partner for corporates, hospitals, universities, and food courts worldwide. With a bold vision to become the world’s largest B2B food-tech company, we connect people through exceptional food experiences powered by advanced technology. Today, we proudly serve 400+ global clients, including leaders like Google, HSBC, Amazon, and Wells Fargo.

At the heart of SmartQ is a culture shaped by four core pillars:

**Great People | Great Food | Great Experience | Greater Good**

These values inspire collaboration, innovation, humility, and a relentless pursuit of excellence.

To dive deeper into what drives us, explore our cultural pillars on the SmartQ LinkedIn ‘Life’ page. It offers an authentic glimpse into the journey you could be part of: https://www.linkedin.com/company/smartq-bottlelabs/life/cdc290f8-ff81-4e7f-9c96-37d842f936c4/?viewA…

**Are you excited to join our team as Business Head?**

As a Business Head at SmartQ you will be spearheading the development of new business, setting the course for other business verticals to follow, executing high-level business strategies, and championing the pursuit of organizational excellence. Your expertise will be crucial in defining and realizing our global aspirations, driving sustainable growth, and ensuring our position as a leader in the industry.

We are looking for a dynamic professional with strong operational expertise and proven leadership

experience who can make a meaningful impact on our expanding business presence. If you are eager to contribute to the evolving world of food and technology and possess the skills to lead with excellence, we would be delighted to have you join our team.

**Roles and responsibilities:**

* Develop and execute comprehensive business strategies aligned with the company’s vision, objectives, and long-term growth plans within the F&B industry.
* Conduct in-depth market analysis to identify emerging trends, customer preferences, and new business opportunities, enabling the organization to maintain a strong competitive advantage.
* Manage end-to-end operations of the F&B business unit, ensuring seamless coordination across departments and delivering operational excellence.
* Streamline operational processes and implement efficiency-driven initiatives to enhance productivity, optimize resource utilization, and reduce operational costs.
* Lead financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and P&L management to achieve revenue growth, profitability, and financial sustainability targets.
* Lead, mentor, and develop high-performing teams by fostering collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning to ensure individual and organizational success.
* Promote a positive and customer-focused workplace culture that encourage teamwork, innovation, and superior service delivery.
* Identify and pursue new business expansion opportunities across existing and untapped markets while collaborating with sales and marketing teams to strengthen business development and accelerate revenue generation.
* Monitor key business metrics, operational KPIs, and financial performance to ensure continuous improvement and achievement of organizational goals.
* Ensure compliance with industry regulations, quality standards, food safety protocols, and company policies across all business operations

**Qualifications:**

* Proven 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in the food services or F&B industry, with a strong track record of driving business growth, operational excellence, and profitability in high-performance environments.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Management, Hospitality, or a related discipline from a recognized institution.
* Demonstrated success in leading large-scale business operations, managing cross-functional teams, and delivering strategic initiatives in a senior leadership capacity.
* Exceptional strategic thinking, business acumen, and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to make data-driven decisions in fast-paced and dynamic environments.
* Strong leadership, stakeholder management, communication, and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence teams, partners, and senior management effectively.
* Sound financial expertise with proven experience in budgeting, forecasting, P&L management, cost optimization, and revenue enhancement strategies.
* Deep understanding of the food services industry, market trends, customer behavior, operational best practices, and competitive business landscapes.

**Message from CEO:**

Food is an everyday necessity, but the experience around it can influence how we feel, connect, and go about our day. At SmartQ, we see an opportunity to make these everyday moments better, one meal at a time. Our aggregation model, powered by technology and operational excellence, brings together food partners, processes, and people to transform dining experience. By combining these capabilities, we continuously seek better ways to solve problems, improve efficiency, and create experiences that are simpler, smarter, and more human. As we continue to redefine this space, we believe the next breakthrough can come from anyone who questions convention, sees possibilities where others see routine, and brings a fresh perspective to a familiar challenge.

We look forward to welcoming minds who will challenge our thinking and help shape what SmartQ becomes next. We invite you to be that person. Together, let’s make everyday experiences extraordinary.

jobs.description:
Leads the strategic vision and roadmap for a digital product or products within a specific business area, demonstrating a deep understanding of the digital product(s). Digital products may have enterprise-wide implications.
  
  
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Product Manager, Specialist role is responsible for leading digital product management initiatives, overseeing the development, implementation, and optimization of strategic products. This role requires close collaboration with cross-functional teams to enhance customer experience, define product roadmaps, and drive business growth. The specialist ensures smooth product execution, manages escalations, and employs data-driven insights to refine product strategies. Additionally, they work with stakeholders to align product goals with business objectives and market needs.
  
  
This Product Manager will lead enhancements to the customer service and contact center tools used by our crew to serve clients, including the integration of AI capabilities
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead digital product management efforts for multiple digital products or one strategic product, ensuring alignment with business goals.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement best practices that enhance the customer experience and drive impactful changes.
* Coach digital product teams on best practices, learnings, and product development methodologies to maximize efficiency.
* Partner with stakeholders to resolve production and implementation issues promptly, supporting escalations when needed to enable rapid delivery.
* Oversee the planning, development, and execution of new digital products, including market analysis, feature definition, and implementation planning.
* Develop pricing and positioning strategies, ensuring products are competitive and aligned with market demand.
* Utilize qualitative and quantitative analysis techniques to continually improve the user experience and optimize product performance.
* Translate product strategy into detailed requirements and prototypes, collaborating with engineering teams to ensure timely and resource-efficient delivery.
* Lead product launches by working closely with marketing teams, executives, and other product management stakeholders to drive successful go-to-market strategies.
* Evaluate promotional plans to ensure consistency with product line strategies and effective messaging across customer segments.
* Participate in ongoing business planning, departmental prioritization activities, and special projects as required.
* Lead the modernization of contact-center desktop capabilities and supporting tools to improve the experience of contact-center staff and participants while enabling stronger customer relationships.
* Coordinate dependencies across multiple applications and product teams by understanding interconnected roadmaps, managing delivery trade-offs, and balancing technical constraints with speed to market.

**Qualifications And Skills**

* Minimum 8 years of related work experience, with at least two years of experience leading large cross-functional teams on major organizational projects.
* Bachelor’s degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Computer Science or IT, or Bachelor’s in Computer Applications (BCA), or Master’s in Computer Applications (MCA).
* Strong expertise in digital product management, market analysis, and user experience optimization.
* Proven ability to translate customer insights into product improvements and new features.
* Experience working with engineering teams to drive product development from concept to launch.
* Excellent strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities to align product strategy with business goals.
* Experience in a contact-center or service environment, including familiarity with contact-center operations, desktop platforms, and the tools that support customer-service teams.
* Demonstrated ability to manage cross-product dependencies and collaborate with multiple product managers; financial-services experience is preferred but not mandatory, and relevant banking or healthcare customer-service systems experience may be considered.

**Location**
This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
  
  
**Our mission**
Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
  
  
**Our commitment to you**
Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
  
  
**Financial wellness**
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
  
  
**Physical wellness**
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
  
  
**Personal wellness**
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
  
  
**How We Work**
Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

The Manager, IT Delivery is responsible for leading high-performing data and technology teams and delivering strategic data initiatives that generate measurable business value.
  
  
This role combines people leadership, product delivery, stakeholder management, and operational oversight. The manager will lead teams operating across data engineering, data platforms, data warehousing, data lakes, data governance, data quality, and analytics.
  
  
The manager will have end-to-end accountability for the development, delivery, maintenance, production support, reliability, and continuous improvement of data products. The successful candidate will bring strong leadership and communication capabilities, experience managing product-oriented teams, and a sound understanding of modern data ecosystems. The role requires the ability to translate business priorities into executable delivery plans, develop engineering talent, manage delivery commitments, and ensure the scalability, quality, security, and reliability of data solutions.

* Manage capacity planning, resource forecasting, delivery commitments, risks, issues, and cross-team dependencies to enable predictable execution.

* Promote effective data governance, data quality, metadata management, lineage, ownership, and stewardship practices.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management, Context Engine
jobs.description:
**Our Company:**
At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
As Director of Product Management, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes for the capabilities that let Teradata's Enterprise Context Engine understand customer data on its own: schema and ontology discovery, natural language processing, and AI driven workflow and policy extraction. The Context Engine extracts, curates, and continuously improves metadata and business context, grounded in Teradata's industry knowledge models, so that human analysts move faster and AI agents are grounded in trusted enterprise meaning.
  
  
You will serve as the Context Engine's senior product leader in the region and partner closely with local engineering, data science, and architecture teams along with product and engineering leaders across the US. You will set direction, make prioritization decisions, and hold your team accountable for customer outcomes, from discovery and design through launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Strategy, Roadmap & Outcomes**

* Own the roadmap knowledge graph completion / Ontology Learning, Reflexion-based memory extraction, and reinforcement learning-focused feature sets within the Context Engine portfolio. Translate customer needs and business priorities into clear requirements, prioritization decisions, and success criteria.
* Act as the primary touchpoint and evangelist for Context Engine to customers, executives, and field teams in the APJ region.
* Define how these capabilities are reusable by and drive value across Teradata products, personas, and business domains, and across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
* Shape the competitive position and differentiation of the Context Engine against competitors such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft, Google, and emerging AI data platform and semantic layer vendors.

**Automated Workflow Assembly**

* Define the product vision for automatically assembling workflows from discovered schemas and semantics, including data preparation, mapping, validation, enrichment, and publication of context, without hand-built pipelines for each customer.
* Specify how agents plan, compose, and execute these workflows, including reusable workflow templates, orchestration, approval checkpoints, and rollback.
* Set requirements for observability, explainability, and auditability so that customers can see why a workflow was assembled the way it was and trust what it produced.
* Define how workflows and discovered context are exposed to external agents and frameworks through Model Context Protocol (MCP) and other open agent interfaces.

**How Success Is Measured**

* Customer adoption and production deployments of semantic extraction and automated workflow capabilities, including successful agent and application consumption of the context they produce.
* Discovery and mapping quality: accuracy, coverage, and confidence calibration of discovered schemas, relationships, and semantic mappings, and the share accepted by stewards without correction.
* Automation outcomes: reduction in time and manual effort to onboard a new customer data estate and reach usable context, and the share of workflows assembled and run without hand-built pipelines.
* Platform usability as measured by targeted KPIs and customer sentiment.
* Pipeline influence, win-rate contribution, and analyst and customer perception of Teradata's context and trusted-AI position.

**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

* Bachelor's degree and 12+ years of experience, including 6+ years in product management or equivalent technical product leadership, with 4+ years on enterprise NLP, search, or metadata and data discovery platforms.
* Hands-on experience with NLP and LLM-based applications such as entity and concept extraction, semantic matching, embeddings, and natural language grounding to structured data, including how to evaluate them.
* Experience with BPMN 2. 0 structured workflows, and a demonstrable record of bringing agentic AI solutions from concept to production.
* Working familiarity with ontology and knowledge graph concepts, and with how graph-based context is consumed by retrieval and agent systems.
* Experience with utilizing agent self-learning approaches such as Reflexion, Reflective learning (ERL), or similar approaches to verbal reinforcement learning to improve agents in response to events and encounters in production systems.

**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.
  
  
Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. ​ We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

Anaqua, Inc. is a premium provider of integrated intellectual property (IP) management technology solutions and services. jobs.title: Head Cashier
jobs.description:
Job Description – Head Cashier

**Location:** Seychelles  
**Department:** Finance & Accounts  
**Designation:** Head Cashier  
**Reporting To:** Finance HOD  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Contract Duration:** 2 Years (including 6 months probation)  
**Experience:** Minimum 3 Years  
**Salary:** USD 706.29 Gross per Month

About the Role

We are looking for a responsible and detail-oriented Head Cashier to manage daily cash collections, cash handling, bank deposits, reconciliations, and customer payment follow-ups.

The candidate will ensure accurate financial records, secure cash management, timely banking, and compliance with company financial policies and procedures.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Cash Collection & Management**

* Handle daily cash collections from retail customers, supermarket cashiers, and wholesale sales representatives.
* Verify, count, and maintain accurate cash collection records.
* Ensure the safe custody of collected cash.

**2. Bank Deposits**

* Deposit daily cash collections into the designated bank account by the next business day.
* Maintain bank deposit slips and supporting documents.

**3. Cash & Bank Reconciliation**

* Reconcile daily cash collections with bank deposits and sales records.
* Identify and resolve cash discrepancies, shortages, and excess amounts.
* Maintain accurate reconciliation reports.

**4. Customer Accounts & Documentation**

* Prepare and issue weekly Statements of Account (SOA).
* Update customer payment records and outstanding balances.
* Maintain proper financial documentation.

**5. Payment Follow-ups**

* Follow up with customers regarding overdue payments.
* Coordinate with the Accounts Receivable team.
* Report payment discrepancies and disputed balances.

**6. Reporting & Compliance**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly cash collection reports.
* Follow company cash handling policies and internal controls.
* Support internal and external audits.
* Maintain confidentiality of financial information.

Mandatory Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in Cashiering, Cash Management, or Finance.
* Supervisory experience is preferred.
* Strong knowledge of cash handling, bank deposits, and bank reconciliation.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and accounting software / ERP systems.
* Excellent numerical accuracy and attention to detail.
* Good communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* High integrity, accountability, and professionalism.

Key Skills

* Cash Management
* Cash Collection & Handling
* Bank Deposits
* Bank Reconciliation
* Accounts Receivable
* Customer Payment Follow-up
* Statement of Accounts (SOA)
* Financial Reporting
* MS Excel
* ERP / Accounting Software

Salary Details

* **Gross Salary:** USD 706.29 per month (inclusive of PIT).
* **Net Salary:** USD 600 per month after PIT.
* **Optional Meals:** USD 90 monthly deduction if company-provided meals are selected.
* **Net Salary after meal deduction:** USD 510 per month.

Company-Provided Benefits

* 2-year employment contract, including 6 months probation.
* Company-sponsored joining air ticket.
* Company-provided accommodation based on employee grade.
* Company-provided transportation to and from the office.
* Company covers medical endorsement, employment approval, qualification verification, and 2-year work permit/visa costs.
* 42 days of paid annual leave upon completion of the 2-year contract, subject to contract terms and Seychelles law.
* Return air ticket at the lowest available fare upon successful completion of the contract, subject to applicable terms.

Additional Conditions

* Employees are responsible for Seychelles NIN charges and travel authorization.
* Certain expenses may be recovered in case of early resignation or contract breach, only as permitted by applicable law and the signed contract.
* Return airfare upon early resignation is to be borne by the employee, subject to applicable terms.
* Any passport deposit arrangement must be voluntary and lawful, with the employee retaining access to their passport upon request.

jobs.title: Vice President - Business Management, Design Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Our Business Management team acts as a trusted advisor to senior leaders and optimizes business performance by helping to drive key initiatives. We act as a counterweight to business and group heads and are responsible for identifying, escalating, and mitigating business risks. The role is dynamic and can vary from business to business, in line with the priorities of different lines of business. This is a time-pressured and high-profile position, instrumental in assisting and advising senior management. You will help coordinate the deployment of corporate resources to address strategic and tactical objectives.

Job summary

As a **Business Management** professional within the **Business Management team**, you will help drive strategic and tactical objectives by coordinating corporate resources and advising senior management. You will implement new business strategy, strategic initiatives, or platforms by aligning partners across Finance, Technology, Operations, Legal, and Compliance. You will optimize bottom-line performance by driving key initiatives related to fees, cost base, risk-weighted assets, and capital utilization. You will identify, escalate, and mitigate business risks that could impair the ability to do business, including legal, tax, regulatory, capacity issues, and extraordinary transaction costs. You will partner across functions to define future workflows and implement related technology and infrastructure projects to support an evolving market structure.

Job responsibilities

* **Implement** new business strategy, strategic initiatives, or platforms, including aligning department and support groups (Finance, Technology, Operations, Legal, Compliance)
* **Optimize** bottom-line business performance by driving key initiatives (fees, cost base, risk-weighted assets, and capital utilization)
* **Identify** business risks that could impair the ability to do business and **escalate and mitigate** those risks (e.g., legal, tax, regulatory, capacity issues, extraordinary transaction costs)
* **Analyze** financial performance, including expenses; **identify** productivity initiatives and **drive** implementation
* **Partner** with the business, Operations, and Technology to define future workflows and **implement** related technology and infrastructure projects to prepare for evolving market structure requirements
* **Partner** with relevant external service and infrastructure providers
* **Represent** the business in internal and external working groups

Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or other related area
* Previous product knowledge and/or prior Business Management or Chief Operating Officer experience
* Energetic and dynamic style
* Highly motivated self-starter with excellent time management and prioritization skills
* Ability to present well to senior and global business heads
* Ability to forge strong internal relationships across a broad range of functions
* Self-motivated, tenacious, and able to work with a high degree of independence
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Ability to define and deliver a strategic agenda across multiple groups
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including ability to analyze large data sets and present conclusions concisely
* Excellent project management and organizational skills, with strong attention to detail and a logical thought process

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. **Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Title**
=============

**Zonal Sales Manager (South) - IndusInd Bank Affluent & NRI Channel**

**Location**
------------

South India (Chennai) handles all four states of South.

**Reporting To**
----------------

National Sales Head - IndusInd Bank Relationship

**Role Purpose**
================

Lead the South India region for ABSLI's strategic partnership with IndusInd Bank's Affluent, HNI, and NRI Banking segments. The incumbent will be responsible for driving life insurance penetration across the bank's affluent customer base by building strong engagement with banking leadership, enhancing frontline capability, driving sales productivity, and ensuring sustainable business growth.

The role requires deep expertise in bancassurance, wealth management, relationship selling, and team leadership to establish ABSLI as the preferred insurance partner within IndusInd's affluent banking ecosystem.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

### **Business Development & Revenue Growth**

* Drive insurance sales across Affluent, Imperia, HNI, and NRI customer segments.
* Deliver annualized premium targets (APE/FYP) for South India.
* Increase wallet share within the affluent customer base.
* Build a robust opportunity pipeline from wealth, investment, and protection-led discussions.
* Drive high-ticket and protection-focused product penetration.

### **Relationship Management**

* Manage relationships with Zonal Heads, Regional Heads, Cluster Heads, and Wealth Leaders of IndusInd Bank.
* Position ABSLI as a strategic partner within the bank's affluent business model.
* Conduct regular business reviews with banking stakeholders.
* Ensure alignment of branch priorities with insurance business objectives.

### **Team Leadership**

* Lead a team of Regional Managers and Relationship Managers across South India.
* Drive productivity and capability building.
* Coach teams on HNI sales conversations and financial planning discussions.
* Build a high-performance sales culture.

### **Capability Development**

* Upskill bank relationship managers on:
  + Financial protection planning
  + Estate planning solutions
  + Retirement planning
  + Wealth transfer concepts
  + NRI insurance solutions
  Tax-efficient insurance products

### **Sales Governance**

* Ensure compliance with IRDAI regulations.
* Monitor suitability and quality parameters.
* Drive persistency and customer retention.
* Maintain healthy business mix and reduce concentration risks.

### **Customer Engagement**

* Conduct HNI customer meets, wealth seminars, and investment forums.
* Participate in client acquisition and portfolio review events.
* Engage with key customers for large-ticket closures.

**Key Result Areas (KRAs)**
===========================

**KRA**

  
  

New Business Premium (APE/FYP) Achievement

  
  

Affluent & HNI Customer Acquisition

  
  

Product Mix & Protection Penetration

  
  

Active Branch Productivity

  
  

Banker Activation & Engagement

  
  

Team Productivity & Retention

  
  

Persistency & Quality Metrics

  
  

Stakeholder Relationship

  
  

**Critical Challenges of the Role**
===================================

### **1. New Partnership Establishment**

* Building mindshare and trust for ABSLI within an existing banking ecosystem.
Competing with legacy bancassurance relationships and established insurers.  

### **2. Affluent Customer Expectations**

* HNI and NRI customers demand advisory-led conversations rather than transactional selling.
Higher scrutiny on product suitability and value proposition.  

### **3. Banker Engagement**

* Securing mindshare from affluent bankers already focused on liabilities, investments, and AUM acquisition.
Maintaining insurance visibility amidst competing priorities.  

### **4. Geographic Complexity**

* Managing multiple states, languages, and diverse customer demographics across South India.

### **5. High Ticket Closure Cycles**

Longer sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, family members, and financial advisors.  



### **6. Wealth vs Protection Balance**

* Driving sustainable protection business while meeting premium targets.
Avoiding overdependence on single-premium or investment-oriented sales.  

### **7. NRI Business Development**

Navigating regulatory processes, documentation requirements, and customer accessibility challenges.  



### **8. Talent & Capability Building**

* Developing teams capable of engaging affluent customers on sophisticated financial planning topics.

**Desired Candidate Profile**
=============================

### **Experience**

* 10-15+ years in Wealth Bancassurance.
* Minimum 5 years in a leadership role.
* Strong experience with HNI, Emerging Affluent, Wealth, or NRI segments.
Proven track record of managing large geographies and partnerships.  

### **Preferred Background**

* Bancassurance leadership.
* Insurance distribution leadership.

### **Key Skills**

* Strategic Sales Leadership
* Wealth & Protection Planning
* Stakeholder Management
* Relationship Management
* Team Development
* Negotiation & Influence
* Business Planning
* Data-Driven Sales Management

**Success Profile (First 12 Months)**
=====================================

The ZSM should be able to:

* Establish ABSLI as a preferred insurance partner within IndusInd's Affluent Banking ecosystem.
* Activate 80-90% of targeted affluent banking locations in South India.
* Build a strong pipeline of HNI/NRI business.
* Deliver target APE/FYP with healthy protection mix.
* Develop a high-performing regional sales team.
* Create sustainable banker engagement and referral generation mechanisms.

**Some careers open more doors than others.**

  

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

  

**Business Descriptor:**

  

International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.

  

### **Principal Responsibilities**

  

* Develop and execute the regional sales strategy for the Mobile Sales Force, delivering sustainable growth across customer acquisition, retail assets, liabilities, cards, personal loans, investments, insurance, foreign exchange and other relevant products.
* Acquire and deepen relationships with Premier and Advance customers, including New to Bank customers, through coordinated sales across liabilities, wealth and lending products.
* Deliver revenue, volume, productivity and profitability targets while maintaining disciplined control of acquisition costs, overheads and resource allocation.
* Build a customer-centric, high-performing regional sales organisation by integrating product teams, strengthening sales management practices and driving consistent service standards.
* Identify market opportunities, customer needs and competitor activity, using insights to refine regional plans, improve distribution reach and develop new revenue opportunities.
* Partner with branches, Direct, Wealth and other Group businesses to maximise referrals, customer migration and relationship opportunities, including corporate employee programmes and third-party distribution partnerships.
* Lead, coach and develop the regional sales team, fostering an inclusive, collaborative and performance-driven culture with clear accountability for results and customer outcomes.
* Own the end-to-end sales and customer onboarding process, ensuring a consistent customer experience and timely resolution of service issues.
* Maintain effective governance and controls across sales operations, ensuring compliance with applicable laws, regulations, Group standards, Financial Crime Compliance requirements and internal procedures.
* Identify, assess and mitigate operational, fraud, credit, conduct and reputational risks; ensure control weaknesses, audit findings and regulatory issues are addressed promptly.
* Work closely with Credit, Collections, Fraud, Compliance and other stakeholders to maintain portfolio quality, minimise delinquencies and support responsible growth.
* Ensure mandatory training, accreditation and compliance objectives are completed by the team within required timelines.

### **Qualifications / Skills**

  

* Postgraduate qualification in Business, Finance, Economics, Marketing or a related discipline.
* Typically 5–10 years’ experience in retail banking, wealth management, financial services sales or a related commercial environment.
* Proven experience leading a geographically dispersed sales force and managing managers or large, multi-product sales teams.
* Strong track record in customer acquisition, relationship deepening, revenue growth and delivery of business targets.
* Experience across retail banking products such as deposits, lending, cards, investments, insurance and foreign exchange.
* Strong commercial and financial management skills, including productivity, profitability, acquisition-cost and expense management.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and execute regional sales strategies using market, customer and competitor insights.
* Strong customer focus, with the ability to improve onboarding, service quality, loyalty and retention.
* Effective coaching, people leadership and change-management skills, with the ability to build a collaborative and performance-led culture.
* Strong stakeholder-management and influencing skills across branches, product teams, wealth, corporate banking, operations, risk and control functions.
* Sound understanding of operational risk, conduct, fraud prevention, credit quality, Anti-Money Laundering, customer due diligence and regulatory requirements.
* Ability to establish robust governance, monitor controls and ensure timely remediation of issues.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and decision-making skills.
* High level of integrity, accountability and commitment to responsible customer and business outcomes.
* Proficiency in using management information, sales-performance metrics and data to drive decisions and improve productivity.

jobs.title: Chief Product Officer
jobs.description:
**About Us**

UMO is a stealth-mode FinTech venture aiming to evolve the way people experience money by building a unified, AI-powered, yet deeply human money platform across fiat, crypto, and investments – subject to regulatory approvals. The platform is being designed to break down traditional barriers to money across access, assets, and experience, enabling simpler, more adaptive ways for people to interact with financial services.

We are currently developing our MVP and navigating licensing requirements, with a multidisciplinary team of 100+ people representing 20+ nationalities. With our headquarters in the UAE, we are united behind a shared ambition and a relentless focus on serving our customers.

**About This Role**

You'll help us build a platform that works for One — the individual, whether that's a business owner, an artist, or a freelancer, not a segment or a balance. We focus on individuals, not numbers. You'll take ownership of our global product ecosystem from zero to one: first the minimal licensable product, then the agentic financial platform we build on top of it. You'll partner directly with the founders on strategic direction, operate with full autonomy, and build shared understanding across the organization.

**You'll Take Ownership Of**

* **Zero-to-One Product Delivery:**
  Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for regulated financial products, from initial concept to launch, prioritizing value delivery over premature optimization.
* **Product & People Leadership:**
  Build and lead the product organization — hire, mentor, and grow product talent, and establish a culture of high performance, data literacy, and low ego. This is core to the role, not an adjunct to it.
* **Agentic Banking Architecture:**
  Architect a financial ecosystem built for autonomous agents from the ground up, treating AI as an operating model for the organization rather than a bolt-on feature.
* **Scope Discipline:**
  Maintain control over delivery timelines under pressure. Cut scope deliberately rather than sacrifice quality, keeping focus on the minimal licensable product.
* **Regulatory & Compliance Architecture:**
  Treat regulatory, compliance, and audit obligations as first-class product inputs, turning friction into intuitive product features.
* **Cross-Functional Feasibility:**
  Partner with the CTO to co-own technical feasibility and organizational commitments, separating what the product does from how it's engineered.
* **Context & Alignment:**
  Act as the primary bridge for shared understanding across the company — communicating product vision, customer needs, and strategic rationale through multiple channels.

**About You**

* **Regulated Startup Background:**
  You've built and shipped regulated financial products from zero to one within a fintech, crypto exchange, custodian, or digital banking environment, with proven exposure to compliance frameworks such as VARA, MiCA, EMI, or PI, and to strict licensing processes.
* **Comfort with Shifting Landscapes:**
  You thrive in continuous-delivery setups with agile teams, staying resilient and decisive under regulatory, investor, and shifting deadline pressures.
* **Agentic Framework Literacy:**
  You have practical understanding of agentic capabilities, architectural pitfalls, and the agentic-deterministic bridge, so deterministic safety holds on the money path.
* **Cross-Domain Fluency:**
  You're comfortable across crypto systems, traditional banking, and modern neobank infrastructure, rather than specialized in a single domain.
* **Outcome Ownership:**
  You own outcomes end-to-end rather than running a feature factory. You commit to measurable results and core OKRs, and you value autonomy while building a collaborative, non-siloed organization.
* **Clarity & Conviction:**
  You reduce ambiguity across teams and argue from data with conviction, but disagree and commit when it's time to align the organization.
* **Language Skills:**
  You speak and write English at a professional level, to support clean communication across global offices.

**This Is Not For You If**

* You're looking for a mature product to optimize. We're building from zero — there's no existing user base to A/B-test against.
* You're a product manager from a large bank who needs six committees to change a button. We move fast, fail fast on wrong calls, and decide from data.
* You know crypto well but see banking regulation as an outdated formality. For us, regulation is part of the product architecture, not an obstacle.
* You want to run a feature factory and just execute roadmaps. We need someone who will fight for the right scope, even if that means shipping less.
* You need the founders to make every product call. You'll have real autonomy here — and the responsibility that comes with it, including owning your own mistakes.

**Can Get You a Few Bonus Points**

* **Founder Roots:**
  Prior experience as a founder or early product leader of a regulated fintech startup, building the organization from the ground up.
* **Agentic Shipping History:**
  Direct experience bringing a live, agentic-first product to market.
* **Augmented Operations:**
  Active daily use of AI agents, personal documentation systems, or a "second brain" to streamline your own operational delivery.

**The UMO Standard**

* **Mandate & Ownership:**
  Full ownership of the product organization and roadmap, reporting directly to the founders.
* **Equity:**
  A meaningful equity stake in a venture built from zero to one.
* **Location & Flexibility:**
  Base yourself in Lisbon, Dubai, Kyiv, or Lviv, with openness to remote for the right fit.
* **Impact & Ownership:**
  Your work directly shapes the product and company direction — not just executes it.
