jobs.title: Head of India
jobs.description:
**The Role**
India is the biggest remittance market with over $130 billion a year flowing home to it, from everywhere: engineers in the Bay Area and Sydney, cabbies in Toronto, construction crews in Dubai, shopkeepers in Leicester, students in Berlin. From Punjabis, Gujaratis, Tamils, Malayalis and Telugus. From people wiring $3,000 a month to a Mumbai mortgage and people sending $80 to a village in Bihar. Your job is to win this market.
  
  
You are someone who gets excited by the nuances of the Indian diaspora and how to reach each group, and who wants to own the P&L, the regulatory landscape and pricing at the same time. If you find the price sensitivity of each cohort exciting, and "why do Malayali nurses cluster in specific hospital systems, and what does that mean for acquisition?" as interesting as "what's RBI's latest remittance policy and which banks make the best partners," this is it.
  
  
As the GM, you own the P&L, and set pricing. For customer growth, you decide which communities to acquire and in what order. Know the RBI's rules well enough to see the openings inside them, not just the limits. A Gujarati family in New Jersey and a Punjabi trucker in Brampton got abroad through completely different networks, and reaching them takes completely different channels.
  
  
Reports to the Head of South Asia. Builds a team of FX Advisors in India and growth managers in sending markets. The face of India inside and outside the company. Total ownership. Be your own CEO
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* The P&L. Volume, gross profit and CAC across every India corridor. Not influence, own. A miss is your miss. A beat is your win.
* Strategy and sequencing. Which sender markets, which communities, which channels, in what order. US, Canada, UK, Europe, Australia and UAE to start. Build the plan, defend it to leadership, execute it.
* Pricing. India is the most rate-sensitive, most competitive remittance market in the world, up against competitors who reprice daily. Set FX and fee strategy corridor by corridor.
* The regulatory and partner landscape. RBI rules, bank partnerships, payout rails. Know the terrain cold and own the local relationships.
* Product. Obsess over UX and the services NRIs actually need. Closer to the customer than anyone in the company, and what you hear feeds straight into product, pricing and customer support.
* The diaspora puzzle. Community partnerships, temples and gurdwaras and churches, cricket leagues, student associations, remittance-heavy employers, influencers, festivals (Diwali is a season, not a day). Get in front of each community authentically, and cheaply.
* The team. Hire, coach and retain people in India and in sending markets. Small, dense, fast.

**Who You Are**

* 10 to 15 years in high-growth environments: startups, operations, consulting, finance, fintech. Has owned a number and talks about it the way owners do.
* Diaspora-fluent. Real knowledge of and networks in the Indian diaspora, and real curiosity about it. Migration patterns, community structures, who sends money to whom and why.
* Commercially sharp. Holds pricing, unit economics and CAC math in their head, and works the data directly. Excel or Sheets required, SQL a real plus.
* A hustler with judgment. Closes a bank partnership Monday, reviews corridor margins Tuesday, shows up at a community event in Jackson Heights on Saturday. Likes all three.
* A regulatory realist. Understands (or can quickly master) RBI rules and the compliance realities of moving money into India. Treats compliance as a partner, not an obstacle.
* Multilingual, ideally. Fluent in English. Hindi, Gujarati, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu or Malayalam are genuine assets.

Location: London or Dubai. Regular travel to India and sending markets is part of the job.
  
  
**Why This Role**
India is the largest remittance market in the world, and winning it moves the whole company forward. This role owns that outcome, with the authority and the accountability that come with it. It also drives real value for the customers: Immigrants work hard for this money, and every basis point saved goes home.
  
  
**About Us**
We’re building the world’s leading cross-border fintech for emerging markets - empowering families, fuelling local economies, and changing how millions access financial services.
  
  
Since our launch in 2019, we have transformed how money moves across borders with our operations spanning 6 out of 7 continents and covering both the busiest and most underserved (remittance) corridors. We tapped into a massive shift - from banks to phones - bringing digital finance to places where traditional systems never reached. The next stage of growth will fuel a network of services and products especially designed to make money more accessible to diaspora communities including local cards, and additional savings and payments features.
  
  
We’re growing fast, backed by world-class investors, and scaling a product that blends
**real world impact with cutting edge fintech innovation**
.
  
  
**Here’s a Little More**

* Founded by Harvard grads and 3-time founders who previously built Segovia (acquired) and GiveDirectly (>$300M revenue, fastest-growing NGO in the world)
* Backed by top investors including Spark Capital, Canaan, Reid Hoffman, Breyer Capital, Unbound, Wamda, and more
* Built by global top performers from Bain, Google, McKinsey, Uber, Checkout, Bolt, and beyond - we move fast, stay humble, and care deeply about our mission
* Truly global team - 250+ people, 50+ nationalities, 50+ languages
* Guided by our values - ownership, impact, humility, and heart - in deed, not just word

Taptap Values
  
  
Impact first
  
  
Team next
  
  
Accept reality
  
  
Propose solutions
  
  
Win with grit
  
  
Be proactively candid, with yourself and others
  
  
Love the particular
  
  
Own it
  
  
Create positive energy
  
  
Maybe, even have fun
  
  
Taptap Send is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. All employment decisions are decided on the basis of qualifications, experience and business need. We strongly encourage applications who are members of underrepresented communities to apply.
  
  
If you require reasonable adjustments to be made during the recruitment process, please do not hesitate to let us know. Any information you provide us in this respect will only be used to accommodate your requirements.
  
  
*Note: we recognize imposter syndrome is real - any candidate that does not perfectly fit every characteristic of this role is still strongly encouraged to apply.*

jobs.title: Manager, Payments & Treasury
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**  
NEXT Ventures is where ambition takes shape and momentum becomes movement. As a global platform, revolutionising access to performance-based capital, we empower the world’s most driven individuals to rise. Through our flagship brand, FundedNext, we empower dreamers to become doers and potential to turn into performance. FNmarkets is our international brokerage arm, serving clients across global markets*.*

With 500+ driven minds across five countries, we power a global rhythm—220,000+ daily users, from 170+ nations, each chasing greatness in their own way.

**Your Role in Our Mission**  
As a Manager, Payments & Treasury (FNmarkets Brokerage), you own the end-to-end movement, safeguarding, and optimization of client and corporate funds across FNmarkets’ international brokerage operations. You will run the PSP and banking portfolio that powers client deposits and withdrawals, manage multi-currency liquidity and FX exposure, and keep settlement, reconciliation, and treasury controls tight as the brokerage scales across markets. Sitting at the intersection of payment operations, treasury, and bank/PSP relationship management, you partner closely with Compliance, Finance, Risk, and trading-platform teams to keep funds flowing reliably, cost-efficiently, and within regulatory requirements.

This role reports to the group Head of Payments & Treasury.

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

* **Payment Operations & PSP Portfolio:**

* **Portfolio Ownership:** Own the PSP and payment-method portfolio (cards, local bank rails, e-wallets, crypto) across the brokerage’s active markets, from onboarding and integration through performance monitoring and offboarding.
* **Payment Routing Optimization:** Optimize payment routing in the orchestrator to lift approval rates, reduce decline and failure rates, and lower blended cost per transaction.
* **SLA & Performance Tracking:** Track and improve deposit/withdrawal success rates, processing times, and chargeback/dispute ratios against agreed SLAs.

**2. Client Funds & Payout Operations:**

* **End-to-End Flow Oversight:** Oversee client deposit and withdrawal flows end to end, ensuring funds are processed accurately, on time, and in line with client-money safeguarding rules.
* **Payout Management:** Manage brokerage client withdrawals and wallet transfers, including volume forecasting, queue management, and exception handling.
* **Fund Segregation & Reporting:** Maintain segregation of client funds from corporate funds and support audit and regulatory reporting on balances.

**3. Treasury, FX & Cash Management:**

* **Multi-Currency Liquidity:** Manage multi-currency liquidity across entities and accounts, ensuring sufficient funding for client withdrawals, settlements, and operating needs.
* **FX & Hedging Execution:** Run FX operations and conversions, monitor currency exposure, and execute hedging or rebalancing as directed by policy.
* **Cash Forecasting & Yield:** Forecast cash positions, optimize working capital, and manage the placement of eligible corporate cash within approved investment and counterparty limits—with client funds held separately and safeguarded at all times.

**4. Banking & Relationship Management:**

* **Partner Management:** Own relationships with banks, PSPs, and acquiring partners—covering commercials, fee and settlement-term negotiation, issue escalation, and periodic performance reviews.
* **Cost Reduction:** Drive down processing, settlement, and FX costs through negotiation and transfer-pricing/routing optimization.
* **Infrastructure Redundancy:** Build banking and PSP redundancy to protect the continuity of client deposits and withdrawals.

**5. Reconciliation, Compliance & Risk:**

* **Multi-Ledger Reconciliation:** Own daily and periodic reconciliation across PSPs, banks, crypto wallets, and the ledger, resolving breaks and ensuring settlement accuracy.

**Country Compliance Office – Vice President - Dubai**

The Middle East and Africa Compliance team is seeking a Vice President, based in Dubai and reporting to the Head of Middle East and Africa Compliance. This broad regional role supports Compliance advisory, Operational Risk and Regulatory Relations priorities, with specialist investment management expertise as a core capability. The Vice President will provide entity-level oversight, including potential registered Compliance Officer or other controlled-function responsibilities as the regional footprint expands, while delivering specialist coverage for MSIM Portfolio Management and Sales & Distribution activities across GCC jurisdictions.

  

**About Morgan Stanley and the DIFC Branch:**

Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm and has served clients in the Middle East and Africa since the early 1970s. From offices in Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar and Johannesburg, the Firm provides investment banking, capital markets, sales and trading, asset management and private wealth management services. The DIFC Branch forms part of this regional platform, connecting clients to Morgan Stanley's global capabilities and solutions. Our success is underpinned by integrity, excellence and a strong team ethic, providing an environment in which people can learn, achieve and grow.

As a market leader, the talent and passion of our people are critical to our success. We share a common set of values rooted in integrity, excellence and strong team ethic. Morgan Stanley provides a strong foundation for building a professional career and a place for people to learn, achieve and grow.

  
  

**Department Overview:**

Compliance advises Business Units and staff on applicable laws, regulations, exchange requirements and Firm policies. The Department implements Compliance and Global Financial Crimes policies and procedures, delivers training, undertakes monitoring and surveillance, and partners with Legal, GFC, Operational Risk and other control functions to maintain a robust second line of defence.

  

**What you'll do in the role:**

* Provide broad MENA Compliance advice across regional business, legal-entity and strategic priorities, applying regulatory requirements and Firm policies with sound judgement and effective challenge.
* Support regulatory governance and entity-level oversight, including submissions, notifications, inspections, remediation, regulatory engagement and controlled-function responsibilities where required and subject to approval.
* Maintain and enhance MENA Compliance and GFC policies, procedures, training and practical guidance, and execute Compliance Monitoring Programme reviews and Operational Risk activities.
* Partner with Legal, GFC, Operational Risk and business stakeholders on new products, services, business models and strategic initiatives, providing pragmatic, solutions-oriented advice.
* Provide specialist investment management coverage for MSIM Portfolio Management and Sales & Distribution activities, including cross-border business, fund and mandate structures, foreign fund registration, distribution, promotion and marketing across GCC jurisdictions.
  

**What you'll bring to the role:**

* Results-oriented Compliance professional with 8+ years' regional or multi-jurisdictional experience, including substantive investment management expertise across public and/or private markets.
* Strong knowledge of MENA regulatory frameworks and practical experience in Saudi Arabia and the UAE; familiarity with Qatar and Kuwait is advantageous.
* Demonstrated expertise in asset and portfolio management, fund distribution and foreign fund marketing, together with experience supporting cross-border activities and global stakeholders.
* Experience in regulatory engagement and change, including submissions, inspections and remediation; prior controlled-function experience, or the credibility to assume such responsibilities subject to regulatory approval, is desirable.
* Excellent analytical, drafting and communion skills.

**WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM MORGAN STANLEY:**

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. **About HAL**

**HAL is a B2B domestic and cross border marketplace being built for SMEs in the UAE. Incubated by SC Ventures, the ventures arm of Standard Chartered Bank, the platform will enable digital commerce and access to financial & value-added services. HAL’s vision is to act as a super glue connecting multiple partners & ecosystems by bringing together buyers, sellers, financial institutions, logistics partners under one roof. We are building this as an agentic AI native stack along with several strategic partners in the UAE who bring different capabilities into the platform.**

**The Senior Marketing Manager will lead HAL's marketing function, working closely with the CEO and the commercial, product and partnerships teams. This is a commercially driven role: success is measured by the qualified B2B leads you generate (sellers, buyers and SMEs looking for finance), the revenue they bring in, and HAL's growing share of the UAE SME market. jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager 3
jobs.description:
#### **About Behavox**

Behavox is shaping the future for how businesses harness their most important raw material - data. Our mission is bold: Organize enterprise data into actionable information that protects and promotes the business growth of multinational companies around the world.

From managing enterprise risk and compliance to maximizing revenue and value, our data operating platform presents a widespread opportunity to build multilingual, AI/ML-based solutions that activate data for every function within a global enterprise.

Our approach is unique, and it's validated by our customers who tell us to keep forging ahead because no one else is aggregating, analyzing, and acting on data to uncover opportunities or solve problems quite the way we are.

We are looking for fearless innovators who have an insatiable appetite for building what no one has built before.

**About the Role**

Behavox's Strategic Account Managers own the full commercial relationship with some of the world's most complex and highly regulated financial institutions. This includes delivery outcomes, commercial performance, executive relationships, and long-term strategic growth across a portfolio of global banks, hedge funds, asset managers, and energy firms operating under the world's most demanding regulatory frameworks.

Clients in this portfolio are building or strengthening unified controls frameworks that bring together communications surveillance, trade surveillance, compliant archiving, and policy management into a single, defensible control system. The Strategic Account Manager's role is to understand where each client sits on that journey, ensure Behavox is delivering against their current needs, and position the platform to serve the full scope of their controls framework over time. This requires full end-to-end ownership of the relationship, delivery, health, satisfaction, retention, and growth for every account in the portfolio, operating with a high degree of autonomy on account strategy, renewals, escalations, and executive relationships.

The role requires the ability to think strategically and execute operationally, often in the same day. The Strategic Account Manager will own all renewals across the portfolio, build retention strategy, lead negotiations, and close; accurately forecast ARR churn risk and develop mitigation plans; drive inbound expansion deals independently in collaboration with Account Executives; and lead executive business reviews that are genuinely strategic: conversations about compliance posture, regulatory risk, control maturity, and platform value.

This is a hybrid position based out of our London office.

**What You'll Bring**

* **Enterprise compliance technology and unified controls frameworks.** Deep working knowledge of how communications surveillance, trade surveillance, compliant archiving, and policy management converge into a single control system at regulated financial institutions; understands how clients evaluate and mature their compliance posture over time.
* **Financial services regulatory environment.** Understands the regulatory obligations driving client demand, from communications monitoring requirements to trade reconstruction and archiving mandates, across global banking, hedge fund, asset management, and energy sectors.
* **Multi-stakeholder account management across regulated financial institutions.** Navigates complex organizational structures involving Heads of Surveillance, compliance analysts, technology teams, and operations teams; manages both executive-level strategic relationships and working-level practitioner relationships simultaneously.
* **Commercial lifecycle management for enterprise SaaS.** Owns the full renewal and expansion cycle: retention strategy, churn forecasting, negotiation, close, and pipeline development in partnership with Account Executives; understands how delivery health directly impacts commercial outcomes.
* **Escalation management and operational accountability**. Owns ticket triage, escalation, and resolution end to end for the full portfolio; manages complex, multi-workstream escalations with minimal manager involvement; builds relationships with Product, Engineering, and Support counterparts to accelerate resolution.

**What You'll Do**

* **Account health monitoring and risk identification.** Independently assesses account health and risk across commercial, operational, and relationship dimensions; surfaces risk early by reading ticket patterns, stakeholder signals, and adoption data as intelligence; builds intervention plans without manager direction.
* **Executive business review design and delivery.** Designs and executes QBRs and EBRs for all accounts including executive-level engagement; leads conversations about compliance posture, regulatory risk, control maturity, and platform value rather than product update calls.
* **Renewal ownership and churn forecasting.** Owns all renewals across the portfolio: builds retention strategy, leads negotiations, closes; accurately forecasts ARR churn risk and develops mitigation plans using account health data, stakeholder intelligence, and delivery performance indicators.
* **Expansion identification and commercial execution.** Drives inbound expansion deals independently; collaborates with Account Executives per Unit of One model for strategic accounts; leads with value, not discount-first positioning; builds commercial plays grounded in customer intelligence.
* **Delivery follow-through and client communication ownership.** Owns the client-facing narrative when delivery issues arise, ensuring commitments made to the client are tracked and fulfilled; translates technical or operational updates into language the client can act on; holds internal teams accountable through to confirmed resolution so the client has everything they need without chasing.

**What We Offer**

* A truly global mission with a passionate community in locations all over the world
* Huge impact and learning potential as our aspirations require bold innovation
* Highly competitive compensation
* Benefits include fully covered health coverage for employee and family
* Generous time-off policy and flexible work schedule

**About Our Process**

  

We take Talent very seriously and we are building a community of extraordinary individuals working together in very high performing teams. We also know that the best Talent always has options so we believe that the process has to be a two way assessment - the company AND the candidate assessing the business needs alignment, the career next step alignment, and the cultural alignment.  
  
During the process we will begin by exploring the core factors regarding salary and location along with core experience and skills and values alignment. We will then deep dive explore the critical technical competencies we have identified for the role, and then we will deep dive in behavioral competencies.  
  
The most aligned candidate will then be asked to do a practical work task simulation activity so we can make sure that you will enjoy the kind of work the role requires, and this task will typically be presented and discussed with a group of colleagues and managers. Finally we will ask you to meet with a number of our senior leaders to make sure that you are making the most informed call possible.

**Please note that:**

* We want to get to know you and have a genuine conversation, so the use of AI tools or assistance during live interviews is strictly prohibited and will result in immediate disqualification from the process
* Interviews may be recorded for internal review purposes to ensure fairness and enable collaborative hiring discussions within the team.

CNS (Computer Network Systems) is a technology company in the middle-east & has over 30 years of successful achievements and long-term partnerships with distinct customers across the region.

We are an IT distributor & our expertise are in Banking & Financial Service Insurance, Technology Enablement, IT Outsourcing, Cyber security, Digital Infrastructure, Hybrid Cloud, Digital Workplace, Customer Experience, Digital Transformation, and Block Chain.

We are a Part of the Ghobash Group of Companies, CNS spread across the region with offices in Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Oman, and Kuwait providing a holistic approach that covers all aspects of information communication technology system integration, consultancy, operation, managed services, and IT outsourcing.

CNS also has state-of-the-art network operation centers in Abu Dhabi and Dubai that develop in-house software and applications providing end-to-end solutions to our customers and partners.

 **Job Description**

Lead new-business development and profitable revenue growth for CNS cybersecurity services in the Abu Dhabi- UAE. The role requires an established cybersecurity services salesperson with existing CISO/CIO relationships in the assigned Emirate, a proven record of originating and closing managed SOC/MDR, offensive-security and advisory engagements, and the ability to build a qualified pipeline from their network. This is a hands-on hunter role, not a general IT product or license sales position.

**DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Own territory-based new business, customer acquisition, account development and cybersecurity services sales in Dubai or Abu Dhabi.
* Leverage existing relationships with CISOs, CIOs, Heads of Security, IT leaders and procurement decision-makers to secure senior customer meetings and qualify demand.
* Develop and close managed SOC, MDR, managed SIEM/SOAR, EDR/XDR, threat monitoring, incident response retainers, vulnerability management and threat-hunting contracts.

**Additional Information**

**Skills & Abilities**

jobs.title: Senior Sales Executive - Key Account Manager - Payments
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, AZ, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
**Key** **Account Manager** – **Payments**

OxyX | SME Growth · Accounting Practice Partnerships · Payments & Business Technology  
Position: Key Account Manager – Payments

**Business: OxyX - Kanzpay**  
***www.KanzPay.com***  
***www.OxyTech.ae***

Reports to: Sales / Business Head  
Location: UAE – field and office-based

***Role purpose***

The Key Account Manager – Payments will drive the adoption and growth of OxyX among UAE small and medium-sized businesses (SMEs). The role combines two complementary routes to market: building productive referral relationships with accounting firms and acquiring, onboarding and managing SMEs directly.

The successful candidate will help business owners understand how OxyX can improve collections, payment journeys, customer engagement and day-to-day business decisions. The role is focused on consultative selling, trusted relationships, activation and sustained usage—not simply signing up accounts.

***Key responsibilities***

*1. Accounting firm partnership development*

* Identify, map and approach accounting, bookkeeping and tax advisory practices serving UAE SMEs. **Build relationships with practice owners, partners, directors and client-facing teams; explain the OxyX partner proposition clearly.** Position accounting firms as trusted referral partners who can introduce OxyX to suitable SME clients while retaining their own client relationships. **Arrange partner meetings, briefings, demonstrations and follow-ups; maintain a structured pipeline of prospective and active firms.** Equip partners with approved presentations, product information, referral processes and client onboarding support. **Identify client needs with partner firms and coordinate introductions with the SME's consent.** Maintain partner engagement, track referred opportunities and support partner activation and retention.

*2. Direct SME acquisition and sales*

* Identify and approach SMEs across relevant sectors, including retail, trading, professional services, hospitality and other suitable business categories. **Understand each prospect's business model, current ERP/accounting setup, payment and collection processes, operational pain points and growth priorities.** Conduct needs-based discussions and demonstrate relevant OxyX capabilities rather than delivering generic product presentations. **Explain how OxyX works as an intelligence and action layer alongside the SME's existing systems, subject to connector availability, permissions and supported data.** Develop proposals, manage objections, follow up opportunities and progress prospects through evaluation, decision and onboarding. **Build relationships with business owners, finance managers, operations managers and other decision-makers.**

*3. SME onboarding, activation and account management*

* Coordinate onboarding with the SME, accounting firm and internal implementation/support teams. **Ensure the SME understands agreed use cases, onboarding requirements, connector prerequisites and each party's responsibilities.** Support initial setup, user orientation and first-use milestones; escalate technical or integration issues promptly. **Monitor engagement, identify underused capabilities and recommend relevant steps to improve adoption and business value.** Maintain regular account reviews, resolve relationship issues and identify opportunities for expansion, renewal and referral. **Capture customer feedback and share product, integration and service improvement suggestions internally.**

*4. Product and market understanding*

* Develop working knowledge of OxyX's SME cockpit, business controls, AI-assisted insights, collections and payment-related workflows, rewards, expense-related capabilities and e-invoicing integrations where available. **Understand the distinction between OxyX technology/workflows and services delivered by banks, payment service providers, acquirers and accredited e-invoicing service providers.** Keep up to date with SME operating challenges, accounting practice needs, market developments and competitor propositions. **Translate customer feedback and market observations into clear inputs for product, marketing, operations and management.**

*Performance expectations*

Performance will be assessed on the quality and consistency of partner development, SME acquisition, successful onboarding, active usage, customer retention and value created for SMEs and accounting partners.

* Qualified accounting firms engaged and converted into active referral partners. **Qualified SME opportunities generated through partner referrals and direct acquisition.** SMEs successfully onboarded and activated, with agreed first-use milestones achieved. **Ongoing product adoption, account engagement, retention and expansion.** Quality of customer relationships, partner feedback and resolution of escalations. **Accurate CRM records, pipeline forecasts, meeting notes and sales reporting.**

*Skills, experience and attributes*

* Experience in B2B sales, key account management, merchant services, payments, fintech, banking, SaaS or SME business solutions. **Ability to sell through relationship-based channels, referral partners, professional firms or business ecosystems.** Confidence engaging business owners, accounting practice partners, finance leaders and operational decision-makers. **Strong consultative selling, presentation, negotiation, follow-up and account-management skills.** Ability to understand business workflows and explain technology in clear, practical, non-technical language. **Comfortable conducting field visits, meetings, product demonstrations and structured follow-ups.** Organised, self-driven and capable of managing a pipeline and multiple partner/customer relationships. **Good written and spoken English; additional languages commonly used in the UAE SME market are an advantage.** Working knowledge of UAE SME business practices and the payments/accounting ecosystem is preferred.

*Working relationships*

The role will work closely with the Sales / Business Head, accounting practice partners, SME owners and finance teams, product and implementation teams, customer support, and relevant external payment or technology partners.

*Professional conduct and role boundaries*

* Represent OxyX accurately and use only current, approved product descriptions, pricing, proposals and marketing materials. **Do not promise product features, integrations, settlement timelines, rewards, savings or business outcomes that have not been confirmed.** Do not present OxyX as a bank, payment service provider, acquirer or accredited e-invoicing service provider. Regulated payment and e-invoicing services are provided by relevant authorised partners. **Follow company policies for customer consent, data confidentiality, information security, onboarding and record keeping.** Do not collect, store or share customer credentials, banking passwords, OTPs or sensitive payment credentials. **Escalate complaints, suspected fraud, data incidents, compliance concerns and requests outside approved authority promptly.**

*What success looks like*

A successful Key Account Manager builds a dependable network of accounting practice referral partners while independently developing SME relationships. SMEs understand the practical value of OxyX, complete onboarding, use the capabilities relevant to their business and continue to engage. Accounting firms see OxyX as a way to strengthen their client service and create additional value—not as a threat to their role. This role is a senior role qualifying for the ESOPS as well. You may choose to apply at: **reach@OxyTech.ae**

Pay: AED3,900.00 - AED17,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Have you sold credit cards, POS machines, ERP systems, Accounting systems, other Payment instruments.

Education:

* Master's (Preferred)

Experience:

* ERP systems: 3 years (Preferred)
* POS: 3 years (Preferred)
* Key Account Management: 3 years (Required)

**Join Zepz: Breaking Down Borders, Together**

**Our Meaningful Mission**  
At Zepz, we're all about breaking down barriers for our customers and our teammates. Our purpose is deeply personal, we provide a lifeline and deliver opportunities to cross-border communities that need it most through cutting edge finance and tech. Zepz is the power behind WorldRemit and Sendwave , driven by the mission to celebrate the incredible impact migrants have, both at home and abroad. We're not just moving money; we're building a world that truly recognises and supports global connections.
  
  
**Who You'll Be Joining**

We look for mission-driven builders who thrive in a fast-paced environment connected to a true purpose. We’re an always developing team of experts that enjoy problem solving and bring clarity to tough challenges. * Outcomes: We work for our customers. Their success and prosperity are the results we focus on delivering.
* Velocity: We are fast! We maintain high energy levels and make smart decisions quickly, keeping us nimble and ahead of the curve.

**Perks of Joining Our Team**

We believe in empowering colleagues because we genuinely trust our team. We also offer unlimited annual leave , great healthcare benefits, and employee discounts. We want you to thrive and focus entirely on making your biggest impact! **About Tide**
At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
  
  
Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.
  
  
Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
  
  
**Tide Facts**

* Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
* Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
* Over $300 million raised in funding
* 3,000 Tideans globally
* We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

**About The Team**
Tide is hiring a Director of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind Commercial Services. You will report to the CDTO and partner with Product and Design leadership as one leadership team accountable for the outcomes of the domain.
  
  
Commercial Services is where Tide extends from helping members run their business to helping them grow it. You will shape how quickly every member becomes discoverable, how much of their buying and selling runs through Tide, and how far AI can turn that into a lasting advantage across every market we serve.
  
  
Sell gives every member a live, discoverable presence, from the Tide Business Pages we are launching for 2 million members across the UK and Europe, to Own Website, catalogue, bookings, CRM and lead capture, and embedded fulfilment through Delivery as a Service.
  
  
Buy turns that member base into a two-sided marketplace through the Tide Online Network, alongside Tide Promotions (gift cards, cashback and personalised offers), business supplies from partners, and Vendor Hub for e-procurement.
  
  
You will be the single owner accountable for engineering delivery, architecture and people across both.
  
  
**About The Role**
This role sits at the intersection of SME commerce, marketplaces and banking. Our members sit on both sides of the marketplace, our partners extend what we can offer them, and our banking platform lets us layer payments, credit, insurance and rewards into the experience at the point of need, which few commerce players can do. We need someone who can bring both streams onto one consistent engineering bar, ship quickly and build the platforms that turn Commercial Services into a material recurring revenue line for Tide.
  
  
As Director of Engineering you will
  
  

* Set the engineering strategy and technical direction across the Sell and Buy value streams, from launch through to scale.
* Lead the Heads of Engineering for Sell and Buy, build the leadership bench underneath them, and own headcount planning, hiring and organisation design.
* Partner with Product and Design leadership on one shared plan, jointly owning delivery and outcomes, including members activated through real sales and purchases, engagement and recurring revenue.

* Apply our OnePlatform principles so we build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated.

* Director engineering leadership of a multi-team organisation of around 50 engineers across backend, frontend, data and analytics, led through at least one layer of engineering leaders.
* Domain experience in e-commerce, two-sided marketplaces, CRM or procurement platforms, including the trust and safety controls they need, with fintech or SME banking experience a plus.
* Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable product and commercial outcomes.
* Experience building partner and third-party integration platforms at scale.
* Strong product and design partnership instincts.
* Comfortable setting direction through ambiguity and launching new products into multiple markets.
* Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, architecture and technical quality.
* Experience bringing AI or agentic experiences into customer-facing commerce products would be a bonus.

* Mobile/Web: Flutter / Angular
* Infrastructure: AWS (SNS+SQS), PostgreSQL via RDS or Aurora, GCP (BigQuery, Vertex)
* Observability: Coralogix (OpenTelemetry
* Claude for agentic ways of working

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

**ABOUT US:**

Who we are

ProductSquads was founded with a bold mission: to engineer capital efficiency through autonomous AI agents, exceptional engineering, and real-time decision intelligence.

We're building an AI-native platform that redefines how software teams deliver value - whether through code written by humans, agents, or both. Our stack combines agentic AI systems, ML pipelines, and high-performance engineering workflows.

This is your chance to build not just models, but systems that think, decide, and act-AI fabric tools, domain-intelligent agents, and real-time decision systems that power the next generation of product delivery.

**THE ROLE:**

What you'll do

We are looking for a visionary and hands-on Head of UX Design to strengthen the user experience of our digital products and establish a high standard for future product development.

This is a player-coach leadership role for someone who combines strategic thinking, creative problem-solving, and hands-on design execution. The ideal candidate will have a strong product mindset, the ability to independently identify opportunities, challenge conventional approaches, and translate innovative ideas into intuitive, scalable, and user-centric product experiences.

The role requires an experienced UX leader who can define and communicate a compelling design vision while remaining actively involved in user journeys, workflow optimisation, wireframing, interactive prototyping, and front-end implementation where appropriate.

The objective is not to redesign the platform from scratch, but to optimise existing workflows, simplify complex user interactions, and establish consistent UX standards for new product development.

We are looking for a proactive, articulate, and innovative design professional who can work independently with minimal supervision, influence stakeholders, and bring fresh, out-of-the-box ideas to product development.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Your scope

1. Strategic Ownership

→ UX vision and roadmap: Define and maintain a multi-year UX roadmap aligned

with product strategy. Ensure the product suite works as one connected experience

through shared patterns, consistent navigation, and workflows that hold up across

products.

→ Turn requirements into UX: Shape requirements from each roadmap initiative into flows, interactions, and designs that work for real users. Push back constructively where a requirement would create a poor experience.

→ Multi-persona design: Design for multiple user personas together, and make the tradeoffs between their needs explicit to Product Managers.

→ Usability validation: Own usability testing and design validation, and partner with PMs on discovery research so user insight shapes requirements early.

2. Hands-on UX Design and Product Development

→ Contribute directly to user flows, information architecture, wireframes, interaction design, high-fidelity screens, and interactive prototypes.

→ Simplify complex workflows and improve navigation, usability, and task completion across existing products.

→ Develop rapid prototypes to validate ideas, communicate design intent, and support faster product decisions.

→ Collaborate with Engineering to ensure designs are technically feasible and implemented accurately.

→ Contribute front-end code where appropriate, based on project requirements and technical capabilities.

→ Maintain a user-first design approach throughout the product development lifecycle, from ideation to implementation and refinement.

3. Innovation and Independent Problem-Solving

→ Bring fresh ideas, emerging design practices, and innovative approaches to product challenges.

→ Challenge assumptions constructively and explore alternative solutions rather than relying solely on existing patterns.

→ Take ownership of ambiguous problems, develop recommendations independently, and drive solutions through to completion.

→ Identify opportunities to reduce user effort, eliminate unnecessary steps, and simplify complex product experiences.

→ Encourage experimentation, rapid prototyping, and evidence-based decision- making.

→ Stay informed about emerging UX trends, AI-enabled design capabilities, and evolving product design practices.

4. Design System Alignment and Experience Consistency

→ Work within the existing design system and established brand guidelines maintained by Engineering.

→ Improve usability and functionality while preserving the product’s visual identity and design consistency.

→ Recommend enhancements to reusable components, interaction patterns, and design guidelines in collaboration with Engineering.

→ Establish scalable UX standards for new features and future product development.

→ Ensure that innovation strengthens the existing product ecosystem without creating unnecessary design fragmentation.

5. Communication and Stakeholder Management

→ Demonstrate excellent verbal and written communication skills, articulating design concepts and decisions clearly.

→ Present UX strategies, prototypes, recommendations, and trade-offs confidently to senior leadership, Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders.

→ Explain complex design problems in simple, structured, and business-oriented language.

→ Influence stakeholders through clear reasoning, user insights, prototypes, and practical recommendations.

→ Ask the right questions, challenge requirements constructively, and establish alignment before execution.

→ Proactively communicate progress, risks, dependencies, and recommendations without requiring repeated follow-ups.

→ Facilitate productive design discussions and manage differing viewpoints with confidence and professionalism.

6. User Research and Continuous Product Improvement

→ Use customer feedback, stakeholder insights, usability testing, and product data to identify improvement opportunities.

→ Validate design concepts through prototypes and user feedback wherever appropriate.

→ Collaborate with Product teams to understand user pain points and prioritise meaningful improvements.

→ Define relevant measures of success, including usability, task completion, user adoption, and workflow efficiency.

→ Continuously refine product experiences based on evidence, feedback, and business outcomes.

**REQUIREMENTS:**

What you'll bring

→ Significant experience in UX Design, Product Design, Interaction Design, or a related discipline within a product development organisation.

→ Demonstrated experience defining UX strategy and translating it into tangible product improvements.

→ A strong portfolio showcasing end-to-end product design, workflow optimisation, innovative solutions, and interactive prototypes.

→ Experience designing complex digital products, enterprise platforms, or B2B SaaS applications.

→ Strong understanding of user-centred design, information architecture, interaction design, usability, accessibility, and responsive design.

→ Experience working with established design systems and collaborating closely with Product Management and Engineering.

→ Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.

→ Strong analytical thinking, creativity, and the ability to solve ambiguous problems independently.

→ Proven ability to manage priorities, make decisions, and deliver outcomes with minimal supervision.

**Nice to have**

Proficiency in Figma, FigJam, prototyping tools, and collaborative design platforms.

→ Experience with usability testing, product analytics, and research-driven design decisions.

→ Familiarity with AI-assisted design tools and emerging product design practices.

→ Experience establishing UX standards and scalable design practices in a growing product organisation.

With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
In this role, you will lead product strategy and execution for Teradata's core database engine: the massively parallel query engine behind every workload on the platform. You will shape the roadmap across the optimizer, execution runtime, workload management, and Global Planner, and own how the engine performs on native storage, cloud object storage, and open table formats such as Apache Iceberg and Delta Lake.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of the database engine and AI. AI agents are becoming the dominant consumers of enterprise data, issuing high volumes of exploratory, speculative queries, while GenAI and machine learning can improve the engine from the inside. Every core component needs to be rethought in this light, and you will lead that rethink and turn it into a roadmap engineering can build.
  
  
Two things anchor the role. Performance: you will spend significant time inside real workloads, query plans, and benchmarks, working with engineering to deliver measurable gains release after release. SQL: you will be the steward of Teradata SQL, the surface customers live in, making its syntax, semantics, and ergonomics simpler, more expressive, and safer for developers, analysts, and AI agents.
  
  

* Strategy: Own the engine vision and multi-year roadmap, co-owning architecture direction with senior engineering leaders and making principled trade-offs across performance, cost, and complexity.
* AI and agents: Lead the rethink of every core engine component for AI agents as the new dominant workload, and apply GenAI and ML inside the engine to make it faster and more autonomous.
* Optimizer, execution, and workload management: Agents send many redundant queries. Explore optimizing across queries, sharing intermediate results, and returning early or approximate answers. Apply learned cardinality and cost models and LLM-assisted rewrite, with guardrails that protect plan stability. Define how workload management absorbs bursty machine traffic through agent identity, priorities, and budgets.
* Performance: Work hands-on with engineering on query plans, regressions, and bottlenecks. Own the benchmark suite and KPIs (latency, concurrency, plan stability, price-performance), including agentic workloads, and build regression gates into releases.
* Open Table formats: Own the engine side of Iceberg and Delta Lake (scan planning, pruning, pushdown, write paths) so customers never trade performance for openness. Automate statistics, clustering, and compaction with AI.
* SQL language and query interface: Design features that turn complex problems into simple, readable queries, reduce footguns while keeping power and backward compatibility, and stay aligned with ANSI SQL. Make the dialect something agents can safely generate and execute, and let agents steer with cost estimates, plan explanations, and hints.

**Who You'll Work With**
You will work with senior database engineering leaders, performance engineering, AI platform teams, the open table format product team, sales engineering, and executive leadership across the US, Europe, and India. This role starts as an individual contributor, leading through technical depth and influence and mentoring Staff-level PMs. It may grow into managing a team of product managers.
  
  
What Makes You a Qualified Candidate
  
  

* 15+ years in databases, query engines, or distributed data systems, including senior product management or equivalent principal or staff engineering experience
* Expert understanding of database internals: query planning, cost-based optimization, execution models, and MPP trade-offs
* Deep SQL expertise: a heavy SQL user (data engineer, analyst, or DBA) with strong opinions on language design, ergonomics, and compatibility
* A hands-on performance mindset: reading query plans, designing benchmarks, and finding root causes with senior engineers
* A strong working understanding of LLMs and AI agents, and an informed view on how they change database design and how ML can improve database internals
* Architecture-level knowledge of Snowflake, Databricks, and ClickHouse, and fluency in lakehouse architecture and open table formats
* Degree in Computer Science or a related field; an MS or PhD in databases, distributed systems, or ML for systems is a plus

**What You'll Bring**

* First-principles thinking and good taste: willingness to question long-standing database assumptions, a preference for elegance over verbosity, customer obsession, daily use of GenAI tools, and the credibility to earn the trust of senior engineers
* The ability to read research critically, separate promise from hype, and design experiments to prove value, with a track record of setting multi-year platform strategy
* A plus: experience designing SQL features or language extensions, hands-on work with optimizers or learned database components, open-source contributions, or publications at SIGMOD, VLDB, or CIDR

**Position:** Business Development Manager (BDM) – Field Sales  
**Experience:** 2–8 Years

jobs.title: Accounts & Finance Manager – Cross-Border E-commerce
jobs.description:
**Location:** Andheri East, Mumbai, Maharashtra  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience Required:** 7–12 Years  
**Department:** Accounts & Finance  
**Reporting To:** Director / CEO

Job Summary

We are hiring an experienced Accounts & Finance Manager to oversee financial operations across multiple Indian and international entities within our cross-border e-commerce business.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in accounting and financial reporting, marketplace reconciliations, international taxation, inventory accounting, cash flow management, statutory compliance and team management.

Key Responsibilities

**Accounting & Financial Reporting**

* Manage accounting operations across multiple Indian and international entities.
* Ensure timely monthly, quarterly and annual financial closures.
* Prepare and review P&L, Balance Sheets, Trial Balance and financial statements.
* Finalize monthly P&L by the 10th of every month.
* Review ledgers, bank accounts, credit cards, sales, purchases, creditors, debtors and intercompany transactions.
* Manage accruals, provisions, depreciation, prepaid expenses and forex adjustments.

**E-commerce Accounting & Reconciliation**

* Handle marketplace reconciliations across Amazon, Noon, eBay, Walmart, Lazada, Shopee, Shopify and other platforms.
* Reconcile marketplace sales, settlements, commissions, refunds, returns, chargebacks and deductions.
* Monitor marketplace receivables, delayed settlements and stuck payouts.
* Reconcile marketplace reports with bank statements and accounting records.
* Coordinate with operations and account management teams to resolve discrepancies.

**Financial MIS & Profitability Analysis**

* Prepare monthly financial MIS and consolidated financial reports.
* Analyse revenue, margins, expenses and business profitability.
* Conduct product, brand and marketplace-level profitability analysis.
* Prepare landed-cost calculations, logistics cost comparisons and breakeven analysis.
* Identify cost leakages and opportunities for cost optimization.
* Present financial performance and variance analysis to management.

**Inventory & Procurement Accounting**

* Reconcile inventory across books, warehouses, marketplace reports and operational trackers.
* Monitor inventory movements, stock ageing, purchases, returns and damaged stock.
* Conduct inventory verification and investigate stock discrepancies.
* Review purchase and procurement reconciliations.

**Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Manage GST, TDS, Income Tax, Tax Audit, Advance Tax, PT, PF and ESIC coordination.
* Handle export-related GST compliance, LUT renewals and refund applications.
* Coordinate international taxation, including UAE VAT and Corporate Tax, Saudi VAT and Zakat, USA tax compliance, Singapore GST and UK VAT.
* Coordinate with Chartered Accountants, auditors and external tax consultants.
* Manage transfer pricing, related-party compliance and applicable international tax documentation.

**Banking & Treasury**

* Manage banking operations across domestic and international entities.
* Monitor bank reconciliations, cash balances and fund movements.
* Manage Payoneer and other international payment accounts.
* Track foreign remittances, export proceeds and import payments.
* Coordinate with AD banks for EDPMS, IDPMS and remittance documentation.
* Monitor cash flow, forex exposure and intercompany fund transfers.

**Audit, Cost Control & Team Management**

* Coordinate internal, statutory, tax and international audits.
* Maintain financial controls, SOPs, documentation and compliance trackers.
* Review logistics and vendor invoices and identify cost-saving opportunities.
* Lead and supervise the Accounts & Finance team.
* Allocate responsibilities, review performance and train team members.
* Work closely with management on budgets, financial projections and business planning.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* CA / CA Inter / CMA / MBA Finance / M.Com / B.Com.
* 7–12 years of experience in Accounts & Finance.
* Minimum 3–5 years of managerial or team supervisory experience.
* Experience in e-commerce, retail, export-import, cross-border trade or multi-entity accounting preferred.
* Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial reporting and taxation.
* Experience in international entities, marketplace reconciliation and foreign currency transactions.
* Proficiency in Tally Prime or other ERP/accounting software.
* Advanced Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, Lookup functions and financial modelling.
* Strong analytical skills, leadership, ownership and attention to detail.

Pay: ₹500,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**Job Summary / Introduction**

* Drive the development of the FAB Asset Management product range across all asset classes and product types, grounded in market analysis, client demand and competitive positioning.
* Own product ideation and design - investment proposition, target segment, vehicle and share class design, fee structure and commercial positioning - with legal documentation, regulatory filing and implementation executed by the relevant departments.
* Own product pricing and economics, including fee grids, margins, distribution economics and profitability, ensuring products are competitive in the market and commercially viable for FAB AM.
* Manage the product lifecycle end-to-end, from pipeline and business case to launch readiness, post-launch review, range rationalisation, mergers and closures.
* Contribute directly to the commercial effort alongside the sales and distribution teams, in particular on RFPs, due diligence questionnaires and client proposals.
* Live and demonstrate the FAB AM values.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Market and competitive analysis: Analyse market trends, flows, client demand and regulatory developments across all asset classes and product types, and maintain systematic benchmarking of competitor ranges, structures, fee levels and commercial propositions.
* Pricing and product economics: Define and own the pricing architecture - management and performance fees, share classes, distribution economics, breakpoints and discounts - and model revenue, margin and profitability per product.
* Product design and structuring: Design the product: investment proposition, mandate and benchmark, vehicle and domicile, share classes, currency and hedging, distribution model and target investor base; structuring here is design, not legal implementation.
* Business case and pipeline: Build the business case for each new product and prepare the papers required by the relevant committees; own the product pipeline and the multi-year roadmap, aligned to the commercial strategy and distribution capacity.
* Commercial positioning: Define the positioning, differentiation and value proposition of each product, and equip the commercial teams with the content, arguments and competitive comparisons needed to sell effectively.
* RFPs and commercial proposals: Contribute actively to the commercial effort with the sales and distribution teams by drafting and reviewing the product, strategy and competitive sections of RFPs, DDQs and client proposals, and by maintaining a reusable library of approved product content and Q&A.
* Lifecycle management: Monitor the performance, flows, profitability and relevance of the existing range, and drive rationalisation, repositioning, mergers and closures where appropriate.
* Cross-functional delivery: Act as design authority and business owner through the delivery of each product, working with Investments, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Operations, Technology and external counsel who execute documentation, filing and implementation.
* Regulatory awareness and reporting: Maintain a solid understanding of the ADGM and CMA product frameworks and their implications for product design and distribution, and report to management on pipeline, launches, pricing and product economics.

**Requirements / Qualifications**

* Experience: 5 to 10 years in product development, product management or product strategy within asset management or regulated financial services.
* Market, competition and pricing: Hands-on experience analysing markets, client demand and competitor ranges using industry databases, and defining or challenging fee structures and product profitability.
* Product knowledge: Solid understanding of investment products, strategies and vehicle structures across all asset classes and product types, including share class and distribution mechanics, and sufficient familiarity with product documentation to direct the teams executing it.
* Commercial support: Practical experience responding to RFPs and due diligence questionnaires and producing client-facing proposal content, with excellent written English and the ability to meet tight commercial deadlines.
* Regulatory and stakeholder skills: Working knowledge of the regulatory environment applicable to product design and distribution; proven ability to lead multi-stakeholder workstreams and manage timelines and dependencies.
* Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business or a related discipline.
* Capabilities: Analytical rigour, commercial judgement, initiative and the ability to turn market insight into a credible, differentiated and profitable product proposition.

**Preferred / Beneficial**

* Regulatory and stakeholder skills: ADGM and CMA an advantage.
* Qualifications: CFA, CAIA or equivalent professional qualifications are advantageous.

* Support the execution of the digital payment’s roadmap aligned with business objectives.
* Identify opportunities to improve existing payment products and introduce new payment capabilities.
* Monitor product performance and recommend enhancements to improve customer adoption and profitability.
* Support the rollout of new payment initiatives, ensuring timely delivery and successful implementation.

**Product Development**

* Coordinate product launches, enhancements, and system upgrades with internal and external stakeholders.
* Prepare business requirements, user stories, and functional specifications for new initiatives.

**Stakeholder & Vendor Management**

* Coordinate with payment processors, card schemes, fintech partners, and solution vendors during implementation and ongoing operations.
* Support relationship management with external partners and service providers.
* Facilitate communication between business users and technology teams throughout project delivery.

* Manage digital payment projects from planning through implementation and post-launch support.
* Coordinate project activities, monitor timelines, risks, budgets, and deliverables.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies and support continuous delivery initiatives.
* Ensure project documentation, testing, and operational readiness are completed before implementation.

**Performance & Analytics**

* Monitor key business metrics including transaction volumes, active customers, revenue, product utilization, and operational performance.
* Prepare dashboards, reports, and management updates on payment product performance.
* Identify trends and recommend initiatives to improve product adoption and customer engagement.
* Support pricing reviews, campaign analysis, and revenue optimization initiatives.

**Compliance & Risk**

* Ensure digital payment products comply with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and card scheme rules.
* Support operational risk assessments and implementation of appropriate controls.

* Assist in managing vendor governance, audit requirements, and issue resolution.

**Market Research & Innovation**

**Experience & Requirements**

* Good understanding of card issuing, merchant acquiring, payment gateways, prepaid cards, QR payments, and digital wallets.
* Knowledge of payment ecosystems, payment processing, and industry best practices.
* Experience preparing business requirements and coordinating product implementations.
* Familiarity with payment regulations, risk management, and operational controls.
* Experience working with cross-functional teams and external vendors.
* Knowledge of Agile delivery methodologies and digital product development.
* Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in data analysis and reporting tools is desirable.
* Commercial mindset with a focus on customer experience, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: VP, Product
jobs.description:
*At Securonix, we’re on a mission to secure the world by staying ahead of cyber threats, reinforcing all layers of our platform with AI capabilities. Our*
***Securonix Unified Defense SIEM***
*provides organizations with the first and only AI-Reinforced solution built with a cybersecurity mesh architecture on a highly scalable data cloud. Enhanced by*
***Securonix EON’***
*s AI capabilities, our innovative cloud-native solution delivers a seamless CyberOps experience, empowering organizations to scale their security operations and keep up with evolving threats.*

*Recognized as a*
***five-time leader***
*in the*
***Gartner Magic Quadrant for SIEM***
*and highly rated on*
***Gartner Peer Insights***
*, our award-winning Unified Defense SIEM provides organizations with 365 days of ‘hot’ data for rapid search and investigation, threat content-as-a-service, proactive defense through continuous peer and partner collaboration, and a fully integrated*
***Threat Detection, Investigation, and Response (TDIR)***
*experience—all within a single platform. Built on a cloud-native architecture, the platform leverages the Snowflake Data Cloud for unparalleled scalability and performance.*

*Securonix is proud to be a*
***cybersecurity unicorn***
*and featured in CRN's 2024*
***Security 100 list***
*. Backed by*
***Vista Equity Partners***
*, one of the largest private equity firms with over $100 billion in assets under management, we have a unique advantage in driving innovation and growth. With a global footprint, we serve more than*
***1,000 customers worldwide***
*, including*
***10% of the Fortune 100***
*. Our network of*
***150+ partners***
*and Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs) enables us to deliver unmatched security solutions on a global scale.*

*At Securonix, we are driven by our core values and place our people at the heart of everything we do:*

* ***Winning as One Team***
  *: We work together with universal respect to achieve aligned outcomes*
* ***Customer Driven Innovation***
  *: We innovate to stay ahead of the market and create value for our customers*
* ***Agility in Action***
  *: We embrace change and are unified in our purpose and objectives amidst change*

*Join us as we redefine cybersecurity, innovate fearlessly, and grow together as one team!*

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

Cyber threats are evolving faster than ever — and so are we. At Securonix, we deliver world-class SIEM, UEBA, SOAR, and Threat Intelligence solutions that help enterprises detect, investigate, and respond to threats with unmatched speed and accuracy. We’re seeking a Vice President of Product who can lead a talented team of product managers to drive innovation, execution, and market impact across our entire product portfolio.

We are seeking an experienced, execution-focused Vice President of Product to own the delivery of our product roadmap across all core offerings — SIEM, UEBA, SOAR, and Threat Intelligence. You will lead a team of product managers, ensuring we deliver exceptional value to customers while maintaining our position as a cybersecurity market leader.

This role is customer-facing yet execution-driven — you will engage with top clients and analysts while focusing on delivering high-quality, stable, and innovative products on time. You'll also work cross-functionally with Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success to ensure alignment and maximize market success.

If you thrive on turning strategy into results, leading high-performing teams, and shaping products that protect some of the world's largest organizations, this is your opportunity to make a global impact.

**POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Lead, coach, and inspire a team of product managers, creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, and innovation.
* Own execution of the Securonix product roadmap across SIEM, UEBA, SOAR, and Threat Intelligence offerings.
* Contribute to product vision and long-term strategy in partnership with the executive leadership team.
* Act as a primary product voice with customers, prospects, and analysts to validate direction and maintain market relevance.
* Partner with Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success to drive successful launches and ongoing adoption.
* Implement and refine product delivery processes to improve speed, quality, and cross team coordination.
* Ensure competitive differentiation by evolving and scaling our mature product suite while introducing market-leading capabilities

**REQUIRED SKILLS:**

* 12+ years in product management, with at least 5 years in senior leadership.
* Required: Experience with SIEM, UEBA, and/or SOAR; Threat Intelligence experience strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated success in scaling mature enterprise cybersecurity products.
* Proven ability to deliver complex roadmaps on time while ensuring product stability and customer satisfaction.
* Strong understanding of enterprise security operations, threat detection, and threat
* Exceptional leadership skills with a player-coach mindset.
* Excellent communicator, comfortable influencing across all levels of an organization.

**Success Metrics:**

* On-time roadmap delivery
* Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) growth
* Competitive product wins
* Product stability and operational excellence

**Benefits:**

As a full-time employee with Securonix, you will be eligible for the following employee benefits:

* Health Insurance with a total sum insured is INR 7,50,000
* Coverage: Self, Spouse, 2 kids, Dependent parents, or parents-in-law
* Personal Accident with total sum insured is INR 10,00,000
* Term Life Insurance with a sum assured for employees is 5 times fixed base pay is covered.

*Securonix is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an innovative, inclusive, diverse and discrimination-free work environment. Employment with Securonix is based on merit, competence, and qualifications. It is our policy to administer all personnel actions, including recruiting, hiring, training, and promoting employees, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, or any other legally protected classification in accordance with applicable federal and state laws. Consistent with the obligations of these laws, Securonix will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities.*
