jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

* The PaPM CoE Delivery Head is responsible for leading the end-to-end PaPM Centre of Excellence (CoE), create a centralised capability to drive solution standardisation, architectural governance, delivery excellence, reusable assets, technical expertise across PaPM implementation. Partner with Technology and Finance stakeholders to translate strategic objectives into scalable solutions, improve delivery efficiency, build organisational capabilities and maximise value derived from PaPM Investments.

**The PaPM CoE Delivery Head In India Will**
**Strategy & Leadership**

* Ensuring successful execution of the strategic roadmap, delivery of business use cases, platform governance, and operational excellence. The role is accountable for building and managing a high-performing team of PaPM specialists, establishing delivery standards, ensuring architecture compliance, and maximizing value realization from the PaPM platform across Finance, Treasury, Risk, Sustainability, and Performance Management functions. The role acts as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, technology teams, vendors, and senior leadership
* Define and execute the SAP PaPM CoE vision, operating model, and strategic roadmap.
* Drive adoption of SAP PaPM as the strategic platform for allocations, profitability analysis, scenario modelling, regulatory calculations, and performance management.
* Align PaPM initiatives with Finance Transformation, Enterprise Architecture, Data, Analytics, and AI strategies.
* Establish long-term capability plans covering people, process, technology, and governance.
* Provide thought leadership on emerging SAP PaPM capabilities, AI enablement, and automation opportunities

**Delivery & Execution**

* Own the delivery portfolio and annual Book of Work (BoW) across all PaPM programs and initiatives.
* Ensure successful delivery of projects through design, build, testing, deployment, and stabilization.
* Establish predictable delivery governance, quality standards, and execution metrics.
* Drive prioritization of demand, capacity planning, and resource allocation.
* Ensure timely delivery within agreed scope, budget, quality, and risk parameters.
* Lead resolution of critical delivery issues and escalationsReview the lessons learned from previous releases / phases and to ensure that follow up / corrective actions are taken on time to ensure the smooth execution of upcoming test phases.

**Architecture & Solution Governance**

* Own PaPM design standards, architecture principles, and implementation patterns.
* Chair Solution Design Reviews and Architecture Governance forums.
* Ensure solutions adhere to enterprise architecture, security, compliance, and non-functional requirements.
* Approve onboarding of new use cases into PaPM based on complexity, ROI, data readiness, and strategic fit.
* Drive reusability and standardization across solution components.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as the senior point of contact for CFO, Finance Transformation, Treasury, Risk, Technology, and Operations stakeholders.
* Build trusted relationships with senior business sponsors and journey owners.
* Present delivery status, risks, investment cases, and strategic recommendations to senior governance forums and steering committees.
* Manage vendor partnerships and oversee external delivery teams.

**CoE Management & Talent Development**

* Build and lead a multi-disciplinary team consisting of Solution Leads, Architects, Analysts, Modelers, and Platform Specialists.
* Define capability development strategy and certification pathways.
* Establish knowledge management, training programs, and communities of practice.
* Drive workforce planning and succession planning for niche PaPM skills.
* Foster innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement across global teams.

**Platform Operations & Sustainability**

* Own platform health, stability, scalability, and performance.
* Ensure robust support, maintenance, release management, and incident management processes.
* Drive continuous optimization and technical debt reduction initiatives.
* Establish operational KPIs and service management standards.
* Ensure business continuity and resilience of critical PaPM processes

**Risk, Governance & Controls**

* Embed strong delivery, technology, and operational risk management practices.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory, audit, security, and enterprise control requirements.
* Maintain transparent governance and reporting across all PaPM initiatives.
* Drive proactive identification and mitigation of delivery, platform, and resource risks

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Delivery of annual PaPM Book of Work.
* Time-to-market improvement for new use cases.
* Platform availability and stability.
* Stakeholder satisfaction scores.
* Budget adherence and cost efficiency.
* Adoption and utilization of PaPM capabilities.
* Audit and control compliance.
* Team capability and certification growth.
* Reuse of standard components and design patterns.

**Essential**
**Required Experience**

* 12+ years of experience in Finance Technology, Enterprise Applications, or Finance Transformation.
* 7+ years of SAP experience with significant exposure to SAP PaPM.
* Proven leadership experience managing global delivery teams and complex transformation programs.
* Strong understanding of:
* SAP PaPM
* SAP BW/BW4HANA
* SAP S/4HANA
* Finance and Controllership processes
* Profitability and Cost Management
* Transfer Pricing
* Allocations and Recharges
* Performance Management
* Experience managing senior business stakeholders and executive governance forums.
* Demonstrated success building and scaling Centres of Excellence.

**Preferred**

* Experience within Banking or Financial Services.
* Exposure to FP&A, Treasury, Risk, Regulatory Reporting, or Sustainability reporting.
* Experience leading vendor-delivered and hybrid delivery models.
* Knowledge of AI-enabled solution delivery and advanced analytics platforms.

**Skills And Competencies**

* SAP PaPM Architecture
* SAP PaPM Modelling
* Solution Design
* Enterprise Architecture
* SAP BW / HANA
* SAP S/4HANA Integration
* Program Delivery
* Agile Delivery
* Data Management & Governance
* Financial Modelling & Allocations

At Capital One, we’re building a leading information-based technology company. Still founder-led by Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Richard Fairbank, Capital One is on a mission to help our customers succeed by bringing ingenuity, simplicity, and humanity to banking.

At Capital One India, we are at the cutting edge of solving fundamental business problems using advanced data methodologies, statistics, and machine learning algorithms. We analyze data to derive valuable business insights, make decisions, and develop innovative and patentable products.

Directors in Risk Management at Capital One are highly motivated Risk Management professionals with excellent organizational, leadership and communication skills. They have a high level of exposure across lines of business and the opportunity to work with Executives to create and implement innovative solutions to identify and mitigate potential risks to the Company. You will lead a team of Risk Specialists and Legal professionals and act as a thought leader working across the enterprise to develop and implement cutting edge Risk and Legal solutions to ensure Capital One’s continued stability and success. You will partner with Executives and lines of business to drive organizational change in order to better manage the Company’s Risk in an open, collaborative environment where new ideas and solutions are both welcomed and rewarded.

**Responsibilities:**

* Identify opportunities to improve our Risk Management and Legal processes and execute well-managed change to strategies, methodologies, governance, and reporting elements
* Lead and oversee risk and legal functions and deliverables from Risk and Legal team
* Synthesize and elevate information to executive levels to drive action
* Leverage data, metrics, and analysis to create a comprehensive approach to monitoring our process improvement strategies as they move through the organization
* Work with business partners to validate risk processes impacting the company’s bottom line
* Define and implement operating models / interaction models with multiple stakeholder teams ensuring consistency in risk and legal operations between teams
* Consult on analysis and reporting outcomes to observe trends and provide insights on changes to the Company’s risk environments
* Perform and support detailed validation data analysis to include trending, problem identification, and development/completion of remediation plans
* Collaborate effectively with stakeholders and leaders across multiple organizations to achieve objectives
* Play a key role in contributing to the effective design and delivery of our risk management and legal framework
* Demonstrate problem-solving and analysis skills with attention to detail
* Demonstrate strong communication, collaboration, problem solving and influencing skills across various levels of the organization
* Actively support internal and external audits and exams
* Balance multiple priorities to help drive business value and support team objectives, while managing tasks and activities related to risk management initiatives in a well-managed capacity
* Lead a team of professionals to advise and consult key stakeholders to drive effective risk identification, assessment, and disposition.
* Set direction, manage expectations, and lead cross-functional teams
* Foster an environment of trust, collaboration & belonging while leading a team

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s/Master's Degree
* At least 18 years of experience in risk management
* At least 8 years of experience in people management
* At least 10 years of experience in financial services

jobs.title: Senior Vice President, Financial Planning & Analysis Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**Senior Vice President, Financial Planning & Analysis Manager – India Lead, CTF & BSRA**
At BNY, our culture allows us to run our company better and enables employees’ growth and success. As a leading global financial services company at the heart of the global financial system, we influence nearly 20% of the world’s investible assets. Every day, our teams harness cutting-edge AI and breakthrough technologies to collaborate with clients, driving transformative solutions that redefine industries and uplift communities worldwide.
  
  
Recognized as a top destination for innovators, BNY is where bold ideas meet advanced technology and exceptional talent. Together, we power the future of finance – and this is what is all about. Join us and be part of something extraordinary.
  
  
We’re seeking a future team member for the role of
**Senior Vice President, Financial Planning & Analysis Manager**
to join our
**Corporate Treasury Finance (CTF) & Balance Sheet Reporting & Analytics (BSRA)**
team within Finance. This role is located in
**Pune, India**
.
  
  
In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:
  
  

* Functional leadership: Lead Corporate Treasury Finance (CTF) and Balance Sheet Reporting & Analytics (BSRA) from India, with full accountability for the quality, timeliness, control and continuous improvement of all deliverables.
* Plan & forecast: Own the end-to-end Balance Sheet and Net Interest Income (NII) plan and forecast process (plan rounds, rest-of-year and multi-year outlooks) for supported Lines of Business, ensuring a consistent methodology and timely submission into planning systems.
* Deposit forecast governance: Lead the deposit forecast and challenger process with Treasury Finance, GLS and LOB CFOs – framing assumptions, sensitivities, beta/pricing expectations and decision asks.
* NII & balance sheet narrative: Own the NII and balance sheet story for senior management, explaining drivers of variance versus plan, forecast and prior periods (rate, volume and mix) along with forward-looking risks and opportunities.
* Subject-matter expertise: Provide leadership on Funds Transfer Pricing (FTP), liquidity metrics (LCR and liquidity stress testing), interest-bearing and non-interest-bearing balance dynamics, and assess the impact of central bank rate changes, client flows and product/currency mix on deposits and NII.
* Reporting & analytics: Oversee daily, weekly, month-end and quarterly reporting – including month-to-date NII estimates, earnings support, management memos and client-, LOB- and firm-level analytics such as deposit pricing cohorts, client movers and beta analysis.
* Stakeholder partnership: Serve as trusted advisor and senior point of contact for Corporate Treasury, CIO, Treasury Finance, LOB CFOs, GLS, Interest Rate Risk, International Treasury, Controllers and Technology; represent India in senior forums and build durable partnerships through clear service models, SLAs and governance cadences.
* Scope expansion: Identify and lead the transition of new LOBs, platforms and processes into the India hub, partnering with Finance Data Strategy, Technology and other Centers of Excellence on firm-wide initiatives.
* Transformation & AI: Drive process simplification, report rationalization and adoption of Power BI, self-serve dashboards, automation and AI agents, tracking measurable efficiency gains aligned to Finance objectives.

To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:
  
  

* Education: Master’s degree in a financial discipline such as accounting, finance, economics or statistics, or local country equivalent, is required; MBA preferred. Professional qualifications such as CA, CFA, FRM or CPA are a strong advantage.
* Experience: 15+ years of progressive experience in finance, FP&A, treasury finance or balance sheet management within banking or financial services.
* Domain expertise: Strong knowledge of Asset and Liability Management (ALM), deposits, NII, FTP, liquidity (LCR/LST), interest rate risk and the bank balance sheet, with a sound understanding of financial controls and governance.
* Global operating model: Proven track record of building and scaling India-based Centers of Excellence that partner with US/EMEA senior leadership; ability to influence senior stakeholders and translate complex technical-financial topics into clear business narratives.
* Communication & tools: Excellent written, verbal and executive presentation skills; advanced MS Office; proficiency with enterprise planning, reporting and ERP tools (e.g., Planning Analytics/TM1, Cognos, HFM, Oracle) and Power BI – exposure to Python/SQL, automation and AI tools is a plus.
* People leadership: 7+ years leading multi-layered teams (VPs, AVPs, Specialists and Analysts), with demonstrated strength in organization design, workforce and succession planning, coaching and performance management, and in building an inclusive, high-performance culture.

At BNY, our culture speaks for itself, check out the latest BNY news at:
  
  
BNY Newsroom
  
  
BNY LinkedIn
  
  
**Here’s a Few Of Our Recent Awards**

* America’s Most Innovative Companies, Fortune, 2025
* World’s Most Admired Companies, Fortune 2025
* “Most Just Companies”, Just Capital and CNBC, 2025

**Our Benefits And Rewards**
BNY offers highly competitive compensation, benefits, and wellbeing programs rooted in a strong culture of excellence and our pay-for-performance philosophy. We provide access to flexible global resources and tools for your life’s journey. Focus on your health, foster your personal resilience, and reach your financial goals as a valued member of our team, along with generous paid leaves, including paid volunteer time, that can support you and your family through moments that matter.
  
  
BNY is an Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer - Underrepresented racial and ethnic groups/Females/Individuals with Disabilities/Protected Veterans.

jobs.title: Revenue Accounting Engineering and Delivery Tech Lead - India
jobs.description:
**Role Purpose**
The Head of Engineering for Revenue Accounting India will provide senior technology and engineering leadership for the Revenue Accounting organization in India, building a world-class engineering capability and driving modernization, engineering excellence and predictable delivery across the Revenue Accounting technology estate.
  
  
The role will establish India as a
**strategic engineering centre supporting end-to-end delivery**
, partnering with global Technology and Finance leadership to deliver critical Revenue Accounting capabilities and strategic transformation.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine strong engineering and technology leadership with the ability to lead a large, complex organization, develop exceptional talent, modernize the technology estate and deliver consistently in a highly regulated environment.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
**Engineering Leadership & Strategy**

* Lead the Revenue Accounting engineering organization in India, with accountability for engineering excellence, talent, technology and delivery outcomes.
* Define and execute the India engineering strategy, aligned to the global Revenue Accounting technology strategy and broader Finance transformation agenda.
* Provide strong technical leadership across the engineering organization, ensuring strategic technology decisions balance business outcomes, architecture, resilience, risk and long-term sustainability.
* Establish clear engineering standards across software design, architecture, development, testing, DevSecOps, observability, resilience and production engineering.
* Champion a culture of engineering ownership where teams are accountable for solutions throughout the technology lifecycle, from design and build through deployment and production.

**Technology Modernization**

* Drive modernization of the Revenue Accounting technology estate, including MOTIF and the broader subledger ecosystem, simplifying legacy architecture and moving toward strategic target-state capabilities.
* Actively manage technical debt and drive simplification of applications, infrastructure, data flows and engineering processes.
* Promote modern architecture and engineering patterns including cloud, APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture, automation and modern data capabilities where appropriate.
* Ensure technology investment balances immediate business and regulatory requirements with the long-term strategic health of the platform.

**Delivery & Transformation**

* Drive predictable execution of the Revenue Accounting engineering roadmap, aligning engineering capacity to the highest-value business, regulatory and strategic outcomes.
* Provide senior engineering leadership to major Finance transformation initiatives, ensuring Revenue Accounting capabilities integrate effectively with the target front-to-back accounting architecture.
* Establish transparent measures of engineering health, delivery effectiveness, quality, risk and productivity.
* Identify and proactively manage material technology dependencies, delivery risks and capacity constraints.

**Talent & Organizational Leadership**

* Build and develop a high-performing engineering organization across India, strengthening both engineering leadership and deep technical capability.
* Attract, retain and develop outstanding engineering talent while creating clear career paths for technical specialists and engineering leaders.
* Build a strong succession pipeline across Director, VP, technical leadership and senior engineering roles.
* Strengthen institutional knowledge and reduce key-person or third-party dependencies through targeted insourcing, mobility, cross-training and capability development.
* Foster an inclusive, collaborative and high-performance engineering culture where teams are empowered to challenge, innovate and continuously improve.

**Innovation & AI**

* Champion the responsible adoption of AI-enabled software engineering, intelligent automation and modern developer tooling across the engineering lifecycle.
* Identify opportunities to improve developer productivity, test automation, software quality and speed to market through AI and automation.
* Create an environment that encourages experimentation while ensuring innovation is governed appropriately for a regulated technology environment.

**Partnership & Stakeholder Leadership**

* Act as a senior member of the global Revenue Accounting technology leadership team, ensuring India is fully integrated into global strategy and decision-making.
* Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Finance, Product, Architecture, Operations, Risk, Controls and Technology.
* Influence enterprise technology and engineering decisions beyond the immediate Revenue Accounting organization.
* Represent Revenue Accounting within the broader India technology leadership community and strengthen India's position as a strategic engineering hub.

****Desirable Skills****
The following would be advantageous:
  
  
  

* Experience within financial accounting technology, including subledger, general ledger, financial control or regulatory reporting platforms.
* Understanding of front-to-back accounting flows, including transaction capture, accounting event generation, subledger processing, reconciliation, financial controls and general-ledger integration.
* Experience delivering large-scale Finance or enterprise transformation within a global financial institution.
* Experience with large-scale platform or cloud modernization.
* Knowledge of modern technologies and patterns including Java, APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture, AWS/cloud technologies, DevSecOps and modern data platforms.
* Experience implementing AI-assisted software engineering, developer productivity tooling or intelligent test automation at enterprise scale.
* Experience developing product-oriented and Agile engineering organizations.
* Experience implementing insourcing strategies and transferring critical technology or domain capability from third-party providers into permanent engineering teams.
* Experience leading globally distributed engineering organizations, particularly across India, the UK and US.
* Understanding of technology economics and experience optimizing engineering investment, infrastructure costs and third-party expenditure.

****Accountabilities****
The Head of Engineering will have clear accountability across the following areas:
  
  
**Technology & Architecture**

* Technical health and strategic evolution of the Revenue Accounting technology estate within the role's remit.
* Alignment to enterprise architecture, engineering and technology standards.
* Reduction of legacy complexity and technical debt.
* Creation of sustainable, resilient and scalable technology solutions.

**Engineering & Delivery**

* Quality, predictability and effectiveness of engineering delivery.
* Engineering standards and controls throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Effective management of engineering capacity, dependencies and technology risks.
* Continuous improvement of engineering productivity, quality and time to market.

**Service, Resilience & Controls**

* Stability, resilience, security and maintainability of technology platforms.
* Effective management of production risk, recurring incidents and systemic technology issues.
* Compliance with applicable technology, cyber, data, resilience and regulatory requirements.
* Timely identification, escalation and remediation of material technology risks and control weaknesses.

**People & Organization**

* Organizational health and effectiveness of the India Revenue Accounting engineering function.
* Workforce strategy, organizational design and location strategy.
* Attraction, retention, development and succession of engineering talent.
* Development of strong engineering and technology leadership capability.
* Reduction of key-person risk and inappropriate dependency on external providers.

Finance & Accounting Operations Leader
  
  
**Job Location:**
Bangalore, Pune

WFO

**Total Experience And Relevant Experience**
15+ years of overall experience, with strong leadership exposure in managing large-scale Finance & Accounting operations.

Strong experience in large-scale Finance & Accounting operations, P&L ownership, revenue and margin management, cost optimization, budgeting, financial reviews, and profitability improvement. Proven expertise in driving business planning, account growth, and revenue enhancement within existing service lines. Strong experience in transformation, operational excellence, work redesign, productivity improvement, resource optimization, and operating model optimization. Experience in leading end-to-end transitions covering target operating model, workforce, infrastructure, technology, contractual, and training readiness. Strong functional exposure across RTR, AP, AR, and FP&A. Strong people leadership experience in managing large teams.

Open to all candidates.

Good to Have: MBA Finance, CA, CMA, CPA, or equivalent finance qualification.
  
  
**Specific Remarks**
Strong preference for candidates with relevant experience in large-scale Finance & Accounting operations and leadership roles. Regular education preferred.
  
  
**Certification**

**Detailed Job Description**
The role will be responsible for providing strategic and operational leadership for large-scale Finance & Accounting operations. The incumbent will own business performance, drive profitability, lead transformation initiatives, strengthen client relationships, and ensure delivery excellence across multiple F&A service lines.
  
  
The candidate will have strong ownership of P&L performance, including revenue, margins, cost optimization, budgeting, financial reviews, profitability improvement, and corrective action planning. The incumbent will lead transformation and operational excellence initiatives by driving work redesign, productivity improvement, process optimization, automation, resource optimization, and operating model enhancement. The role will provide strategic oversight for end-to-end transitions, including target operating model design, workforce planning, infrastructure readiness, technology enablement, contractual requirements, process readiness, and training. The individual will oversee end-to-end Finance & Accounting operations across Record to Report, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and FP&A. The role will ensure strong performance across delivery, quality, productivity, utilization, service levels, financial outcomes, and customer satisfaction.
  
  
The candidate will establish and lead robust governance frameworks, conduct regular business and performance reviews, manage senior stakeholders, ensure contractual compliance, identify and mitigate operational risks, and drive timely resolution of critical issues and escalations.
  
  
The role will also require strong people leadership capabilities to manage large and diverse teams, build leadership capability, drive performance management, strengthen employee engagement, and develop a high-performance culture aligned with business objectives.

**Job Description**
Job Description - General Manager – Finance & Accounts
  
  
General Manager – Finance & Accounts
  
  
Finance, Accounts & Compliance
  
  
Head Office, Pune
  
  
**About Teerth Realties**
Every Teerth project moves through investment and capex gates, and finance controls those gates. jobs.title: NFR Senior Manager
jobs.description:
#### **Job ID**

66592

#### **Work Style**

Hybrid Worker

#### **Brand**

HSBC

#### **Job Type**

Full Time

#### **Date Posted**

24 November 2026

#### **Apply By**

29 November 2026

**Some careers have more impact than others.**

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a meaningful difference, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be. As one of the world’s largest banking and financial services organisations, HSBC operates across 62 countries and territories.

We aim to be where the growth is—enabling businesses to thrive, economies to prosper and people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We’re seeking an experienced professional to join our Securities Services team as **NFR Senior Manager.**

  

**In this role, you will:**

* Report to the FMI NFR Head, the Senior Manager will act as a key partner in shaping and delivering the FMI non-financial risk agenda. The role holder will recommend priorities, take ownership of agreed deliverables and lead implementation across in-scope FMI activities and NTTPs, ensuring alignment with Group mandatory procedures, the Risk Management Framework (RMF) and Third-Party Risk Policy requirements.
* This newly created position will lead the design, implementation and ongoing enhancement of the FMI NTTP risk management operating model. The Senior Manager will translate policy requirements into effective governance, controls and management information (MI), challenge existing practices and drive consistent adoption. Success will be measured through demonstrable improvements in risk management and sustainable control outcomes, rather than completion of activities alone.
* Working across Network Management and Market Intelligence (N2MI), Trading Facilities and CCP Management (TFCM), CSD Management and PS Management, the role holder will influence senior stakeholders and lead resolution of complex risk and control matters. The role will operate autonomously within an agreed mandate, escalating material exposures, unresolved disagreements and decisions requiring the FMI NFR Head’s authority. The FMI NFR Head retains overall functional accountability, while business and control owners retain responsibility for their risks, controls and remediation.
* Partner with the FMI NFR Head to establish a prioritised programme of activity that strengthens the control environment for in-scope FMI NTTPs. Lead delivery of agreed outcomes, ensuring risk management practices are consistent, evidence-based and aligned with Third-Party Risk Policy requirements, FMI-specific expectations and applicable risk appetite.
* Lead the development of clear, forward-looking risk insight and recommendations to inform governance and senior decision-making. Challenge control weaknesses, emerging exposures and the adequacy of proposed responses, holding accountable owners to agreed remediation outcomes and escalating material concerns or delivery risks.
* Drive change across FMI by leading implementation of CIB-led Third-Party Risk Management initiatives and improvements to mandatory procedures, operating instructions, reporting and tooling. Assess market infrastructure and regulatory developments, recommend proportionate responses and secure stakeholder commitment to changes that are practical, consistently embedded and sustainable.
* Partner with the FMI NFR Head to shape priorities and lead implementation and enhancement of mandatory FMI procedures and associated controls across in-scope NTTPs. Lead annual reviews and updates across N2MI and TFCM, challenge gaps and drive consistent application as business and regulatory requirements evolve.
* Lead oversight of FMI third-party controls and monitoring, critically assess results and challenge the adequacy of control design, operation and supporting evidence against Third-Party Risk Policy requirements and FMI-specific expectations. Drive resolution of weaknesses with accountable owners and maintain audit-ready documentation standards.
* Lead development and quality assurance of monthly governance packs and MI for the FMI Business Control Committee and N2MI Governance Committee. Translate complex matters into clear risk assessments, recommendations and decisions required; present and defend key messages, challenge senior stakeholders and escalate material concerns through the appropriate governance channels.
* Lead end-to-end oversight of NFR actions, issues and remediation, including Management Self-Identified Issues (MSIIs) and Audit Identified Issues (AIIs). Challenge root-cause analysis, action plans, milestones and closure evidence; hold accountable owners to agreed outcomes and escalate delays, unresolved exposures or remediation that does not deliver sustainable risk reduction.
* Lead FMI’s coordination of internal and external audits and assurance reviews. Establish coherent responses across the FMI team, challenge evidence quality and consistency, identify cross-cutting themes and drive delivery of agreed remediation with accountable owners, escalating significant matters to the FMI NFR Head.
* Lead FMI’s implementation and embedding of CIB-led Third-Party Risk Management initiatives. Assess business impacts, establish clear delivery plans and accountabilities, influence stakeholders across business, operations and Risk and Control functions, and resolve implementation challenges to secure effective adoption.
* Drive continuous improvement and simplification of FMI NFR processes, reporting and tooling. Challenge inefficient practices, prioritise changes that strengthen control effectiveness, data quality and management insight, and lead delivery from design through implementation and embedding within an agreed mandate.
* Lead analysis and preparation of responses to regulatory requests and senior management queries. Proactively assess emerging market infrastructure and regulatory developments, determine implications for FMI NTTP operational performance and the control environment, and recommend prioritised, proportionate responses to the FMI NFR Head and relevant stakeholders.
  

**To be successful you will:**

* Substantial experience in non-financial risk, operational risk, third-party risk or governance and controls within financial services or a similarly regulated environment, with a demonstrated record of leading complex risk and control initiatives.
* A self-starting, solution-oriented approach, independently setting priorities aligned with the FMI NFR agenda and driving delivery without close supervision. Takes proactive initiative and end-to-end ownership, remaining accountable for outcomes and exercising sound judgement on when to engage or escalate.
* Strong practical expertise in risk and control frameworks, including the ability to challenge risk assessments, control design and effectiveness, root-cause analysis, remediation plans and closure evidence, and maintain audit-quality documentation.
* Strong analytical capability and sound judgement to interpret complex information, identify emerging risks and cross-cutting themes, and recommend priorities based on materiality.
* Demonstrated ability to partner with senior leaders, influence and constructively challenge stakeholders, resolve competing priorities and secure delivery across business, operations and Risk and Control functions without relying on direct reporting authority.
* Strong executive communication skills, including producing concise MI, dashboards and governance papers, presenting complex matters clearly, making evidence-based recommendations and articulating the decisions and actions required from senior stakeholders.
* Proven ability to lead cross-functional change from design through implementation and embedding, establish clear accountability and manage multiple priorities with disciplined delivery and attention to detail. Evidence of sustainable improvements in risk management or control effectiveness, supported by proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint and Word.
* Knowledge of FM

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Commercial Services
jobs.description:
### **A****BOUT TIDE**

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

**Tide facts:**

* Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
* Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
* Over $300 million raised in funding
* 3,000 Tideans globally
* We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

### **ABOUT THE TEAM:**

Tide is hiring a Director of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind Commercial Services. You will report to the CDTO and partner with Product and Design leadership as one leadership team accountable for the outcomes of the domain.

Commercial Services is where Tide extends from helping members run their business to helping them grow it. You will shape how quickly every member becomes discoverable, how much of their buying and selling runs through Tide, and how far AI can turn that into a lasting advantage across every market we serve.

Sell gives every member a live, discoverable presence, from the Tide Business Pages we are launching for 2 million members across the UK and Europe, to Own Website, catalogue, bookings, CRM and lead capture, and embedded fulfilment through Delivery as a Service.

Buy turns that member base into a two-sided marketplace through the Tide Online Network, alongside Tide Promotions (gift cards, cashback and personalised offers), business supplies from partners, and Vendor Hub for e-procurement.

You will be the single owner accountable for engineering delivery, architecture and people across both.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE:**

This role sits at the intersection of SME commerce, marketplaces and banking. Our members sit on both sides of the marketplace, our partners extend what we can offer them, and our banking platform lets us layer payments, credit, insurance and rewards into the experience at the point of need, which few commerce players can do. We need someone who can bring both streams onto one consistent engineering bar, ship quickly and build the platforms that turn Commercial Services into a material recurring revenue line for Tide.

As Director of Engineering you will

* Set the engineering strategy and technical direction across the Sell and Buy value streams, from launch through to scale.
* Lead the Heads of Engineering for Sell and Buy, build the leadership bench underneath them, and own headcount planning, hiring and organisation design.
* Partner with Product and Design leadership on one shared plan, jointly owning delivery and outcomes, including members activated through real sales and purchases, engagement and recurring revenue.
* Scale the Tide Business Pages and Tide Online Network into a trusted, high-traffic marketplace, including search, listings, member-to-member leads, chat and buyer requests.
* Build the partner integration platform behind our website, gift card, business supply and logistics partners, enabling new partners and offers to be onboarded quickly and safely.
* Work with Payments, Acquiring, Credit, Insurance and Wealth to embed payments, credit, insurance and rewards into commerce journeys at the point of need.
* Build trust into the marketplace in partnership with Ongoing Monitoring and Risk, from verified seller status to initial and ongoing monitoring of listings and member-to-member communication.
* Set a consistent engineering practice and quality bar across architecture, delivery health measured through DORA metrics, reliability and security.
* Lead our move towards AI-assisted and agentic commerce, where a member describes what they need and Tide finds, compares and sources it.
* Apply our OnePlatform principles so we build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated.

### **WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:**

* Director engineering leadership of a multi-team organisation of around 50 engineers across backend, frontend, data and analytics, led through at least one layer of engineering leaders.
* Domain experience in e-commerce, two-sided marketplaces, CRM or procurement platforms, including the trust and safety controls they need, with fintech or SME banking experience a plus.
* Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable product and commercial outcomes.
* Experience building partner and third-party integration platforms at scale.
* Strong product and design partnership instincts.
* Comfortable setting direction through ambiguity and launching new products into multiple markets.
* Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, architecture and technical quality.
* Experience bringing AI or agentic experiences into customer-facing commerce products would be a bonus.

### **OUR TECH STACK:**

* Backend: Java, Spring/Spring Boot, microservices architecture
* Mobile/Web: Flutter / Angular
* Infrastructure: AWS (SNS+SQS), PostgreSQL via RDS or Aurora, GCP (BigQuery, Vertex)
* Observability: Coralogix (OpenTelemetry
* Claude for agentic ways of working

### **WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN:**

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:

* Competitive Compensation - Competitive salary and share options.
* Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
* Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
* Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
* Health Insurance – Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options.
* Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
* Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
* Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
* Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
* WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
* Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office.
* Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it's time for a replacement.
* Snacks & Meals – Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent).

### **TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING**

At Tide, we champion a **flexible workplace** model thatsupports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

#LI-AC1 #LI-Hybrid

### **TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE**

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. jobs.title: Senior Director - Head of Platform, AI & Enterprise Platforms
jobs.description:
Portage Point is a Chicago-headquartered advisory, interim management and investment banking firm focused on serving the middle-market. Backed by New Mountain Capital, the firm has grown at over 30% annually since its founding in 2016 and today operates from ten offices across the United States and an office in Gurugram.

The firm delivers integrated financial and operational solutions across Transaction Advisory Services, Transaction Execution Services, Office of the CFO, Valuations, Performance Improvement, Turnaround & Restructuring and Investment Banking. Engagement teams are lean and execution-oriented, working directly with senior stakeholders to navigate complex transaction, transitions and transformations.

Triple P India (TPI) is a strategic extension of the firm's platform, established to build a high-quality team that operates as an integrated part of U.S.-based teams. The platform is designed to provide meaningful responsibility, direct exposure to senior leadership and long-term growth in a high-performance environment.

The AI & Technology function serves as the strategic and operational core of the firm AI platform, building the enterprise-grade infrastructure, AI product platform and data foundation that power Portage Point's AI-enabled service delivery model. The Head of Platform role is the technical backbone of this function, directly owning the design, build and operation of the multi-tenant Portage Point Platform and the Enterprise Data Vault that underpins all AI products. The platform hosts a growing portfolio of AI solutions across practice lines and is architected from day one to support future client access optionality as the firm's AI offering matures.

The Head of Platform reports to the CTO and is the principal hands-on solution architect of the AI Platform. The Head of Platform designs the platform architecture, produces Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and provides the technical depth that enables the firm's AI-enabled service model. The role builds and operates a multi-tenant, cloud-native platform that hosts, scales and governs firm's AI product portfolio and simultaneously architects the Enterprise Data Vault, the firm's proprietary data moat built from anonymized, indexed engagement data across mandates. Build and operationalise the platform and data vault as per roadmap timelines.

The Head of Platform operates within architectural guardrails set by the CTO, with autonomy over reversible engineering decisions and a defined escalation path for irreversible architectural choices. If you are a hands-on architect and have built platforms that power AI products at scale and want to build and operate one of the most ambitious AI platform builds in middle-market advisory, this is the right role for you.

### **Responsibilities**

* Mentor leads on architectural thinking and ADR production
* Work with Head of IT / Infra / Security to embed security-by-design and jointly own SOC 2 Type II technical controls at the application and data layer
* Support talent acquisition and firm development efforts
* Lead technical trainings on architecture, data engineering and AI infrastructure
* Contribute to a high-performing and inclusive engineering culture

* LLM / RAG architecture and MLOps at production scale – vector database selection and management (Pinecone / Weaviate / PGVector), embedding pipeline design, retrieval strategy optimisation; model registry, A/B testing infrastructure, feature stores, model versioning and rollback
* Security-first design with SOC 2 Type II technical controls ownership at application and data layer, ADR track record reviewed at CXO or board level

* Prior exposure to private equity, M&A, or restructuring transaction environments preferred; ability to collaborate across US and India time zones and willingness to flex working hours for cross-border stakeholder engagement
* Superior written and verbal communication skills, including executive-ready presentation and reporting skills
* Proven ability to thrive in lean, fast-moving teams

Engagement teams are lean and execution-oriented, working directly with senior stakeholders to navigate complex transaction, transitions and transformations.

Triple P India (TPI) is a strategic extension of the firm's platform, established to build a high-quality team that operates as an integrated part of U.S.-based teams. The Senior Director, Enterprise Technology Build & Operations will report directly into the CTO, and holds unified accountability for Portage Point corporate technology environment and security posture. As firm scales, there is a need for robust IT operations, security and infrastructure planning and management. This role ensures the firm's IT foundation is reliable, secure and audit-ready, integrating network and endpoint operations, Microsoft 365 governance, ITSM delivery, Zero Trust security architecture, SOC 2 Type II compliance and AI-specific security controls under a single point of ownership. The role approves IT operations and service management designs, security architecture decisions, vendor engagements and infrastructure implementation decisions within CTO-approved standards.

### **Responsibilities**

* Design and operate enterprise network infrastructure (for e.g. Cisco Meraki, SD-WAN, dual-ISP failover, next-gen firewall) and Microsoft 365 environment (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, Microsoft Purview) — covering tenant governance, licensing optimisation, DLP, retention and compliance features; manage the endpoint platform (Intune / Autopilot) including device enrolment, configuration, patch management and Conditional Access compliance enforcement
* Partner with the Head of Innovation and Product Manager on the platform roadmap, product intake from practice lines and release readiness
* Own the ITSM framework (ServiceNow or Jira Service Management) across incident, change, problem, service request and asset management; operate the IT service desk with P1–P4 SLA tiers, CSAT measurement and self-service knowledge base; personally own IT onboarding (Day 1 device, accounts and access) and offboarding (account revocation and access audit) within defined SLAs
* Design and enforce end-to-end security architecture with Zero Trust Network Access, micro-segmentation, Azure AD / Entra ID PIM, Conditional Access, application-layer security (OWASP Top 10 controls for all AI products), encryption, key management (Azure Key Vault) and AI-specific controls covering prompt injection defences, model access controls and audit trails for all LLM interactions
* Own the SOC 2 Type II programme – map platform and corporate IT controls to AICPA Trust Services Criteria, manage gap remediation, coordinate the external audit and produce the SOC 2 report for client and PE sponsor review; maintain TPI's information security policy suite; ensure compliance (personal data mapping, legal basis documentation, breach notification); manage the third-party and vendor risk assessment programme
* Design and operate the vulnerability management programme (Tenable.io or Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management) with automated scanning and enforced remediation SLAs; deploy and operate SIEM (Microsoft Sentinel) for identity, data exfiltration and AI-specific threat detection; own the Incident Response Plan and personally lead all P1 and P2 security incidents
* Lead and develop the combined IT and security team of engineers and analysts; own IT procurement (TCO analysis, with CTO) and the full vendor portfolio; design and test IT BCP and DR procedures; produce monthly ITSM performance review and quarterly security dashboard for the CTO and COO
* Support talent acquisition and firm development efforts
* Lead technical trainings on architecture, data engineering and AI infrastructure
* Contribute to a high-performing and inclusive engineering culture

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree from a top undergraduate program required

jobs.title: Area Manager - Credit & Operations
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONAREA MANAGER – CREDIT & OPERATIONS

**Industry:** NBFC- Gold Loan  
**Location:** Thiruvananthapuram / Assigned Area  
**Department:** Credit & Operations  
**Reporting To:** Regional Manager / Head of Operations

1. Job Purpose

The Area Manager – Credit & Operations will be responsible for managing credit operations, customer visits, loan appraisal and approval, branch performance, business development and portfolio quality across assigned branches.

The position requires an experienced professional who can balance credit discipline with business growth, regularly visit branches, motivate employees, support customer acquisition and ensure efficient branch operations.

The Area Manager will play a key role in improving business performance across Gold Loan, Business Loan and Commercial Property Loan products.

2. Duties & Responsibilities

**A. Branch Visits & Business Development**

* Visit every assigned branch at least once a week.
* Review branch-wise business performance, loan disbursements, outstanding and collection efficiency.
* Motivate Branch Managers and employees to improve business sourcing and achieve assigned targets.
* Conduct regular meetings with branch teams to review performance and business plans.
* Identify local business opportunities and support branches in acquiring new customers.
* Participate in important customer meetings and assist branch teams in converting high-value loan proposals.
* Identify operational and business challenges and provide suitable solutions.
* Monitor staff productivity and provide guidance to improve individual performance.
* Develop strategies to improve branch business across Gold Loans, Business Loans and Commercial Property Loans.
* Submit weekly branch visit reports with observations, business updates and action plans.

**B. Customer Visits & Credit Assessment**

* Conduct regular customer visits for Business Loan and Commercial Property Loan proposals.
* Visit business premises, commercial establishments and properties to assess customer credentials and business activities.
* Evaluate customer repayment capacity, business operations and financial position.
* Independently verify information provided in loan applications and identify discrepancies.
* Meet prospective and existing customers to understand their financial requirements.
* Support branch teams in handling high-value and critical loan proposals.
* Ensure proper field verification and due diligence before recommending loan proposals.

**C. Credit Appraisal & Loan Approval**

* Review and evaluate loan applications across assigned branches.
* Assess customer eligibility, repayment capacity, income documents and credit history.
* Ensure proper assessment of collateral, property valuation and legal documentation.
* Review and approve or recommend loan proposals within delegated authority.
* Ensure adherence to credit policies, lending norms and product-specific eligibility criteria.
* Identify potential credit risks and take preventive measures.
* Ensure proper documentation and verification before loan disbursement.
* Improve credit processing turnaround time without compromising lending standards.

**D. Gold Loan Operations**

* Monitor gold loan appraisal procedures and ensure adherence to company guidelines.
* Ensure accuracy in gold purity testing, weight assessment and valuation.
* Monitor Loan-to-Value (LTV) compliance and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Conduct surprise inspections and verification of gold packets and vault procedures.
* Ensure proper custody, security and reconciliation of pledged gold ornaments.
* Monitor gold loan renewals, closures, overdue accounts and auction procedures.

**E. Business Loan & Commercial Property Loan Operations**

* Supervise credit evaluation and processing of Business Loan and Commercial Property Loan applications.
* Review financial statements, bank statements, income documents and business cash flows.
* Ensure proper property valuation, legal scrutiny and title verification for property-backed loans.
* Coordinate with legal, technical and credit teams for timely processing.
* Ensure compliance with approved lending policies and sanction conditions.
* Monitor documentation, disbursement and post-disbursement compliance.

**F. Branch Operations & Process Control**

* Monitor daily branch operations and ensure operational discipline.
* Conduct periodic branch inspections and operational audits.
* Ensure proper cash management, document custody and record maintenance.
* Review daily transactions, disbursement reports and operational MIS.
* Identify process gaps and implement corrective measures.
* Ensure adherence to internal SOPs and operational guidelines.

**G. Portfolio Monitoring, Collections & Recovery**

* Monitor branch-wise portfolio performance and overdue accounts.
* Track NPA, delinquency and collection efficiency.
* Identify early warning signals and potentially stressed accounts.
* Coordinate with Branch Managers for recovery and overdue reduction.
* Ensure timely follow-up of maturing and overdue loan accounts.
* Recommend corrective actions to improve portfolio quality.

**H. Team Management & Motivation**

* Guide, supervise and motivate Branch Managers and branch employees.
* Train branch teams on credit policies, documentation and operational procedures.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and operational training.
* Ensure accountability and adherence to defined responsibilities.
* Support branch teams in achieving business and collection targets.
* Build a customer-focused and result-oriented working culture.

**I. Compliance, Risk Management & Audit**

* Ensure compliance with applicable RBI regulations and internal policies.
* Monitor KYC, AML and customer due diligence requirements.
* Coordinate internal, concurrent and statutory audits.
* Ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Report operational irregularities, fraud indicators and policy violations to management.
* Ensure effective implementation of risk management practices across branches.

**J. MIS & Management Reporting**

* Prepare and review branch-wise credit and operational performance reports.
* Monitor loan sanctions, disbursements, outstanding, collections and overdue positions.
* Submit periodic reports to Regional Management / Head Office.
* Analyse operational bottlenecks and recommend process improvements.
* Prepare weekly branch visit reports and follow up on pending action points.
* Support management in implementing business growth and risk management strategies.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* **Branch Visits:** Minimum one visit to every assigned branch every week.
* **Business Growth:** Improvement in branch-wise sourcing and loan disbursements.
* **Customer Visits:** Regular field visits for customer verification and credit assessment.
* **Credit Approval:** Timely appraisal and decision-making.
* **Branch Motivation:** Regular performance meetings and staff engagement.
* **Credit Quality:** Effective control over NPA and overdue accounts.
* **Gold Loan Operations:** Accuracy in appraisal, LTV compliance and gold security.
* **Operational Efficiency:** Audit scores, process adherence and documentation quality.
* **Collections:** Improvement in recovery and collection efficiency.
* **Reporting:** Timely submission of weekly and monthly MIS reports.

4. Candidate Profile

* Graduate / Postgraduate in any discipline; finance or banking qualifications preferred.
* 8–15 years of experience in Banking or NBFC operations.
* Strong experience in credit appraisal, loan operations and branch administration.
* Exposure to Gold Loans, Business Loans and Loan Against Property / Commercial Property Loans.
* Experience in handling multiple branches or geographical areas preferred.
* Good knowledge of RBI regulations, KYC, AML and credit risk management.
* Strong customer relationship, business development and team leadership skills.
* Willingness to travel regularly

About the Company K. Subraya Anantha Kamath & Sons is an established cashew processing and trading company with a legacy dating back to 1945. We are looking for a detail-oriented and responsible accountant with practical experience in Zoho Books and GST compliance to manage our accounting operations. 2. Key Responsibilities A. B. C. D. Inventory & Stock Accounting - Maintain inventory records in Zoho. - Monitor raw cashew nut purchases and stock. - Track cashew kernel grades and quantities. - Maintain stock records of finished goods, packing materials and by-products. - Reconcile physical stock with accounting records. - Coordinate with factory and stores personnel for stock verification. E. Sales & Purchase Accounting - Verify purchase invoices, sales invoices and debit/credit notes. - Ensure correct GST rates, HSN codes and tax classifications. - Track customer outstanding balances. - Monitor supplier balances and payment due dates. - Maintain proper records of domestic and export transactions. Timely GST preparation and compliance. 4. Accuracy of customer and supplier balances. 5. Timely submission of monthly MIS reports. 6. Accuracy of inventory and stock reconciliation. 7. Timely identification and reporting of accounting discrepancies. 6. What We Expect We expect the accountant to take ownership of the company's accounting system, ensure that all transactions are properly recorded and reconciled, and provide reliable financial information to management for decision-making. At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.

The Senior Manager, Business Governance & Controls (BG&C), leads the first-line operational risk and control agenda for the Bengaluru GCC. The role also leads the continuous improvement of control testing, assurance insights and governance reporting across the GCC.

  

Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.

  

**Role Type: Full Time, Permanent**  
**Role Location: Bengaluru**

**What will your day look like?**
---------------------------------

As a Senior Manager, BG&C, you will:

  

* Develop and execute the GCC first-line risk and control strategy, aligned with ANZ’s Risk Appetite, enterprise risk framework and relevant regulatory obligations.
* Establish and maintain a consistent GCC-wide approach to identifying, assessing, managing, monitoring and reporting operational and compliance risks, with clear business ownership of risks and controls.

* Drive continuous improvement of the GCC risk and control environment, supporting business, process, systems and automation changes while ensuring associated risks are understood and appropriately managed.

* Stakeholder engagement and relationship‑building skills, with confidence to challenge constructively.
* Planning and prioritisation skills to manage testing cycles, competing workloads, and quality standards.
* Experience delivering control testing, quality assurance, or risk assessment activities in a regulated environment.
* Demonstrated involvement in analysing business processes and identifying control gaps or compliance issues.

* Knowledge of banking processes and/or products

Win strategic clients through personal origination, develop partnerships and distribution channels, and recruit, coach, and scale a UAE Sales and Business Development team with disciplined targets, processes, and economics.

jobs.title: VP WRB Operational Excellence
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

* Drive transformational change across our global finance operations through process optimisation, quality enhancement, and strategic innovation.
* This is pivotal role reports directly to the GPLs and partners with central Process Performance Excellence (PPE) team to elevate operational maturity across GCFO workstreams
* Drive PPE Framework & Op Ex Strategy within relevant GPL workstream to identify optimisation opportunities
* Collaborate with GPLs and work on Book of work to focus to uplift the maturity of the processes and making it leaner etc.
* Play a critical role in process mining, identifying KPIs & dashboards to drive process insights

****Key Responsibilities****
**Strategy**
**Process Transformation & Innovation**

* Lead end-to-end process redesign initiatives across finance functions, delivering measurable improvements in efficiency, accuracy, & cycle times
* Architect scalable operating models that support business growth while reducing complexity & operational risk
* Champion automation & digital transformation leveraging RPA, AI/ML, and intelligent workflow solutions
* Establish PPE governance frameworks with clear ownership, controls, & performance metrics
* Drive standardisation & harmonisation of processes across regions & business units

**Business**
**Operational Excellence & Quality Management**

* Design & implement comprehensive quality assurance frameworks with zero-defect mindset
* Deploy Lean Six Sigma methodologies to eliminate waste, reduce variation, & optimise resource utilization
* Build continuous improvement culture through kaizen events, process mining, & root cause analysis
* Operationalise KPI dashboards & real-time monitoring capabilities for proactive issue resolution
* Lead defect prevention programs & implement mistake-proofing techniques across critical processes

**Processes**
**Strategic Partnership & Change Leadership**

* Work with Finance leadership to translate strategic objectives into operational roadmaps
* Act as trusted advisor to GPL and PPE Head on operational transformation priorities
* Lead cross-functional teams through complex change initiatives with strong stakeholder engagement
* Develop business cases demonstrating ROI for process improvement & technology investments
* Foster collaboration between Finance, Technology, Operations & Risk teams

**People & Talent**
**Capability Building**

* Develop training programs to upskill finance teams on process improvement methodologies
* Create centre of excellence for process optimization, automation, and quality management
* Mentor Process leaders on operational excellence principles & change management

**Risk Management**
**Regulatory & Compliance Excellence**

* Ensure process designs meet regulatory requirements (UK ACG, Basel, PRA, IFRS, tax & Regulatory compliance)
* Strengthen controls environment while simplifying processes & reducing operational burden
* Support audit readiness through robust documentation, testing protocols, & evidence management
* Drive remediation of audit findings & regulatory observations with sustainable solutions

**Governance**

* Reports directly to Head of Operational Excellence who drives the Strategy, operating model changes & strategic initiatives across GPLs.

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

**Key stakeholders**

* GCFO COO MT
* Relevant GPL
* PPE Team
* Global Op Ex team
* ARIS GPT
* SAP Signavio
* ProHance team
* Relevant Technology teams
* Infrastructure & Security Teams

* Expert in process mapping, analysis, and redesign using tools like ARIS, Signavio, or Celonis
* Proficient in data analytics and visualization platforms (Tableau, Power BI, Alteryx)
* Strong knowledge of ERP systems (SAP, Oracle) and finance technology ecosystem
* Experience with project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, hybrid approaches)
* Advanced Excel and data manipulation capabilities for complex analysis

****Qualifications****
**Education**

* MBA, Master's in Finance, or equivalent advanced degree
* 12-15+ years in finance operations, with 5+ years leading operational excellence or transformation programs
* Proven track record delivering large-scale process transformation in banking or financial services

**Training**

* Deep domain expertise across multiple finance functions (Accounting, Financial Reporting, FP&A, Treasury, Tax)
* Hands-on experience with process improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping)
* Demonstrated success implementing automation solutions (RPA, workflow tools, AI-enabled platforms)
* Strong understanding of regulatory environment and compliance requirements in banking

**Licenses**

* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification required; Master Black Belt preferred

**Certifications**

* Professional certifications (CA, CPA, CFA, CIMA, or equivalent) highly valued

****About Standard Chartered****
We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.
  
  
Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.
  
  
****What We Offer****

* Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
* In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
* Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
* Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
* Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
* Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
* A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

25/11/2026

jobs.description:
We’re seeking someone to join our team as a Change The Bank Director in the Asset Servicing Group to manage assigned APAC and India change projects with a degree of autonomy, from initial analysis through implementation and adoption.
  
  
In the Operations division, we partner with business units across the Firm to support financial transactions, devise and implement effective controls and develop client relationships. This is a Team Specialist position at Director level within the Core Services.
  
  
Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, always evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world.
  
  
**What You'll Do In The Role**

* Work closely with Operations to understand front-to-back processes, controls and pain points, and identify opportunities for efficiency, automation and platform renovation.
* Partner with Technology, global Asset Servicing teams, Business Units and partner functions to define requirements and deliver practical, scalable solutions.
* Develop and maintain project plans, milestones and governance, proactively managing risks, issues, dependencies and escalations.
* Provide clear delivery updates and change communications to stakeholders, including senior management, highlighting progress, decisions and areas requiring attention.
* Coordinate solution validation, user acceptance testing, defect resolution and business sign-off against agreed requirements and controls.
* Support implementation readiness and post-delivery review, ensuring changes achieve measurable and sustainable business outcomes.

**What You'll Bring To The Role**

* 5–7 years of relevant industry experience, ideally in Corporate Actions, Asset Servicing or securities operations.
* Good knowledge of process governance, operational risk, controls and escalation management.
* Experience delivering change with Technology teams, including requirements definition, solution design, testing and implementation.
* Strong stakeholder management and written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to provide clear delivery updates across global teams and to senior stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, assess options and articulate business value.
* Proven project management skills, including the ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and drive delivery in a fast-paced environment.
* A continuous-improvement mindset, strong attention to detail and a collaborative approach to knowledge sharing.

**What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley**
At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.
  
  
To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.
  
  
Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.
  
  
Our workforce reflects a broad cross-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.
  
  
For more information, please visit: https://www.morganstanley.com/people-opportunities/eeo.
