jobs.title: Sr Manager - Process Transformation
jobs.description:
**Business Unit:**
Cubic Corporation
  
  
**Company Details:**
Cubic offers an opportunity to provide innovative technology for government and commercial customers around the globe, helping to solve their future problems today. We’re the leading integrator of payment and information technology and services for intelligent travel solutions worldwide, and the leading provider of realistic combat training systems, secure communications and networking and highly specialized support services for military and security forces of the U.S. and allied nations. If you have an entrepreneurial spirit and thrive in an innovative environment, we want to talk to you about your next role at Cubic! We are seeking employees inspired by technology, and motivated by the rewards of hard work, commitment, teamwork, quality, integrity, and respect. We invite you to explore opportunities with Cubic.
  
  
**Job Details:**
**Job Summary:**
The Finance Operation Process leader will drive establishing baseline processes, increasing efficiency and leading continuous improvement across the finance operations teams and develop appropriate performance indicators to convey fact-based success measurements. In this role, the Finance Operations Process leader will drive the injection of contemporary finance practices rooted in automation, data modeling and integrated business planning and reporting. This position typically works under limited supervision and direction. Incumbents of this position regularly exercise discretionary and regular decision-making authority.
  
  

* Eliminate waste and non-value-added activities using Lean principles to build a results-driven, low-bureaucracy operating culture
* Apply DMAIC methodology to identify process gaps, design solutions, and deliver measurable improvements in operational efficiency
* Develop and deliver role-based training programs to drive consistent process adoption, reducing error rates and rework across Finance Operations
* Conduct regular internal audits using control frameworks to verify that process documentation is accurate, current, and compliant
* Define and track KPIs post-implementation — including cost savings, cycle time, and error reduction — to validate ROI and sustain process gains
* Lead continuous improvement and automation initiatives (RPA, workflow tools) with clear business cases showing efficiency, cost, and risk-reduction benefits
* Apply knowledge of modern finance practices — cloud ERP systems, data modeling, and automated controls — to strengthen financial operations
* Manage cross-functional project teams through full project lifecycles, from charter and scope definition to delivery and handovers using structured PM frameworks
* Perform root cause analysis on complex operational issues, developing corrective actions that align with business objectives and financial targets
* Champion a Kaizen mindset across teams, embedding a culture of incremental improvement, accountability, and quality at every process level
* Support additional initiatives assigned by leadership, contributing finance and operational expertise across evolving business priorities
* Drive end-to-end finance transformation by streamlining procurement, invoice processing, and payment workflows — reducing cycle times, strengthening vendor controls, and delivering measurable cost and compliance improvements
* Minimum Job Requirements: Four-year college degree in Accounting or Finance with at least seven to ten years progressive finance and accounting experience required, preferably in a large organization. An MBA and CPA Certification are highly desirable. Minimum of 10 years’ experience with general ledger, P&L and Balance Sheet. Ability to build strong partnerships with colleagues, customers, and suppliers. Ability to identify areas of under-performance and agree plans to rectify. Demonstrate experience of design and implementation of business process with a continuous improvement mindset. Must be initiative-taking, pragmatic, and able to work independently. Diligent and strong attention to detail. Strong influencing skills, able to solve problems and find effective and timely resolutions. Demonstrates excellent interpersonal skills with a willingness to share knowledge, coach and collaborate effectively with individuals and other departments. Strong organization and planning skills with the ability to multitask and ruthlessly prioritize. Financial experience in a manufacturing environment and service-based organization is highly desirable. Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or similar software, prior experience of SAP preferred but not essential. Able to protect and handle confidential personnel information. Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer required. Limited to travel including international.

**Condition of Employment:**
Successful outcome of a National Police Check and background check.
  
  
‎
  
  
**Worker Type:**
Employee
  
  
‎
  
  
*We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. We do not discriminate based on any protected characteristic under applicable law.*

LSEG needs a seasoned Enterprise Architect to work in our Finance Engineering where we are going through a multi-year transformation journey.
  
  
In this role, you will be accountable for creating strategy, roadmaps and business cases across Finance Systems. You will need to closely work with business to align the tech strategy with business strategy and steer them in the right direction. The role will also provide ongoing architectural guidance to multiple large programs through their lifecycle.
  
  
Responsible for governance of the applications and solutions under Finance Engineering capability. You need to ensure the overall architecture, design, implementation and integrity of the Finance platforms within Corporate Engineering is sound. Also responsible for ensuring that the solution delivered to business units is engineered according to Enterprise architecture and infrastructure standards.
  
  
Key Responsibilities;
  
  

* Provide strategic guidance and direction to drive the architecture and solutions for Finance Engineering platforms and systems
* Enhance entire Finance echo systems with AI driven solutions and delivery
* Design data modernization strategies and architecture solutions including Oracle Exadata/ADB and Data integration, Data foundation for AI/ML and GenAI solutions
* Design migration/modernization strategy for transitioning databases to OCI, including creating architecture blueprints and detailed documentation
* Define architecture strategies for scale, reliability and high performance
* Streamline data management across Finance systems
* Enable data driven decision making across organization
* Setting the long-term strategy of architecture to support the Finance Business and Engineering strategic goals
* Manage relationships with the Finance leadership to influence the adoption of tools/technology versus customization
* Maximise relationships with vendors, regulators and industry bodies to seek and adopt industry standard methodologies in enterprise architecture and technology strategy
* Act as trusted advisor and leader across the wider LSEG Engineering
* Leads the solutioning ensuring alignment with the broader Corporate Engineering and Group Engineering strategies
* Facilitate the adoption of Product-led and agile delivery methodology to enable business agility and a culture of continuous improvement.
* Provides leadership, mentor and development to their team to drive high performance
* Maintains relationships with key suppliers, setting performance standards and handling the resolution of raised service issues
* Works closely with other Corporate Engineering capability teams with comprehensive interlocking understanding and shared plans/goals/priorities

jobs.description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.
  
  
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Solution Architecture
  
  
Ready to set the architecture direction for HSBC’s CTO Platforms domain?
  
  
Why HSBC
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
Join CTO Platforms to shape the architectural direction for a value stream or domain within a large regulated bank. This role sets target and transition architectures and keeps delivery aligned to reference architectures, standards and guardrails. You’ll represent architecture in governance and Design Authority forums, presenting options and trade-offs and helping decisions land clearly. The role also focuses on cross-programme dependencies and early risk identification so delivery stays coherent across teams. You’ll influence strategic initiatives including Compass and the AI/GenAI agenda by promoting shared platforms and governed capabilities. Success looks like simpler, reusable and well-controlled technology outcomes that engineering teams can deliver with clarity and pace.
  
  
What you'll be doing
  
  

* Set architectural direction for an assigned value stream or domain aligned to target architecture, reference architectures, standards and guardrails
* Produce and maintain target and transition architectures with clear sequencing, dependencies, decision points and interim guardrails
* Represent architecture in governance and Design Authority forums, presenting options, trade-offs, recommendations and exception impacts
* Identify and manage cross-programme architectural dependencies, risks and constraints and escalate early to support timely decisions
* Embed alignment to Group architecture strategy and standards including Build vs Buy, reuse, simplification and control-by-design
* Shape architectural direction for strategic R&C initiatives including Compass and the AI/GenAI agenda to converge on shared platforms and governed capabilities
* Translate architectural direction into solution designs with engineering teams using patterns, non-functional requirements and guardrails to maintain delivery alignment
* Strengthen solution architecture capability across engineering through coaching, quality reviews and communities of practice

What we're looking for
  
  

* Bring extensive experience as a solution, domain or enterprise architect in a large complex and regulated organisation
* Demonstrate defining target-state architectures and translating them into transition states, roadmaps and decision frameworks
* Show strong experience reviewing solution designs and articulating options, trade-offs and recommendations based on evidence and standards
* Apply broad understanding of modern application, integration, data and cloud architectures including APIs, event-driven patterns, microservices, CI/CD and operational non-functional requirements
* Embed security, resilience, privacy, records management and auditability requirements into designs and delivery workflows
* Apply Build vs Buy, reuse, simplification and technology rationalisation including assessing Low-Code/No-Code and third-party options
* Use working knowledge of AI and GenAI architecture including responsible adoption, platform integration, data and knowledge foundations, governance, monitoring and evidence
* Operate effectively in senior governance forums and across geographically distributed teams with clear stakeholder management and influencing
* Communicate complex technology choices clearly through concise architecture artefacts for business and technology audiences

Building coherent platforms at scale
  
  
If you want to shape how platforms evolve across a complex environment this role offers the scope to make a visible difference. You’ll help teams converge on shared architectures that are easier to deliver, operate and govern. You’ll bring clarity to decisions that cut across programmes and turn architectural intent into practical delivery guardrails. If this aligns with the work you want to do next we’d welcome your application.
  
  
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

**Job Summary**
Program Director role responsible for shaping and driving complex enterprise programs focused on secure adoption of Azure platforms ensuring strategic alignment with long term business goals and regulatory expectations while optimizing hybrid working models and enhancing resilience of digital services that support global transactions and modern payment ecosystems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive end to end ownership of large scale technology programs that focus on secure Azure adoption while ensuring alignment with enterprise strategy and regulatory obligations across all business units and global locations.
* Oversee program planning and roadmap development by defining scope milestones dependencies and resource needs that enable secure and resilient Azure security initiatives across hybrid work environments.
* Guide cross functional teams to integrate Azure security controls into application architectures infrastructure operations and data flows so that business services remain protected and continuously available.
* Coordinate risk assessment activities to identify security gaps within Azure workloads and associated payment services then translate findings into prioritized remediation plans with measurable outcomes.
* Provide direction for establishing program wide security governance structures including policies standards and procedures that embed Azure security practices into everyday operations and decision making.
* Align program deliverables with organizational strategy by ensuring that Azure security investments support long term growth improved customer trust and efficient digital payment experiences.
* Manage stakeholder expectations by communicating program status risks and achievements through concise narratives and dashboards that highlight progress toward secure cloud and payment transformation goals.
* Support development of reusable patterns and reference architectures for Azure security so that project teams can implement consistent controls and reduce time to market for new solutions.
* Drive continuous improvement by analyzing operational metrics incident trends and audit results to refine Azure security capabilities and strengthen resilience of transaction and payment platforms.
* Collaborate with finance and portfolio management partners to optimize program budgets and investment decisions ensuring that Azure security and payment initiatives deliver tangible business value.
* Enable hybrid work effectiveness by promoting secure access models identity controls and collaboration tools that protect program information while supporting flexible working arrangements.
* Mentor senior program managers and technical leads by sharing best practices in strategic leadership Azure security risk management and stakeholder engagement to build strong succession pipelines.
* Advance responsible technology outcomes by ensuring that security design decisions within Azure platforms contribute to safer financial transactions and more trustworthy digital experiences for society.

**Qualifications**

* Apply deep experience in Azure security including identity access management network protection data security and compliance configuration to design secure program architectures and guardrails.
* Demonstrate strong strategic leadership capabilities by setting program vision influencing senior stakeholders and guiding complex decision making that balances risk cost and long term business impact.
* Leverage exposure to forex payments or broader financial transaction domains to interpret regulatory expectations operational risks and customer experience needs within secure digital payment programs.
* Use extensive experience in large enterprise environments to coordinate multidisciplinary teams vendors and partners while maintaining clarity of goals timelines and quality expectations.
* Employ advanced communication and negotiation skills to manage diverse stakeholders by turning technical security topics into understandable implications for business performance and customer trust.
* Draw on more than twenty two years of progressive program management experience to handle ambiguity orchestrate transformation agendas and deliver consistent outcomes over multi year horizons.

**Certifications Required**
Preferred certifications include Azure Security Engineer Associate and Certified Information Systems Security Professional CISSP or equivalent cloud security credentials.

SAP Solution Design, SAP Implementation, Business Processes, Functional Expertise , Functional Architecture, SAP Digital Transformation, SAP FICO, SAP Supply Chain, S/4 HANA, Migration, Manufacturing process, End to End SAP Implementation

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

The Director, Contact Center Governance, Controls & Performance Management is a strategic leadership role responsible for establishing and leading the governance, performance management, financial control, operational risk, compliance, and quality oversight framework for Contact Center Operations. This leader serves as the first line of defense and is accountable for ensuring operational processes, customer servicing activities, technology platforms, and business controls operate effectively while supporting enterprise objectives, regulatory requirements, financial performance expectations, and customer experience goals.

The Director partners closely with Operations, Technology, Risk, Compliance, Finance, Quality, and Change Management teams to drive operational excellence, strengthen controls, improve performance visibility, and ensure successful execution of strategic initiatives. This role is responsible for executive performance reporting, Contact Center Operations Management Business Reviews (MBRs), Balanced Scorecard governance, operational readiness reviews, financial analysis, technology change governance, testing of new system rollouts, and deployment of AI-enabled controls and quality assurance capabilities.

Reporting directly to the SVP, Contact Center Operations, this position plays a critical role in protecting enterprise value, enabling scalable growth, reducing operational risk, improving financial discipline, and driving a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and data-driven decision making.

**JOB FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Governance, Risk & Controls Leadership**

* Lead the overall governance and first-line control framework for Contact Center Operations, including policies, procedures, control standards, process documentation, and governance routines aligned with enterprise requirements.
* Identify, assess, monitor, and mitigate operational, regulatory, compliance, financial, and reputational risks across Contact Center Operations.
* Oversee RCSA activities, issue management, remediation plans, corrective actions, audit responses, and regulatory examination support.
* Serve as the primary liaison for Internal Audit, Compliance, Risk Management, external auditors, and regulatory examination teams.

**Performance Management & Executive Reporting**

* Own the Contact Center Operations performance management framework, including KPI governance across customer experience, quality, productivity, compliance, operational effectiveness, financial performance, and risk management.
* Lead monthly Contact Center Operations Management Business Reviews (MBRs), executive operating reviews, and Balanced Scorecard governance forums.
* Develop executive dashboards, scorecards, and reporting packages that provide actionable operational and financial insights.
* Drive accountability for performance improvement initiatives through structured action planning, follow-up governance, and data-driven recommendations.

* Develop business cases supporting automation, process improvement, technology investments, and strategic initiatives.

* Ensure AI-enabled solutions operate within established governance, regulatory, compliance, risk management, and model oversight standards.

**Technology Governance & Change Management**

* Partner with Technology and business stakeholders to ensure controls, compliance requirements, and operational readiness expectations are embedded into new systems and process changes.
* Lead operational readiness reviews for technology implementations, automation initiatives, and strategic system rollouts.
* Oversee User Acceptance Testing (UAT), business validation, control testing, implementation governance, and post-implementation performance monitoring.

* Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related discipline required.

**Experience**

* Minimum 15-18 years of progressive experience in Operational Risk, Internal Controls, Compliance, Audit, Accounting, Finance, or Financial Services Operations.
* Experience supporting audits, regulatory examinations, enterprise risk management activities, and remediation governance.
* Experience managing operational controls within a highly regulated financial services environment.
* Demonstrated experience in accounting, financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and business performance management.

**Job Summary**
---------------

Treasury works closely with senior management, the businesses, Country CEOs / CFOs, and Finance to manage and promote the bank’s liquidity, capital, and balance sheet position. Treasury is laser-focussed on its vision to be “Open, progressive and trusted, working commercially with our partners” to create sustainable value by balancing the supply and demand of liquidity and capital.

Within Treasury (which comprises Capital, Liquidity & Markets), the Treasury Liquidity function is responsible for driving the strategic liquidity agenda and Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Booking (‘IRRBB’).

The Associate Director – IRRBB, India hub will support the Head of IRRBB, India Hub in advancing IRRBB Analytics for overseeing and executing comprehensive internal analyses. The role holder will help in migrating and centralising global IRRBB processes from Group and Clusters, performing detailed stress tests and scenario analyses, leveraging IRRBB data to provide insightful risk assessments and mitigation strategies. This position requires a deep understanding of IRRBB, strong analytical skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with senior stakeholders across the organization.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Strategy**  
• Keep up to date with the Group’s business strategy (incl. SC Ventures) and ensure the IRRBB frameworks are aligned to that.
  
• Partner with Global Head of IRRBB in developing and recommending risk mitigation strategies based on the findings from stress tests and scenario analyses. Ensure that these strategies are effectively communicated and implemented across relevant business units.

**Business**  
• Awareness and understanding of the wider business, economic and market environment in which the Group operates, with a focus on the Group’s participation in the Digital Assets and platforms space.
  
• Provide insights on current and forward looking IRRBB exposures, impact assessments on interest income and actions available for balance sheet optimisation.
  
• Lead the engagement with businesses on balance sheet optimisation strategies including but not limited to asset & liability mix to manage IRRBB while optimising returns.

**Processes**  
• **Analytics:** Support the newly developed IRRBB analytics capabilities on a regular basis, including operating the RCO IRRBB calculation engine to run bespoke scenarios and extracting and analysing the results, covering key metric including, but not limited to, Weekly NIIS Flash, Hedging Strategy Assessments, Corporate Plan NII impact simulations and PV01 analysis. This will also involve working with CPM and Finance closely to prepare MI slides for relevant committees like GALCO, ALCO and IRRBB Steering Forums.

* **Strategy:** Support IRRBB strategy by engaging Treasury Markets on NII sensitivities, hedging performance and P&L forecasting. Support investor relations for quarterly results, including GALCO/ALCO hedging updates, and contribute to annual disclosures through slide preparation, briefing notes, Q&A drafting and investor query responses.

* **Framework & Governance:** Support IRRBB governance through preparation of monthly GALCO/ALCO packs with commentary, review of risk metrics and monitoring of group, solo and local limits. Lead regulatory submissions and challenge returns, oversee MAT and risk appetite reviews, maintain IRRBB policies, support disclosures and audits, escalate emerging topics and drive regulatory engagement and interpretation.

* **Modelling & Methodology** : Apply and maintain IRRBB models per regulatory requirements, including PTR and CASA assumptions. Review and update IRRBB and structural hedging policies, maintain standards, and perform annual forecasts of NII, EBE, and P2A. Conduct policy effectiveness, self-assessment, gap and impact analyses, harmonize models with group, and run simulations and scenario analyses to support regulatory and corporate planning.

* **Structural Hedging:** Support the structural hedging in planning, executing, and monitoring hedges, including P&L sign-off and capacity management. Support group IRBB hedging programs, assess available instruments, forecast and quantify hedge requirements, run analytics and simulations, and provide MI for GALCO discussions to drive informed hedging decisions.

* **Stress Testing:** Support IRRBB stress testing including ICAAP and Pillar 2 assessments, NMD parameter stress, country/cluster ICAP, and reverse stress testing. Conduct basis risk evaluations, Pillar 2 charge reviews, and prepare Pillar 3 disclosures. Support IRBB-related GIA and audit reviews, ensuring all stress testing aligns with ORF requirements and regulatory expectations.

* **IRRBB Technology Journey:** Support delivery of new system rollouts, enhancements and data fixes by providing requirements, validating functionality, and ensuring data accuracy. Collaborate with stakeholders to implement changes efficiently, maintain alignment with IRRBB policy and reporting standards, and drive continuous improvement of systems and processes.

**People & Talent**  
• Be part of a diverse team of skilled and experienced professionals in India.
  
• Collaborate within Treasury and with key partners in Finance, CPM, Technology, and Change in India and the clusters.
  
• Lead by example in reinforcing the appropriate culture and values of the function.
  
• Contribute to ongoing training and development of team members.

**Risk Management**  
• Oversee enterprise-wide interest rate risk in the banking book ensuring alignment with risk appetite and regulatory requirements. Monitor, measure and manage exposures, set limits, and perform scenario analysis and stress testing. Maintain robust frameworks, policies and governance, validate models, provide insights for strategic planning and support senior management, GALCO/ALCO and regulators on risk mitigation, reporting and capital optimisation.

**Governance**  
• Assess the effectiveness arrangements to deliver effective governance, oversight and controls in the IRRBB frameworks and, if necessary, oversee changes in these areas
  
• Understand the regulatory framework in which the Group operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role.
  
• Contribute to delivering ‘effective governance’ by actively challenging Treasury / Business / Risk counterparts; and willingness to work with the Prudential Regulatory Authority in an open and cooperative manner.

**Key stakeholders/Committees**  
• Global Treasurer
  
• Treasury Liquidity, Capital, Recovery & Resolution Planning, Issuance, Markets
  
• Regional & Country Treasury teams
  
• Business stakeholders in CCIB, CPBB and SC Ventures
  
• CPM and FRM
  
• Financial Planning & Analytics
  
• Country & Business Finance
  
• Various other Finance teams (e.g., Regulatory Reporting, BSA and Disclosures)
  
• Treasury CRO
  
• Technology & Change organisation
  
• Investor Relations
  
• Rating Agencies, Investors
  
• Regulators
  
• GALCO
  
• Board Risk Committee (BRC)
  
• Digital Asset Risk Committee (DRC – attending as permanent invitee)

**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

* Balance Sheet Management

• Funding & Liquidity Risk
  
• Funding & Liquidity Regulations
  
• People management
  
• Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Book
  
• Funds Transfer Pricing
  
• Product / Business Knowledge
  
• Strategic Change Leadership
  
• Financial Reporting and Performance Management
  
• Planning, Modelling, Forecasting
  
• Banking Technology Infrastructure

---------------

jobs.description:
**Associate Director /Manager | M&A-Deal Transformation & Post Merger integration**
  
• **Job requisition ID** : 116760
  
• **Location**: Bengaluru
  
• **Entity**: Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu India LLP

**The team**

Businesses are continuously exploring opportunities to grow / rationalize costs and mergers and acquisitions, or carve-outs through separations and divestitures, are among the most complex business activities an organization will undertake. Deloitte’s global network of consulting

practitioner’s help clients identify and solve their most critical information and transformational challenges. With market-leading expertise in 17 industry segments, superior business transformation capabilities, and deep technical expertise, our global network of more than 33,000 consulting practitioners create unmatched market offerings to solve our clients’ toughest business issues.

Mergers & Acquisitions team helps strategize, design, and implement end-to-end solutions for successful transactions, from advance-planning to post-transaction restructuring. The team helps drive performance for businesses in every key M&A-related function: project management, commercial activity optimization, operations and supply chain, IT systems, human capital management, and finance activities. Learn more about our Strategy & Transactions Practice

  

**Your work profile**

Professionals in M&A group offer both advisory and deployment services that provide clients with comprehensive solutions to help them better manage the critical business functions.

We accomplish this mission through continued development of people in our Strategy, Risk and Transactions - M&A: Deal Transformation and Post Merger Integration

The primary role is to make direct contributions to the engagement team by assisting healthcare sector clients on Organization Readiness and integration or carve-outs in a deal / M&A scenario.

  

**Delivery of specific capability in Pharma M&A: DT & PMI**

**Organization readiness in a post deal integration:**

* Understand the integration vision and strategy set out in the deal objective
* Work with C-suite executives, business and internal firm stakeholders to identify integration guiding principles
* Identify the target operating model, organization construct and governance model for the consolidated entity
* Evaluate the considerations for organization readiness for interim (Day 1 /100), desired end state
* Establish Day 1 / Day 100 checklists and workplans
* Contribute in Integration Management office (IMO) for end-to-end program management of workstreams involved in the Integration process
  

**Integration support for post-deal activities:**

* Program / Integration/ Transformation management office planning and readiness
* Day 1 / 100 Readiness planning
* Assess the IT landscape and identify the areas of synergies / dis-synergies
* Vendor evaluation and selection
* IT spend analysis (including vendor contract reviews for any hidden transactional costs), provide recommendations on the cost efficiencies
* Bid formulation and vendor management
* Facilitate execution of the post deal integration of IT operations and organization
  

**Carve-out and separation:**

* Develop the separation strategy and assess the separation readiness
* Evaluate financial and operational entanglements / interdependencies
* Identify the operating model, organization construct and governance model for the re-structured entity
* Evaluate the considerations for organization readiness for interim (Day 1 /100) and desired end state
* Establish Day 1 / Day 100 checklists and workplans
* Contribute in managing the Separation Management Office (SMO) across the workstreams
* Assess the TSA requirements, prepare TSA schedules and TSA exit strategies
* Cost modelling for one-time and recurring costs due to separation (stranded cost, standalone costs etc.)
* Define step- wise separation road map
  

**Commercial and Operational Diligence and Transformation:**

* Evaluate the strategic and commercial feasibility of a deal / transaction
* Evaluate the current business capabilities and identify red flags on operational issues/risks
* Assess the Post deal consolidation and transformation opportunities
* Leverage industry best practices and Deloitte accelerators to define methodological approach to consolidation / separation
* Undertake detailed functional integration planning (e.g. Sales and Marketing, operations, Finance, IT, HR etc.) for Day 1 /100 and End state
* Support delivery of functional plans
  

**Synergy / dis-synergy assessment & delivery:**

* Identify areas of potential synergies / dis-synergies and establish the degree of integration required
* Define road map for delivery of synergies and advise on synergy benefits tracking
* Work with functional leads on Synergy realization
  

**Key skills required:**

* Candidate should be able to demonstrate experience of working on large transformations including pre-deal or post-deal M&A transactions in healthcare/pharma/hospitals space
* Candidate should possess good knowledge of healthcare chain from a business standpoint
* A strong and demonstrated interest in consulting with 8+ years of relevant experience in financial services industry preferably banking
* Relevant understanding of technology landscape of a Healthcare organization would be a key differentiator
* Excellent academic credentials for both undergraduate and graduate coursework. MBA preferred
* Strong advanced MS Excel and MS PowerPoint skills
* Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal
* Leadership qualities and the ability to mentor junior consultants and analysts
* Willingness and ability to take initiative and learn independently
* This role involves travelling.

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer - India
jobs.description:
**Location & work modality: India , Mumbai**

**About Submer**  
  
**At Submer, we are redefining how data centers are built, integrated, and operated, with sustainability, efficiency, and innovation at the core. Our technology is designed to reduce environmental impact while improving performance and efficiency. We are a purpose-driven company with a passion for innovation and a growing global presence.**

**Your impact**

Submer India is seeking an experienced, commercially minded and strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead and build the Finance function in India. This is a growth- and investment-oriented role with particular responsibility for capital strategy, fundraising and the financial architecture supporting enterprise growth and infrastructure expansion.

The CFO will own the India capital agenda within approved mandates, working with India and Group leadership to secure financing and lead transactions through financial closure. The role requires an accomplished senior finance leader with demonstrated CFO-level responsibility and a proven record of personally leading and closing capital-raising transactions, preferably within technology, infrastructure, digital infrastructure, datacentres, engineering, energy or other high-growth and capital-intensive businesses.

The successful candidate will combine capital-raising capability with strong financial stewardship, governance and compliance. The CFO must understand the complete business lifecycle, from establishment and capitalisation through growth, scaling, restructuring and potential strategic transactions and/or potential exit, and be able to operate in an entrepreneurial technology and infrastructure environment.

**What you'll do**

**1. Strategic Financial Leadership**
=====================================

* Act as a key member of the India leadership team and provide strategic financial leadership to support Submer's growth and long-term enterprise value.
* Develop and execute the financial and capital strategy for the India business, linking enterprise growth and infrastructure expansion to appropriate sources of funding.
* Partner with business and operational leadership on investments, expansion plans and commercial opportunities, providing financial insight, strategic decisions and constructive challenge.
* Build scalable financial structures, processes, controls and planning capabilities suitable for a high growth organisation
* Build long term business planning and value creation.

**2. Investment, Fundraising and Capital Raising**
==================================================

* Lead the development and execution of capital-raising strategies for Submer's India business and strategic initiatives, aligned with approved plans and funding mandates.
* Build and maintain relationships with institutional, private equity, venture capital, infrastructure and strategic investors/partners, banks, financial institutions and structured-finance providers, as relevant.
* Lead India investor and lender engagement, financial presentations and, 'fund-sourcing to fund-raising to investment' plans and subsequent discussions; *(coordinate with Group finance and support Group-led transactions under the agreed mandate.)*
* Distinguish corporate capital for enterprise growth, including growth equity, strategic investment and corporate debt, from project or asset capital, including JV/SPV equity, infrastructure debt, construction finance and project finance.
* Develop financial models, investment cases and business plans; evaluate funding structures, financing costs, dilution, security requirements and investment returns.
* Lead financial due diligence readiness, strategic investment, financial structuring and financing negotiations through financial closure, coordinating legal, tax, business and technical inputs and obtaining required approvals.
* Agree capital-raising milestones with leadership and report on funding secured, transaction progress, financing terms and deployment of proceeds; maintain appropriate investor and lender reporting.

**3. Business Lifecycle and Growth Strategy**
=============================================

Guide the business through its financial lifecycle and ensure that funding structures and financial capabilities evolve with its stage of development. This includes:

* Business establishment, entity structuring, financial planning and initial capitalisation.
* Early-stage growth, scaling, fundraising and infrastructure or project expansion.
* Financial governance, commercial growth, profitability and long-term value creation.
* Mergers, acquisitions, strategic partnerships, restructuring and business transformation.
* Transaction readiness and potential exit planning.

Align corporate growth capital, project or asset financing and subsequent refinancing or strategic transactions with business needs, risk appetite and approved return objectives.

**4. Financial Planning, Analysis and Performance Management**
==============================================================

* Lead annual budgeting, long-term financial planning, forecasts and scenario modelling.
* Monitor financial and operational performance against approved plans
* Analyze profitability, cash flow, capital requirements and investment returns.
* Track business and project performance against approved investment cases, identify variances and recommend corrective action.
* Develop management reports and financial dashboards for senior leadership, identifying risks and opportunities and enabling informed decisions.

**5. Corporate Finance and Strategic Transactions**
===================================================

* Evaluate investment and strategic opportunities through valuation, financial analysis and assessment of returns and risks.
* Lead financial due diligence and financial transaction structuring for India-led transactions; *(support Group-led transactions within the agreed mandate.)*
* Structure and financially govern joint ventures and special purpose vehicles (JVs/SPVs), including shareholder funding, debt/equity arrangements, inter-company transactions and project returns.
* Develop and oversee cash waterfalls, distributions, dividend or repatriation arrangements and investor reporting in accordance with approved agreements and applicable requirements.
* Contribute to mergers, acquisitions and strategic partnerships, working with legal, tax, banking and external advisory partners
* Support exit readiness and strategic transaction planning.

**6. Finance Operations, Governance and Compliance**
====================================================

* Establish and maintain robust financial controls, policies and governance, including oversight of capital deployment and entity-level reporting.
* Ensure compliance with applicable Indian accounting, taxation, corporate and regulatory requirements
* Oversee financial, accounting and statutory compliance reporting.
* Ensure timely and accurate financial management and statutory filings.
* Manage relationships with auditors, tax advisors and external consultants; *(coordinating with Group finance as appropriate.)*
* Identify and mitigate financial and business risks, including financing covenant compliance and related-party exposures.

**7. Cash Flow and Working Capital Management**
===============================================

* Lead cash flow, liquidity and working capital planning and management.
* Align liquidity and financing requirements with business growth, capital expenditure and project or JV/SPV funding commitments.
* Manage banking relationships and financing facilities
* Monitor funding availability, drawdown conditions and covenant headroom.
* Monitor capital expenditure and investment commitments and optimise the use of capital across approved business, for infrastructure- and project-based requirements.

**8. Technology and Infrastructure Business Understanding**
=======================================================

**Job Summary**
---------------

At Standard Chartered, excellence means more than achieving financial results — it means embodying our core values and delivering on our promise: Here for good. We foster a diverse and inclusive workplace culture that supports all individuals in realising their full professional potential and actively contributing to our continued success.

We are looking for an experienced professional to join our team in Chennai as a Director/Associate Director of Business Risk Assessment & Advisory focused on the Depository Participant (DP) license framework. This role will provide expert advisory on Conduct, Financial Crime, and Compliance Risk (CFCC) to ensure the integrity and regulatory alignment of our Depository Business. Effective risk management in this role will support the organisation's commitment to regulatory compliance and protect client interests in a rapidly evolving regulatory environment.

**You will have deep expertise in CFCC risk assessment, regulatory interpretation, compliance oversight and risk advisory services under the Depositories Act, 1996 and related SEBI regulations, ensuring we uphold our reputation as a trusted financial institution.**

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Responsible for supporting Head, WRB CFCR Advisory in India for Compliance Advisory for Depository Business under Depository Participant (DP) license.
* Responsible for FC Risk assessment for DP Business
* Responsible for providing details of developments relating to DP compliance and conduct, giving rise to a material risk that serious regulatory breaches or breaches of country risk appetite metrics may occur and notifying any such breaches to (as appropriate) Head, WRB CFCR India, relevant Heads of Business and risk forums

**Strategy**

* Support Head WRB CFCR India in implementing the vision, strategy and direction set for the WRB CFCR function in India
* Practice the culture and compliance with CFCR standards (including conducting business within regulatory requirements, and to high ethical standards) within the Bank and embed a Here for good culture and the Group Code of Conduct.
Establish close links with colleagues of other Client segments and/or Product Groups to achieve common platforms and work plans, implementing a One Bank approach to covering all Clients.  

**Business**

* Analyse comprehensive impact of CFCR matters on the DP business areas, and their operations.
* Ensure that key changes (to laws, rules, regulations) pertaining to DP products are communicated and cascaded (in region/country).
* Support relevant stakeholders to make decisions based on current and possible future policies, practices, and trends.
* Ensure appropriate advice is provided to the relevant stakeholders on the interpretation and application of regulatory expectations, laws, best practices and policies related to CFCR (DP advisory).

**Processes**

* Support Head WRB CFCR India in review and approval of appropriate policies/processes/DOls to address CFCR risks related to DP, aligning them with relevant regulatory requirements.
* Provide support and challenge to the relevant stakeholders to ensure that they establish and monitor appropriate processes for compliance with CFCR policies, procedures and standards (including meeting regulatory obligations and maintaining high standards of conduct) pertaining to DP in WRB.

**People & Talent**

* Help in creating an environment of appropriate culture and values. work in collaboration with risk and control partners
* Work collaboratively with the team.

This role reports directly to the Head, WRB CFCR Advisory India, and interfaces regularly with senior business leaders, risk committees, and regulatory bodies. You will have an opportunity to influence policy formulation, risk frameworks and compliance culture at both a local and regional level, ensuring that our Depository Business consistently meets the highest standards.

You will also contribute to strategic initiatives aiming at digital transformation and risk automation, supporting Standard Chartered’s vision to be digitally enabled while maintaining rigorous control disciplines.

As part of your key contributions, you will participate in external regulatory engagements, representing the bank’s perspective with clarity and professionalism. You will work to anticipate regulatory trends and prepare the organisation for compliance-related changes, thereby reducing potential operational and reputational risks.

Furthermore, you will support internal audit and regulatory inspection processes, ensuring timely and effective remediation of findings and recommendations.

**Skills and Experience**
-------------------------

* Business Acumen, Product and Operations

• Business Ethics
  
• CFCC Risk Management
  
• CFCC Risk Advisory
  
• Leadership (Influencing and Inspiring)
  
• Managing Change
  
• Data gathering, analytics and insights
  
• Enterprise and Operational Risk Management
  
• Collaboration and Stakeholder Management
  
• Regulatory Environment – Financial Services

**Qualifications**
------------------

We seek candidates with a minimum of 15 years’ relevant work experience within banking, financial institutions, regulatory bodies, fintech or closely related industries. Specifically, at least 10 years’ experience in conduct, compliance or risk management roles with a strong emphasis on Depository Participant regulations and securities market frameworks.

The ideal candidate will have advanced practitioner level expertise including:

* 5+ years of specialised conduct or compliance risk management experience.
* Demonstrable experience with NSDL, CDSL and SEBI regulatory requirements in the Indian context.
* Hands-on experience managing conduct risks including data risk, conflict of interest, regulatory reporting, and client market conduct.
* Robust knowledge of financial crime risks such as anti-money laundering, anti-bribery and corruption, sanctions compliance, and fraud prevention.
* 4+ years of practitioner level experience in business, product, or operational risk management with exposure to compliance and financial crime disciplines.
* 3+ years of complementary experience in interconnected risk surveillance operations or control oversight functions.

Key competencies required for success in this role include an action-oriented approach, strong collaboration and communication skills, and the courage to challenge and lead change. You will need to maintain a customer focus while ensuring high decision quality and ethical standards.

Other essential competencies encompass talent development, vision and purpose alignment, providing clear guidance, instilling trust, managing ambiguity effectively, adopting a nimble learning mindset, and demonstrating a strategic outlook. Technical competencies relevant to this role involve deep expertise in CFCC risk management and advisory within the financial services sector.

Standard Chartered is a leading international bank that combines agility with scale to deliver impactful financial solutions globally. With over 170 years of heritage, we are committed to making a positive difference for our clients, communities, and colleagues across diverse geographies.

We pride ourselves on challenging convention and embracing innovation while being grounded in strong ethical values. Our inclusive culture champions diversity and fosters an environment where every individual’s unique talents are recognised, respected, and nurtured.

The VP will lead the delivery of assigned service priorities and is responsible with key stakeholders to deliver the expected outcomes within set time boundaries.
  
  
Reporting directly to the Head of Client Service Engineering, the VP Client Service Engineering plays a pivotal role in driving end-to-end change through process reengineering, automation, and efficiency improvements. He/She will lead multiple client service priorities, collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, and ensure the successful execution of initiatives that align with the bank's strategic objectives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Service Journey Reimagination
  
  

* Lead the redesign of client service journeys to ensure they are client-centric, efficient, and risk-controlled. Drive end-to-end process optimization and automation initiatives.

Service Delivery & Performance Management
  
  

* Ensure delivery and scalability of redesigned service journeys, coordinating cross-functional teams.

jobs.title: Director - Visa Direct Business Strategy & Planning
jobs.description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Job Description**
Role Summary:
  
  
The Visa Direct CEMEA - Business Strategy and Planning - Director is the Business Planning & Strategy lead for Visa Direct in CEMEA, based in Dubai. The role works closely with the head of Strategy and Business Planning for CMS, as well as the VP, Head of Money Movement Solutions CEMEA, as strategic and planning partner on all internal and external initiatives. This role will help drive the strategy and transformation of Money Movement Solutions CEMEA while collaborating with key members of the CEMEA Leadership Team, Global Visa Direct Team, and other stakeholders.
  
  
**Strategy**
This role encompasses:
  
  

* Own the end-to-end Visa Direct CEMEA strategy, and translate Visa 2030 priorities into sub-regional and country plans with clear owners and milestones.
* Set product and use-case priorities by market with Regional and Global Visa Direct Commercialization and Product teams; prioritise opportunities through market sizing, whitespace, competitor and market-share analysis.
* Lead analysis and recommendations on Visa Direct pricing, incentives and IRF changes, and support M&A, investment and partnership opportunities with due diligence and business cases.
* Scan market, regulatory and ecosystem trends (e.g. real-time payments, stablecoins, fintech disruption) and provide insights on impact to strategy and key initiatives; coordinate with the VCS BPO Director on topics spanning CMS.

**Business Planning & Performance**

* With Finance and key business partners, lead the annual operating plan (AOP) and multi-year outlook, target setting, OKR planning and review, scorecards and business reviews; track quarterly Opex and investment.
* Maintain one consolidated view of revenue, net revenue, AANR and other KPIs, flag gaps and risks early, and reuse CMS Data, Analytics & AI and global dashboards rather than duplicating reporting.
* Drive AANR-to-net-revenue conversion by tracking signed agreements through launch to live volume; run pipeline and AANR governance with sub-regional sales leaders and shape priority deal strategy with CMS Deals Management.

**Sales And Account Management Excellence**

* Support the sales and account management center of excellence (COE): manage sales and implementation pipelines, share sales goals with partnering client segment units and define the optimal client coverage model.
* Plan sales targets in line with the AOP; provide inputs to incentive design (SIP) and recognition programs; monitor team performance against targets.
* Optimize sales processes, tools (MS Dynamics) and funding programs (e.g. VIK, MDF), with training to improve the team's skills.
* Orchestrate account planning to identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities, and drive the annual Global Client Engagement Survey (GCES) and corrective actions.

**Communications**

* Maintain internal communications (all-hands, newsletters) and share success stories across the CEMEA Money Movement organization.
* Lead materials for key cadences (MBRs, QBRs, all-staffs, Global and CEMEA LT sessions, client councils) and run the leadership operating rhythm with clear agendas, decisions and actions.
* Liaise with Global Money Movement, Investor Relations and Communications for Visa CEO, CFO, President and investment community forums.

**Execution**

* As a strategic partner to the CEMEA CMS head of BPO and head of Money Movement, organize and prioritize critical information and data for efficient decision-making and manage time-sensitive senior requests.
* Deliver strategic initiatives, from spinning up cross-functional teams to deal due diligence, and build the program management function to drive execution of key CEMEA Money Movement initiatives.
* Coordinate planning cycles with Global Visa Direct and Global CMS BPO, bring global best practice to the region and reuse CMS BPO and Centers of Excellence capabilities rather than rebuilding them.
* Work as one team with the other CMS functional BPOs and CoE to share best practices from Visa Direct with the wider team

This role sits at the intersection of multiple functions, so organizational savvy and interpersonal skills are critical. It works with Product groups, AEs, Merchant Sales, Regions, Operations, Technology, Risk, Data Science, Marketing, Communications, Legal, Corporate Strategy, Interchange/Pricing and Finance. About 60% of the role is the recurring operating rhythm (planning, OKRs, MBR/QBR, pipeline and performance reviews, Opex) and 40% strategic, project and ad-hoc work. The individual will be a thought leader in strategy and business growth with a proven track record in fast-paced environments with demanding timelines.
  
  
Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* 12+ years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g., Masters, MBA, MD, PhD).
* Prior experience in management consulting or corporate strategy.
* Proven track record in annual and multi-year planning, OKRs and executive business reviews; strong financial acumen, including business cases and financial modeling.
* Financial/payment industry knowledge mandatory (money movement, cross-border flows); experience across emerging, multi-country markets such as CEMEA.
* Excellent problem-solving skills, customer-centric mindset and thought leadership, with evidence of tangible business results.
* Excellent communication, collaboration and influence skills; able to explain complex concepts to broad audiences and lead cross-functional teams to obtain buy-in.
* Strong sense of urgency and experience driving to successful commercialization; takes prompt, decisive action after analyzing relevant information.
* Ability to explain complex business and technical concepts to broad audiences in an approachable way.
* Experience leading and developing people; inclusive, learning-agile, with a real interest in the fintech ecosystem and a technology / digital-first approach; English required, Arabic, Russian or French an advantage.
* High levels of learning-agility with a real interest in the fintech ecosystem and a ‘technology / digital-first’ approach.
* Diversity of thought and experience. Continually seeks new perspectives and feedback, takes an inclusive approach, and engages diverse points of view.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.title: Director – Source to Pay Excellence - Dubai Holding Group Services
jobs.description:
**About Dubai Holding Group Services:**

Group Services is Dubai Holding’s shared business services arm that provides consolidated business solutions in procurement, finance and human capital across the Group. With a commitment to talent, digital innovation and continuous improvement, it delivers best-in-class service, enhancing the Group's overall performance.

Group Services is dedicated to transforming operations, elevating service quality and cultivating specialised teams focused on excellence and innovation.

**Group Services comprises:**

Group Services Procurement delivers end-to-end value through strategic sourcing, supplier management, and contracting. Enabled by advanced technology, streamlined processes, strong governance, and data-driven insights, it ensures responsible sourcing, cost efficiency, and operational excellence.

Group Services Finance manages financial transactions, budgeting, and reporting to ensure strong fiscal health and cash flow. It empowers informed decision-making through insights that drive sustainable growth and profitability.

Group Services Human Capital manages the full employee lifecycle, ensuring a smooth journey from recruitment to offboarding while fostering a culture that values and supports people—the Group’s greatest asset.

**Empowering talent for the future:**

Group Services’ greatest strength lies in its people; their collective capabilities serve as the driving force of the company. Dedicated to creating a vibrant talent hub where challenging the norm leads to innovation, collaboration fuels creativity and caring for people and partners cultivates strong relationships, Group Services aims to build a foundation for sustained success.

As a business that views success as a shared journey and celebrates every achievement along the way, Group Services offers the opportunity to grow, develop skills and make a meaningful impact.

Dubai Holding Group Services proudly supports a diverse portfolio of companies, including:

* Dubai Holding Real Estate
* Dubai Holding Entertainment
* Dubai Holding Community Management
* Dubai Holding Land Estates
* Dubai Holding Hospitality
* Dubai Holding Investments
* Dubai Holding Asset Management

**About the Job:**

Dubai Holding Group Services is seeking a Director – Source to Pay Excellence to lead the enterprise-wide transformation of Source-to-Pay services across Dubai Holding. This is a senior leadership role with accountability for shaping the S2P transformation agenda, strengthening the operating model, improving end-to-end service performance and enabling technology-led ways of working across Procurement, Contracting, Vendor Management and Purchase-to-Pay.

The role requires a credible transformation leader who can operate at executive level, translate business priorities into practical delivery roadmaps, challenge current ways of working, and mobilise cross-functional stakeholders across Group Services, Dubai Holding verticals, DHIT, Procurement and Finance. The successful candidate will be expected to build a high-performing S2P Excellence capability and establish the foundations for measurable, sustainable value realisation.

**Key Role and Responsibilities**

**Enterprise Transformation Scope**

* Own the Source-to-Pay excellence agenda across Procurement, Contracting, Vendor Management, Supplier Enablement and Purchase-to-Pay, ensuring transformation priorities are aligned to business needs and Group Services strategic objectives.
* Assess current operating models, process performance, governance, system utilisation and customer pain points to identify material improvement opportunities.
* Develop practical transformation roadmaps, business cases and implementation plans that improve service quality, cycle time, compliance, user experience and value delivery.

**Delivery Leadership and Governance**

* Act as the senior figurehead for S2P transformation, providing direction, challenge and escalation support across complex cross-functional initiatives.
* Lead prioritisation of transformation opportunities using Voice of the Customer input, operational data, service metrics, risk indicators and strategic value potential.
* Manage approvals for key transformation documentation, including business requirements, design decisions, delivery milestones, stakeholder sign-offs and change readiness outputs.
* Partner with DHIT and technology suppliers to ensure system enhancements, Oracle Fusion optimisation and digital enablement initiatives are business-led, well governed and adoption-focused.

**Stakeholder, Change and Value Realisation**

* Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Group Services, Dubai Holding verticals, Procurement, Finance, Legal, Risk, Compliance and IT.
* Work with Change and Communications teams to ensure transformation activity is supported by clear engagement, training, adoption and transition plans.
* Define measurable success criteria and benefits tracking for each major S2P initiative, ensuring improvements are evidenced through data and embedded into service performance management.
* Lead, coach and develop the S2P Excellence Team, setting clear priorities, standards and ways of working for a high-performing transformation capability.

**Indicative Measures of Success**

* Clear, prioritised S2P transformation roadmap endorsed by senior stakeholders.
* Improved process efficiency, cycle time, compliance, user adoption and service experience across priority S2P processes.
* Higher utilisation and optimisation of existing enterprise technology, particularly Oracle Fusion Cloud capabilities.
* A credible S2P Excellence function recognised for driving practical, measurable and sustainable transformation outcomes.

**About You:**

**Qualifications**

* Degree-qualified, ideally in Business, Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Engineering, Technology or a related discipline.
* Relevant transformation, procurement, shared services, Lean Six Sigma, change management or programme delivery qualifications would be advantageous.

**Experience**

* 10+ years’ experience in Procurement, Source-to-Pay, Finance operations, shared services or enterprise transformation, including significant exposure to complex multi-business environments.
* Proven track record leading end-to-end process transformation from opportunity identification and business case development through to delivery, adoption and benefits realisation.
* Strong understanding of S2P technologies, ERP-enabled process design and Oracle Fusion Cloud capabilities, with the ability to work effectively with IT and implementation partners.
* Experience engaging senior stakeholders, managing governance forums, resolving cross-functional issues and influencing decisions without relying solely on formal authority.

jobs.title: Head of People Transformation & Enterprise Process Excellence
jobs.description:
**We're Hiring | Head of People Transformation & Enterprise Process Excellence**

**Role Purpose**

The Head of People Transformation & Enterprise Process Excellence will establish and lead a scalable, business-focused approach to transformation, process management and continuous improvement across a growing international organisation.

Reporting directly to the Chief People Officer (CPO) and operating as a senior member of the Human Resources leadership team, the Head will initially focus on transforming HR processes and the end-to-end employee experience. The role will establish the HR process architecture, assess current practices, design future-state processes, clarify process ownership and decision rights, and introduce meaningful KPIs, SLAs and governance frameworks.

The Chief People Officer retains accountability for the HR strategy, HR operating model and HR organisational structure. The Head will provide process-based insight to inform operating-model decisions and translate the agreed model into end-to-end processes, governance, roles, controls, measures and implementation plans.

The Head will also establish an enterprise process-excellence framework and practical methodology that can be adopted by other business functions. Working across organisational and geographic boundaries, the role will enable leaders and process owners to improve the performance, consistency, control and experience of their processes while retaining accountability within the relevant function.

The position combines strategic design with hands-on transformation delivery. It will ensure that organisational processes support continued international growth while reinforcing culture, values, regulatory obligations and commitment to fair, inclusive and high-quality employee experiences.

The role may commence as an individual contributor during the initial diagnostic and mobilisation period. Delivery of the broader enterprise mandate will require the timely establishment of a dedicated People Transformation and Enterprise Process Excellence team, supported by nominated process owners, subject-matter experts and enabling functions. The Head will define the required capability and phased resourcing model with the Chief People Officer. Scope, sequencing and delivery commitments will remain aligned with approved capacity and resources.

**Key Accountabilities**

1. Transformation Strategy & Leadership

* Partner with the Chief People Officer to define and deliver the People Transformation and Enterprise Process Excellence strategy.
* Translate business and growth priorities into a practical, prioritised and measurable transformation roadmap.
* Act as a trusted adviser to senior leadership on process, governance, transformation and organisational-effectiveness matters.
* Build senior stakeholder alignment around transformation priorities and develop evidence-based recommendations and business cases.
* Establish governance for transformation initiatives, including decision forums, escalation paths, risk management and benefits tracking.
* Provide transparent reporting on progress, outcomes and key decisions.

2. Alignment with the HR Operating Model

* Ensure process transformation aligns with the approved or evolving HR operating model.
* Provide evidence from process diagnostics, performance data, employee experience and stakeholder feedback to support decision-making.
* Translate the approved operating model into process architecture, workflows, governance, controls, measures and implementation plans.
* Clarify responsibilities through accountability frameworks and RACI models.
* Define effective process interfaces between HR, leaders, employees and enabling functions such as Finance, Technology, Compliance, Legal, Risk and Operations.
* Support the implementation of approved operating-model changes.

3. HR Process Architecture & End-to-End Process Transformation

* Establish a Group-wide HR process architecture covering the complete employee lifecycle.
* Lead discovery sessions, stakeholder interviews, process mapping, maturity assessments and diagnostic reviews.
* Conduct gap analyses and identify inefficiencies, duplication, unclear ownership and control weaknesses.
* Design scalable, employee-focused and measurable future-state processes.
* Ensure processes are considered end-to-end, including workflows, systems, controls, decision points and employee touchpoints.
* Translate future-state designs into policies, procedures, controls, templates and implementation actions.
* Prioritise transformation initiatives according to business value, risk, employee impact and implementation feasibility.

Indicative HR Process Portfolio

Subject to agreed priorities, the portfolio may include:

* Position creation and requisition approval
* End-to-end recruitment and hiring
* Onboarding
* Performance management
* Learning, development and talent management
* Compensation, promotion, recognition and internal mobility
* Employee engagement
* Leave administration
* Offboarding, exit management and knowledge transfer

4. Process Governance, Documentation & Ownership

* Establish standards for process design, documentation, approval, ownership and change control.
* Create and maintain an accessible process repository.
* Establish regular process review and assurance cycles.
* Coordinate risk-based process health checks and conformance reviews.
* Partner with Internal Audit, Risk and Compliance functions to ensure appropriate control frameworks are embedded.
* Balance standardisation with local regulatory requirements.

5. Performance Excellence, KPIs & Service Levels

* Define KPIs, SLAs, targets, ownership and reporting frameworks.
* Introduce process-performance dashboards and review cadences.
* Use data and stakeholder feedback to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Maintain a continuous-improvement pipeline and benefits tracking methodology.
* Ensure measures drive end-to-end performance and employee experience.

6. Culture, Engagement, Equity & Inclusion

* Embed organisational values and leadership behaviours into people processes.
* Ensure fair, transparent and inclusive decision-making practices.
* Review people processes for potential barriers, bias and inconsistent application.
* Translate employee feedback into practical process and organisational improvements.
* Partner with HR leadership to strengthen accountability for employee experience outcomes.

7. Enterprise Process Excellence Capability

* Establish a practical enterprise process-excellence framework and methodology.
* Support business functions in defining process ownership, governance, KPIs and improvement priorities.
* Facilitate cross-functional transformation initiatives.
* Coach leaders and process owners on process management and continuous improvement.
* Develop a community of process owners and champions.
* Maintain clear accountability within business functions while providing specialist process expertise.

8. Technology, Data & Automation Enablement

* Assess current process-management, workflow and collaboration tools.
* Establish interim process-repository and governance solutions where required.
* Define business requirements for scalable BPM and process-management capabilities.
* Evaluate existing platforms and recommend fit-for-purpose solutions.
* Partner with Technology and business stakeholders to implement appropriate tools and workflows.
* Identify automation opportunities and improve data quality.
* Ensure technology decisions are driven by future-state process requirements and user needs.

9. Implementation, Adoption & Capability Building

* Translate approved designs into implementation plans with clear milestones and ownership.
* Develop communication, training and change-adoption strategies.
* Monitor adoption and address implementation challenges.
* Build internal process-management and continuous-improvement capability.
* Define future-state team structures, skills and resource req
