jobs.title: VCA Consulting Director, Acquiring Advisory
jobs.description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Job Description**
Role Summary:
  
  
The Visa Consulting Director will be responsible for the growth of the Acquiring Advisory practice across CEMEA. This includes the overall strategy and successful delivery of offerings within this practice under the EMF umbrella, ensuring that it continues to grow across the region. This will require a depth of expertise in the Acquiring business, a solid understanding of the implications of the changing environment for payment service providers and the ability to design modules and set plays that will increase Visa's reputation as the leading advisor in this field. The Director will work in close cooperation with Visa's global consulting practices and with Value-Added Services, notably Visa Acceptance Solutions, and will lead a growing portfolio of Acquiring trainings, bringing a strong management consulting background and setting the standard for AI-enabled advisory delivery across the practice. Success will be measured on Visa's ability to provide proof points of growth in clients' businesses and being able to evidence the fact that we have supported our clients to define and implement strategies that will prepare them for future success.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities/Key Result Areas**

* Own and drive the Acquiring Advisory practice forward as its senior subject matter expert.
* Use this in-depth expertise to review, expand and grow the areas where Visa can support acquirers, processors and PayFacs to optimize and expand their business in a balanced manner that delivers clear results.
* Use Visa and external data to analyze client needs across the region's markets to identify opportunities for Acquiring Advisory consulting assignments with Visa's clients.
* In coordination with regional VCA teams, Country Managers, Products and Account Executives, ensure we operate as One Visa.
* Work in close partnership with Value-Added Services (VAS), and in particular Visa Acceptance Solutions, to shape joint propositions, embed acceptance solutions in consulting recommendations and generate pipeline for VAS products.
* Support the development of Acquiring Advisory project pitches and secure new consulting assignments with clients, as well as relevant re-engagement opportunities via a consultative sales approach in assigned markets under the guidance of the Hub lead and regional consulting leads.
* Deliver consulting projects. Resolve complex strategic problems. Synthesize and manage complex project structures when required. Manage, facilitate and implement consulting services and meet the client's business targets (assignment objectives, project scope, budget, paperwork, external consultants' supervision and project delivery). Ensure a seamless consulting experience for the client including all required areas/departments.
* Work on client site and/or virtually to design and project manage the implementation of recommendations as required.
* Ability and desire to mentor colleagues at all levels of the organization who are working to develop Acquiring expertise.
* Design, update and deliver the portfolio of Acquiring trainings for clients and internal Visa audiences, from executive briefings to in-depth technical and commercial programs, as an increasingly important part of the practice.
* Champion the use of AI across the Acquiring Advisory practice: embed AI tools into research, analysis, benchmarking and deliverable production, and ensure the team's AI fluency keeps pace with the fastest-moving tools available to consultants.
* Work closely with the global Acquiring practice and other global practices: share experience and project learnings in both directions, contribute to the set-up of standardized offerings, and leverage new global consulting solutions that will grow the practice.
* Take ownership of codifying best practices into reusable assets and of the ongoing build and maintenance of leading practices, new trends, business models and case studies to ensure that relevant information is always accessible and up to date.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Basic Qualifications:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent. Master's degree preferred.
* At least 10 years of overall experience, of which more than 5 years as a consultant in a top-tier management consulting firm with strong expertise in Banking and specifically in Acquiring — this consulting background is a core requirement of the role.
* Deep, first-hand expertise across all aspects of a payments acquiring business, including merchant solutions, processing, value proposition design, product development and launch.
* Experience gained within payment acquirers, processors, payment facilitators or card schemes is a strong plus. A combination of regional and global experience strongly desired.
* Strong facilitation and training delivery skills.
* Advanced consulting, client engagement, client contact and presentation skills. Credibility with clients and working teams and diplomatic skills to extract desired outcomes. Comfortable interacting with and presenting to senior management of clients and Visa.
* Full AI fluency and a genuine passion for AI: deep knowledge of GenAI and agentic AI concepts, capabilities and limitations, daily hands-on use of the leading AI tools, and the credibility to set and raise the AI standard for the team's research, analysis and deliverable production.
* Highly analytical with advanced PowerPoint and Excel skills.
* Superior project management skills. Fluent communicator.
* Must have financial acumen and commercial awareness skills.
* Results-driven, flexible and both internally and externally customer focused.
* Able to travel frequently and work on client site and in a multicultural environment across CEMEA.
* Self-motivated and able to use own initiative with limited direction.
* Strong teamwork and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively with interdisciplinary groups.
* Russian language is plus.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

We create credit reports by collecting and analyzing credit histories – sorting through data about the credit people applied for, whether their applications were successful, and how they paid the credit back. **Job Purpose**
Drive the growth of Thermo Fisher Scientific’s Cell & Gene Therapy (CGT) business by enabling and leading integrated workflow selling across businesses.
  
  
The role will identify strategic CGT opportunities, understand customers’ scientific, process-development and manufacturing workflows, and bring together capabilities from across Thermo Fisher Scientific to create differentiated, end-to-end solutions.
  
  
A critical aspect of this role is the ability to
**influence without direct authority**
. The incumbent will work across multiple businesses, commercial teams, product specialists, application scientists, marketing, service and other functions to create alignment around customer opportunities and mobilize the right capabilities to win.
  
  
The role will act as a
**CGT workflow orchestrator**
, moving customer engagement beyond individual products toward integrated solutions spanning research, process development, clinical translation and commercial manufacturing.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**CGT Workflow Selling & Business Growth**

* Develop and execute the commercial strategy for growing Thermo Fisher Scientific’s Cell & Gene Therapy business across assigned markets and strategic customers.
* Identify and develop high-value opportunities where multiple Thermo Fisher businesses can participate in the customer workflow.
* Build a strong pipeline of integrated CGT workflow opportunities rather than relying primarily on individual product opportunities.
* Understand customer programs from early research and process development through clinical translation, scale-up and commercial manufacturing to identify opportunities across the workflow.
* Connect relevant capabilities across cell biology, cell culture, cell processing, gene editing, viral vector and plasmid workflows, bioprocessing, analytical technologies, instruments, consumables, reagents and services.
* Translate customer scientific and manufacturing challenges into integrated Thermo Fisher value propositions.
* Drive penetration and share of wallet within strategic CGT customers through broader workflow adoption.
* Maintain strong commercial discipline around pipeline development, opportunity progression, forecasting and execution.

**One Thermo Fisher – Cross-Business Leadership**

* Serve as the commercial integrator for CGT opportunities across Thermo Fisher Scientific businesses.
* Bring together Business Units, commercial teams, Technical Sales Specialists, Application Scientists, Product Management, Marketing, Service and other relevant stakeholders around priority CGT opportunities.
* Establish a clear opportunity strategy and define how different businesses can collectively address the customer’s workflow.
* Create alignment across businesses on customer priorities, value propositions, engagement strategy and execution.
* Ensure individual product discussions are connected wherever appropriate into a broader CGT workflow and customer strategy.
* Identify gaps or overlaps between businesses and facilitate decisions that enable a coordinated One Thermo Fisher approach.
* Act as the internal voice of the CGT customer, ensuring customer workflow requirements and emerging needs are understood across relevant businesses.

**Influence Without Authority**
Success in this role will depend heavily on the ability to
**lead through influence rather than organizational authority**
.
  
  
The incumbent will:
  
  

* Build credibility and trusted relationships with commercial and business leaders across Thermo Fisher Scientific.
* Influence Business Units and sales teams to collaborate on opportunities that span organizational boundaries.
* Create alignment among stakeholders who may have different priorities, objectives and reporting structures.
* Mobilize resources across businesses without necessarily having direct control over those resources.
* Establish shared objectives and mutual accountability around strategic CGT opportunities.
* Navigate a complex matrix organization and resolve competing priorities through collaboration, data, customer insight and business rationale.
* Build internal advocacy for CGT opportunities and secure commitment from relevant stakeholders.
* Facilitate decisions and maintain momentum across complex opportunities involving multiple internal and customer stakeholders.
* Demonstrate strong executive presence, stakeholder management, negotiation and influencing skills.

**Strategic Customer Leadership**

* Develop strong relationships with biotechnology, biopharmaceutical, CDMO, academic, translational research and other organizations participating in the Cell & Gene Therapy ecosystem.
* Engage senior scientists, R&D leaders, process-development teams, manufacturing leaders, procurement teams and business executives.
* Develop a deep understanding of customers’ therapeutic pipelines, technology platforms, manufacturing strategies, capacity expansion plans and long-term priorities.
* Build multi-year strategic account and workflow plans for priority CGT customers.
* Identify opportunities for broader strategic partnerships extending beyond individual product transactions.
* Lead complex, high-value opportunities involving multiple Thermo Fisher businesses and multiple customer stakeholders.
* Conduct strategic business reviews and workflow discussions with key customers.

**Scientific & Workflow Leadership**

* Develop strong understanding of evolving Cell & Gene Therapy technologies, modalities, manufacturing platforms and customer workflow challenges.
* Maintain working knowledge across cell therapy, gene therapy, gene editing, viral vectors, plasmids, regenerative medicine and other relevant advanced-therapy areas.
* Engage customers in scientifically credible, workflow-oriented discussions.
* Enable commercial teams to move from product selling to consultative, workflow-based and outcome-oriented selling.
* Translate scientific and technology developments into actionable commercial opportunities.
* Partner with Business Units, application teams, R&D and Product Management to communicate unmet customer needs and emerging workflow requirements.
* Support scientific forums, workshops, seminars, roundtables and customer innovation discussions that strengthen Thermo Fisher Scientific’s position within the CGT ecosystem.

**Commercial Enablement & Opportunity Leadership**

* Work alongside divisional and regional commercial teams to identify, qualify and progress strategic CGT opportunities.
* Coach and enable sales teams on CGT workflows, customer discovery, consultative selling and cross-business opportunity development.
* Support teams in mapping customer workflows, stakeholders, decision-making processes and competitive positions.
* Develop compelling integrated value propositions for complex customer opportunities.
* Facilitate opportunity strategy sessions involving relevant businesses and specialists.
* Establish mechanisms to track major cross-business CGT opportunities and ensure clear actions, ownership and follow-through.
* Review pipeline quality, customer engagement and competitive activity and drive corrective actions where required.

**Market Development & Strategic Insights**

* Continuously assess the CGT market, including scientific developments, therapeutic pipelines, manufacturing investments, technology shifts, funding trends and evolving customer needs.
* Identify emerging workflow opportunities and areas where Thermo Fisher Scientific can create differentiated value through its combined portfolio.
* Translate market and customer intelligence into recommendations for commercial strategy, portfolio development, marketing and customer engagement.
* Provide structured feedback to business and regional leadership regarding customer requirements, competitive threats and emerging opportunities.

Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.

To build and grow HSBC Premier Banking relationships with high-net-worth individual (HNI) customers, acting as a single point of contact and providing comprehensive banking support and financial advisory aligned to customer needs. The role focuses on delivering against business targets while meeting Global Premier Service Standards and ensuring strong conduct and regulatory outcomes.

* The Executive Director, Client Coverage, Public Sector is the strategic adviser and relationship lead for a portfolio of major public sector clients, primarily across the Middle East (GCC Region). The portfolio includes central banks, ministries of finance, government entities and agencies, export credit and development agencies, multilateral organisations, regional development banks and selected development organisations. The role is accountable for developing senior client relationships, originating and delivering relevant solutions across Transaction Banking, Financial Markets and Global Banking, and achieving sustainable revenues and returns while maintaining strong credit, financial crime, conduct and regulatory risk discipline. The role also supports the regional team head on origination and client engagement across the region and selectively develops approved prospect relationships.

**Portfolio Strategy And Financial Performance**

* Lead client strategies through disciplined account planning and deliver agreed revenue, profitability, RoRWA and franchise objectives for the designated portfolio.

**Origination And Trusted-adviser Coverage**

* Build senior relationships up to ministerial and C-suite level, anticipate client needs, originate new business and position the Bank as a consistent strategic partner rather than a transactional provider.

**Integrated Client Solutions**

* Mobilise Transaction Banking, Financial Markets, Global Banking, structuring, advisory and industry partners to deliver relevant solutions, deepen inbound flows and selectively deploy balance sheet where supported by appropriate ancillary returns and Group economics.

**Sustainable And Innovative Finance**

* Originate and structure sustainable finance solutions including debt-for-nature, debt-for-development and sustainable loans, and replicate successful structures across the public sector segment.

**Risk, Compliance And Portfolio Stewardship**

* Own client acceptance and ongoing risk management, including AML, CDD and credit; maintain accurate account plans, call reports and deal pipelines; identify, escalate and resolve conduct, regulatory, reputational and credit issues.

**Market Insight And Franchise Development**

* Maintain strong knowledge of political, macroeconomic, country-risk and industry developments; bring international best practice, investment opportunities and thought leadership to clients; support investor roadshows, RFPs and industry engagement.

**Collaboration And Execution**

* Maintain effective relationships with Country and Cluster leadership, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Client Management and product teams; ensure timely meeting notes, coordinated execution and high-quality client outcomes across the Bank network.

**Role Scope**

* This is a senior individual-contributor role with no direct reports. The role holder is expected to contribute to team capability, knowledge sharing, diversity initiatives and the development of colleagues through informal coaching and collaboration.

**Individual Contribution and Team Leadership**

* Operate as a senior individual contributor, providing leadership through client judgement, execution discipline and collaboration across the regional Public Sector franchise.
* Invest in personal development, share knowledge and support the development of colleagues through coaching, inclusive teamwork and participation in learning and diversity initiatives.
* Maintain mandatory learning, professional development and risk-awareness standards applicable to the role.
* Share sector, thematic and market insights with clients and internal partners to strengthen strategic engagement and the Bank’s market position.

**Motivations**

* Strategic client impact: Energised by solving complex public sector priorities and building trusted relationships with senior government, central bank and development-institution stakeholders.
* Origination and innovation: Motivated by creating commercially sound, differentiated solutions across financing, markets, transaction banking and sustainable finance.
* International collaboration: Thrives in a cross-border environment that requires judgement, resilience, teamwork and effective mobilisation of the Bank’s network.

**Key Experiences, Qualifications And Languages**

* Relevant banking experience, preferably in senior relationship management, origination or sales covering public sector, sovereign, financial institution or development-finance clients.
* Regional market knowledge and exposure is critical.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex client relationships, originating cross-product opportunities and coordinating execution across Transaction Banking, Financial Markets and Global Banking.

* Strong knowledge of credit, AML, CDD, conduct and regulatory requirements. Any market-specific licence required to undertake banking business must be maintained.

Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.
  
  
Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.
  
  
**What We Offer**

jobs.title: Growth (French speaking)
jobs.description:
**About Column**
For companies building financial technology and transforming the financial services space, the biggest bottleneck to their growth and innovation is often the underlying banks and infrastructure stack they rely on. We have spent our careers founding and scaling companies like Plaid, Square, Meta, Blend, and Affirm, and have seen this problem firsthand — builders and developers needing to partner with traditional banks, and creating API and abstraction layers over the patchwork that is the bank, its core, and many other vendors. All of this results in a complex (and often expensive) banking supply chain involving a user, fintech, BaaS middleware provider, bank, core and the Federal Reserve.
  
  
At Column, we set out to simplify and fix this. We are a bank and a software company built from the ground up, offering builders and developers technology-forward banking solutions that cut out the hundreds of vendors, middleware providers, and abstraction layers. This means a safer, more transparent, and less costly banking supply chain. Come build with us!
  
  
**The opportunity**
Column's Growth team is focused on managing our highly strategic customer relationships. As a member of the Growth team, you’ll be responsible for building and overseeing all aspects of our customer management while acting as a trusted partner, advisor and advocate for a wide variety of customers. You will also be in charge of designing and implementing the strategy, processes, and content needed to help us scale this key function.
  
  
This role has a unique international focus, helping build one of Column's most strategic expansion initiatives from the ground up. At least have of your work will be dedicated to building and managing partnerships with banks across Africa. The rest of your time will go to working with Column's core fintech partners.
  
  
Column's Growth team is not your typical Customer Success or Account Management team in that Column is a critical, often existential, partner for our customers, our customer relationships are deeply collaborative and complex, and each customer contributes meaningfully to our revenue. We're therefore looking for team members who are analytical, demonstrate great critical thinking, and have experience managing very strategic relationships.
  
  
This role is highly cross-functional and collaborative, partnering closely with Column’s Executive, Solutions Engineering, Sales, Compliance, and Correspondent Banking teams to ensure customers are onboarded smoothly, that we can anticipate and address both issues and opportunities for growth, and that these relationships are healthy and mutually beneficial. You’ll also represent the voice of the customer to help inform Column's strategy, including the product roadmap, go-to-market motions and more.
  
  
Success in this role also means having a desire to become an expert on the Financial Technology space and on how companies partner with Column (our customers include many key industry players such as Brex and Carta).
  
  
**This role reports to the Head of Growth and is an in-person role based out of Dubai, UAE. We will help secure any required visas.**
**What You’ll Do**

* Help establish our customer-facing strategy, processes, playbooks, systems and best practices. Identify patterns and build repeatability at every step
* Manage all aspects of a customer’s relationship with Column, from onboarding and implementation to ongoing management and expansion of the account
* Onboard and manage our emerging markets bank partners: Serve as the day-to-day lead for banks across Africa. Guide them through onboarding and own the ongoing relationship once they’re live.
* Build and nurture relationships across various functions within a customer's organization, identifying and creating advocates wherever you go, and helping find new use cases for partnering with Column
* Proactively identify challenges and opportunities for growth, and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to find solutions in order to move the relationship forward
* Share key findings and recommendations on market feedback and trends to inform Column’s growth strategy and product roadmap
* Perform day-to-day activities consistent with safe and sound business practices and regulatory requirements
* This role includes periodic travel to Africa to meet with our bank partners in person.

**What You’ll Need To Be Successful**

* 5+ years of relevant work experience -- strong preference for a mix of Consulting, Private Equity, Investment Banking, VC or an equivalent role plus operating experience in an early stage company and/or selling a new line of business
* Professional fluency in French and English required
* A desire to become very knowledgeable on the financial technology and payments space. Prior experience in financial services can be helpful but certainly not required
* A growth and critical thinking mindset: You’re comfortable navigating ambiguous environments and are energized by the prospect of helping build processes with little guidance
* Excellent project management: You’re organized, can manage all aspects of partnering with customers, and effectively work with other internal teams
* Ability to turn naysayers into champions: You’re a persuasive communicator and understand the importance of being helpful, responsive, and solutions-oriented
* Curiosity: You know what questions to ask to uncover and understand customer needs and proactively learn more about the industry, competitive landscape, and product offerings to better support your customers
* Insatiable hunger for improvement: you’re a naturally curious person, enjoy digging into the data, and regularly solicit feedback

**What You’ll Get From Us**

* 🏥 Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans, including options that are 100% covered by Column for you and 100% covered for your dependents!
* 🌴 Competitive time-off policy - take the time off that you want and need to relax and recharge
* 🧳 Sabbatical Program - Reach your 5-year anniversary to take up to 8 weeks of fully paid leave to rest, recharge, and pursue personal interest - with full salary and benefits
* 👶 100% paid parental leave, including 16 weeks for birth mothers, 12 weeks for primary caregivers, and 8 weeks for secondary caregivers
* 🎉 Regular team building events, including annual offsite

**We look forward to hearing from you**
Column is committed to working with the best and brightest people from the broadest talent pool possible. We value bringing together a team with different perspectives, educational backgrounds, and life experiences, and believe a diversity of ideas is what allows us to develop the best solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.
  
  
If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application and recruiting process, please reach out to accommodations@column.com.
  
  
We participate in the E-Verify program in certain locations as required by law. Learn more about the E-Verify program here.

jobs.title: Customer Success Director
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
The Job in short
  
  
As a Customer Success Director at Backbase, you will be at the forefront of driving customer satisfaction and success across the Middle East You will be responsible for ensuring that our customers derive maximum value from Backbase’s Engagement Banking Platform. This role involves frequent travel across the region and requires a strong ability to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders at all levels, from C-suite decision-makers to programme leaders.
  
  
Your mission is to foster product adoption and license consumption, enhance customer satisfaction, and contribute to Net ARR Growth by ensuring that our customers successfully leverage Backbase's solutions to achieve their business goals.
  
  
Meet the Job
  
  

* Customer Relationship Management:

Develop and nurture strong, long-lasting relationships with key customers across your region.
  
  
Regularly engage with senior stakeholders to understand their evolving needs and expectations throughout the software development lifecycle, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor and valuable resource.
  
  
Facilitate complex discussions that involve multiple stakeholders, helping to align their goals with Backbase's solutions and unblocking any adoption and license consumption challenges.
  
  

* Value Maximization:

Collaborate with customers to identify opportunities to maximize the value they derive from Backbase products.
  
  
Work with Backbase Customer Advisory to localize business cases. Provide strategic guidance and best practices to ensure business cases align to the region and bank specific goals, ensuring customers are fully utilizing the range of product capabilities available to them.
  
  
Proactively identify and address potential challenges, working towards solutions that align with the customer’s business objectives.
  
  
Develop joint success plans with senior stakeholders, with clear objectives that are aligned with their strategic goals.
  
  
Actively work with the customer on roadmap planning to track and ensure the realization of the business case throughout the programme lifecycle.
  
  

* Advocacy Building:

Identify and cultivate customer advocates who are willing to share their success stories and experiences with Backbase solutions.
  
  
Collaborate with marketing teams to create case studies, testimonials, and other materials that showcase customer success.
  
  

* Feedback Collection and Product Improvement:

Gather and analyze product utilization, and end user feedback on product experiences, providing actionable insights to R&D and steward the Request for Feature (RFF) process as a joint responsibility with the Services team.
  
  
Act as a bridge between customers and Backbase’s product development organization. Work with the Backbase UX Research team, ensuring that customer needs and suggestions are considered in future product enhancements.
  
  

* Account Management:

Proactively manage renewals by aligning customer success plans and business cases with value realization, ensuring continued customer satisfaction and retention.
  
  
In collaboration with Sales, identify opportunities for account growth by understanding the banks’ business dynamics and leveraging them to expand ARR.
  
  
**How About You**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Technology, Business, or a related field.
* Experience: 10+ years of experience in a customer-facing role, including consulting, customer support, delivery or account management in KSA, with a focus on customer success in the technology or software industry.
* Technical Acumen: Previous experience in roles requiring technical understanding, particularly in customer success management within a software company.
* Language Proficiency: Fluent in Arabic, with strong written and verbal communication skills. Proficiency in English is also required.
* Customer-Centric Mindset: Passionate about delivering success for customers, with a deep commitment to understanding customer needs and delivering solutions that exceed their expectations.
* Results-Driven: Strong focus on customer satisfaction, with the ability to analyze data and provide actionable insights and maintain dashboards that drive product adoption and customer success.
* Relationship Builder: Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to challenge, negotiate, influence, and persuade stakeholders.
* Autonomous and Cross-Functional: Ability to work independently, take ownership of customer success initiatives, and drive results, while collaborating across teams with Sales, R&D and Services colleagues, as well as Backbase’s partner network.
* Organizational Skills: Capable of prioritizing tasks, multitasking, and demonstrating adaptability in a dynamic environment.
* Commercial and Functional Acumen: Understand the unique cultural and digital trends in the customer’s market and speak to business drivers, with a strong focus on maximizing value for customers. Experience in banking or other Financial Services is a plus.
* Frequent Traveler: Willingness to travel frequently across the region to engage with banks and ensure their success with Backbase.

This role offers a unique opportunity to make a significant impact on Backbase’s customer success, helping our customers achieve their strategic goals while driving growth and adoption of our engagement banking platform and other solutions.

Role Level: Director Work Type: Full-Time Country: United Arab Emirates City: Dubai Company Website: www.backbase.com Job Function: Customer Service Company Industry/
  
  
Sector: Financial Services

jobs.description:

The role holder is primarily responsible for working with Coverage teams in structuring Cash and Trade solutions, managing and growing of Transaction Banking business across the UAE. The role holder will be a member of the team covering GTB Sales in the UAE.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Identify and develop Cash and Trade business opportunities and profitability across the UAE on a sustainable basis, and making sure the customer experience is to the highest level.
* New Business: Responsible for Cash and Trade product growth jointly with the coverage teams in UAE. Plan and execute calling plans for each industry segment in conjunction with relationship managers (as appropriate) to deepen Cash and Trade product penetration across client portfolio.

* New Markets & Products: Structuring of bespoke open account solutions (SCF & RF) and ensure a high-quality customer experience through consultative approach, design and implementing workable and innovative solutions for customer’s needs. Responsible for structuring Trade deals and providing technical expertise to client base and relationship managers.
* CASA Generation: Structure liquidity and liabilities solutions that drive CASA growth while ensuring best-in-class customer experience.
* Regulatory Oversight: Manage proactively the fraud and compliance risks in the Cash and Trade business when developing solutions for clients.

* Partner with coverage teams to develop quality credit proposals supporting structuring of Trade facilities and proactively managing transactional risk in an efficient and profitable manner. Ensure ancillary business in cash management is ring-fenced to FAB.
* Service Delivery: Collaborate with other stakeholders to Ensure that customer comes first by delivering best-in-class service.
* Business Liaison: Maintain close liaison with intra region and cross regional stakeholders to bring about network connectivity to facilitate cross border transactions and opportunities where possible.
* Customer lead generation/origination to increase share of wallet with existing relationships by deep selling new Cash and Trade products and support
* Coverage team to generate new revenue opportunities from new to bank clients and opportunities.
* Stakeholder Coordination: Provide technical expertise to coverage and partner with coverage teams to develop quality proposals and RFPs that win mandates.
* Driving Cash and Trade sales for clients, in line with specific needs of clients.
* Delivery of specific revenue targets, CASA/liabilities, returns on risk adjusted assets and equity consistent and commensurate with the Bank’s acceptable risk parameters and pricing.
* Work closely with coverage teams and make the unit head aware of performance gaps in your portfolio.
* Actively engage with client together with the Unit Head and Coverage team to build business for the Bank.
* Responsible for structuring Cash & Trade deals and providing technical expertise to relationship managers and facilitate client discussions. This includes structuring Cash and Trade transactions, responding to RFPs and providing technical expertise to relationship managers.
* Participating in and contributing to deal teams where transactions require bespoke Cash and Trade solutions.
* Establish strong stakeholder relationships and work with colleagues and partners across the network to build a strong pipeline.
* Partner with coverage teams in contributing to quality credit proposals supporting structuring of existing and new Trade facilities.
* Proactively managing transactional risk in an efficient and profitable manner.
* Identify opportunities for continuous improvement of products, systems, processes, and practices while considering client needs, market developments and trends.
* Actively participate in opportunities to update product skills, understand market trends and competitor behaviours.
* Work closely with Coverage teams across the region and network to propose new markets, clients, and products.
* Work with Coverage team on creating detailed Key Account Plan for growing trade business and maximize market share.
* Closely monitoring utilization of Trade facilities and cross sell non-credit trade products / services to deepen client wallet.
* Understand and comply with regulations and internal policies i.e., Credit/ Compliance/ Operational Risks, etc.
* Work closely with Cash & Trade Product innovation team in UAE to finalize documentation/ structures/ rollout new trade products/ solutions.
* Understand and apply Business Delegation of Authority Matrix accordingly.
* Compliance with regulations and internal policies i.e., Credit/ Compliance/ Operational Risks, etc. Understand the bank’s risk framework and the relevant internal policies including the lines of defence.

**Requirements / Qualifications**

* Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Commerce, or equivalent discipline.
* 10+ years Transactional Banking Experience with specialized knowledge and experience in Cash Management, Payments, Liquidity Management, Core Trade
* Finance and Value Added Trade Finance.
* Candidate should have a track record in Origination, managing a portfolio of relationships and meeting specific portfolio KPIs and development of client relationships, both new-to-product and new-to-Bank.
* A highly motivated and experienced salesperson with a track record of originating new clients and driving revenues within a portfolio of corporate clients.
* Strong Client network with focus to grow Cash and Trade business for the bank in the region.
* Strong technical knowledge in Cash and Trade Finance products including core and value added Trade Finance. Cash Management products including
* Payments and Digital/Electronic Channels; Collections and Reconciliation tools, Account Services, Liquidity and Liabilities management.
* Self-starter who can handle all enquiries relating to Cash and Trade Finance independently.

* Strong origination capability coupled with excellent customer orientation & negotiation skills.
* Strong communication skills.
* Self-confident and performance driven. Ability to work under pressure and with a strong delivery focus.
* Ability to articulate, formulate and deliver high quality client presentation.
* Understanding of operations processes and procedures, and related risk in cash and trade transactions.
* Familiar with the regulatory environment concerning financial industry in UAE.

jobs.description:
**Organization:**
At CommBank, we never lose sight of the role we play in other people’s financial wellbeing. Our focus is to help people and businesses move forward to progress. To make the right financial decisions and achieve their dreams, targets, and aspirations. Regardless of where you work within our organisation, your initiative, talent, ideas, and energy all contribute to the impact that we can make with our work. Together we can achieve great things.
  
  
**Job Title: Staff Software Engineer**
**Location: Bangalore**
**Business & Team:**
Enterprise Services (ES) is responsible for the world leading application of technology and operations across every aspect of CommBank, from innovative product platforms for our customers to essential tools within our business. We also use technology to drive efficient and timely processing, an essential component of great customer service. CommBank is recognized as leading the industry in IT and operations with its world-class platforms and processes, agile IT infrastructure, and innovation in everything from payments to internet banking and mobile apps. The Payments Platform team resides in the Payments Technology, and its purpose is to restore the trust of our customers by transforming the Payments services experiences provided by the Bank to 99.999% availability, greater agility and reliability.
  
  
Our team is composed of engineers and technology leaders, who bring in the right mix of skills to enable this transformation. We also work very closely with our business and operations colleagues to support these services which are critical to the Australian and Global economy. Our team is also responsible for driving Engineering Governance, Continuous Delivery and key technological simplification pillars such as Cloud and Payments Event based architecture.
  
  
**Impact & Contribution:**
As a Staff Software Engineer within Payments Technology – Payments Platform, you will be responsible for implementing the designs within your application to align to Payments Reference Architecture. Specifically, as a Staff Software Engineer, you are expected to develop solutions and guide design to drive outcomes across the Core Product Systems within Payments Platform. You are responsible for design analysis and the estimation process from Business Case, ideation, discovery and
  
  
inception phases
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Design and implement BIAN APIs and specifications
* Lead high performing API and Cloud Engineering team
* Ownership and governance of solution designs
* Adopt a ‘Design to Run’ mentality to architect robust solutions that are fully supportable in a production environment
* Provide developmental advice and consult for business case/ideation, discovery, inception and enhancement requests by examining current vs target architectures ensuring align with ES strategy and architecture standards
* Collaborate with Solution Architecture and functional SME’s to prototype solutions to explore alternatives, seeking simple & standard solutions with a low cost of ownership
* Collaborate with upstream and downstream system representatives to ensure an integrated end to end solution is delivered to achieve the desired outcomes
* Proactively seek opportunities for continuous improvement of Core Product systems and data to leverage existing capabilities
* Work with senior technical and business management teams in identifying issues of current state architecture, developing target state architecture with the ability to communicate the features and benefits
* Effectively lead and influence business partners, peers, team members and vendors
* Identifies and engages stakeholders, including architecture disciplines, asset owners, delivery owner, business stakeholders and SMEs to ensure architecture is optimal, and has the greatest chance of success
* Effectively challenges business leaders to obtain the best technology solutions and fit with ES strategy

**Education Qualification:**
B.Tech

We're aware of some accessibility issues on this site, particularly for screen reader users. We want to make finding your dream job as easy as possible, so if you require additional support please contact HR Direct on 1800 989 696.

jobs.description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
We are seeking a Principal Solution Architect to provide architecture and hands-on technical leadership across Distribution Technology platforms and strategic initiatives. The role is responsible for translating business and technology requirements into secure, scalable, resilient and maintainable solutions spanning Microsoft Azure, data platforms, API and integration architecture, cloud infrastructure, DevSecOps, digital platforms and AI-enabled solutions.This is not a conceptual architecture position. The architect is expected to be hand on and implement solutions, working across architecture, infrastructure, application development, data engineering, security, production support and business teams to take solutions from design through implementation and operational readiness.
  
  
**Major Duties And Responsibilities**
Solution Architecture and Technical Leadership

Define data structures, views and interfaces consumed by applications and analytics platforms.
  
  
Partner with enterprise data and application teams on entity, client and product data integrations.
  
  
Support data lineage, data quality and troubleshooting across complex flows.
  
  
**DevSecOps and Engineering Enablement**
Define and improve automated CI/CD patterns for cloud applications and services.
  
  
Work with enterprise DevOps teams to automate build, deployment and environment workflows.
  
  
Promote infrastructure automation, repeatable deployments and environment consistency.
  
  
Establish engineering practices that improve deployment reliability and reduce manual operational effort.
  
  
Provide architecture and technical guidance on source control, deployment pipelines, configuration and runtime environments.
  
  
**Strategic Platforms and Emerging Technology·**
Provide architecture leadership for strategic NTAM Distribution initiatives involving digital, data and AI capabilities.
  
  
Collaborate with enterprise AI and platform teams on infrastructure and integration requirements for GenAI-enabled applications.
  
  
Evaluate emerging technology through prototypes and proof-of-concepts while keeping architecture aligned with enterprise standards.
  
  
Develop reusable architecture approaches for new capabilities rather than creating initiative-specific solutions wherever possible.

**Organisational Development Consultant**
=========================================

Req ID: 128597

Department: T&C Organisation Design & Implementation

Division: Talent & Culture

Location: Bengaluru

**About Us**
------------

At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.

  

Organisation Design and Implementation are trusted advisors and delivery partners to T&C and the business, through a strategy led, data informed, and people enabled approach to delivering workforce transformation projects end-to-end.

**About the Role**
------------------

As an Advisor - Organisation Design & Implementationin Talent & Culture, you’ll play a key role in helping day-to-day delivery and execution of large, complex people and workforce transformation initiatives, ensuring clear business outcomes are achieved. These initiatives may include the development of new operating models, organisation design and restructures, location or offshoring strategies, M&A people streams, data-led workforce analysis or broader transformation programs.

  

Supporting the development of high-quality insights, recommendations and deliverables that help leaders make informed decisions and enable successful implementation. This may include owning defined workstreams, coordinating project activities, conducting analysis, preparing materials, managing risks and dependencies, and partnering with stakeholders across the business and T&C.

  

The role plays an important part in helping OD&I deliver practical, evidence-based and people-centred outcomes. It requires strong consulting, problem-solving, stakeholder engagement and delivery skills, with the ability to work through complexity, manage competing priorities and contribute to successful transformation outcome.

  

The degree of autonomy, program size / complexity and leadership responsibility will vary depending on the level of the role.

  

Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.

**Role Location:**  
Bengaluru

Regular Shifts(Hybrid/Blended)

---------------------------------

* Supporting the delivery of Organisation Design & Implementation initiatives across operating model, organisation design, data management, workforce transformation, restructuring and implementation.
* Owning or contributing to defined project workstreams, ensuring activities are delivered to a high standard and aligned to agreed outcomes.
* Conducting organisational and workforce analysis to support insights and recommendations, including structure, spans and layers, role design, capability, governance and implementation considerations.
* Preparing high-quality project deliverables, including analysis, options, recommendations, stakeholder packs, governance materials, implementation plans and progress updates.

* Supporting governance activities, including project planning, status reporting, issue and risk management, dependency tracking and action management.

* Contributing to continuous improvement of OD&I frameworks, tools, methodologies, templates and ways of working

**What will you bring?**
------------------------

To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:

  

* Must have a minimum of 5+ years of relevant experience contributing to people, workforce, organisation design, operating model, or business transformation initiatives.
* Understanding of one or more OD&I core capabilities, such as organisation design, operating model design, restructuring, M&A people streams, workforce transformation, location strategy or data management.

* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to produce high-quality presentations, papers, updates and stakeholder communications.

* Ability to think systemically, connecting organisational, operational, customer, financial and people impacts when developing analysis and recommendations
* Experience in supporting the professional development and capability uplift of teams.

ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. jobs.description:
**At Bayer, we believe work should matter. Every day, our teams push toward a future where "Health for all, Hunger for none" is within reach, and every role, from the lab to the field to the boardroom, helps us get there. We give people the ownership to shape outcomes, the support to grow through new skills and experiences, and a global community where different perspectives are valued. If you want your work to count and the room to become your best, you'll find it here.**

  

**We’re changing the way we work at Bayer, for higher productivity, faster innovation, and better results. We call it Dynamic Shared Ownership (DSO). Learn more about what DSO will mean for you in your new role here** **https://www.bayer.com/en/strategy/strategy**

  

**Job Purpose**

The **Associate – Cash Applications** is responsible for the accurate and timely application of customer payments within the Accounts Receivable process. The role involves matching remittance information, clearing open items, reconciling cash receipts, resolving unapplied or unidentified payments, and supporting day-to-day Cash Application activities.

The Associate works closely with customers and internal teams to ensure accurate processing, timely resolution of exceptions, strong controls, and high-quality service delivery.

**Key Tasks and Responsibilities**

* Process and apply incoming customer payments accurately and within agreed timelines, including bank transfers, lockbox receipts, cheques, cards, direct debits, and other payment methods.
* Match remittance advice with customer payments and correctly allocate receipts against invoices, customer accounts, deductions, credit notes, and other open items in the ERP system.
* Perform daily cash and bank reconciliation activities and ensure alignment between bank statements, cash receipt records, and the Accounts Receivable sub-ledger.
* Investigate unapplied, unidentified, misapplied, duplicate, short, or excess payments and coordinate with customers and relevant internal teams for resolution.
* Maintain customer accounts, clear open items, process approved adjustments, and follow up on workflow items and process exceptions.
* Handle customer and internal queries through email, calls, workflow tools, and other communication channels.
* Record and execute transactions in line with approved process documentation, accounting policies, service-level agreements, and quality standards.
* Complete required Internal Control System activities accurately and on time and maintain supporting documentation for audit purposes.
* Support month-end and period-end closing activities.
* Prepare and maintain operational reports related to cash posting, unapplied cash, unidentified cash, ageing, productivity, quality, and other relevant KPIs.
* Identify recurring process issues and escalate exceptions or process gaps to the Senior Associate or Team Lead.
* Support process improvement, automation, analytics, and AI initiatives within Cash Applications.
* Maintain process documentation, standard operating procedures, and work instructions.
* Participate in knowledge-sharing, cross-training, and continuous-learning activities.
* Adapt to changes in processes, systems, regional requirements, and transformation initiatives while maintaining service quality.

**Who you are**

* University degree or equivalent qualification, preferably in **Accounting, Finance, Commerce, Business Administration** , or a related discipline.
* Typically **1–3 years of relevant experience** in Cash Applications, Accounts Receivable, or another Order-to-Cash process.
* Good understanding of **Cash Applications, customer account reconciliation, open-item clearing, unapplied cash management, and basic accounting principles** .
* Experience working with ERP systems. Hands-on experience with **SAP or SAP S/4HANA** would be an advantage.
* Good working knowledge of **Microsoft Office, particularly Excel** .
* Experience working in a shared-services, global, or multi-regional environment would be an advantage.
Fresh graduates with relevant accounting/finance knowledge and strong aptitude may also be considered depending on the business requirement.  

**Core Competencies**

* High attention to detail and accuracy.
* Good analytical, reconciliation, and problem-solving skills.
* Customer-oriented mindset with clear written and verbal communication.
* Ability to manage daily volumes, prioritise activities, and meet agreed timelines.
* Good collaboration skills and ability to work with teams across functions and regions.
* Willingness to learn and contribute to process improvements, automation, analytics, and AI-enabled solutions.
Can-do attitude, adaptability, learning agility, and commitment to quality and compliance.  

Key Working Relationships

* Customers and business partners across the assigned region/country.
* Senior Process Associates, Operational Managers, and Team Leads.
* Collections, Credit, Billing, Customer Service, Banking, Treasury, and Master Data teams.
* Internal Controls and Audit teams.
Process Experts and other cross-functional teams.  

Key Performance Indicators

* Cash application timeliness and accuracy.
* Unapplied and unidentified cash ageing.
* AMR processing rate.
* Query resolution time and SLA adherence.
* Productivity and quality.
* Control and audit compliance.
Accuracy and completeness of assigned activities.

**Description**

**About Alvarez & Marsal**

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work - guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity - are why our people love working at A&M.

**The Team**

Our Performance Improvement team provides Business Transformation and Performance Improvement Services to Corporates, Investors, and their portfolio companies, delivering –

* Performance improvement via cost reduction and revenue growth programmes

**How you will contribute**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Associate – ERP Implementation / Transformation Readiness to lead finance preparedness activities ahead of an ERP transformation. The role will assess and prepare the Finance organization, processes, data, master data, controls, reporting, and technology landscape for a successful ERP implementation. The role will work closely with Finance leadership, business process owners, ERP implementation teams, IT, data teams, and other functional workstreams to identify readiness gaps, define remediation actions, and establish the foundation required for a successful implementation.

The ideal candidate will have strong FICO functional knowledge, finance transformation experience, business process understanding, and program management capabilities.

  
  

Key Responsibilities

Expertise across one or more of the following areas

  
  

1. FI/CO Implementation Readiness Assessment

* Lead a comprehensive assessment of the organization's readiness for ERP implementation.
* Assess current-state FI/CO processes, organizational structures, master data, transactional data, reporting, controls, integrations, and technology landscape.
* Identify key gaps, dependencies, risks, and prerequisites that need to be addressed before implementation.
* Develop a structured FICO readiness roadmap with priorities, owners, timelines, and remediation actions.
* Assess readiness against SAP/Oracle/MS Dynamics 365 capabilities and recommended leading practices.
  

  

2. Finance Process Readiness

* Assess current finance processes across: General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Bank Accounting, Intercompany Accounting, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Product Costing, Profitability Analysis, Period-end and year-end close and Management reporting
* Identify process standardization opportunities before ERP implementation.
* Identify manual, spreadsheet-driven, highly customized, or non-standard processes that may create implementation risks.
* Define future-state process principles and readiness requirements.
* Assess the organization's ability to adopt SAP standard functionality and minimize unnecessary customizations.
  

  

3. Finance Master Data & Chart of Accounts Readiness

* Assess the quality, consistency, ownership, and governance of key finance master data.
* Lead readiness assessment for: Chart of Accounts, General Ledger accounts, Cost Centers, Profit Centers, Internal Orders, Customers and Vendors, Fixed Assets, Banks and bank accounts
* Evaluate opportunities for master-data rationalization and harmonization.
* Assess alignment of the existing Chart of Accounts with the future ERP design.
* Identify duplicate, obsolete, inactive, or poorly governed master data.
* Define data cleansing and remediation requirements before migration.
  

  

4. Functional Readiness

* Assess the organization's preparedness for key capabilities, including:
* Universal Journal / ACDOCA (in case of S4HANA), New Asset Accounting, Business Partner, Parallel ledgers, Multiple currencies, Profitability Analysis, Fiori-based finance processes, Embedded analytics, Intercompany accounting and Centralized finance processes
* Identify implications of moving from legacy ERP environments to current ERP environments.
* Assess existing customizations and determine which should be retired, redesigned, replaced with standard ERP functionality, or retained.
* Support clean-core readiness assessments.
  

  

5. Data Migration Readiness

* Lead assessment of finance data migration preparedness.
* Define requirements for historical and open-item data migration.
* Assess data quality and reconciliation requirements.
* Establish data ownership and accountability across Finance and IT.
* Define cleansing, transformation, mapping, and validation requirements.
* Establish reconciliation principles between legacy systems and new ERP systems.
* Identify data migration risks and dependencies early in the program.
  

  

6. Integration & Technology Readiness

* Assess FI/CO dependencies and integration points with:
* MM, SD, PP, Asset Management, Treasury, Procurement, Sales, Payroll, Banking platforms, Tax systems and Data warehouses and reporting platforms
* Identify upstream and downstream systems that require remediation or redesign.
* Assess interfaces, data flows, integration dependencies, and reconciliation requirements.
* Coordinate with enterprise architecture and technical teams to address integration readiness.
  

  

7. Reporting & Management Information Readiness

* Assess existing statutory, management, operational, and regulatory reporting requirements.
* Identify reports dependent on legacy ERP structures, custom tables, or manual data manipulation.
* Map critical reports to the future reporting architecture.
* Assess readiness for analytics and enterprise reporting platforms where applicable.
* Define reporting rationalization opportunities and critical reporting requirements for migration.
  

  

8. Controls & Compliance Readiness

* Assess the impact of ERP implementation on finance controls and compliance processes.
* Identify key controls affected by changes to processes, organizational structures, master data, workflows, and system configurations.
* Assess segregation-of-duties implications.
* Ensure critical financial controls are incorporated into the future-state design.
* Support audit, compliance, and control stakeholders in understanding S/4HANA implications.
  

  

9. Stakeholder & Program Leadership

* Act as a key interface for the transformation program.
* Partner with CFO organization, Controllers, Finance process owners, IT, ERP implementation teams, and business leadership.
* Lead workshops to assess readiness and agree remediation priorities.
* Present readiness findings, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Manage cross-functional dependencies and ensure timely resolution of readiness issues.
* Establish governance mechanisms for tracking preparedness activities.
  

  

10. Team Leadership

* Lead a team of finance transformation professionals.
* Define workplans, deliverables, timelines, and responsibilities.
* Review and ensure quality of readiness assessments and recommendations.
* Coach team members on ERP capabilities, finance processes, and consulting methodologies.
* Coordinate activities across FI/CO, data, integration, reporting, controls, and change management teams.

  

**Qualifications**

* 3-8 years of experience in ERP transformation and implementation programs
* Experience conducting ERP implementation readiness, assessment, or transformation planning activities.
* Strong experience with SAP / Oracle Fusion / MS Dynamics
* Strong understanding of end-to-end Finance processes and their ERP enabl

* Develop and execute data extraction, transformation, loading, and validation processes.
* Prepare and execute SQL/PL-SQL scripts for data migration, data conversion, and reconciliation.

* Support SIT, UAT, cutover planning, production deployment, and go-live activities.
* Ensure successful migration execution within project timelines and quality standards.

* Strong hands-on experience in FLEXCUBE migration projects.
* Overall IT/Core Banking experience of 5–15 years.
* Mandatory FLEXCUBE project experience.
* Experience working with FLEXCUBE versions ranging from 11.8 to 14.x.
* Strong proficiency in Oracle SQL and PL/SQL.
* Hands-on experience in data extraction, transformation, loading (ETL), and data conversion.
* Expertise in source-to-target data mapping and migration strategy.
* Experience with Oracle database objects, packages, procedures, functions, and migration scripts.
* Knowledge of SQL\*Loader and data loading utilities.
* Experience in data reconciliation, data validation, and data integrity checks.
* Strong understanding of Core Banking modules such as:
* CASA (Current and Savings Accounts)
* Customer Information / CIF
* Branch Operations
* Teller Operations
* Loans and Lending
* Deposits and Term Deposits
* General Ledger (GL)
* Funds Transfer and Payments
* Understanding of migration testing, mock runs, cutover, and go-live activities.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience migrating legacy banking platforms to FLEXCUBE.
* Experience in FLEXCUBE version migration and upgrades.
* Exposure to multiple Core Banking migration projects.
* Knowledge of Oracle Data Integrator (ODI), Informatica, or other ETL tools.
* Experience with Unix/Linux and Shell Scripting.
* Understanding of banking data models and FLEXCUBE database structures.
* Experience working with international banking clients and cross-functional delivery teams.
* Good analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities.

**Mandatory Eligibility Criteria**

* FLEXCUBE experience is mandatory.
* Candidates must have actual FLEXCUBE migration project experience.
* Experience in at least one complete or substantial migration project is preferred.
* Candidates must be able to explain the source banking system, target FLEXCUBE version, modules migrated, migration approach, and their individual contribution.
* Candidates with only general Oracle database migration or FLEXCUBE production support experience will not be considered.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills are essential.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

We are looking for hands-on FLEXCUBE Migration Professionals who can independently manage migration deliverables, understand complex banking data structures, execute migration activities, and ensure accurate and seamless data transition.

The candidate should demonstrate strong technical expertise, banking domain knowledge, ownership of migration activities, and the ability to collaborate effectively with functional, technical, and client teams.

If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

  

**Role Summary**  
  
The IT Project Manager is a member of the global Agile Delivery & Project Management team within the Digital Services Team (DST) and reports to the Manager, Agile Delivery. The role leads a broad range of technology projects that support Husky's core business functions. These include Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Sales, Service, Finance and HR, as well as enterprise applications, system integrations, infrastructure and business process improvement.

Working closely with the Manager, Agile Delivery, business stakeholders, Steering Committees, technical teams and vendors, the IT Project Manager is responsible for planning, managing and delivering projects that achieve their intended business outcomes. All work is completed in accordance with the DST PMO project management model, governance standards and controlled templates.

**Key Responsibilities/Areas of Accountability**

* Manage multiple concurrent projects end to end, from initiation and charter through stage gates, Go/No-Go, go-live, hypercare and closure.

* Work with sponsors and business stakeholders to define scope, success criteria, deliverables and expected benefits.

* Understand the business processes behind each project, such as order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, plan-to-produce and record-to-report, and make sure solutions support how the business operates.

* Build and maintain integrated project plans that reflect dependencies, critical paths and resource needs. Track progress and re-forecast proactively when conditions change.

* Coordinate project teams across Business, IT, Operations, Engineering and Finance, bringing technical, process and people workstreams together into one coherent plan.

* Help bring unclear or stalled work back on track by clarifying scope, ownership and next steps.

* Manage vendor and partner engagements, including Statements of Work, onboarding, knowledge transfer and deliverable quality.

* Maintain project governance, including RAID registers, decision logs, Project Status Updates and Steering Committee reporting, using the governance profile appropriate to project size and risk.

* Identify and manage risks and issues, and escalate them in a timely way with clear impacts and recommended actions.

* Manage project financials, including budgets, forecasts and variance reporting.

* Engage Architecture, Information Security, Financial Controls/ITGC and Audit/SOX requirements where applicable.

* Coordinate testing, cutover and business readiness activities, and partner with business and change leads on training and communication to support adoption.

* Apply Agile, Waterfall or Hybrid delivery approaches as appropriate to the work.

* Support peers and project team members by sharing experience, and contribute to continuous improvement of PMO practices, templates and lessons learned.

**Qualifications/Requirements**

* Degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Business or a related field.

* 5+ years of IT project management experience with a proven track record of delivering projects on time, on budget and to agreed scope.

* Experience delivering projects across multiple business functions, such as Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Sales, Service and Finance.

* Solid understanding of end-to-end business processes and how enterprise systems support them.

* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with cross-functional stakeholders and vendors, including aligning competing priorities and resolving issues.

* Experience working with global or distributed teams across time zones.

* Experience managing third-party vendors, including SOWs and deliverable management.

* Strong working knowledge of project governance, including stage gates, RAID management, status and Steering Committee reporting, and financial tracking.

* Clear and confident written and verbal communication skills in English.

* Strong planning, organization and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

* Working knowledge of Agile and traditional delivery methodologies.

* Proficiency with tools such as Planview, Azure DevOps, Microsoft Project, Excel and Microsoft 365/Teams.

**Assets**

* Experience delivering ERP projects (for example, BaaN, AX, Dynamics, or Oracle) across modules such as supply chain, procurement, sales, finance or manufacturing.

* Experience with supply chain and operations solutions, such as planning, procurement, inventory, warehouse management, logistics or MES.

* Experience with sales and service solutions, such as CRM, configure-price-quote (CPQ), e-commerce, field service or aftermarket systems.

* Experience with finance solutions and integrations, such as financial close, accounts payable/receivable, banking or tax systems.

* Experience with system integrations, infrastructure or application rollouts across multiple sites or regions.

* Experience applying Audit/SOX and ITGC controls within project delivery.

* Project management certification, such as PMP, PMI-ACP, PRINCE2, CSM/PSM or equivalent.

  
  
  

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

jobs.title: Business Analytics Analyst
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**
----------------

**Overview**:

Citi, the leading global bank, has approximately 200 million customer accounts and does business in more than 160 countries and jurisdictions. Citi provides consumers, corporations, governments and institutions with a broad range of financial products and services, including consumer banking and credit, corporate and investment banking, securities brokerage, transaction services, and wealth management. Our core activities are safeguarding assets, lending money, making payments and accessing the capital markets on behalf of our clients.

Our mission is to serve as a trusted partner to our clients by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress. We strive to earn and maintain our clients and the publics trust by constantly adhering to the highest ethical standards and making a positive impact on the communities we serve. Our Leadership Standards is a common set of skills and expected behaviors that illustrate how our employees should work every day to be successful and strengthens our ability to execute against our strategic priorities.

  
  

**The Quality Assurance and Testing Validation (QATV) team** delivers independent oversight and rigorous validation across the organization's regulatory reporting ecosystem and is dedicated to ensuring the highest standards of accuracy, reliability and control through testing Citi’s regulatory and management reporting while providing an objective assessment of issue remediation.

QATV Reporting & Analytics team provides analytical support on:

Reporting & Intelligence — Building and maintaining data marts, synthesizing test results into quantitative metrics, and authoring detailed qualitative narratives and formal publication reports for senior stakeholders and report owners.

Operational Intelligence & Capacity Planning — Monitor testing sprints to ensure timeline adherence, leading proactive capacity planning across all execution phases, and leveraging skill assessments to assign qualified personnel to appropriate testing stages.

  
  

Testing & Exception Management Automation — Automation of design, creation, and execution of test scripts

  
  

**Job Summary:**

The **Business Analytics****Int Analyst** will be part of QATV team within Citi AIM vertical, a global community driving data-driven transformation across Citi. In this role, the Analyst will support the QATV function by maintaining dedicated testing data marts, consolidating validation outcomes, identifying data inconsistencies, and assisting in the drafting of detailed narrative reports and metrics for final publication to key stakeholders.

Working in close collaboration with team leads, the Analyst will also support testing delivery governance and resource management. This includes monitoring sprint cycles to track milestone adherence, maintaining capacity planning models to ensure balanced workload distribution, and assisting with skills-matrix assessments to align team capabilities with testing demand across all phases of regulatory validation.

**In this role, you are expected to:**

* Assist in organizing and maintaining dedicated testing data marts and data pipelines.
* Extract, validate, and analyze test execution data to calculate key quality and performance metrics.
* Help draft initial narrative summaries, executive dashboards, and documentation for final test result publication.
* Research and identify data inconsistencies, trends, or reporting gaps to support root-cause analysis.
* Track and update sprint milestones, deliverables, and cycle times to ensure on-time testing execution.
* Support team capacity planning by gathering allocation data and tracking utilization across testing stages.
* Assist in maintaining skill inventory matrices to facilitate optimal, competency-based resource assignment.
* Continuously improve processes and strategies by exploring and evaluating new data sources, tools, and capabilities
* Work closely with internal and external business partners in building, implementing, tracking and improving decision strategies
  

  

**Qualifications:**

* Work experience: 5+ years with Masters as Educational background

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and quantify opportunities for improvement.

* Technical Skills: Basic statistical Modeling (Logistic Regression, Decision Tree), SQL, SAS , Python

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

* Banking Knowledge: Good understanding of the banking domain, banking products and Operations in banking is preferred.

* Soft Skills: Ability to multi-task effectively and efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

* undefined
  

  

**Education:**

* Bachelors/University degree or equivalent experience
