jobs.title: AVP - Control Finance
jobs.description:
Date live: 11/19/2026

Business Area: Finance

Area of Expertise: Controls

Contract: Permanent

Reference Code: JR-0000138160

  

Join Barclays as AVP - Control Finance, where core responsibility is to execute design assessment and operating effectiveness testing of controls in accordance with testing plans and aligned to relevant policies, procedures and quality standards providing assurance to Management that the processes and controls within the reviewed Business Unit are effectively designed and operating to mitigating the identified risks. At Barclays, we don't just anticipate the future - we're creating it.

  

To be successful in this role, you should have below skills:

  
  

* Experience in risk management or controls assurance or internal audit.
* Understanding of SOx and Risk Management practices including but not limited to Internal Audit.
* Ability to communicate internal control concepts clearly, in a business context.
* Verbal and written communication skills to deal with internal and external stakeholders. Keeps stakeholders up to date with the progress of the audit work, observation status, etc.
* Understand on Investment banking products and had exposure to Banking & Markets division.
* Understanding of Markets finance functions.
  

  

Some other highly valued skills may include below:

  
  

* Knowledge of internal control and regulatory requirements & practice e.g. Sarbanes-Oxley, COSO, Basel IV regulations.
* Proficient in use of MS Office packages (Outlook, Word, Excel, Power-point).
* Understanding on data analytics skills used in control testing.
  

  

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

  
  

The role is based out of Gurugram.

**Purpose of the role**

To partner with the bank, to provide independent insurance on control processes and advise on improvements to ensure the efficiency and effectiveness of the bank’s internal controls framework.

**Accountabilities**

* Collaboration across the bank to maintain a satisfactory, robust, and efficient control environment through the execution of ad-hoc assessments and testing on the design and operational effectiveness of the internal controls, aligned to control policies and standards.
* Development of detailed test plans and procedures to identify weaknesses in internal controls and other initiatives aligned to the bank’s control framework to mitigate any potential risks and issues, prioritised by its severity to disrupt bank operations, potential losses, and reputational impact.
* Communication of key findings and observations to the relevant stakeholders and business units to improve overall control efficiency and provide corrective actions to senior managers. Collaboration with other control professionals to resolve complex issues and ensure consistent testing methodologies across the bank.
* Development of a knowledge centre containing detailed documentation of control assessments, testing on design and operational effectiveness of procedures, findings, and the distribution of material on internal controls to train and upskill colleagues within the bank.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

jobs.title: Implementation Engineer Islamic Core BankingDubai UAE On-site Hybrid
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
Fimple is a product company building a cloud-native, highly composable and extendible platform. It covers the full platform needs of digital, disruptive and new financial players who need to move fast. Our solution is modern, API-native and built around an ecosystem with strong marketplace support, so financial institutions can grow in a fast-changing market.
  
  
We are looking for an Implementation Engineer to join our Fimple Delivery team in Dubai, UAE. Your main goal will be to set up the Fimple banking platform for the bank and configure it in line with the bank’s needs, first during the implementation and then as the bank’s needs grow after go-live. You will be Fimple’s face to the bank’s business teams: working closely with them to understand their business needs, set up the platform to match their banking products and processes, and help them go live successfully.
  
  
You don’t need to know everything on day one. Working closely with and be supported by Fimple’s core banking experts, and learning our platform and Islamic banking products on the job.
  
  
We are not looking for a traditional core banking implementer. We are looking for agile, open-minded people who are curious to learn and improve, don’t just repeat old methods, and always look for a better, faster way to get things done. You should use AI tools in your daily work and turn complex banking needs into simple, practical solutions.
  
  
**Who You Are**

* Open to innovation: you enjoy new technologies and new ways of working, and you don’t cling to old methods
* AI-savvy: you already use AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) to analyze requirements, write documents, prepare test scenarios, investigate issues and speed up your work
* Solution-oriented: you focus on solving the problem, not on listing obstacles
* Flexible and practical: you adapt quickly when priorities change and look for the simplest solution that works, not the most complicated one
* Ownership mindset: you take responsibility and carry things through to the end
* Fast learner: you pick up new products, domains and tools quickly

**Key Responsibilities**

* Set up the Fimple banking platform for the bank and configure it in line with the bank’s needs, both during the implementation and after go-live
* Act as the day-to-day contact for the bank’s business teams and Fimple’s face to the bank
* Take part in end-to-end core banking implementation projects, from requirement gathering to go-live and post-go-live support
* Run workshops with clients to understand their banking products, business processes and regulatory needs
* Perform gap analysis between client requirements and Fimple platform capabilities, and suggest practical solutions
* Configure and set up banking products and parameters on the platform, such as Islamic financing and deposit products, customer onboarding, limits, fees and charges, and accounting rules
* Use AI-powered tools and automation to speed up analysis, documentation, testing and issue resolution
* Write clear, concise functional documents, including business requirements, functional specifications, configuration workbooks and process flows
* Prepare test scenarios and support SIT and UAT phases with clients
* Work with Fimple’s product, development and QA teams to deliver solutions and handle change requests
* Train client users and create user guides
* Analyze and troubleshoot functional issues during implementation and after go-live
* Suggest improvements to our delivery processes and help build a faster, smarter way of implementing core banking

**Qualifications**

* Fluent English– must
* Arabic – strong plus
* Turkish – plus
* Must be currently living in Dubai, UAE or willing to relocate
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Management Information Systems, Banking, or a related discipline
* 3+ years of experience in banking, in banking operations, core banking, loan, trade finance or treasury implementation functional consulting or business analysis
* Solid knowledge of banking business processes, such as retail and/or corporate banking, deposits, lending, payments, general ledger, accounting, customer lifecycle, Trade Finance and Treasury.
* Understanding of how banking systems work, including products, parameters, end-of-day processes and integrations

jobs.title: Manager, IT Business Analysis (UAE National)
jobs.description:
**Job Purpose:**

The Manager, IT Business Analysis turns business needs into well-defined digital solutions across EDB’s priority programmes. Working with Business, IT and enterprise functions such as Risk, Compliance, Operations, Finance and HR, the role leads business analysis from discovery to Go-Live with a product owner mindset: framing work around customer and business outcomes, crafting end-to-end digital journeys and prioritizing what delivers the most value. It works within EDB’s change-governance standards, reports against agreed metrics and raises risks, issues and blockers early. In line with EDB’s agentic-AI-based delivery model, it uses AI to produce requirements, workflows and indicative UI wireframes, and sets the standard for business analysis across the bank.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities:**

**Business Analysis Responsibilities:**

* Lead business analysis on assigned programmes from discovery to Go-Live: elicit and analyze requirements through workshops and interviews, and produce BRDs, functional specifications, user stories and clear acceptance criteria.
* Work iteratively with the business – draft early, review while gathering requirements, refine to sign-off – and stay engaged through design, build, SIT, UAT and Go-Live rather than handing over at sign-off.
* Map as-is and to-be processes; identify bottlenecks, control gaps and manual effort; and recommend simplification, automation and straight-through processing.
* Maintain end-to-end traceability from business objective to requirement, design, test case and defect; review vendor specifications and test coverage; and support SIT, UAT and business sign-off.
* Work across Business, IT and enterprise functions – Risk, Compliance, Legal, Finance, Operations, HR and Audit – to align requirements and secure timely decisions and sign-offs

**Product Ownership Responsibilities:**

* Bring a product owner mindset to every initiative: frame it around the customer and business outcome, the problem it solves and how its value will be measured.
* Craft end-to-end digital journeys for customers, Relationship Managers and operations teams – mapping today’s pain points and designing target journeys that remove manual steps, handoffs and re-keying.
* Shape scope into MVPs and phased releases, write epics and user stories, and own and prioritise backlogs with business owners on value, risk, regulatory need and effort.
* Define journey success measures such as turnaround time, straight-through-processing rate and adoption, and track them after Go-Live.

**AI-Assisted Delivery Responsibilities:**

* Use EDB-approved AI tools to accelerate the drafting of requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and test scenarios, verifying and owning every output.
* Build AI-assisted workflows, BPMN process flows and indicative UI wireframes that let the business picture the end result early, and iterate them with stakeholders before build.
* Apply responsible-AI practice: approved tools only, data kept within approved boundaries, and human review and sign-off before any AI-drafted content is final.
* Contribute reusable prompts, templates and agent workflows to EDB’s agentic-AI delivery model.

**Governance, Reporting and Risk Responsibilities**

* Adhere to EDB’s change-governance standards – stage gates, change control, approvals and documentation – and apply BA and project management principles consistently across programmes.
* Manage requirement changes, decisions and dependencies through formal change control, and ensure solutions meet regulatory, compliance, risk, control and audit requirements.
* Provide regular, structured status reporting and track delivery and BA metrics – requirements progress, sign-offs, change volumes, defect trends and benefits – for programme leadership.
* Highlight risks, issues and blockers early, before they become serious, with their impact and a recommended mitigation, and escalate them through the right forums.

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Senior Solutions Architect to join our Commercial Sector Enterprise team in the UAE. You will work directly with customers in Financial Services organizations navigating complex digital transformations where the technology strategy is not yet defined and the right path forward requires both technical depth and business judgment.
  
  
This is a builder role. You will go into customer environments, understand their hardest problems, and design solutions that work — from whiteboard architecture through proof of concept to production. You will bring deep expertise across cloud infrastructure, modern application development, data and analytics, and increasingly, generative AI and machine learning. You will earn trust by shipping things that matter, not by presenting slides.
  
  
You will be part of a collaborative, supportive team that values curiosity, ownership, and impact. We learn from each other, develop each other, and build an environment where every voice is heard.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As a Senior Solutions Architect, you will own the technical relationship with customers end-to-end. This means:
  
  

* Partnering with enterprise FSI customers to understand their business objectives, assess their current technology landscape, and architect cloud solutions that deliver real outcomes — in cost optimization, operational efficiency, security, reliability, and innovation.

  

* Building hands-on: prototypes, proofs of concept, reference architectures, and production-ready designs. You lead by doing, not just advising.

  

* Helping customers adopt and build with generative AI and machine learning — identifying high-value use cases, designing architectures for foundation models and intelligent applications, and guiding teams from experimentation to production.

  

* Acting as the customer's technical advocate inside AWS — translating field insights into clear, prioritized feedback that shapes the roadmap for AWS services and features.

  

* Creating and sharing technical content that scales your impact: workshops, blog posts, code samples, reference architectures, and public talks at meetups, user groups, and conferences.

  
  
A day in the life  
No two days look the same. You might spend the morning whiteboarding a solution for a bank's leadership team, then move into a hands-on working session with an insurer's engineering team to design a resilient, low-latency payments or core banking architecture. In the afternoon you might review a colleague's proposal for a regulatory reporting data platform, write a blog post about a security and compliance pattern you found in the field, or join a call with an AWS service team to push for a feature your customer needs. You balance depth with breadth, strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and customer urgency with long-term technical direction.  
  
About the team  
AWS Solutions Architects in MENAT are a tight-knit team of builders and technologists who are passionate about helping customers in one of the world's fastest-growing cloud markets. We work across diverse industries and cultures, which demands adaptability, curiosity, and genuine respect for our customers' contexts. We support each other through knowledge sharing, peer reviews, and a culture of continuous learning. We believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives, and we actively foster an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
* 8+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 8+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 10+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
* Experience working with end user or developer communities
* 10+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

**About VISO TRUST**

VISO TRUST is an AI-powered third-party risk management (TPRM) platform used by more than 100 enterprise customers. Our AI agents collect and analyze vendor security evidence, so customers get fast, accurate risk assessments without questionnaires. Our Managed Services team of security auditors reviews assessments for customers who want expert human review. VISO TRUST is part of Protecht, a global risk management software company.

**About the Role**

You will lead our India-based Managed Services team. You own delivery quality, turnaround, capacity and hiring for a team of auditors and analysts, led through a team manager who reports to you. You are also the senior face of Managed Services to customers, and you work with Sales and Customer Success to grow and retain those accounts.

**What You'll Do**

* Lead and develop the Managed Services team through its manager: set goals, coach, review performance and build the next layer of leaders.
* Own delivery: assessment quality, time in review, auditor productivity and SLA adherence.
* Run capacity planning: forecast assessment volume, plan staffing and flag constraints early.
* Hire: define roles, run hiring and onboard new auditors to our methodology and platform.
* Improve how the work gets done: refine review standards and QA, and partner with Product and Engineering to feed auditor insight into our AI agents and evaluation process.
* Work with customers: lead service reviews, handle escalations and explain our methodology to security and risk teams.
* Support growth: join sales and renewal conversations to scope, price and position Managed Services alongside Sales and Customer Success.
* Report on team performance, utilization and customer outcomes to leadership.

**What You Bring**

* 12+ years in information security, IT audit or third-party risk, including 4+ years managing teams and at least one role leading managers.
* Hands-on knowledge of vendor security assessments: SOC 2 reports, ISO 27001, penetration test reports and security policies.
* Experience delivering for US or global enterprise clients in a managed service, consulting or audit setting. Big Four experience is a plus.
* A track record of capacity planning and hiring for a delivery team.
* Confidence in client-facing conversations, including escalations and commercial discussions.
* Clear, concise written and spoken English.
* Certifications such as CISSP, CISA, CISM, CTPRP or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer are preferred.

**Working Arrangement**

This is a fully remote role on mostly standard India business hours. It also requires a few hours a week in the evening (IST) to overlap with US-based customers and colleagues.

**Why VISO**

* Competitive fixed salary plus performance-based variable pay
* Employment through our global employer partner, with statutory benefits including PF and gratuity
* A fully remote team, with flexibility on evenings when you join US calls
* The chance to shape how AI and human expertise work together in TPRM, inside a growing global risk software company

VISO TRUST is now part of the Protecht Group, a global leader in risk management solutions. Together, we provide a comprehensive platform for managing risk across the enterprise, helping organizations move faster while maintaining strong security and regulatory standards.

jobs.title: SENIOR DIRECTOR, AI SERVICE LINE
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

**The Opportunity**

The Data and Analytics services industry is undergoing its most consequential transformation in two decades — and this role sits at the epicentre of it. At Saama Technologies, we are not retrofitting AI into an existing delivery organisation. We are building an entirely new category of delivery capability, one where AI agents, LLMs, and autonomous workflows are not accelerators bolted onto existing processes, but first-class components of how we architect, deliver, and govern client engagements.

**Your Mandate**

You will build and lead Saama's most strategically critical delivery capability — a purpose-built team for AI-native client engagements where specification replaces code as the primary unit of human effort, and AI agents orchestrate delivery end to end. In parallel, you will serve as the organisation's foremost internal change agent, progressively uplifting existing delivery teams to adopt AI-augmented ways of working, and anchoring technology governance through an Architecture Review Board with organisation-wide authority.

**Key Accountabilities**

* You will
  **own end-to-end technical delivery for the organisation's AI-native client engagements**
  — a first-principles capability built for greenfield mandates where traditional software delivery models no longer apply. You will be taking full ownership of end-to-end technical delivery, estimation, AI-specific quality assurance, model evaluation, and technology risk management within each engagement.
* You will
  **define, enforce, and continuously evolve the delivery standards, assets and accelerators choices, and quality gates that govern AI-native engagements**
  . This includes establishing a specification-centric development methodology and translating it into a repeatable, practice that the broader organisation can adopt at scale.
* You will
  **ensure every AI-native engagement is architected not only for current client outcomes but for long-term extensibility**
  — specifically, designing solutions that can subsequently be integrated into the organisation's broader delivery portfolio and replicated across accounts.
* You will
  **lead the progressive AI enablement of existing delivery teams across the organisation**
  — embedding AI coding tools, intelligent automation, and prompt engineering practices into data engineering workflows previously built on conventional, human-led approaches. You will co-lead the transition from time-and-materials commercial models to outcomes-based constructs in partnership with Business Unit leads, and will track productivity uplift and AI maturity systematically across accounts.
* You will be
  **part of the organisation's Architecture Review Board**
  — a mandatory governance gate for all AI-embedded client projects — conduct periodic technology risk audits across the active delivery portfolio, define and maintain AI standards and responsible AI guardrails, and serve as the final escalation authority for AI technical decisions across all Business Units.
* You will
  **represent Saama in client-facing engagements**
  — leading technical solutioning discussions, delivery consulting, and value proposition conversations directly with client stakeholders. You will bring credibility and depth to conversations on technology risk, architecture trade-offs, and AI adoption strategy, serving as a trusted advisor to clients across active and prospective engagements.
* You will
  **build the AI Service Line’s delivery capability on two tracks**
  — targeted external hiring to bring in specialised AI engineering and architecture talent, and a structured internal programme for upskilling and cross-skilling existing associates into AI-native delivery roles. You will own the capability roadmap that ensures the team’s depth and breadth keeps pace with the demands of the engagement portfolio.

**What You Bring**

* 20+ years of progressive experience in Data, Analytics, and AI delivery within an IT services context, with at least four years in a Senior Director or equivalent leadership role accountable for delivery quality, team performance, and client outcomes.
* Demonstrated hands-on expertise in AI engineering and architecture — including LLM integration, agentic workflow design, RAG pipeline development, and evaluation frameworks for generative AI systems — and the ability to lead senior engineers in applying these within live client engagements.
* A proven track record of building net-new delivery capabilities from the ground up, including team formation, methodology design, and commercial model evolution — not merely inheriting and optimising established practice.
* Experience leading or co-leading commercial model transitions — from time-and-materials to outcomes-based constructs — in partnership with business development, presales, and client governance functions.
* Familiarity with cloud-native AI delivery on platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, and AWS, including native AI tooling and its application in enterprise Data and Analytics engagements.

You will be the technical lead on Solace opportunities across Indian government bodies, public sector undertakings and the country's largest enterprises, working with Account Executives, system integrators and channel partners.

  

**What You’ll Do**

Be a trusted advisor, not just a demonstrator

* Partner with Account Executives to qualify opportunities, shape account strategies and drive deals to closure.
* Educate customers on event-driven architecture (EDA) and agentic AI, and challenge them to think bigger about their real-time data and AI strategy.
* Guide customers on integration patterns and modernization strategies, including the convergence of EDA and multi-agent AI systems.

  

Build champions and relationships

* Build deep relationships with technical and business stakeholders, from enterprise architects and CTOs to CIOs, department heads and programme officers, and turn users into advocates.
* Run on-site visits, regular check-ins and discovery sessions to stay aligned with evolving needs.
* Translate the Solace platform, from Event Broker to Agent Mesh, into outcomes customers care about.

  

Own technical validation and proof of value

* Lead demonstrations, Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Proofs of Value (PoVs) that map to customer objectives, including tender-mandated PoCs and bid-stage technical presentations.
* Own the evaluation process, guiding prospects through workshops, hands-on trials and technical validation.

  

Government and public sector engagement

Serve as the technical lead for Solace opportunities across central and state government departments, public sector undertakings (PSUs), regulators, defense and strategic establishments, smart-city programmes and government-owned platforms, typically alongside system integrators and channel partners.

* Translate programme requirements into validated event-driven and agentic AI solutions for use cases such as citizen and agency services, transport and aviation operations, logistics and sustainment, command-and-control style situational awareness, and real-time data exchange between departments.
* Position Solace Event Brokers, Event Mesh and Agent Mesh for on-premises, private-cloud and air-gapped deployments, including constrained or intermittently connected sites, and for hybrid deployments across state data centers and Indian cloud regions.
* Speak credibly to Indian security, data and compliance expectations, including MeitY cloud empanelment and GI Cloud (MeghRaj) hosting, the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, CERT-In directions, and sector rules such as RBI and SEBI requirements where public sector banks and market infrastructure are involved.
* Support government acquisition motions: respond to RFPs, RFIs and Expressions of Interest, write technical bid volumes and compliance matrices, handle pre-bid queries and corrigenda, and work within tender portals, GeM, GFR procurement norms and L1 and QCBS evaluation models.
* Understand Make in India public procurement preferences and local-content requirements, and help partners position Solace within them.
* Enable system integrators, OEM partners and channel partners (for example, national and global SIs with large public sector practices) so they can qualify, architect and deliver Solace-based solutions to government customers.
* Align Solace with national modernization priorities such as Digital India, data-centric and interoperable platforms, open standards, and responsible AI adoption.

  

Large enterprise engagement

Lead technical engagements with India's largest enterprises, where scale, resilience and regulatory pressure make real-time event infrastructure a board-level topic.

* **Banking, financial services and insurance (BFSI):** real-time payments and transaction flows, market data distribution, core banking modernization, fraud and risk signals, and AI agents for operations and customer service, within RBI, SEBI and IRDAI expectations on resilience, outsourcing and data localization.
* **Telecom and digital platforms:** real-time provisioning, recharge and balance events, customer 360 and channel modernization at very high volumes.
* **Aviation and transport:** airport and airline operations, flight and baggage events, and partner data exchange across heavily siloed ecosystems.
* **Manufacturing and energy:** plant-to-cloud event meshes, IoT and MQTT connectivity, supply chain visibility and Industry 4.0 programmes.
* **Logistics and retail:** shipment and fleet tracking, order orchestration and omnichannel inventory events.
* Help enterprises evolve beyond batch and request/response integration, and move from legacy middleware (IBM MQ, TIBCO, ESBs) towards a distributed, event-driven enterprise that can support real-time AI.
* Work with global system integrators and consulting partners that run large Indian enterprise transformation programmes.

  

Evangelise event-driven architecture

* Show deep command of core EDA concepts and patterns: publish/subscribe, event sourcing, CQRS, event streaming, and choreography versus orchestration, applied to real Indian enterprise and government architectures.
* Articulate the business value of EDA to executive and technical audiences: faster time-to-insight, operational resilience, accelerated digital transformation, and the ability to scale AI applications on a live data fabric.
* Position Solace Event Brokers against Apache Kafka, IBM MQ, RabbitMQ, TIBCO and cloud-native brokers, and against locally hosted open-source deployments that customers often start with. Be ready to explain where multi-protocol support, hybrid and multi-cloud event mesh, enterprise-grade QoS and dynamic topic routing create clear differentiation, and to defend total cost of ownership in L1-driven evaluations.
* Guide customers through an EDA maturity model, from point-to-point integration and basic messaging to a distributed, event-driven enterprise ready for real-time AI and autonomous systems.

  

Solace Agent Mesh subject matter expert

* Position Solace Agent Mesh Enterprise as the production-grade foundation for agentic AI, bridging event-driven infrastructure with LLM orchestration and multi-agent workflows.
* Show how Agent Mesh extends an existing Solace Event Mesh investment into agentic AI and shortens time-to-production for AI initiatives.
* Explain horizontal scalability, fault-tolerant asynchronous messaging and governance to technical teams and executives, including how agents can run with models and data kept inside the customer's own or sovereign environment.

* Serve as the field voice for Agent Mesh adoption in India, feeding real use cases and objections back to Product and GTM teams.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist, Applied AI
jobs.description:
**The role**
------------

You own a set of enterprise accounts once they go live, and your job is to grow them. That means making sure delivery lands, the client sees results in their own numbers, and each account has a clear plan for what we do next with them.

You work with the client's business leaders on one side and our forward deployed engineers (FDEs) on the other. You run discovery with the client, turn their business logic into a call flow, and hand the FDE a clear spec for the workflow. When the FDE is deep in a complex build, you write the agent prompt yourself.

This is not a sales role. You grow accounts by delivering value the client can measure, and by spotting where else in their business we can do the same.

 **Requirements**  

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Run discovery. Understand the use case and the client's process, find the real pain point, and agree the north star metric with the client so everyone knows what outcome the agent has to deliver.
* Design the call flow. Translate business logic into a call flow and conversation design, then brief the FDE on the workflow to build.
* Build agents. Write and iterate production prompts, especially when the FDE is busy on a complex workflow.
* Do RCA. When results dip, listen to the conversations, work out why they failed (prompt, data, flow or telephony) and drive the fix.
* Own the client relationship. Be the person the client calls first. Run governance calls, reviews and escalations, and build trust with stakeholders from operations teams up to business heads.
* Make delivery happen. Plan and run the project with the FDEs: scope, timelines, dependencies on the client's tech and data teams, go-lives. Unblock things before they slip.
* Run on numbers. Own the account's metrics (connect rate, conversion, collections, cost per outcome). Build the analysis, explain what moved and why, and turn it into the next change to the agent.
* Build the account roadmap. For every account, write a strategic plan for expansion: new use cases, new teams, more volume. Size each one, build the business case and take it to the client.
* Sell through value. Pitch upsell and cross-sell with evidence from your own account's results, working with sales and leadership on commercials.
* Test and improve. Run A/B tests on agents, prompts and voices, and read them out.

**Who we're looking for**
-------------------------

Two backgrounds have worked best for this role:

* A growth product manager, ideally with about 2 years of consulting before moving into product, or
* A consultant with 3 to 4 years at a top-tier consulting firm.

Either way, you have:

* Strong client handling. You're comfortable in a room with senior stakeholders and can manage difficult conversations.
* Sharp analytics. You can pull and work the data yourself (SQL, spreadsheets) and turn it into a recommendation.
* Project management discipline across several workstreams and people you don't manage.
* Commercial instinct: you can see where an account can grow and make the case for it.
* Clear, short writing.
* Prompt engineering experience. We don't mean using ChatGPT or Claude day to day; we mean you have built agents that carry out a specific task and have run at scale with real users.
* Conversation design sense. You can read a transcript, see where it went wrong, and fix the flow or the prompt.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience at a voice or conversational AI company, or deploying AI for enterprise clients.
* BFSI background: lending, collections or insurance operations.
* Working proficiency in Hindi or a South Indian language.

  
**Benefits**  

* You own real revenue accounts from day one and work directly with the partner who runs them.
* You'll learn what makes AI agents work in production at scale.
* There's a clear path to running a portfolio of accounts as the team grows.

Enterprise transition strategy, deal shaping, mobilization assurance and transition innovation

India GDS Location
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Executive Director - Managed Services Transition Principal is a senior individual contributor accountable for defining, shaping and assuring the most complex and strategically significant Finance Managed Services transitions across Finance Managed Services. The role operates as EY’s authoritative transition specialist on major pursuits and mobilizations, providing independent judgement, deep subject-matter expertise and executive-level client counsel from RFP strategy through stable operations.
  
  
The role does not rely on formal line-management authority. Its Executive Director scope is created through enterprise-wide influence, ownership of high-value and high-risk transition outcomes, direct engagement with C-suite and Partner stakeholders, and stewardship of EY transition methods, intellectual property and digitally enabled practices. The incumbent personally intervenes at critical points, resolves ambiguity across commercial, operational, technology and people dimensions, and sets the standard for transition quality across portfolios and geographies.
  
  
**Role Scope and Impact**

* Provide domain authority across Record to Report, Procure to Pay, Order to Cash, Financial Planning and Analysis, tax, treasury and controllership transitions, adapting the scope to the services included in each client solution.
* Ensure transition designs protect financial control, statutory and regulatory obligations, close and reporting timetables, cash flow, working capital and business continuity.
* Provide transition leadership for the largest, most complex and highest-risk Finance Managed Services opportunities, including deals with multi-tower, multi-country, regulated, carve-out, transformation or accelerated-mobilization characteristics.
* Own the integrity of transition solutions and mobilization outcomes for assigned strategic deals, acting as the single senior subject-matter authority rather than as a people leader.
* Shape pursuits with Service Line Leads, Finance Managed Services Deal Leads, solution architects, commercial teams and delivery executives, translating client requirements into differentiated, executable and commercially viable transition strategies.
* Exercise enterprise-level influence across EY member firms, regions, service lines and third parties to secure alignment where priorities, risk appetites, contractual commitments or delivery models conflict.
* Create reusable transition assets, reference architectures, control frameworks, benchmarks and AI-enabled techniques that improve quality, speed, predictability and margin across the wider Finance Managed Services business.
* Represent EY’s transition proposition with senior client executives during orals, negotiations, governance forums and critical mobilization decisions.

* Strategic deal shaping and client leadership

+ Translate the client finance strategy, target operating model and retained-finance responsibilities into an executable transition solution, including service boundaries, controls, data, systems, governance and acceptance criteria.
+ Engage credibly with CFOs, Finance Directors, Controllers and process owners on financial close, reporting, compliance, working capital and service-performance outcomes.
+ Develop compelling transition strategies for complex RFPs, sole-source opportunities and strategic renewals, integrating finance organization, process, policy, controls, data, technology, service management, tax, treasury and commercial considerations.
+ Lead the transition narrative in client orals and executive workshops, using evidence-based storytelling to demonstrate value, manage concerns and establish confidence in EY’s ability to mobilize safely.
+ Advise client C-suite and senior EY leaders on transition feasibility, sequencing, risk exposure, investment choices and trade-offs, particularly where requirements are incomplete or competing objectives cannot all be achieved.
+ Challenge deal assumptions and contractual commitments where transition risk, dependency, cost or timing is not adequately understood.

* Transition solution design & execution assurance

+ Architect transition waves that account for period-end and year-end close, statutory reporting, audit dependencies, tax calendars, treasury cut-offs and business-critical finance cycles.
+ Assure the design and operation of financial controls, segregation of duties, data reconciliation, opening balances, knowledge transfer, service acceptance and retained-organisation readiness.
+ Architect end-to-end transition approaches for highly interdependent finance process towers, retained organisations, delivery locations and geographies, defining critical paths, entry and exit criteria, governance, control points, dependencies and operational acceptance requirements.
+ Provide independent assurance across mobilization, identifying systemic risks early and directing corrective action through accountable delivery owners without assuming permanent line-management responsibility.
+ Act as the senior escalation point for transition issues with material client, regulatory, financial, reputational or service-continuity implications.
+ Confirm that transitions achieve safe landing into steady-state operations, with clear ownership, measurable readiness and no unmanaged residual risk.

* Functional authority and innovation

+ Own and evolve selected elements of EY’s Finance Managed Services transition methodology, playbooks, quality standards and governance principles.
+ Develop industry-leading transition techniques using AI, automation, data-led assurance and digital collaboration tools.
+ Convert experience from strategic deals into reusable intellectual property, patterns, benchmarks and lessons that can be adopted across portfolios.
+ Provide expert coaching and technical direction to deal and transition practitioners through communities of practice, design reviews and targeted interventions, without direct supervisory accountability.
+ Build external market credibility through client forums, thought leadership, alliance activity and selected industry engagement.

* Analytical and Decision-Making Responsibilities

+ Evaluate finance-specific trade-offs involving control effectiveness, close stability, reporting accuracy, working-capital impact, service cost, standardisation and regulatory exposure.
+ Determine whether process, data and control readiness is sufficient to proceed with migration, parallel run, cutover and operational acceptance.
+ Solve novel, ambiguous and enterprise-scale transition problems for which established precedents may not exist.
+ Make or recommend high-consequence decisions on transition design, sequencing, risk treatment, governance and readiness within delegated authority.
+ Evaluate complex commercial and delivery trade-offs, including speed versus control, standardization versus client specificity, investment versus risk, and short-term mobilization needs versus long-term service sustainability.

You will work with client stakeholders, lead teams, and help deliver implementation-driven solutions in a complex global tax environment.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Manager, Tax Services on the Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Business Development: Develop and maintain contact with top decision makers at key clients; organize and lead pursuit teams; participate and lead aspects of the proposal development process; contribute to the development of proposal pricing strategies.
* Client Management: Manage the day-to-day interactions with executive clients and sponsors.
* Engagement Management: Lead engagement planning and budgeting; mobilize and manage engagement teams; define deliverable structure and content; facilitate buy-in of proposed solutions from top management levels at the client; direct on-time, quality delivery of work products; manage engagement economics; and manage engagement risk.
* Practice Development & Eminence: Develop practical solutions and methodologies; develop "thought-ware" and "point-of-view" documents; participate in public speaking events; get published in industry periodicals.
* People Development: Perform role of counselor and coach; provide input and guidance into the staffing process; actively participate in staff recruitment and retention activities; provide leadership and support for delivery teams and staff in local offices.

**The team**
Deloitte’s Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) group helps our clients’ tax departments improve their operations by developing new technology-enabled, cutting-edge methods and processes. Deloitte TTC professionals are aligned across our global network of member firms to address our clients’ objectives in a seamless fashion. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who help connect our clients’ global strategies and the options that exist to turn theory into an executable plan.
  
  
TTC’s Enterprise Tax Integration (ETI) professionals provide an integrated approach to process improvement that can help the tax department maximize its strategic value to the organization. Companies that have already implemented or are considering implementing an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system often overlook the tax benefits these systems can provide or underestimate the impact on the tax department. To be most effective from a tax perspective, a successful ERP implementation requires professionals who specialize in tax and can effectively address a corporate tax function’s unique needs, requirements, and obligations. Our ETI team, the largest of its type, offers the necessary combination of skills, methodology and practical experience to help clients avoid the pitfalls of an ERP implementation.
  
  
Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) - Ever expanding regulations and increasing scrutiny on multinational corporations has made it necessary for leading-edge tax departments to serve a critical role in the risk management and overall performance of the enterprise. This has resulted in an opportunity for Deloitte to provide even greater value through our tax services, in helping develop tax departments of the future that are strategic, agile, and, above all, focused on creating value for the business.
  
  
Deloitte's TTC group helps our clients’ tax department move forward from their current state to the next generation of tax functions and is dedicated to finding new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations. Deloitte Tax LLP professionals are aligned worldwide to serve our clients’ needs through the TTC group. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co-sourcing specialists who can help make the necessary connections between our clients’ global strategies and the many options for carrying them out in the tax function.

jobs.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS – RCT**
**Manager – Data, Cloud & AI Engineering**
**Manager – Technology Consulting**
**Experience: Strictly 8+ years**
**Mandatory eligibility:**
Candidates must have 8 or more years of relevant professional experience, including hands-on Python, advanced SQL, cloud, AI, and Financial Crime Compliance domain experience. Candidates below 8 years or without any mandatory capability are not eligible.
  
  
**The opportunity**
Lead the delivery of data, cloud, and AI-enabled Financial Crime solutions for global financial services clients. This Manager role combines technical depth with delivery leadership, stakeholder management, team development, and end-to-end ownership. The successful candidate will shape solutions across KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud while remaining close enough to the technology to guide architecture, review critical designs, resolve delivery risks, and assure quality.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced Manager with strong Python and advanced SQL capability, practical cloud and AI delivery experience, and broad Financial Crime Compliance knowledge. The role owns outcomes from discovery and estimation through design, build, testing, deployment, transition, and production stabilization. It also includes team leadership, work planning, governance, financial oversight, client communication, and development of reusable assets and delivery standards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of Financial Crime technology workstreams, programs, or managed-service outcomes.
* Own solution scope, delivery plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, issues, quality, resource needs, and stakeholder commitments.
* Provide technical direction for Python applications, advanced SQL solutions, cloud architecture, data pipelines, APIs, analytics, and AI components.
* Translate KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud requirements into scalable technical solutions and delivery roadmaps.
* Partner with compliance SMEs, product owners, architects, engineering teams, data teams, model-risk stakeholders, QA, infrastructure, and operations.
* Lead design reviews, code and SQL quality reviews, architecture decisions, defect triage, performance tuning, release readiness, and production stabilization.
* Ensure appropriate security, privacy, auditability, explainability, data lineage, model governance, monitoring, and regulatory-control considerations.
* Drive automation, reusable components, engineering standards, knowledge assets, and continuous improvement across the delivery lifecycle.
* Prepare and present status, decisions, risks, dependencies, and recovery plans to senior client and internal stakeholders.
* Support proposals, solutioning, effort estimation, staffing, capability development, and account growth activities.

**Deliverable ownership**

* Accountable for agreed deliverables, acceptance criteria, delivery schedule, quality, and business outcomes across assigned workstreams.
* Build and maintain integrated delivery plans covering requirements, design, data readiness, engineering, testing, deployment, transition, and support.
* Establish governance routines, delivery metrics, RAID management, change control, escalation paths, and executive reporting.
* Validate estimates, capacity, sequencing, dependencies, and release scope; act early on slippage, quality gaps, or unresolved decisions.
* Ensure traceability from business and compliance requirements to technical design, test evidence, deployment artefacts, and operational handover.
* Coordinate cross-team dependencies and secure timely sign-offs from business, compliance, technology, model-risk, security, and operations stakeholders.
* Own defect closure, production-readiness checks, go-live decisions, warranty support, and lessons learned for assigned deliveries.

**Team management and leadership**

* Lead multidisciplinary teams of software engineers, data engineers, analysts, QA professionals, and domain specialists.
* Define team structure, roles, goals, operating model, work allocation, and individual accountability for delivery outcomes.
* Provide regular coaching, technical mentoring, feedback, recognition, and career-development support.
* Monitor capacity, utilization, skills coverage, onboarding, knowledge transfer, succession needs, and delivery continuity.
* Foster a collaborative, inclusive, quality-focused environment with clear standards for ownership and communication.
* Resolve delivery conflicts, remove blockers, manage escalations, and support sound decisions under competing priorities.
* Identify capability gaps and create targeted upskilling plans across Python, SQL, cloud, AI, and Financial Crime domain knowledge.

**Mandatory Technical Skills**

* Python: Strong hands-on experience designing and reviewing production-grade Python solutions, including object-oriented design, data processing, APIs, testing, logging, exception handling, security, and performance optimization.
* Advanced SQL: Expert-level capability in complex joins, common table expressions, window functions, stored procedures, query optimization, large-volume analysis, reconciliation, data profiling, and investigation queries.
* Cloud: Mandatory delivery experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS, or GCP, covering solution design, deployment, data services, security, monitoring, integration, scalability, and operational support.
* AI: Mandatory practical experience delivering AI or machine-learning capabilities, including generative AI or predictive analytics, model or prompt evaluation, API integration, responsible AI controls, security, explainability, and production monitoring.
* Engineering leadership: Ability to guide architecture, review code and designs, define standards, oversee CI/CD, manage non-functional requirements, and resolve complex technical issues.
* Data and integration: Experience with data pipelines, APIs, batch processing, data quality, lineage, metadata, and integration across enterprise platforms.

**Mandatory Financial Crime domain knowledge (2 or more mandatory)**

* KYC / CDD / EDD: Customer onboarding, identity and document checks, customer risk rating, beneficial ownership, periodic review, remediation, and enhanced due diligence.
* AML: Financial crime risk indicators and typologies, alert and case workflows, investigations, escalation, regulatory reporting concepts, and control effectiveness.
* Transaction Monitoring (TM): Scenario and rule logic, thresholds, segmentation, alert generation, tuning, back-testing, false-positive reduction, and data-quality controls.
* Sanctions: Customer and payment screening, watchlists, potential-match handling, disposition workflows, screening effectiveness, and data quality.
* Fraud: Fraud indicators, transaction and event analysis, rules or models, alert prioritization, investigation workflows, case outcomes, and prevention controls.

**AI leadership expectations**

* Identify and prioritize AI use cases for alert triage, investigation support, entity resolution, anomaly detection, document analysis, quality assurance, and engineering productivity.
* Ensure human oversight, explainability, privacy, security, bias assessment, auditability, model-risk alignment, and appropriate use of regulated data.
* Define measurable acceptance criteria and monitoring for accuracy, grounding, latency, reliability, operational risk, and business value.
* Use AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly for code, testing, documentation, and analysis while maintaining review and security controls.

*Founded in 2000, Ivalua is a leading global provider of cloud-based procurement solutions.*
**Company Overview**
At Ivalua we are a global community of exceptional professionals, who believe that digital transformation revolutionises supply chain sustainability and resiliency to unlock the power of supplier collaboration.
  
  
We achieve this through our leading cloud-based spend management platform that empowers hundreds of the world's most admired brands to effectively manage all categories of spend and all suppliers to increase profitability, improve ESG (environmental, social, and corporate governance) performance, lower risk, and improve productivity. Driven by our passions and fueled by our shared ambitions, we empower and challenge each other to create meaningful experiences for our colleagues, customers, partners, and communities.
  
  
Learn more at www.ivalua.com. Follow us on LinkedIn.

As we continue to grow across EMEA, North America, and APAC, we’re building a Value Engineering (VE) team that partners directly with senior executives to quantify and articulate the business value of digital procurement transformation. The Ivalua Value Engineering (VE) team is a highly strategic, executive-facing unit that partners directly with senior leaders (like CPOs, CFOs, and CIOs) at large global enterprises. They bridge the gap between technology and finance, helping prospective and existing customers quantify and track the hard business impact of digital procurement transformations.

You’ll work directly with senior executive stakeholders to model ROI, build transformation roadmaps, and guide executive decisions throughout the buying and adoption journey.

Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated manager to join our dynamic Control & Compliance team. The ideal candidate will bring technical expertise in risk management, internal control assessment and implementation of internal control framework. In this role, you will lead the delivery of high-quality outcomes across a portfolio of clients in the internal audit and internal controls space. You will manage multiple engagement teams and stakeholders, both internally and externally, taking full ownership of projects and relationships. Your focus will be on delivering impactful results, on time, within budget and in line with EY’s quality and risk management practices. Key responsibilities include:
  
  

* Client Delivery and Project Management: Lead and manage multiple client engagements. Oversee planning, fieldwork and reporting of findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders. Ensuring high-quality deliverables, on time within budget.
* Technical Expertise: Act as a key trusted advisor in discussing complex regulations with clients, including UK Corporate Reform, US Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance, Global Internal Audit Standards and other industry-specific regulatory compliance requirements.
* Quality and Risk Management: Ensure compliance with EY’s quality and risk management processes across client acceptance, contracting and engagement delivery. Proactively identify and manage risks across engagements, escalating issues where appropriate.
* Stakeholder Management: Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders and proactively manage client expectations to ensure alignment on project goals, timelines and deliverables. Collaborate cross-functionally with other EY service lines and subject matter experts to deliver high quality insights. Collaborate with internal leader/s, provide regular updates on engagement progress and support internal decision-making through clear communication and proactive escalation and the ability to flex communication styles.
* Team Leadership and Development: Mentor and coach junior team members through effective supervision to develop their technical and professional skills. Support career development through performance reviews and providing timely, regular and actionable feedback. You will contribute to a positive team environment by demonstrating consistent commitment and optimism toward work challenges.
* Business Development: Build the EY brand through high quality delivery. Support in the identification of new opportunities and development of proposals. Build EY’s market presence through contribution to thought leadership and client events.
* Promoting EY’s values: Champion EY’s commitments to integrity, respect and teaming in all client and internal interactions. Foster an inclusive and diverse working environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.
* Practice development: contribute to practice development and internal initiatives such as learning and development programmes and solution development.

**Skills And Experience**
You will be a trusted manager with proven technical expertise in risk, control and compliance that will complement our teams in delivering high-quality solutions to our clients. Your skills and experience will include:
  
  

* Control & Compliance experience: Proven and relevant professional experience across core process and controls solutions (e.g. internal audit, SOX and internal controls) in consulting, government or industry. Extensive experience in process mapping, walkthroughs, risk analysis (strategic, financial, operational and compliance) and control identification and design assessment. The ability to act as a trusted advisor to clients on risk and control issues, such as controls remediation or Enterprise Risk Management.
* Technical skills and knowledge: In depth understanding of core business processes, associated risks, and leading practice controls. Strong leadership and communication skills, technical knowledge, and the ability to write at a publication quality level in order to communicate findings and recommendations to clients. Strong business acumen, including the ability to compile information quickly and accurately, and to test data and assumptions for informed decision-making.
* Engagement management: Track record demonstrating success in leading high-performing teams, mentor junior staff and foster a culture of continuous learning. Experienced in managing complex project and multiple stakeholder groups including senior clients and internal leadership. Demonstrated ability to balance project management and delivery skills across a range of clients, including financial management, quality, and risk management requirements.
* Communication and interpersonal skills: Strong communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence and build trust at all levels. Being an active listener, having self-awareness when dealing with others, and adapting your own approach to differences in individual style and backgrounds, recognising the risk of unconscious biases.
* Client delivery: Demonstrated success in delivering high-quality, client-focused solutions on time and within budget with a commitment to going above and beyond for clients.
* Commercial acumen: Commercially aware, with a track record of developing relevant propositions and sales collateral and supporting business development efforts.

jobs.title: Lead Architect/ Senior Associate Director
jobs.description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.
  
  
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Sr. Associate Director, Solution Architecture
  
  
Ready to set the architecture direction for HSBC’s CTO Platforms domain?
  
  
Why HSBC
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
Join CTO Platforms to shape the architectural direction for a value stream or domain within a large regulated bank. This role sets target and transition architectures and keeps delivery aligned to reference architectures, standards and guardrails. You’ll represent architecture in governance and Design Authority forums, presenting options and trade-offs and helping decisions land clearly. The role also focuses on cross-programme dependencies and early risk identification so delivery stays coherent across teams. You’ll influence strategic initiatives including Compass and the AI/GenAI agenda by promoting shared platforms and governed capabilities. Success looks like simpler, reusable and well-controlled technology outcomes that engineering teams can deliver with clarity and pace.
  
  
What you'll be doing
  
  

* Set architectural direction for an assigned value stream or domain aligned to target architecture, reference architectures, standards and guardrails
* Produce and maintain target and transition architectures with clear sequencing, dependencies, decision points and interim guardrails
* Represent architecture in governance and Design Authority forums, presenting options, trade-offs, recommendations and exception impacts
* Identify and manage cross-programme architectural dependencies, risks and constraints and escalate early to support timely decisions
* Embed alignment to Group architecture strategy and standards including Build vs Buy, reuse, simplification and control-by-design
* Shape architectural direction for strategic R&C initiatives including Compass and the AI/GenAI agenda to converge on shared platforms and governed capabilities
* Translate architectural direction into solution designs with engineering teams using patterns, non-functional requirements and guardrails to maintain delivery alignment
* Strengthen solution architecture capability across engineering through coaching, quality reviews and communities of practice

What we're looking for
  
  

* Bring extensive experience as a solution, domain or enterprise architect in a large complex and regulated organisation
* Demonstrate defining target-state architectures and translating them into transition states, roadmaps and decision frameworks
* Show strong experience reviewing solution designs and articulating options, trade-offs and recommendations based on evidence and standards
* Apply broad understanding of modern application, integration, data and cloud architectures including APIs, event-driven patterns, microservices, CI/CD and operational non-functional requirements
* Embed security, resilience, privacy, records management and auditability requirements into designs and delivery workflows
* Apply Build vs Buy, reuse, simplification and technology rationalisation including assessing Low-Code/No-Code and third-party options
* Use working knowledge of AI and GenAI architecture including responsible adoption, platform integration, data and knowledge foundations, governance, monitoring and evidence
* Operate effectively in senior governance forums and across geographically distributed teams with clear stakeholder management and influencing
* Communicate complex technology choices clearly through concise architecture artefacts for business and technology audiences

Building coherent platforms at scale
  
  
If you want to shape how platforms evolve across a complex environment this role offers the scope to make a visible difference. You’ll help teams converge on shared architectures that are easier to deliver, operate and govern. You’ll bring clarity to decisions that cut across programmes and turn architectural intent into practical delivery guardrails. If this aligns with the work you want to do next we’d welcome your application.
  
  
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
  
  
www.hsbc.com/careers
  
  
HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

jobs.title: Manager, Tax Process Strategy & Solutions
jobs.description:
The Tax Process Strategy & Solutions Manager supports process leads and the Tax Practice to understand how one or more product(s) fit into the overall “vision” for one or more business area(s). The goal of this role is to drive long-term scalability and sustainability of the business for a competitive advantage. To execute their area of responsibility, this role collaborates with staff, the tax practice, product teams, IT, other functional areas within the broader RSM firm, and field offices to ensure we achieve the vision cohesively and effectively.

You will play a key role in the build-out and continued improvement and stewardship of our process and technology for US individual and trust/estate taxation.

The ideal candidate will be a self-directed problem solver with an ownership mindset and will have: (a) extensive experience independently preparing and reviewing complex Form 1040 and 1041 tax returns, as well as having handled and advised on diverse issues and complexities (federal, state and foreign) arising from ownership of complex flowthrough (partnership, S-Corporation) operating businesses, real estate entities, fund of funds, hedge funds and private equity; and (b) played a key hand in technology, tax research, process improvement or workpaper standardization initiatives: whether at the practice, region or market level, or within the context of one or more large or complex engagements.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES**

* Collaborates with process leads and Tax practice SMEs to understand how products fit into the overall "vision" for one or more business area(s).
* Acts as primary internal functional process owner/SME for how assigned third party or custom developed solutions are used in tax engagement team processes, maintaining expertise on products through their lifecycle, developing an in depth understanding of user experience and needs by partnering with tax professionals.
* Works with process leads, Change Management, and practice leaders to establish usage and product-related targets; assesses performance against these targets.
* Understands the long-term strategy of how the products fit into the overall digital ecosystem and end user process (e.g., assists with process-related deliverables, such as process mapping and business requirements).
* Partners with practice leaders and SMEs to understand, analyze, and prioritize business needs for providing requirements to BAs and product teams for custom developed solutions or for enhancement requests to vendors.
* Responsible for end-user product documentation/content including user guides, knowledge docs, and training materials.
* Leads efforts to improve internal processes, controls, and procedures through documentation, validation, and testing.
* Partners with tax practice subject matter experts in the development and maintenance of tax content within and between applications.
* Designs and develops workpapers, data mappings, and other tax specific deliverables and content within applications, actively using expertise in accounting, tax, and the tax engagement lifecycle.
* Elicit, gather and define business needs and prioritize functional business requirements with BAs
* Conduct tax research on tax technical topics and determine process implications
* Maintain currency of integrations with other solutions and assists in the pertinent testing
* Coordinates with RSM product team or vendor to understand new features/functionality and works with Change Management, process leads, and business teams to socialize the timing of new capabilities and how they fit into end-to-end process.
* Assists process lead(s) and business analysts with end-to-end process development, data flows, end-user process documentation including user guides, process flows, and training materials
* Represents the "voice of the business" and balances management needs with end-users' requests.
* Acts as a key contact for internal stakeholders and clients on complex tax technology matters, resolving issues with autonomy.
* Partners with Change Management and practice leaders to help lead implementation and ongoing adoption of products.
* Serves as a Performance Advisor to Associates and Senior Associates providing coaching, feedback, and development support.

**EDUCATION / CERTIFICATION REQUIREMENTS**

* Bachelor's degree (preference given to accounting, business or technology major)
* Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Chartered Accountant (CA), Enrolled Agent (EA) or JD, or actively pursuing

**JOB REQUIREMENTS**

* Minimum of 10 years’ experience having done tax compliance and advisory for high net-worth individuals within mid to large size public account firms (required).
* Must be capable of dealing confidently and professionally at executive level and with customers (required).
* Results driven; high integrity; ability to influence, negotiate and build relationships; superior communications skills; make complex decisions and manage change (required).
* Effective communication skills for differing audiences and situations (required).
* Tax compliance or advisory experience with deep expertise in accounting or tax fundamentals (required)
* Proficient in individual and fiduciary taxation, with an understanding of complex investments (e.g., real estate, fund of funds, hedge funds, private equity) and their implications (required), such as but not limited to the following:
* Multiple activity streams with differing passive/non-passive and NII determinations
* Partnership basis and pertinent limitations
* Passive activity losses (Form 8582)
* Trader income and materially participating real estate professional rules
* Net investment income tax / Form 8960
* Section 199A / QBI deduction
* Foreign tax credit / Form 1116
* International disclosures: Forms 926, 8621, 8938, 8865
* Trust accounting / figuring distributable net income
* Proficient with multi-state taxation and familiar with foreign disclosures (required)
* Proficient in investment partnership taxation (preferred)
* Proficient in preparing and reviewing returns with CCH Axcess Tax or Thomson Reuters GoSystem (required)
* Proficient in using SurePrep to prepare and review returns (preferred)
* Proficient in conducting tax research and effectively consulting and using various resources (e.g., government authority form instructions, statutes, regulations, and secondary resources and research products) (required)
* Must effectively operate with limited supervision (required)

**SUCCESSFUL CHARACTERISTICS / SKILLS**

* Strategic, out-of-the-box thinker and problem-solving experience to assess, analyze, troubleshoot, and resolve issues and think through and identify the implications of issues or proposed actions or designs.
* Excellent analytical skills, extraordinary attention to detail, and ability to present recommendations.
* Strong leadership capabilities, experience and passion for talent development, and proven experience leading teams through change and digital transformation.
* Passion for technology and providing exceptional experiences both internally for our employees and externally for clients and prospects.
* Strong ownership, bias to action, and know-how to succeed in ambiguity.

Coach - Define team objectives and outcomes. Enable success across boundaries. Help the team adapt and learn.
  
  
Care - Attract and retain great people. Know each individual’s capabilities and aspirations. Invest in the growth of others.
  
  
Understanding Customer/Partner Technical Environment

Leads team in collaborating to understand the business solution/problem. Identifies widespread patterns in blockers across business areas or territories. Develops strategies to prevent blockers and issues in the future. When necessary, attends steering committee meetings with strategic customers to remove blockers and ensure delivery success.
  
  
Works in close collaboration with the Project Manager and Account Team to anticipate, identify, categorize, and communicate business and technical risks. Outlines methodology and governance principles and practices for the broader organization that allows others to minimize risks.
